local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")
local CombatFeedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Enemies = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies") or Instance.new("Folder")
Enemies.Name = "PetEnemies"
Enemies.Parent = Workspace
local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER = 6

local DEFAULTS = {
	EnemySpawnEnabled = true,
	EnemySpawnInterval = 6,
	EnemySpawnChance = 1,
	EnemyMaxCount = MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER,
	EnemySpawnMinDistance = 24,
	EnemySpawnMaxDistance = 34,
	EnemyHealth = 35,
	EnemyGoldMin = 10,
	EnemyGoldMax = 30,
}

local AREA_CONFIG = {
	Spawn = {Health = 35, Damage = 5, Speed = 4.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 92, 92)},
	Candy = {Health = 55, Damage = 7, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 190)},
	Tech = {Health = 80, Damage = 10, Speed = 6.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 255)},
	Desert = {Health = 100, Damage = 12, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 175, 75)},
	Ocean = {Health = 120, Damage = 14, Speed = 7, Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 170, 255)},
	Volcano = {Health = 160, Damage = 18, Speed = 6, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 35)},
	Winter = {Health = 140, Damage = 16, Speed = 5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)},
}

local cooldowns = {}
local scavenged = {}
local playerEnemies = {}
local lastSpawn = {}
local enemyAttackCooldowns = {}
local comboState = {}
local enemyMotion = {}
local enemyTemplateNames
local MOVEMENT_TICK = 1 / 60
local STEERING_RESPONSE = 12
local ROTATION_RESPONSE = 14
local ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 0.45
local ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION = 0.72

local function moveSmoothly(enemy, targetPosition, targetLookPosition, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
	local current = enemy:GetPivot()
	local currentPosition = current.Position
	local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPosition.X, currentPosition.Y, targetPosition.Z)
	local offset = flatTarget - currentPosition
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	local maxStep = speed * deltaTime
	local alpha = math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	local desiredVelocity = distance > 0.05 and offset.Unit * math.min(speed, distance / math.max(deltaTime, 0.001)) or Vector3.zero
	local currentVelocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	local velocity = typeof(currentVelocity) == "Vector3" and currentVelocity:Lerp(desiredVelocity, alpha) or desiredVelocity
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", velocity)
	local displacement = velocity * deltaTime
	if displacement.Magnitude > maxStep then displacement = displacement.Unit * maxStep end
	local nextPosition = currentPosition + displacement
	local groundY = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GroundY"))
	if groundY then nextPosition = Vector3.new(nextPosition.X, groundY, nextPosition.Z) end
	local jumpOffset = jumping and math.sin(math.clamp((os.clock() - (enemyMotion[enemy].jumpStart or os.clock())) / 0.55, 0, 1) * math.pi) * 1.4 or 0
	nextPosition += Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
	local lookPosition = Vector3.new(targetLookPosition.X, nextPosition.Y, targetLookPosition.Z)
	local lookDirection = lookPosition - nextPosition
	local targetCFrame = lookDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, lookPosition) or CFrame.new(nextPosition)
	local rotationAlpha = math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	enemy:PivotTo(current:Lerp(targetCFrame, rotationAlpha))
	return distance
end

local function stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
	local velocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	if typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local nextVelocity = velocity:Lerp(Vector3.zero, math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", nextVelocity)
end

local enemyTemplateNames = {"Mouse", "Bee", "Lizard", "Desert Mouse", "Ocean Dog", "Volcano Bunny", "Frozen Dog"}

local function tell(player, action, message, pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Mood") or nil,
		hunger = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Hunger") or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function combat(player, kind, data)
	data = data or {}
	data.kind = kind
	CombatFeedback:FireClient(player, data)
end

local function burst(position, color, count, scale)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = Workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.9
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(7, 16)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 20)
	Debris:AddItem(part, scale or 1)
end

local function ownerPet(player, petId)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= player.UserId then return end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not root or not main or (root.Position - main.Position).Magnitude > 22 then return end
	return pet
end

local function giveGold(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not currency then return false end
	currency.Value += amount
	return true
end

local function getEnemyNear(position, radius)
	local best, distance
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health"))
		if main and health and health > 0 then
			local current = (main.Position - position).Magnitude
			if current <= radius and (not distance or current < distance) then
				best, distance = enemy, current
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getActivePet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local best
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") ~= "Stop" and (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) > 0 then
				best = pet
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getPetMain(pet)
	local main = pet and (pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
	return main and main:IsA("BasePart") and main or nil
end

local function hitboxParts(cframe, size, excluded)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, params)
end

local function attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then return end
	if enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] and now - enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] < 1.65 then return end
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	if not enemyMain or not petMain then return end
	local distance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5.5) + 1 then return end
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(enemyMain.Position, petMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.3), Vector3.new(6, 5, 6), {enemy})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(pet) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then return end
	enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = now
	motion.attackLockUntil = now + ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", pet.Name)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", now)
	local damage = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackDamage")) or 5)
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) - damage)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", health)
	pet:SetAttribute("LastEnemyAttack", now)
	combat(player, "EnemyHit", {position = petMain.Position, damage = damage, enemy = enemy.Name})
	tell(player, "EnemyAttack", "An enemy pet attacked " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. " for " .. math.floor(damage) .. ".", pet)
	burst(petMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(235, 75, 75), 18, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Stop")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		combat(player, "PetKnockedOut", {position = petMain.Position, text = "KNOCKED OUT!"})
		tell(player, "PetDefeated", "Your pet was knocked out and needs a moment to recover.", pet)
		task.delay(6, function()
			if pet.Parent then
				pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
				pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")
				pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", true)
				combat(player, "PetRecovered", {position = getPetMain(pet) and getPetMain(pet).Position})
			end
		end)
	end
end

local boundsForZone

local function setMotion(enemy, moving, jumping)
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") ~= moving then enemy:SetAttribute("Moving", moving) end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Jumping") ~= jumping then enemy:SetAttribute("Jumping", jumping) end
end

local function updateEnemy(enemy, deltaTime)
	local targetUserId = enemy:GetAttribute("OwnerTarget")
	if typeof(targetUserId) ~= "number" then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetUserId)
	local pet = player and getActivePet(player)
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not enemyMain or not playerRoot then return end
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {nextRoam = 0, roamTarget = nil, nextJump = os.clock() + math.random(2, 5), jumpUntil = 0, attackLockUntil = 0}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	local now = os.clock()
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then
		local look = Vector3.new(playerRoot.Position.X, enemyMain.Position.Y, playerRoot.Position.Z)
		if (look - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot():Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(enemy:GetPivot().Position, look), math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))) end
		stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
		setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		return
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
	end
	local targetDistance = (enemyMain.Position - playerRoot.Position).Magnitude
	local stopDistance = 7
	if petMain then
		local petDistance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
		local attackRange = math.max(4, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5)
		if petDistance <= attackRange then
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
			enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
			attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
			return
		end
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing") end
	if targetDistance < 26 then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
		local speed = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, playerRoot.Position, playerRoot.Position, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		setMotion(enemy, distance > stopDistance + 0.15, jumping)
	else
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Roaming")
		if now >= motion.nextRoam or not motion.roamTarget then
			local zoneCenter = enemyMain.Position
			local zone = Workspace.Map and Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild(tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")))
			local low, high = zone and boundsForZone(zone)
			if low and high then
				zoneCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(math.floor(low.X), math.floor(high.X)), enemyMain.Position.Y, math.random(math.floor(low.Z), math.floor(high.Z)))
			else
				zoneCenter += Vector3.new(math.random(-14, 14), 0, math.random(-14, 14))
			end
			motion.roamTarget = zoneCenter
			motion.nextRoam = now + math.random(3, 7)
		end
		local speed = (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5) * ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, motion.roamTarget, motion.roamTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		if distance > 2 then
			setMotion(enemy, true, jumping)
		else
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		end
	end
	if now >= motion.nextJump and (enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") == true or petMain ~= nil) then
		motion.jumpStart = now
		motion.jumpUntil = now + 0.55
		motion.nextJump = now + math.random(3, 6)
		setMotion(enemy, true, true)
		combat(player, "EnemyJump", {position = enemyMain.Position, enemy = enemy.Name})
	end
end

local function attack(player, pet)
	local main = getPetMain(pet)
	if not main then return end
	local enemy = getEnemyNear(main.Position, 32)
	if not enemy then tell(player, "Attack", "No enemy pet is close enough.", pet) return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local key = player.UserId
	if cooldowns[key] and now - cooldowns[key] < 0.48 then return end
	cooldowns[key] = now
	local state = comboState[key] or {count = 0, last = 0}
	state.count = now - state.last <= 1.4 and (state.count % 4) + 1 or 1
	state.last = now
	comboState[key] = state
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(main.Position, enemyMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.1), Vector3.new(7, 6, 8), {pet, player.Character})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(enemy) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then
		combat(player, "Whiff", {position = main.Position, combo = state.count})
		return
	end
	local baseDamage = 10 * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1)
	local damage = math.floor(baseDamage * (1 + state.count * 0.18))
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) - damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("LastHitBy", player.UserId)
	combat(player, "PetHit", {position = enemyMain.Position, damage = damage, combo = state.count, enemy = enemy.Name})
	burst(enemyMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 70), 24, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		local reward = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GoldReward")) or 10
		giveGold(player, reward)
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "DefeatEnemies")
		combat(player, "EnemyDefeated", {position = enemyMain.Position, reward = reward, combo = state.count, text = "DEFEATED!"})
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet defeated an enemy and found " .. reward .. " gold.", pet)
		enemy:Destroy()
	else
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet attacked for " .. math.floor(damage) .. " damage.", pet)
	end
end

local function scavenge(player, pet)
	local key = pet:GetDebugId()
	if scavenged[key] and os.clock() - scavenged[key] < 20 then
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "This pet needs a little time before scavenging again.", pet)
		return
	end
	scavenged[key] = os.clock()
	local amount = math.floor(math.random(5, 25) * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1))
	if giveGold(player, amount) then
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "Scavenge")
		local main = getPetMain(pet)
		if main then burst(main.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 70), 16, 1) end
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "Your pet scavenged " .. amount .. " gold.", pet)
	end
end

local function chooseTemplate(zone)
	local petFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not petFolder then return nil end
	local configured = zone and zone:GetAttribute("EnemyTemplate")
	if type(configured) == "string" then
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(configured)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then return template end
	end
	local available = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(enemyTemplateNames) do
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then table.insert(available, template) end
	end
	return #available > 0 and available[math.random(1, #available)] or nil
end

boundsForZone = function(zone)
	local minVector, maxVector
	for _, item in zone:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			local half = item.Size * 0.5
			local low = item.Position - half
			local high = item.Position + half
			minVector = minVector and Vector3.new(math.min(minVector.X, low.X), math.min(minVector.Y, low.Y), math.min(minVector.Z, low.Z)) or low
			maxVector = maxVector and Vector3.new(math.max(maxVector.X, high.X), math.max(maxVector.Y, high.Y), math.max(maxVector.Z, high.Z)) or high
		end
	end
	return minVector, maxVector
end

local function zoneAt(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if not map then return nil end
	for _, zone in map:GetChildren() do
		if zone:IsA("Folder") or zone:IsA("Model") then
			local minVector, maxVector = boundsForZone(zone)
			if minVector and position.X >= minVector.X and position.X <= maxVector.X and position.Z >= minVector.Z and position.Z <= maxVector.Z then return zone end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function eventValue(name, default)
	local value = WorldEvents:GetAttribute(name)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value or default
end

local function readSetting(player, zone, name)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil and zone then value = zone:GetAttribute(name) end
	if value == nil then value = DEFAULTS[name] end
	return value
end

local function configureSettings(player)
	for name, value in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
		if player:GetAttribute(name) == nil then player:SetAttribute(name, value) end
	end
end

local function configureEnemy(enemy, ownerTarget, zone)
	local main = enemy:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not main then enemy:Destroy() return nil end
	local area = AREA_CONFIG[zone and zone.Name] or AREA_CONFIG.Spawn
	local health = math.max(1, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyHealth")) or area.Health) * eventValue("HealthMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMin = math.max(0, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMin")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMin) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMax = math.max(goldMin, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMax")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMax) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	enemy.PrimaryPart = main
	enemy:SetAttribute("IsPetEnemy", true)
	enemy:SetAttribute("OwnerTarget", ownerTarget.UserId)
	enemy:SetAttribute("ZoneName", zone and zone.Name or "Unzoned")
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("GoldReward", math.random(goldMin, goldMax))
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackDamage", area.Damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackRange", 5.5)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MoveSpeed", area.Speed)
	enemy:SetAttribute("CombatColor", area.Color)
	for _, descendant in enemy:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", Vector3.zero)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Spawning")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", "")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", 0)
	return enemy
end

local function getCollectAreaPosition(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return position end
	local closestPoint, closestDistance
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			local localPosition = areaPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
			local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
			local clamped = Vector3.new(
				math.clamp(localPosition.X, -halfSize.X + 3, halfSize.X - 3),
				0,
				math.clamp(localPosition.Z, -halfSize.Z + 3, halfSize.Z - 3)
			)
			local candidate = areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(clamped)
			local distance = (candidate - position).Magnitude
			if not closestDistance or distance < closestDistance then
				closestPoint, closestDistance = candidate, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPoint or position
end

local function getAnyCollectAreaPosition(referencePosition)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return nil end
	local candidates = {}
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") and areaPart.Size.X > 8 and areaPart.Size.Z > 8 then
			table.insert(candidates, areaPart)
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then return nil end
	local areaPart = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
	local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
	local localPosition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.X + 4), math.floor(halfSize.X - 4)),
		0,
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.Z + 4), math.floor(halfSize.Z - 4))
	)
	return areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)
end

local function placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, horizontalPosition, referenceY, character)
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, enemy, Enemies}
	rayParams.IgnoreWater = false
	local origin = Vector3.new(horizontalPosition.X, math.max(referenceY + 80, horizontalPosition.Y + 80), horizontalPosition.Z)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -240, 0), rayParams)
	if not result then return false end
	local pivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(horizontalPosition.X, result.Position.Y + 0.1, horizontalPosition.Z) * pivot.Rotation)
	local boxCFrame, boxSize = enemy:GetBoundingBox()
	local bottomOffset = boxCFrame.Position.Y - boxSize.Y * 0.5 - enemy:GetPivot().Position.Y
	enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 - bottomOffset, 0))
	local groundedPivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:SetAttribute("GroundY", groundedPivot.Position.Y)
	return true
end

local function spawnNearPlayer(player)
	local enemies = playerEnemies[player] or {}
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
	local spawnMultiplier = eventValue("SpawnMultiplier", 1)
	local configuredMax = tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemyMaxCount")) or MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER
	local maxCount = math.clamp(math.floor(configuredMax * spawnMultiplier), 0, MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER)
	if readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnEnabled") ~= true or #enemies >= maxCount then return end
	if math.random() > math.clamp((tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnChance")) or 1) * math.min(spawnMultiplier, 2), 0, 1) then return end
	local template = chooseTemplate(zone)
	if not template then return end
	local enemy = configureEnemy(template:Clone(), player, zone)
	if not enemy then return end
	enemy.Name = "PetEnemy_Player_" .. player.UserId .. "_" .. math.random(1000, 9999)
	local minDistance = math.max(8, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMinDistance")) or 24)
	local maxDistance = math.max(minDistance, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMaxDistance")) or 34)
	local frontDirection = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if frontDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then frontDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else frontDirection = frontDirection.Unit end
	local rightDirection = Vector3.new(-frontDirection.Z, 0, frontDirection.X)
	local distance = math.random(math.floor(minDistance), math.floor(maxDistance))
	local sideOffset = math.random(-8, 8)
	local spawnPosition = root.Position + frontDirection * distance + rightDirection * sideOffset
	spawnPosition = getCollectAreaPosition(spawnPosition)
	if not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, spawnPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
		local fallbackPosition = getAnyCollectAreaPosition(root.Position)
		if not fallbackPosition or not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, fallbackPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
			enemy:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end
	enemy.Parent = Enemies
	table.insert(enemies, enemy)
	playerEnemies[player] = enemies
	combat(player, "EnemySpawned", {position = enemy.PrimaryPart.Position, enemy = enemy.Name, zone = enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")})
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function()
		enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = nil
		local list = playerEnemies[player]
		if list then for index, current in ipairs(list) do if current == enemy then table.remove(list, index) break end end end
	end)
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	configureSettings(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
		playerEnemies[player] = {}
		lastSpawn[player] = 0
		comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setupPlayer(player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
	playerEnemies[player] = nil
	lastSpawn[player] = nil
	cooldowns[player.UserId] = nil
	comboState[player.UserId] = nil
end)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	local pet = ownerPet(player, petId)
	if not pet then return end
	if action == "Attack" then attack(player, pet) elseif action == "Scavenge" then scavenge(player, pet) end
end)

local function autoAttackPets()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		if not folder then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
			if not pet:IsA("Model") then continue end
			local state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState")
			if state ~= "Follow" then continue end
			local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
			if not petMain then continue end
			local enemy = getEnemyNear(petMain.Position, 32)
			if enemy then
				attack(player, pet)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.5) do
		autoAttackPets()
	end
end)

local movementAccumulator = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	movementAccumulator += dt
	if movementAccumulator < MOVEMENT_TICK then return end
	local stepDelta = movementAccumulator
	movementAccumulator = 0
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy.Parent then updateEnemy(enemy, stepDelta) end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(2) do
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
				local interval = math.max(2, (tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnInterval")) or DEFAULTS.EnemySpawnInterval) * eventValue("SpawnIntervalMultiplier", 1))
				if os.clock() - (lastSpawn[player] or 0) >= interval then
					lastSpawn[player] = os.clock()
					spawnNearPlayer(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

--// Services
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local tagName = "GMHeadTag"
local glowName = "GMHeadGlow"
local tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 54)
local tagHex = "#FFDD36"

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = glowName
	glow.Adornee = head
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
	glow.Parent = character

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = tagName
	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Text = "GM"
	label.TextColor3 = tagColor
	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
	label.Parent = billboard

	local textTween = TweenService:Create(
		label,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 18
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Stop" or action == "Follow" or action == "Sit" or action == "Sleep" or action == "Jump" or action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, action)
		if action == "Sleep" then stats.mood += 5 end
		if action == "Jump" then stats.mood += 2 end
		local color = action == "Sleep" and Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
		effect(pet, color, action == "Fly" and 22 or 12)
		send(player, action, "Pet behavior set to " .. action .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)
	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1
				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Cooldowns = {}

--// Script

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false

	local PetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	PetFolder.Name = Player.Name
	PetFolder.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets

	repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	LoadEquipped(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
	workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:Destroy()
end)

-- Clicker
Remotes.Clicker.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Clicker" then return end

	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Music
Remotes.Setting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, SettingName, Toggled)
	Player.Data.PlayerData[SettingName].Value = Toggled
end)

-- Rebirth
function Rebirth(Player) -- this will run the action when you passed all requirements for rebirthing
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = 0
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += 1
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += 10 -- gems
end

Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true	
		if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1) then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		else
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1.25) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Pet
function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", Player.UserId)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetName", PetInstance.PetName.Value)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			local character = Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then NewPet:PivotTo(root.CFrame) end
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already equipped
	if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player) <= Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value then return end -- Too many pets equipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = true
	PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, Pet)
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet or not Pet:IsDescendantOf(Player.Data.Pets) then return end
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipAll(Player)
	local pets = Player:FindFirstChild("Data") and Player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not pets then return end
	for _, Pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet:IsA("Folder") or Pet:IsA("Configuration") then
			UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
		end
	end
	LoadEquipped(Player)
end

function EquipAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for equipping a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	else
		EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	end
end

function DeleteAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for deleting a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then UnequipPet(Player, Pet) end -- unequip if it's equipped
	Pet:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Pet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Action, Parameter)
	if Action == "UnequipAll" then
		UnequipAll(Player)
		return
	end
	if type(Parameter) ~= "table" then -- so if this condition is true, then Parameter should be the id of the pet
		local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[Parameter]

		if Action == "Equip" then
			EquipAction(Player, Pet)
		elseif Action == "Delete" then
			DeleteAction(Player, Pet)
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	else -- there are multiple ids
		if Action == "Equip" then -- equip all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				EquipAction(Player, Pet)
			end

		elseif Action == "Delete" then -- delete all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				DeleteAction(Player, Pet)				
			end
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	end
end)

-- Egg
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

function ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

	for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
	end

	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
		return a[2] > b[2]
	end)

	local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

	for _,v in Pets do
		local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
		TotalWeight += Chance
		v[2] = Chance
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0,TotalWeight)

	local Counter = 0
	for _,v in Pets do	
		Counter += v[2]

		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v[1]
		end
	end
end

Remotes.Egg.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Egg, Amount)
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then return end -- cooldown
	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + Amount > Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player) then return end -- max storage

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)

	if not EggInfo then print(Egg.." does not exist!") return end -- egg does not exist!
	if EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then return end -- robux egg

	if Amount == 3 and ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then
		return -- if this is true, it means the player is trying to open a triple egg while there is a gamepass which they don't own
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount
		Player.Data.PlayerData.EggsHatched.Value += Amount
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true

		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()

		local Results = {}

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for i = 1, Amount do
			local PetName = ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier) 

			if not Player.Data.AutoDelete[PetName].Value then -- auto delete
				local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
				NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
				NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
			end

			Results[i] = PetName
		end

		return Results
	end
end

--// Auto Delete
Remotes.AutoDelete.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Pet)
	Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value = not Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
	return Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
end

--// Area
Remotes.Area.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == true then return end
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end)()

	local NextArea = ReplicatedStorage.Areas:FindFirstChild(Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1)
	if not NextArea then return end


	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value < NextArea.Cost.Value then return end

	if NextArea.Cost.Value == -1 then return end -- max area

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= NextArea.Cost.Value
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = tonumber(NextArea.Name)
end)

--// Gemshop
Remotes.GemUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Upgrade)
	if not ReplicatedStorage.GemShop:FindFirstChild(Upgrade) then return end

	local GemUpg = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop[Upgrade]
	local UpgradeTier = Player.Data.PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..Upgrade]

	if UpgradeTier.Value >= GemUpg.Max.Value then return end -- max

	local Cost = GemUpg.Price
	local Price

	if Cost.Exponential.Value then
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value * Cost.IncreasePer.Value ^ UpgradeTier.Value
	else
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value + Cost.IncreasePer.Value * (UpgradeTier.Value+1)
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value >= Price then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Price
		UpgradeTier.Value += 1
	end
end)

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then

				y.Name = tostring(new)
