				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore
		local MainFrame = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame
		MainFrame.Title.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and "Top 100 Most "..RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Title
		MainFrame.Players.Amount.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Stat
		
		local Template = script.Template
		if Leaderboard:FindFirstChild("Template") then
			Template = Leaderboard.Template
		end
		
		for i = 1,100 do			
			local Clone = Template:Clone()
			Clone.LayoutOrder = i
			Clone.Name = i
			Clone.Rank.Text = ""
			Clone.PlrName.Text = ""
			Clone.Amount.Text = ""
			Clone.Parent = MainFrame.Players.Scroll
		end 
	end
end

return Main

	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = config.color
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Parent = panel
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
	corner.Parent = btn
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Name = "Stroke"
	stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.6
	stroke.Parent = btn
	
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.R * 255 * 1.2)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.G * 255 * 1.2)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.B * 255 * 1.2))
		),
		config.color
	)
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = btn
	
	local iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)

	iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	iconLabel.TextSize = 14
	iconLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	iconLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5

	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.35)

	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = config.cmd
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	nameLabel.TextSize = 10
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
	nameLabel.Parent = btn
	
	local glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	glow.Name = "Glow"
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.3, 1.3)
	glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.15, -0.15)
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glow.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"
	glow.ImageColor3 = config.color
	glow.ImageTransparency = 1
	glow.ZIndex = -1
	glow.Parent = btn
	
	btn:SetAttribute("BaseColor", config.color)
	btn:SetAttribute("HoverColor", config.hover)

			hoverTween(btn, true)
			TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.2}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 0.7}):Play()
		end
	end)
	
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if activeButton ~= btn then
			hoverTween(btn, false)
			TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.6}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end)
	
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if currentPetId then
			feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, config.cmd)
		end
	end)
	
	buttonMap[config.cmd] = btn
	return btn
end

		TweenService:Create(activeButton, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundColor3 = hover}):Play()

inventoryButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if currentPetId then feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, "Inventory") end
end)

local hideToken = 0
local visibleActions = {
	Pet = true, Inventory = true, Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true,
	Sleep = true, Jump = true, Fly = true, Feed = true, Attack = true,
	Scavenge = true,
}

local function show(data)
	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))
	stateLabel.Text = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	
	local stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 120, 80)
	local stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
	local state = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	if state == "Stop" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 60)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
	elseif state == "Follow" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 100)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
	elseif state == "Sit" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 50)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 180)
	elseif state == "Sleep" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 140)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
	elseif state == "Jump" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 160)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)
	elseif state == "Fly" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 80, 180)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
	end
	TweenService:Create(stateBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundColor3 = stateColor}):Play()
	stateLabel.TextColor3 = stateTextCol
	
	local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(data.mood) or 0, 0, 100)
	local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(data.hunger) or 0, 0, 100)
	
	TweenService:Create(moodFill, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(hungerFill, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)}):Play()
	moodValue.Text = math.floor(mood).."%"
	hungerValue.Text = math.floor(hunger).."%"
	
	local moodColor = mood >= 70 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or mood >= 35 and Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70)
	moodFill.BackgroundColor3 = moodColor
	
	setActiveButton(state)
	
	if not panel.Visible then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(10, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenScale(0.8, 0.2)
			task.wait(0.2)
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.action == "Needs" then
		if panel.Visible and data.petId and data.petId == currentPetId then
			show(data)
		end
		return
	end
	if not visibleActions[data.action] then return end
	show(data)
	if data.action == "Inventory" then
		local frames = getFrames()
		local petFrame = frames and frames:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if petFrame then
			petFrame.Visible = true
			local blocker = petFrame:FindFirstChild("SideFrameBlocker")
			if blocker then blocker.Visible = true end
		end
	end
end)

	local adornee = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not adornee then return end
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

	billboard.LightInfluence = 0
	billboard.MaxDistance = 15
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 82)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 1.8, 3), 0)
	billboard.Parent = pet
	local background = Instance.new("Frame")

	background.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

	currentState = state
	if type(state) ~= "table" or not state.Active then
		banner.Visible = false
		return
	end
	banner.Visible = true
	eventTitle.Text = state.Name or "WORLD EVENT"
	description.Text = state.Description or ""
	local progress = tonumber(state.ObjectiveProgress) or 0
	local target = math.max(1, tonumber(state.ObjectiveTarget) or 1)
	objective.Text = string.format("%s  %d / %d", state.ObjectiveText or "Shared objective", progress, target)
	participation.Text = state.ObjectiveCompleted and "Objective complete! Rewards will be granted when the event ends." or "Contribute to earn the completion reward."

	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / target, 0, 1), 1)
end

local ADMINRANK = 254 -- What rank in group for admin


--// MAIN SCRIPT
local AdminFunctions = {}

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// General
function AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, AdminList) -- checks if user is allowed to use commands
	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK
	else
		return CreatorId == Player.UserId
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == PlayerName then
			return Player
		end
	end
end

--// Stats
function AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(Player, StatName)
	for _, Stat in Player.Data:GetDescendants() do
		if string.lower(Stat.Name) == StatName then
			return Stat
		end
	end
end

--// Pets
function AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(Player, PetName)
	for _, Pet in ReplicatedStorage.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if string.lower(Pet.Name) == PetName then
			return Pet
		end
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

return AdminFunctions

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 18
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Stop" or action == "Follow" or action == "Sit" or action == "Sleep" or action == "Jump" or action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, action)
		if action == "Sleep" then stats.mood += 5 end
		if action == "Jump" then stats.mood += 2 end
		local color = action == "Sleep" and Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
		effect(pet, color, action == "Fly" and 22 or 12)
		send(player, action, "Pet behavior set to " .. action .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)
	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1
				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local systemFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DayNightSystem")
local toggleCycle = systemFolder:WaitForChild("ToggleCycle") :: RemoteEvent

local DAY_LENGTH_MINUTES = 12
local START_TIME = 8
local cycleEnabled = true
local currentClockTime = START_TIME

systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime

local function setCycleEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	cycleEnabled = enabled
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

toggleCycle.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, requestedState: boolean?)
	if typeof(requestedState) == "boolean" then
		setCycleEnabled(requestedState)
	else
		setCycleEnabled(not cycleEnabled)
	end
	print(string.format("[DayNightSystem] %s set cycle %s", player.Name, cycleEnabled and "On" or "Off"))
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
	if not cycleEnabled then
		return
	end

	currentClockTime = (currentClockTime + (24 / (DAY_LENGTH_MINUTES * 60)) * deltaTime) % 24
	Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
end)

print("[DayNightSystem] Dynamic day/night cycle started")

statusLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.RED
statusLabel.TextSize = 13
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- BOTTOM CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------

local bottom = Instance.new("Frame")
bottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
bottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -40)
bottom.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bottom.Parent = content

local logsButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
logsButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30)
logsButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 5)
logsButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.BUTTON
logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
logsButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
logsButton.TextSize = 12
logsButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
logsButton.Parent = bottom

local logsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
logsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
logsCorner.Parent = logsButton

--------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------

local function log(...)
	if not logsEnabled then
		return
	end

	print("[Lemonade WebSync]", ...)
end

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN,
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		connectButton.Text = "Connect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.RED

		setStatus(
			"Offline",
			COLORS.RED,
			COLORS.RED
		)
	end
end

local function updateLastSync()
	lastSyncText = os.date("%X")

	syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: " .. lastSyncText
end

local function getProjectName(): string
	local gameName = game:GetAttribute("GameName")

	if typeof(gameName) == "string" and gameName ~= "" then
		return gameName
	end

	return game.Name
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP HELPER
--------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	method: string,
	path: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)

	local url = CONFIG.BACKEND_URL .. path

	local requestData = {
		Url = url,
		Method = method,
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		},
	}

	if sessionToken then
		requestData.Headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. sessionToken
	end

	if body ~= nil then
		requestData.Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
	end

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync(requestData)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP error:", response)
		return false, nil
	end

	if not response.Success then
		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP status:",
			response.StatusCode,
			response.StatusMessage
		)

		return false, response
	end

	local decoded = nil

	if response.Body and response.Body ~= "" then
		local decodeSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
		end)

		if decodeSuccess then
			decoded = result
		end
	end

	return true, decoded
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function connectToBackend()

	if connecting then
		return
	end

	if connected then
		return
	end

	connecting = true

	connectButton.Text = "Connecting..."
	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW,
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	log("Connecting to backend...")

	local success, response = request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectName = getProjectName(),
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "2.3",
			studioName = "Roblox Studio",
		}
	)

	if success and response then

		sessionToken = response.token
		projectId = response.projectId

		if typeof(response.prompts) == "number" then
			promptCount = response.prompts
			promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: " .. tostring(promptCount)
		end

		setConnectedState(true)
		updateLastSync()

		projectLabel.Text =
			"Project: " ..
			(response.projectName or "ok")

		log("Connected successfully.")
	else

		setConnectedState(false)

		connectButton.Text = "Connect"

		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] Failed to connect."
		)
	end

	connecting = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DISCONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function disconnectFromBackend()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	log("Disconnecting...")

	request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectId = projectId,
		}
	)

	sessionToken = nil
	projectId = nil

	setConnectedState(false)

	log("Disconnected.")
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while true do

		task.wait(CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)

		if connected and sessionToken then

			local success = request(
				"POST",
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					projectId = projectId,
					projectName = getProjectName(),
					placeId = game.PlaceId,
				}
			)

			if success then
				updateLastSync()
			else
				warn(
					"[Lemonade WebSync] Heartbeat failed."
				)
			end
		end
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PLUGIN BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()

	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled

	if widget.Enabled then
		log("Widget opened.")
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLOSE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

connectButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if connected then
		disconnectFromBackend()
	else
		connectToBackend()
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOG TOGGLE
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	logsEnabled = not logsEnabled

	if logsEnabled then
		logsButton.Text = "Logs On"
	else
		logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL UI
--------------------------------------------------

projectLabel.Text = "Project: " .. getProjectName()
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"

setConnectedState(false)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SELECTION DEBUG
--------------------------------------------------

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	local selected = Selection:Get()

	log(
		"Selection changed:",
		#selected
	)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
--------------------------------------------------

print("========================================")
print("[Lemonade WebSync] Plugin Loaded")
print("Project:", getProjectName())
print("PlaceId:", game.PlaceId)
print("========================================")

function CreatePopup(Type)
	if Player.Data.Settings.Popups.Value then
		local NewPopup = RS.Assets.Templates[Type]:Clone()
		NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.1,0)
		NewPopup.Visible = true
		NewPopup.Parent = Player.PlayerGui.Interface.HUD.Popups
		return NewPopup
	end
	
	return
end

function PlayAnimation(Popup, Time)
	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

function Module.CreateBottomStatPopup(Amount, Stat, Colors, Time)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

--// Function for handling buttons

local ButtonHandler = {}

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local function BlurAnimation(Transparency)
	Tween.Tween(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameUI.Blur, {Speed = 0.25}, {BackgroundTransparency=Transparency})
end

ButtonHandler.OnClick = function(Frame,Size)	
	if not Frame.Visible then
		--// Close other frames
		for _,OtherFrame in Frame.Parent:GetChildren() do
			if OtherFrame:IsA("Frame") and OtherFrame.Visible then
				OtherFrame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.1, true)
				task.wait(0.04)
				OtherFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end

		--// Open frame

		Frame.Size = Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.1)
		Frame.Visible = true
		Frame:TweenSize(Size, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)

	else
		--// Close the frame

		BlurAnimation(1)
		Frame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		Frame.Visible = false
	end

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)
	local Setting = GameSettings:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Setting then return false, "Unknown setting" end
	if Setting:IsA("IntValue") or Setting:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Setting.Value = Num
	elseif Setting:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Setting.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	elseif Setting:IsA("StringValue") then
		Setting.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Setting.Value)
end

function SettingsHandler.AllAreas()
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Area in Areas:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Area:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		Result[#Result + 1] = { name = Area.Name, cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0 }
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return tonumber(A.name) < tonumber(B.name) end)
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetAreaCost(AreaName, NewValue)
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return false, "No areas" end
	local Area = Areas:FindFirstChild(tostring(AreaName))
	if not Area or not Area:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Area not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Area.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set area " .. AreaName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function SettingsHandler.AllGemShop()
	local GemShop = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if not GemShop then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Upgrade in GemShop:GetChildren() do
		local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
		local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
		local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
		local UpgName = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or Upgrade.Name
		local DefaultReward = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("DefaultReward") and Reward.DefaultReward.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Reward.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Reward.Exponential.Value or false
		local DefaultPrice = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("DefaultPrice") and Price.DefaultPrice.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Price.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Price.Exponential.Value or false
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = Upgrade.Name,
			name = UpgName,
			max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			reward = { default = DefaultReward, increasePer = IncreasePerR, exponential = ExpR },
			price = { default = DefaultPrice, increasePer = IncreasePerP, exponential = ExpP },
		}
	end
	return Result
end

return SettingsHandler

local tagHex = "#FFDD36"

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")

	glow.Adornee = head
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
	glow.Parent = character

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = tagName
	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Text = "GM"
	label.TextColor3 = tagColor
	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
	label.Parent = billboard

	local textTween = TweenService:Create(
		label,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 150), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55}
	)
	textTween:Play()
end

local function refresh()
	if player.Character then addTag(player.Character) end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsGM"):Connect(refresh)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	addTag(character)
end)

	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138903578"
	killSound.Volume = 0.6
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	killSound:Play()
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
	elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(data.reward or 0) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		playKillSound(data.position)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			humanoid.Jump = false
		end
		local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
		if controller then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
			if ok and module and module.Play then module.Play("Double Jump Backflip Animation") end
		end
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end
	
	Save["Accessories"] = {}
	local accessories = Folder:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if accessories then
		for _, accessory in accessories:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("BoolValue") and accessory.Value then Save["Accessories"][accessory.Name] = true end
		end
	end

	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

return SavingFunctions

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

local accessoryData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
local data = player:WaitForChild("Data")
local pets = data:WaitForChild("Pets")

local function corner(parent, radius)

end

local function text(parent, value, size, color, font)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = value
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 250)
	label.Font = font or Enum.Font.SourceSans
	label.TextSize = size or 16
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

local banner = Instance.new("Frame")

corner(banner, 12)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

local bannerClose = Instance.new("TextButton")

bannerClose.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)

bannerClose.TextSize = 16

local eventTitle = text(banner, "WORLD EVENT", 17, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)

local countdown = text(banner, "00:00", 15, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)

local description = text(banner, "", 13, Color3.fromRGB(210, 220, 235))

description.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
description.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
local objective = text(banner, "", 13, Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
objective.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 53)
objective.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
objective.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
local participation = text(banner, "Join the objective to earn the completion reward.", 12, Color3.fromRGB(160, 230, 190), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
participation.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 92)
participation.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18)
participation.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
local track = Instance.new("Frame")

local accessoryPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
