corner(accessoryPanel, 12)
local panelTitle = text(accessoryPanel, "PET ACCESSORIES", 18, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
panelTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10)
panelTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26)
panelTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
local selectedText = text(accessoryPanel, "Select a pet in your inventory", 13, Color3.fromRGB(185, 200, 220))
selectedText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 38)
selectedText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 34)
selectedText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
list.Name = "Collection"
list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 78)
list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -88)
list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
list.BorderSizePixel = 0
list.ScrollBarThickness = 5
list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
list.Parent = accessoryPanel

layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.Parent = list

local selectedPetId
local function owned(name)
	local folder = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function redrawAccessories()
	for _, child in list:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	for name, info in pairs(accessoryData) do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 54)
		button.AutoButtonColor = true
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.BackgroundColor3 = owned(name) and Color3.fromRGB(48, 95, 78) or Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 70)
		button.Text = (owned(name) and "EQUIP  " or "LOCKED  ") .. info.DisplayName .. "\n" .. info.Rarity .. " • " .. info.Source
		button.TextColor3 = owned(name) and Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(165, 175, 190)
		button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		button.TextSize = 14
		button.TextWrapped = true
		button.Parent = list
		corner(button, 8)
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if owned(name) and selectedPetId then
				accessoryAction:FireServer("Equip", {PetId = selectedPetId, Accessory = name})
				selectedText.Text = "Equipped " .. info.DisplayName .. " on pet " .. selectedPetId
			end
		end)
	end
	task.defer(function() list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y) end)
end

local function refreshSelectedPet()
	local newest
	for _, pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Folder") then newest = pet end
	end
	if newest then
		selectedPetId = newest.Name
		selectedText.Text = "Selected pet: " .. tostring(newest.PetName.Value)
		accessoryPanel.Visible = true
	end
end

local currentState
local function updateEvent(state)
	currentState = state
	if type(state) ~= "table" or not state.Active then
		banner.Visible = false
		return
	end
	banner.Visible = true
	eventTitle.Text = state.Name or "WORLD EVENT"
	description.Text = state.Description or ""
	local progress = tonumber(state.ObjectiveProgress) or 0
	local target = math.max(1, tonumber(state.ObjectiveTarget) or 1)
	objective.Text = string.format("%s  %d / %d", state.ObjectiveText or "Shared objective", progress, target)
	participation.Text = state.ObjectiveCompleted and "Objective complete! Rewards will be granted when the event ends." or "Contribute to earn the completion reward."
	participation.TextColor3 = state.ObjectiveCompleted and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 220, 175)
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / target, 0, 1), 1)
end

stateChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(updateEvent)
for _, name in {"Active", "Description", "EndsAt", "ObjectiveText", "ObjectiveProgress", "ObjectiveTarget", "ObjectiveCompleted"} do
	worldEvents:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
		local state = currentState or {}
		state.Active = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Active")
		state.Name = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Name")
		state.Description = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Description")
		state.EndsAt = worldEvents:GetAttribute("EndsAt")
		state.ObjectiveText = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveText")
		state.ObjectiveProgress = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveProgress")
		state.ObjectiveTarget = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveTarget")
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveCompleted") == true
		updateEvent(state)
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		if currentState and currentState.Active then
			local remaining = math.max(0, (tonumber(currentState.EndsAt) or 0) - os.time())
			countdown.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(remaining / 60), remaining % 60)
			if remaining <= 0 then banner.Visible = false end
		end
	end
end)

pets.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshSelectedPet)
data.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child.Name == "Accessories" then
		for _, value in child:GetChildren() do value.Changed:Connect(redrawAccessories) end
		redrawAccessories()
	end
end)
local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
if accessories then
	for _, value in accessories:GetChildren() do value.Changed:Connect(redrawAccessories) end
end
refreshSelectedPet()
redrawAccessories()

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

--[[
	This script handles the client. 
	
	Contents:
	- ClickButton
	- Overlay (Currency counter)
	- Popups
	- Close Buttons of Frames
	- Buttons on the side
	- Settings
	- Rebirth
	- Shop
	- Pet Inventory
	- Egg Preview (Frame that shows the price etc)
	- Egg Hatching
	- Pet Follow
	- Areas
	- Trading
	- Gem Shop
	- Codes
	- Stats
	- Functions
	
	Only edit if you know what you're doing!
]]

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Loading
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil

if Player.Parent == nil then return end

--// Variables
local Data = Player.Data
local PlayerData = Data.PlayerData

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local Utilities = require(Modules.Utilities)

local UI = Player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("GameUI")
local Frames = UI.Frames

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

--// Clicker
if GameSettings.GameType.Value == "Clicker" then
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(UI.Clicker)

	UI.Clicker.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)

	if GameSettings.ClickingAnywhere.Value then
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
			if Processed then return end
			if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end -- not a left mouse click
			Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Overlay
local CurrencySide = UI[GameSettings.CurrencySide.Value]
CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
end)

CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
PlayerData.Currency2.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
end)


--// Popups
local CurrencyOld = PlayerData.Currency.Value
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function(NewValue)
	task.spawn(function()
		if NewValue > CurrencyOld then
			local NewPopup = script.Popup:Clone()
			NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
			NewPopup.Currency.Image = CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Currency.Image
			NewPopup.Amount.Text = "+"..Utilities.Short.en(NewValue - CurrencyOld)
			NewPopup.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0, math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0) -- sets it in a random position in the middle square
			NewPopup.Parent = UI.Popups
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.176,0,0.105,0), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5)
			task.wait(1)
			NewPopup:TweenPosition(CurrencySide.Position, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.05,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			task.wait(1.4)
			NewPopup:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	CurrencyOld = NewValue
end)

--// Frames
local BaseSize = {}
for _,Frame in Frames:GetChildren() do
	if not Frame:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Frame:GetAttribute("Keep") then continue end

	BaseSize[Frame.Name] = Frame.Size

	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Close") then
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Frame.Close)
		Frame.Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(Frame, UDim2.new(0,0,0,0))
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Buttons
local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
for _,Button in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if not Button:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Button:GetAttribute("AuctionButton") then continue end

	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Button)
	Button.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(UI.Frames[Button.Name], BaseSize[Button.Name])
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)
end

--// Settings
local SettingsScroll = Frames.Settings.ObjectHolder

-- Music Setting
local MusicSetting = SettingsScroll.Music
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.Off)

MusicSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

MusicSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
PlayerData.Music.Changed:Connect(function()
	SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
end)

-- ShowOtherPets
local ShowOtherPetsSetting = SettingsScroll.ShowOtherPets
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

--// Rebirth
local RebirthPrice, RebirthMulti = GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value, GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value

function UpdateRebirthInfo()
	Frames.Rebirth.Counter.Text = "You have "..Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Rebirth.Value).." Rebirths"
	if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
		Frames.Rebirth.Description.Text = "Buying a Rebirth will increase your "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value.." Multiplier with x"..RebirthMulti
		Frames.Rebirth.Cost.Text = "You need atleast "..Utilities.Short.en(RebirthPrice * (PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1)).." "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value
	elseif GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Exponential" then
		Frames.Rebirth.Description.Text = "Buying a Rebirth will increase your "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value.." Multiplier with ^"..(RebirthMulti+0.5)
		Frames.Rebirth.Cost.Text = "You need atleast "..Utilities.Short.en(RebirthPrice * ((RebirthMulti+1.25) ^ PlayerData.Rebirth.Value)).." "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value
	end
end

UpdateRebirthInfo()

PlayerData.Rebirth.Changed:Connect(function()
	UpdateRebirthInfo()
end)

Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Frames.Rebirth.Buy)

Frames.Rebirth.Buy.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Remotes.Rebirth:FireServer()
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

--// Shop
for _,Gamepass in ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
	local NewGamepass = script.GamepassTemplate:Clone()

	local GamepassInfo

	local Succes, Error = pcall(function()
		GamepassInfo = MarketPlaceService:GetProductInfo(Gamepass.Value, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
	end)

	if Error then 
		warn("An error as occured while gathering gamepass data: "..Error) 
		NewGamepass:Destroy() continue 
	else
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.ImageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://"..(GamepassInfo.IconImageAssetId or 666669321)
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.Description.Text = GamepassInfo.Description 
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.GPName.Text = GamepassInfo.Name
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.Price.Text = Data.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value and "Owned ✅" or "\u{E002}"..(GamepassInfo.PriceInRobux or 10000)

		Data.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Changed:Connect(function()
			NewGamepass.InnerPart.Price.Text = Data.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value and "Owned ✅" or "\u{E002}"..GamepassInfo.PriceInRobux
		end)

		NewGamepass.InnerPart.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, Gamepass.Value)
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)

		NewGamepass.Parent = Frames.Shop.Gamepasses
	end
end

--// Pet Inventory
local PetInventory = {} -- all pets will be added in this table

local PetFrame = Frames.Pets
local SideFrame = PetFrame.SideFrame
PetFrame.SideFrameBlocker.Visible = true

local IsMultiDeleting = false
local SelectedForDelete = {}

function SortInventory(SortTable, ObjectHolder)
	local TableToSort = SortTable ~= nil and SortTable or PetInventory -- so it can differentiate between trade and normal inventories

	table.sort(TableToSort, function(a,b)
		if not a or not b then return end

		if a.Multiplier ~= b.Multiplier then
			return a.Multiplier > b.Multiplier
		else
			return a.ID > b.ID
		end
	end)

	for Order,PetInfo in TableToSort do
		if not Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetInfo.ID) then
			table.remove(TableToSort, Order)
			continue
		end

		if not ObjectHolder then
			PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		else
			ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		end
	end
end

local CurrentlySelected = 0

function AddPet(PetInstance, SortTable, Parent) -- Creates a pet slot
	task.wait(0.1)
	local NewPet = script.PetTemplate:Clone()

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Parent = NewPet.Display

	local MainPart = PetModel:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	local Pos

	if not MainPart then
		warn(PetModel.Name.." does not have a MainPart, please add one by calling one of the parts 'MainPart'")

		for _,v in PetModel:GetChildren() do -- this here chooses a random part of the pet instead of the mainpart.
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				Pos = v.Position
				break
			end
		end
	else
		Pos = MainPart.Position
	end

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	NewPet.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))

--// Egg Preview
local PreviewFrame = UI.PreviewFrame
local DefaultSize = PreviewFrame.Size
local CurrentTarget = PreviewFrame.CurrentTarget
PreviewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)

function FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable)
	local CurrentClosest, ClosestDistance = nil, 100

	for _,Egg in EggsAvailable do
		local EggModel = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg]
		local mag = (EggModel:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= ClosestDistance then
			CurrentClosest = EggModel
			ClosestDistance = mag
		end
	end
	return CurrentClosest
end

local IsClosing = false -- so it doesnt ruin the animation

function FindEgg()
	if not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Player.Character.Humanoid.Health == 0 then return end

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local EggsAvailable = {}
	local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/11

	for _,Egg in workspace.Map.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if Egg == nil then continue end
		if not Egg:FindFirstChild("EggModel") then warn(Egg.Name.." does not have an EggModel") end

		local mag = (Egg:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= 12 then
			EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = Egg.Name
		end
	end

	local SetVisibility = #EggsAvailable >= 1 -- if its 0 then its already false

	if SetVisibility then -- a egg(s) is in distance
		local Egg = #EggsAvailable > 1 and FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable) or workspace.Map.Eggs[EggsAvailable[1]]
		local WSP = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg:GetPivot().Position)
		PreviewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
		CurrentTarget.Value = Egg.Name
	else
		CurrentTarget.Value = "None"
	end

	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then
		SetVisibility = false -- if you are opening an egg itll auto close the previewframe
	end

	--// Make the previewframe visible
	if SetVisibility and not PreviewFrame.Visible then
		PreviewFrame.Visible = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(DefaultSize.X.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.X.Offset, DefaultSize.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.Y.Offset)})	
	elseif not SetVisibility and PreviewFrame.Visible and not IsClosing then -- set to invisible, while is visible & isnt closing
		IsClosing = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)})	
		task.wait(0.15)
		PreviewFrame.Visible = false
		IsClosing = false
	end
end

function UpdatePreviewFrame()
	if CurrentTarget.Value ~= "None" then
		local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value
		PreviewFrame.EggInfo.EggName.Text = Egg

		if not ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg) then print(Egg.." does not have settings in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs!") return end

		local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]

		local IsRobuxEgg = EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId")
		if IsRobuxEgg then
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs \u{E002}"..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		else
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs "..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		end

		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Triple.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg
		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Auto.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg

		--// This part gets the pet chances
		local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

		for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
		end

		table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
			return a[2] > b[2]
		end)

		local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for _,v in Pets do
			local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
			TotalWeight += Chance
			v[2] = Chance
		end

		for i = 1,9 do
			local PetInfo = Pets[i]
			local PetSlot = PreviewFrame.PetChances.List["Pet"..i]
			PetSlot.Visible = PetInfo ~= nil

			if PetInfo == nil then continue end

			PetSlot.Rarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]].Settings.Rarity.Value
			PetSlot.Percentage.Text = Utilities.Short.en(100/TotalWeight * PetInfo[2]).."%"
			PetSlot.Delete.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[PetInfo[1]].Value
			PetSlot.PetName.Value = PetInfo[1]

			local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]]:Clone()
			PetModel.Parent = PetSlot.Pet

			local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
			local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
			PetSlot.Pet.CurrentCamera = Camera
			PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
		end
	end
end

--// Egg Hatching
local IsAutoOpening = false

function HatchEgg(Egg: string, Result: string, Offset:number)
	local OpeningTime = 3

	local NewViewport = script.EggViewport:Clone()
	NewViewport.Parent = UI.OpenEgg

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 15
	Frames.Visible = false
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = false

	local Clone = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg].EggModel:Clone()
	Clone:ScaleTo(0.5)
	Clone.Parent = workspace

	local Rot, X, Y, Z = Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue")
	Rot.Value = 30 Z.Value = -4 X.Value = 10

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 1.5
	PL.Parent = Clone.Egg

	Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z))
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local TweenIn = TweenService:Create(X, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = Offset})
	TweenIn:Play()

	local RotTweenIn = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 0})
	RotTweenIn:Play()

	-- add an audio for the egg flying in
	TweenIn.Completed:Wait()

	local Eggdelay = 0.075
	for i = 1,(OpeningTime * 1.5) + 1 do
		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 6})
		Tween:Play()
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -6})
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween:Play()
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		Eggdelay -= .005
	end

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()	
	Clone:Destroy()	

	-- Now we're going to show the pet

	local PetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result]:Clone()
	PetModel:ScaleTo(0.6)
	PetModel.Parent = workspace

	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[Result].Value
	NewViewport.PetName.Text = Result
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = true
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Text = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result].Settings.Rarity.Value
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = true

	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 2
	PL.Parent = PetModel.MainPart

	X.Value = Offset Y.Value = 0 Z.Value = -4 Rot.Value = 175
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	task.wait(OpeningTime*0.25)

	NewViewport:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(NewViewport.Position.X.Scale, 0, NewViewport.Position.Y.Scale + 10, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, OpeningTime * 0.1)
	TweenService:Create(Y, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -5}):Play()
	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = false
	task.wait(OpeningTime * 0.15)

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()
	X:Destroy() Y:Destroy() Z:Destroy() Rot:Destroy()

	PetModel:Destroy()
	NewViewport:Destroy()

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = true
	Frames.Visible = true	
end

function SingleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return end

	if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then
		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 1)

		if Result ~= nil then
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end
	else
		MarketPlaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Player, EggInfo.ProductId.Value)
	end
end

function TripleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 3)

	if Result ~= nil then
		for i = 1,#Result do
			coroutine.wrap(function()
				local Position = (i - 2) * 3
				HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
			end)()
		end
	end
end

local function ChooseEggAmount(Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return 1 end

	local EggAmount = 1

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then 
		return EggAmount
	end -- triple egg is a gamepass that the player doesn't own, so open 1 egg

	if PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * 3 then
		EggAmount = 3
	end

	return EggAmount
end

function AutoEgg()
	if IsAutoOpening then return end

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("AutoEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value then 
		MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value)
		return
	end

	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value	
	IsAutoOpening = true

	while true do
		if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then task.wait(0.1) continue end -- player is already opening an egg

		if CurrentTarget.Value == "None" or CurrentTarget.Value ~= Egg then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, ChooseEggAmount(Egg))

		if Result == nil then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		if #Result > 1 then
			for i = 1,#Result do
				coroutine.wrap(function()
					local Position = (i - 2) * 3
					HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
				end)()
			end
		else
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

--// Pet Follow
-- Credits to azypro777 for helping out with this part!
local Spacing, PetSize, MaxClimbHeight = 5, 3, 6

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
local RayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -500, 0)

local TempPets = Instance.new("Folder")
TempPets.Name = "PlayerPets"
TempPets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then -- Show pets is false
		-- put the pets in "TempPets"
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end
			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end
	end
end

local Module = {}

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

function Module.Tween(Object, Info, Goal1)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		Info.Speed or 0.25,
		Info.EasingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Info.EasingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
		Info.RepeatCount or 0,
		Info.Reverses or false,
		Info.DelayTime or 0
	)
	
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(Object, info, Goal1)
	Tween:Play()
end

function Module.TweenModel(EndCFrame,TI,Model)
	local NewCFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	NewCFrameValue.Value = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(NewCFrameValue,TI,EndCFrame)
	local Connection
	Connection = NewCFrameValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		Model:PivotTo(NewCFrameValue.Value)
	end)
	Tween:Play()
	Tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		NewCFrameValue:Destroy()
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

return Module

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

local function ShowNotice(Text, Color)
	Notice.Text = Text
	Notice.TextColor3 = Color or Colors.Green
	Notice.TextTransparency = 0

--// View Builder
local Views = {}

local function MakeScroll(Parent, Position, Size)
	local Scroll = New("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Size,
		Position = Position,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 5,
	}, Parent)
	New("UIListLayout", {
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}, Scroll)
	return Scroll
end

local function SetupPetViewport(Viewport, PetName)
	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if not PetModel then return end

	local Clone = PetModel:Clone()
	Clone.Parent = Viewport

	local MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not MainPart then
		MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
	end
	if not MainPart then return end

	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	Viewport.CurrentCamera = Camera

	local Pos = MainPart.Position
	local Size = Clone:GetExtentsSize()
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + Size.X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
end

local function PetRarity(PetName)
	local Pet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if Pet and Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings") and Pet.Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity") then
		return Pet.Settings.Rarity.Value
	end
	return "?"
end

RefreshList = function()
	Clear(PetList)
	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then continue end

		local Card = New("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.26),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, PetList)
		Rounded(Card, 10)

		local Viewport = New("ViewportFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Darker,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Viewport, 8)
		SetupPetViewport(Viewport, Pet.PetName.Value)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.2),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = PetRarity(Pet.PetName.Value),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.55),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.25),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		local SelectBtn = New("TextButton", {
			Text = "Select",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.25),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.5),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(SelectBtn, 8)
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(SelectBtn)

		SelectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			SelectedPetId = tonumber(Pet.Name)
			SelectedPetName = Pet.PetName.Value
			SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: " .. SelectedPetName
			SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Colors.Accent
		end)
	end

	if Count == 0 then
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "No pets available to list.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.1),
		}, PetList)
	end
end

ListConfirm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local Price = tonumber(PriceBox.Text)
	if not SelectedPetId then
		ShowNotice("Select a pet first", Colors.Red)
		return
	end
	if not Price or Price < 1 then
		ShowNotice("Enter a valid price", Colors.Red)
		return
	end

	ListConfirm.Text = "..."
	local Result = ListPetRemote:InvokeServer(SelectedPetId, Price)
	if Result and Result ~= "" and Result ~= "Not loaded" and Result ~= "In a trade" and Result ~= "Slow down" and Result ~= "Invalid price" and Result ~= "Pet not found" and Result ~= "Unequip the pet first" and Result ~= "Max active listings" and Result ~= "Try again" and Result ~= "Invalid input" then
		local ListedName = SelectedPetName
		SelectedPetId = nil
		SelectedPetName = nil
		SelectedLabel.Text = "No pet selected"
		SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Colors.Dim
		ShowNotice("Listed " .. ListedName .. " for " .. Price .. " gems", Colors.Green)
		PriceBox.Text = ""
		RefreshList()
		RefreshMyListings()
	else
		ShowNotice(Result or "Failed to list", Colors.Red)
	end
	ListConfirm.Text = "List for 24h"
end)

	OpenButton.Title.Text = "Auction"

--// Position: find the last existing button BEFORE parenting the clone,
-- otherwise the clone is its own "last child" and ends up overlapping it.
local HasLayout = ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") ~= nil
	or ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout") ~= nil

local LastButton = nil
if not HasLayout then
	for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA("Frame") then LastButton = Child end
	end
end

OpenButton.Parent = ButtonSide.Buttons
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(OpenButton)

if HasLayout then
	OpenButton.LayoutOrder = 999
elseif LastButton then
	OpenButton.Position = UDim2.new(LastButton.Position.X.Scale, LastButton.Position.X.Offset, LastButton.Position.Y.Scale + LastButton.Size.Y.Scale + 0.01, LastButton.Position.Y.Offset)
end

local OpenClick = OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Click") or OpenButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
if OpenClick then
	OpenClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
		RefreshAll()
	end)
end

--// Notifications
AuctionNotice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Kind, Value)
	if Kind == "sold" then
		if Value > 0 then
			ShowNotice("Your pet sold for " .. Short.en(Value) .. " gems!", Colors.Green)
		end
		RefreshInbox()
		RefreshMyListings()
	elseif Kind == "petReturned" then
		ShowNotice("An unsold pet was returned to you", Colors.Accent)
		RefreshInbox()
	elseif Kind == "listingsChanged" then
		if AuctionFrame.Visible then
			RefreshBrowse()
			RefreshMyListings()
		end
	end
end)

end)

	if fading then return end
	fading = true
	for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do

			if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then goals.TextTransparency = 1 end

		task.wait(0.65)
	end
	ready = true
	panel.Visible = true
	playButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(83, 188, 255)
end)

--// ============================================================
--// Admin Dashboard Client v4 — Premium Dark UI
--// Opens with /admin chat command. Server-verified.
--// ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
if not Remotes then return end
local RF = Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminDashboard", 15)
if not RF then return end
local AdminCheck = RF:WaitForChild("AdminCheck", 10)
local AdminRemote = RF:WaitForChild("AdminRemote", 10)
if not AdminCheck or not AdminRemote then return end
local AdminNotify = RF:WaitForChild("AdminNotify", 10)

local OK, IsAdmin = pcall(function() return AdminCheck:InvokeServer() end)
if not OK or not IsAdmin then return end

--// ============================================================
--// Theme
--// ============================================================
local Th = {
	Bg          = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 18),
	Surface     = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 28),
	Surface2    = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 32),
	Card        = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 38),
	CardHover   = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 50),
	Input       = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 24),
	Accent      = Color3.fromRGB(108, 72, 220),
	AccentHover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 94, 240),
	AccentDim   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 38, 140),
	Green       = Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 90),
	GreenDim    = Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 52),
	Red         = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	RedHover    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75),
	RedDim      = Color3.fromRGB(140, 35, 35),
	Orange      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40),
	Yellow      = Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 60),
	Text        = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
	Sub         = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165),
	Muted       = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100),
	Border      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	BorderLight = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 60),
	Online      = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 100),
	Offline     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
}

--// ============================================================
--// Helpers
--// ============================================================
local function Inst(Class: string, Props: {[string]: any}, Parent: Instance?): Instance
	local I = Instance.new(Class)
	for K, V in pairs(Props) do I[K] = V end
	if Parent then I.Parent = Parent end
	return I
end

local function RC(F, R) Inst("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R or 6)}, F) end
local function RS(F, Col) Inst("UIStroke", {Color = Col or Th.Border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.3}, F) end
local function RP(F, T, B, L, R)
	Inst("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T or 4),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, B or 4),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, L or 6),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, R or 6),
	}, F)
end

local function Lbl(P, Text, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local L = Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Col or Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}, P)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 14}, L)
	return L
end

local function Btn(P, Text, Fn, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local BC = Col or Th.Accent
	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = BC,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)}):Play()
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC}):Play()
	end)
	if Fn then B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Fn) end
	return B
end

local function Txt(P: Instance, Ph: string?, Sz: UDim2?, Pos: UDim2?): TextBox
	local B = Inst("TextBox", {
		PlaceholderText = Ph or "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = Th.Muted,
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Input, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P) :: TextBox
	RC(B, 6)
	RP(B, 2, 2, 8, 8)
	RS(B)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	return B
end

local function Scr(P, Sz, Pos)
	local S = Inst("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Th.AccentDim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, S)
	RP(S, 4, 4, 4, 4)
	return S
end

local function Card(P, H, Ord)
	local F = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H or 36),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = Ord or 0,
	}, P)
	RC(F, 6)
	RS(F, Th.Border)
	return F
end

local function StatCard(P, Title, Value, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 46, Ord)
	RP(F, 6, 6, 10, 10)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.06))
	Lbl(F, tostring(Value), Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.44))
	return F
end

local function ARow(P, Title, Ph, Btns, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 40, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 13), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
	local Box = Txt(F, Ph, UDim2.new(0.26, 0, 0, 28), UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.08))
	local N = #Btns
	local Gap = 4
	local BW = (0.34 * F.AbsoluteSize.X - Gap * (N - 1)) / N
	BW = math.max(BW / F.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.08)
	local X = 0.62
	for _, S in Btns do
		local LS = S
		Btn(F, LS.text, function() LS.click(Box) end, LS.color, UDim2.new(BW, -2, 0, 28), UDim2.new(X, 0, 0.06, 0))
		X += BW + Gap / F.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	return F, Box
end

local function DangerRow(P, Title, Fn, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 36, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Btn(F, Title, function() Fn(F) end, Th.Red, UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.08, 0))
	return F
end

local function SectionHdr(P, Text, Ord)
	Lbl(P, Text, Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)).LayoutOrder = Ord or 0
end

local function EmptyState(P, Icon, Title, Desc)
	local Holder = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 0,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 30,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Sub,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Desc, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 3,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, Holder)
	return Holder
end

--// ============================================================
--// Toast
--// ============================================================
local ToastId = 0
local function Toast(Msg, Type)
	ToastId += 1
	local MyId = ToastId
	local Col = Type == "error" and Th.Red or Type == "warning" and Th.Orange or Th.Green
	local Icon = Type == "error" and "✕  " or Type == "warning" and "⚠  " or "✓  "

	local T = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 38),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 600,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, SG)
	RC(T, 8)
	RS(T, Col)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon .. tostring(Msg), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Col, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.15, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 601,
	}, T)

	TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.04, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.delay(3, function()
		if ToastId == MyId then
			TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, function() T:Destroy() end)
		end
	end)
end

--// ============================================================
--// Confirm Modal
--// ============================================================
local function Confirm(Title, Msg, BtnText, Callback)
	local Overlay = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		ZIndex = 500,
	}, SG)

	local Modal = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 190),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 501,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, Overlay)
	RC(Modal, 12)
	RS(Modal, Th.BorderLight)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Msg, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 50), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 46),
		TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	local CancelBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = "Cancel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Border,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -184, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(CancelBtn, 6)

	local ConfirmBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = BtnText or "Confirm", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Red,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(ConfirmBtn, 6)

	local function Close()
		TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TS:Create(Overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.2, function() Overlay:Destroy() end)
	end

	CancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Close)
	ConfirmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Callback()
		Close()
	end)

	TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
end

--// ============================================================
--// Remote wrappers
--// ============================================================
local function Req(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R, M = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	if not OK then Toast("Error: " .. tostring(R), "error") return nil end
	if type(R) == "string" then Toast(M or R, R:find("Error") and "error" or "success")
	elseif type(R) == "boolean" and M then Toast(M, R and "success" or "error") end
	return R
end

local function ReqS(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	return OK and R or nil
end

--// ============================================================
--// Main Window
--// ============================================================
local SG = Inst("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "AdminDashboard", ResetOnSpawn = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	DisplayOrder = 100, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

local WIN_W, WIN_H = 840, 540
local SideW = 144

local Main = Inst("Frame", {

-- Title bar
local TitleH = 38
local TitleBar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TitleH),

	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, Main)
RC(TitleBar, 12)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "⚡ Admin Panel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15,
	TextColor3 = Th.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,

--// ============================================================
--// Tab System
--// ============================================================
local Tabs = {}
local TabSide = {}
local TabRefresh = {}
local CurTab = "Players"
local TabBtns = {}

local function ShowTab(Name)
	CurTab = Name
	for N, F in pairs(Tabs) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, F in pairs(TabSide) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, B in pairs(TabBtns) do
		if N == Name then
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Accent
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Text
		else
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Sub
		end
	end
	if TabRefresh[Name] then pcall(TabRefresh[Name]) end
end

local TabOrder = 0
local function AddTab(Name, Ord)
	TabOrder += 1
	local OrdVal = Ord or TabOrder

	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 30),
		LayoutOrder = OrdVal,
	}, TabBar)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 11}, B)
	B.Name = Name
	TabBtns[Name] = B

	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.CardHover}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowTab(Name) end)

	local S = Scr(Content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	S.Visible = false
	Tabs[Name] = S
	return S
end

--// Clear helper
local function Clear(P: Instance?)
	if not P then return end
	for _, Child in P:GetChildren() do
		if not Child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not Child:IsA("UIPadding") and not Child:IsA("UICorner") and not Child:IsA("UIStroke") then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

	if not CL or #CL == 0 then

		return
	end
	SectionHdr(CodesS, "── ACTIVE CODES ──────────────────────", 0)
	local Ord = 1
	for _, Cd in CL do
		local R = Card(CodesS, 32, Ord)
		RP(R, 4, 4, 8, 8)
		Lbl(R, Cd.code, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
		if Cd.rewardType == "pet" then
			Lbl(R, "Pet: " .. tostring(Cd.rewardValue), Th.Yellow, UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.1))
		else

--[[
Thanks for using my plugin! This script contains information on how to edit your game.

In ReplicatedStorage-> Game Settings, you can edit the following:
- ClickingAnywhere, this is a beta feature for clicker games which allows you to click an ywhere on the game to get clicks. Set it to true if you want this
- CurrencyMultiplier, this is the default that you get of currency, increasing this will make your game easier
- Datasave, this is the key for saving your player data, changing this will wipe people's stats.
- MaxDrops, incase you have a game where objects are dropped, you can edit this value to set the max per area
- RebirthBasePrice, howmuch rebirth costs (excluding increasing costs)
- RebirthMultiplier, howmuch currency multiplier Rebirth gives

In ReplicatedStorage-> Gamepasses, you can edit the following
- DoubleCurrency, change the value of this numbervalue to your gamepass id

In ReplicatedStorage-> Eggs, you can edit the following
- Names of the eggs (must also change the egg incubator's name in workspace)
- Cost of the egg, edit the cost number value
- Pets inside the egg, the name is the pet name and the value is the chance

In ReplicatedStorage-> Areas, you can edit the following
(will be finished in the future)

And ofcourse, you can edit all the scripts!
]]

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

--// EDIT STUFF HERE:
local ADMINRANK = 254 -- What rank in group for admin


--// MAIN SCRIPT
local AdminFunctions = {}

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// General
function AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, AdminList) -- checks if user is allowed to use commands
	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK
	else
		return CreatorId == Player.UserId
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == PlayerName then
			return Player
		end
	end
end

--// Stats
function AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(Player, StatName)
	for _, Stat in Player.Data:GetDescendants() do
		if string.lower(Stat.Name) == StatName then
			return Stat
		end
	end
end

--// Pets
function AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(Player, PetName)
	for _, Pet in ReplicatedStorage.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if string.lower(Pet.Name) == PetName then
			return Pet
		end
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

	local Codes = {
		["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"},
		["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
		["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
		["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"},
	}

	local Result = {}
	for Code, Reward in pairs(Codes) do
		local IsPet = type(Reward[1]) == "string"
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			code = Code,
			rewardType = IsPet and "pet" or "currency",
			rewardValue = Reward[1],
			rewardTarget = Reward[2] or nil,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.code < B.code end)
	return Result
end

return CodesHandler

-- BOTTOM CONTROLS

logsCorner.Parent = logsButton

--------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------

local function log(...)
	if not logsEnabled then
		return
	end

	print("[Lemonade WebSync]", ...)
end

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN,
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		connectButton.Text = "Connect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.RED

		setStatus(
			"Offline",
			COLORS.RED,
			COLORS.RED
		)
	end
end

local function updateLastSync()
	lastSyncText = os.date("%X")

	syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: " .. lastSyncText
end

local function getProjectName(): string
	local gameName = game:GetAttribute("GameName")

	if typeof(gameName) == "string" and gameName ~= "" then
		return gameName
	end

	return game.Name
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP HELPER
--------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	method: string,
	path: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)

	local url = CONFIG.BACKEND_URL .. path

	local requestData = {
		Url = url,
		Method = method,
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		},
	}

	if sessionToken then
		requestData.Headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. sessionToken
	end

	if body ~= nil then
		requestData.Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
	end

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync(requestData)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP error:", response)
		return false, nil
	end

	if not response.Success then
		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP status:",
			response.StatusCode,
			response.StatusMessage
		)

		return false, response
	end

	local decoded = nil

	if response.Body and response.Body ~= "" then
		local decodeSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
		end)

		if decodeSuccess then
			decoded = result
		end
	end

	return true, decoded
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function connectToBackend()

	if connecting then
		return
	end

	if connected then
		return
	end

	connecting = true

	connectButton.Text = "Connecting..."
	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW,
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	log("Connecting to backend...")

	local success, response = request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectName = getProjectName(),
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "2.3",
			studioName = "Roblox Studio",
		}
	)

	if success and response then

		sessionToken = response.token
		projectId = response.projectId

		if typeof(response.prompts) == "number" then
			promptCount = response.prompts
			promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: " .. tostring(promptCount)
		end

		setConnectedState(true)
		updateLastSync()

		projectLabel.Text =
			"Project: " ..
			(response.projectName or "ok")

		log("Connected successfully.")
	else

		setConnectedState(false)

		connectButton.Text = "Connect"

		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] Failed to connect."
		)
	end

	connecting = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DISCONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function disconnectFromBackend()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	log("Disconnecting...")

	request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectId = projectId,
		}
	)

	sessionToken = nil
	projectId = nil

	setConnectedState(false)

	log("Disconnected.")
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while true do

		task.wait(CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)

		if connected and sessionToken then

			local success = request(
				"POST",
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					projectId = projectId,
					projectName = getProjectName(),
					placeId = game.PlaceId,
				}
			)

			if success then
				updateLastSync()
			else
				warn(
					"[Lemonade WebSync] Heartbeat failed."
				)
			end
		end
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PLUGIN BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()

	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled

	if widget.Enabled then
		log("Widget opened.")
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLOSE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

connectButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if connected then
		disconnectFromBackend()
	else
		connectToBackend()
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOG TOGGLE
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	logsEnabled = not logsEnabled

	if logsEnabled then
		logsButton.Text = "Logs On"
	else
		logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL UI
--------------------------------------------------

projectLabel.Text = "Project: " .. getProjectName()
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"

setConnectedState(false)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SELECTION DEBUG
--------------------------------------------------

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	local selected = Selection:Get()

	log(
		"Selection changed:",
		#selected
	)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
--------------------------------------------------

print("========================================")
print("[Lemonade WebSync] Plugin Loaded")
print("Project:", getProjectName())
print("PlaceId:", game.PlaceId)
print("========================================")

--!strict
-- CameraEffects.lua
-- Camera shake, punch zoom, orbit, slow-motion effects

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local CameraEffects = {}
CameraEffects.__index = CameraEffects

local activeEffects = {}
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local connection = nil

-- Noise generator for shake
local function perlinNoise(x: number, y: number): number
	local n = bit32.bxor(bit32.lshift(x, 16), y)
	n = bit32.bxor(n, bit32.rshift(n, 13))
	n = (n * (n * n * 60493 + 19990303) + 1376312589) % 2147483648
	return (n / 2147483648) * 2 - 1
end

local function getNoise(t: number): Vector2
	return Vector2.new(perlinNoise(math.floor(t * 100), 0), perlinNoise(0, math.floor(t * 100)))
end

-- Start the update loop
local function ensureConnection()
	if connection then return end
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not camera then return end
		
		local totalOffset = Vector3.zero
		local totalFOVOffset = 0
		local timeScale = 1
		local now = os.clock()
		
		for _, effect in activeEffects do
			if now > effect.endTime then continue end
			
			local progress = (now - effect.startTime) / effect.duration
			local eased = 1 - (1 - progress) ^ 2 -- ease-out quad
			
			if effect.type == "shake" then
				local noise = getNoise(now * effect.frequency)
				local intensity = effect.intensity * (1 - eased)
				totalOffset += Vector3.new(noise.X, noise.Y, 0) * intensity
				
			elseif effect.type == "punch" then
				totalFOVOffset += effect.amount * (1 - eased)
				
			elseif effect.type == "slowmo" then
				timeScale = math.min(timeScale, effect.factor)
			end
		end
		
		-- Apply shake
		if totalOffset.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(totalOffset)
		end
		
		-- Apply FOV punch
		if totalFOVOffset ~= 0 then
			camera.FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView + totalFOVOffset
		end
		
		-- Clean up expired
		for i = #activeEffects, 1, -1 do
			if os.clock() > activeEffects[i].endTime then
				table.remove(activeEffects, i)
			end
		end
		
		if #activeEffects == 0 and connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
			connection = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Presets
local PRESETS = {
	Micro = { intensity = 2, duration = 0.1, frequency = 60 },
	Light = { intensity = 4, duration = 0.2, frequency = 40 },
	Medium = { intensity = 8, duration = 0.4, frequency = 30 },
	Heavy = { intensity = 16, duration = 0.6, frequency = 20 },
	Massive = { intensity = 24, duration = 1.0, frequency = 15 },
}

-- Public API
function CameraEffects.Shake(presetName: string?, custom: {intensity: number, duration: number, frequency: number}?)
	local preset = PRESETS[presetName or "Light"]
	local params = custom or preset
	ensureConnection()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "shake",
		startTime = os.clock(),
		duration = params.duration,
		intensity = params.intensity,
		frequency = params.frequency,
		endTime = os.clock() + params.duration,
	})
end

function CameraEffects.PunchZoom(amount: number, duration: number, easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?)
	ensureConnection()
	local startFOV = camera.FieldOfView
	local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		FieldOfView = startFOV + amount
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			FieldOfView = startFOV
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function CameraEffects.Orbit(center: Vector3, radius: number, duration: number)
	ensureConnection()
	local startTime = os.clock()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "orbit",
		startTime = startTime,
		duration = duration,
		center = center,
		radius = radius,
		endTime = startTime + duration,
		-- Orbit handled in RenderStepped would need more complex implementation
	})
end

function CameraEffects.SlowMotion(factor: number, duration: number)
	ensureConnection()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "slowmo",
		startTime = os.clock(),
		duration = duration,
		factor = factor,
		endTime = os.clock() + duration,
	})
end

function CameraEffects.StopAll()
	table.clear(activeEffects)
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
end

-- Effect presets for game moments
CameraEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Micro") end,
	LevelUp = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Light") end,
	EnemyHit = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Medium") end,
	BossDefeat = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Heavy") end,
	Rebirth = function() 
		CameraEffects.Shake("Massive")
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(10, 0.3)
	end,
	RareHatch = function()
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(-15, 0.3)
		task.wait(0.05)
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(15, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end,
}

return CameraEffects
