--!strict
-- AuctionEngine.lua
-- Buy order matching, price history, sniping alerts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AuctionEngine = {}
AuctionEngine.__index = AuctionEngine

-- DataStore keys
local DATASTORE_KEYS = {
	Listing = "Auction_Listing_",
	BuyOrder = "Auction_BuyOrder_",
	History = "Auction_History_",
	Watchlist = "Auction_Watchlist_",
}

-- In-memory caches
local activeListings = {}      -- [listingId] = listing
local activeBuyOrders = {}     -- [orderId] = order
local priceHistory = {}        -- [itemId][bucketKey] = {min, max, avg, volume}
local watchlists = {}          -- [playerId] = {itemId, ...}
local snipingThresholds = {}   -- [playerId][itemId] = threshold (0-1)

-- Messaging topics
local TOPICS = {
	ListingPosted = "Auction_ListingPosted",
	BuyOrderPlaced = "Auction_BuyOrderPlaced",
	BuyOrderFilled = "Auction_BuyOrderFilled",
	SnipingAlert = "Auction_SnipingAlert",
	HistoryUpdated = "Auction_HistoryUpdated",
}

-- ============================================
-- DATA MODELS
-- ============================================

export type Listing = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	sellerId: number,
	price: number,
	quantity: number,
	listedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "active" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type BuyOrder = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	buyerId: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	quantity: number,
	filled: number,
	placedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "open" | "partial" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type HistoryBucket = {
	minPrice: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	avgPrice: number,
	volume: number,
	timestamp: number,
}

-- ============================================
-- MATCHING ENGINE
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing: Listing): {filled: number, orders: {BuyOrder}}
	local matches = {}
	local remainingQty = listing.quantity
	
	-- Find compatible buy orders: same item, maxPrice >= listPrice, open/partial status
	local candidates = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.itemId == listing.itemId
			and order.maxPrice >= listing.price
			and (order.status == "open" or order.status == "partial")
			and order.buyerId ~= listing.sellerId
			and os.time() < order.expiresAt then
			table.insert(candidates, order)
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price-time priority: highest maxPrice first, then earliest placed
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		if a.maxPrice ~= b.maxPrice then
			return a.maxPrice > b.maxPrice
		end
		return a.placedAt < b.placedAt
	end)
	
	for _, order in candidates do
		if remainingQty <= 0 then break end
		
		local fillQty = math.min(remainingQty, order.quantity - order.filled)
		if fillQty <= 0 then continue end
		
		order.filled += fillQty
		remainingQty -= fillQty
		
		if order.filled >= order.quantity then
			order.status = "filled"
		else
			order.status = "partial"
		end
		
		table.insert(matches, {orderId = order.id, filledQty = fillQty, fillPrice = listing.price})
	end
	
	return {filled = listing.quantity - remainingQty, orders = matches}
end

-- ============================================
-- BUY ORDER MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.PlaceBuyOrder(buyerId: number, itemId: string, maxPrice: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?, string?)
	if maxPrice <= 0 or quantity <= 0 then
		return false, "Invalid price or quantity"
	end
	
	if durationHours < 1 or durationHours > 168 then -- max 1 week
		return false, "Duration must be 1-168 hours"
	end
	
	local orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local order: BuyOrder = {
		id = orderId,
		itemId = itemId,
		buyerId = buyerId,
		maxPrice = maxPrice,
		quantity = quantity,
		filled = 0,
		placedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "open",
	}
	
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = order
	
	-- Check for immediate matches against existing listings
	-- (In production, this would iterate active listings)
	
	-- Publish event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderPlaced, {
			orderId = orderId,
			itemId = itemId,
			maxPrice = maxPrice,
			quantity = quantity,
			buyerId = buyerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, orderId, nil
end

function AuctionEngine.CancelBuyOrder(buyerId: number, orderId: string): boolean
	local order = activeBuyOrders[orderId]
	if not order or order.buyerId ~= buyerId then return false end
	
	if order.status ~= "open" and order.status ~= "partial" then
		return false
	end
	
	order.status = "cancelled"
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = nil
	return true
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPlayerBuyOrders(playerId: number): {BuyOrder}
	local result = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.buyerId == playerId then
			table.insert(result, order)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- PRICE HISTORY
-- ============================================

local BUCKET_DURATIONS = {
	Hour = 3600,
	SixHour = 21600,
	Day = 86400,
	Week = 604800,
}

function AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType: string, timestamp: number): string
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	return tostring(math.floor(timestamp / duration) * duration)
end

function AuctionEngine.RecordSale(itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, timestamp: number?)
	timestamp = timestamp or os.time()
	
	for bucketType, duration in BUCKET_DURATIONS do
		local bucketKey = AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType, timestamp)
		local key = itemId .. "_" .. bucketKey
		
		if not priceHistory[key] then
			priceHistory[key] = {
				minPrice = price,
				maxPrice = price,
				totalPrice = price * quantity,
				volume = quantity,
				count = 1,
				timestamp = timestamp,
			}
		else
			local bucket = priceHistory[key]
			bucket.minPrice = math.min(bucket.minPrice, price)
			bucket.maxPrice = math.max(bucket.maxPrice, price)
			bucket.totalPrice += price * quantity
			bucket.volume += quantity
			bucket.count += 1
		end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId: string, bucketType: string, fromTimestamp: number, toTimestamp: number): {HistoryBucket}
	local results = {}
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	
	for bucketKey, data in priceHistory do
		if not string.find(bucketKey, itemId .. "_") then continue end
		if data.timestamp < fromTimestamp or data.timestamp > toTimestamp then continue end
		
		table.insert(results, {
			minPrice = data.minPrice,
			maxPrice = data.maxPrice,
			avgPrice = data.count > 0 and (data.totalPrice / data.volume) or 0,
			volume = data.volume,
			timestamp = data.timestamp,
		})
	end
	
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.timestamp < b.timestamp end)
	return results
end

function AuctionEngine.GetMovingAverage(itemId: string, bucketType: string, periods: number): number
	local history = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, bucketType, os.time() - periods * BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType], os.time())
	if #history == 0 then return 0 end
	
	local sum = 0
	for _, bucket in history do
		sum += bucket.avgPrice
	end
	return sum / #history
end

function AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId: string): {min: number, max: number, avg: number, volume: number, movingAvg7d: number}
	local now = os.time()
	local dayHistory = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, "Day", now - 7 * 86400, now)
	
	if #dayHistory == 0 then
		return {min = 0, max = 0, avg = 0, volume = 0, movingAvg7d = 0}
	end
	
	local totalVolume = 0
	local weightedSum = 0
	local minPrice = math.huge
	local maxPrice = 0
	
	for _, bucket in dayHistory do
		minPrice = math.min(minPrice, bucket.minPrice)
		maxPrice = math.max(maxPrice, bucket.maxPrice)
		totalVolume += bucket.volume
		weightedSum += bucket.avgPrice * bucket.volume
	end
	
	return {
		min = minPrice == math.huge and 0 or minPrice,
		max = maxPrice,
		avg = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
		volume = totalVolume,
		movingAvg7d = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
	}
end

-- ============================================
-- SNIPING ALERTS
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.SetSnipingThreshold(playerId: number, itemId: string, threshold: number)
	-- threshold = discount percentage (0.15 = 15% below moving average)
	if not snipingThresholds[playerId] then snipingThresholds[playerId] = {} end
	snipingThresholds[playerId][itemId] = math.clamp(threshold, 0.01, 0.50)
end

function AuctionEngine.GetSnipingThresholds(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	return snipingThresholds[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing: Listing): boolean
	local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
	if stats.movingAvg7d == 0 then return false end
	
	local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
	
	-- Check all players watching this item
	-- In practice, iterate watchlists or subscriptions
	return discount >= 0.15 -- default threshold
end

function AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing: Listing, discount: number)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.SnipingAlert, {
			itemId = listing.itemId,
			listingPrice = listing.price,
			movingAvg = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId).movingAvg7d,
			discount = discount,
			listingId = listing.id,
		})
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- WATCHLIST
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.AddToWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if not watchlists[playerId] then watchlists[playerId] = {} end
	if not table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId) then
		table.insert(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.RemoveFromWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if watchlists[playerId] then
		local idx = table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
		if idx then table.remove(watchlists[playerId], idx) end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlist(playerId: number): {string}
	return watchlists[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlistData(playerId: number): {{itemId: string, lowestAsk: number, avgPrice: number, volume24h: number, priceDelta24h: number}}
	local watchlist = watchlists[playerId] or {}
	local results = {}
	
	for _, itemId in watchlist do
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId)
		-- In production, fetch lowest ask from active listings
		table.insert(results, {
			itemId = itemId,
			lowestAsk = stats.min,
			avgPrice = stats.avg,
			volume24h = stats.volume,
			priceDelta24h = 0, -- would need previous day comparison
		})
	end
	
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- LISTING MANAGEMENT (stubs for integration)
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.CreateListing(sellerId: number, itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?)
	local listingId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local listing: Listing = {
		id = listingId,
		itemId = itemId,
		sellerId = sellerId,
		price = price,
		quantity = quantity,
		listedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "active",
	}
	
	activeListings[listingId] = listing
	
	-- Check for matching buy orders
	local matches = AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing)
	if matches.filled > 0 then
		-- Process fills
		for _, match in matches.orders do
			-- Record sale for history
			AuctionEngine.RecordSale(listing.itemId, match.fillPrice, match.filledQty)
			
			-- Notify buyer
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderFilled, {
					orderId = match.orderId,
					itemId = listing.itemId,
					fillPrice = match.fillPrice,
					quantity = match.filledQty,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Check sniping alerts
	if AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing) then
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
		if stats.movingAvg7d > 0 then
			local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
			AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing, discount)
		end
	end
	
	-- Publish listing event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ListingPosted, {
			listingId = listingId,
			itemId = itemId,
			price = price,
			quantity = quantity,
			sellerId = sellerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, listingId
end

function AuctionEngine.GetActiveListings(itemId: string?): {Listing}
	local results = {}
	for _, listing in activeListings do
		if listing.status == "active" and os.time() < listing.expiresAt then
			if not itemId or listing.itemId == itemId then
				table.insert(results, listing)
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price ascending
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.price < b.price end)
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- BACKGROUND JOBS
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Price history aggregation (every 5 minutes)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(300)
			
			-- Cleanup expired orders/listings
			local now = os.time()
			for id, order in activeBuyOrders do
				if now >= order.expiresAt then
					order.status = "expired"
					activeBuyOrders[id] = nil
				end
			end
			
			for id, listing in activeListings do
				if now >= listing.expiresAt then
					listing.status = "expired"
				end
			end
			
			-- Cleanup old price history (keep 90 days)
			local cutoff = os.time() - 90 * 86400
			for key, data in priceHistory do
				if data.timestamp < cutoff then
					priceHistory[key] = nil
				end
			end
			
			MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.HistoryUpdated, {timestamp = os.time()})
		end
	end)
end

return AuctionEngine

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Cooldowns = {}

--// Script

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false

	local PetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	PetFolder.Name = Player.Name
	PetFolder.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets

	repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	LoadEquipped(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
	workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:Destroy()
end)

-- Clicker
Remotes.Clicker.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Clicker" then return end

	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Music
Remotes.Setting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, SettingName, Toggled)
	Player.Data.PlayerData[SettingName].Value = Toggled
end)

-- Rebirth
function Rebirth(Player) -- this will run the action when you passed all requirements for rebirthing
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = 0
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += 1
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += 10 -- gems
end

Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true	
		if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1) then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		else
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1.25) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Pet
function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", Player.UserId)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetName", PetInstance.PetName.Value)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			local character = Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then NewPet:PivotTo(root.CFrame) end
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already equipped
	if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player) <= Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value then return end -- Too many pets equipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = true
	PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, Pet)
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet or not Pet:IsDescendantOf(Player.Data.Pets) then return end
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipAll(Player)
	local pets = Player:FindFirstChild("Data") and Player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not pets then return end
	for _, Pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet:IsA("Folder") or Pet:IsA("Configuration") then
			UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
		end
	end
	LoadEquipped(Player)
end

function EquipAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for equipping a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	else
		EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	end
end

function DeleteAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for deleting a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then UnequipPet(Player, Pet) end -- unequip if it's equipped
	Pet:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Pet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Action, Parameter)
	if Action == "UnequipAll" then
		UnequipAll(Player)
		return
	end
	if type(Parameter) ~= "table" then -- so if this condition is true, then Parameter should be the id of the pet
		local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[Parameter]

		if Action == "Equip" then
			EquipAction(Player, Pet)
		elseif Action == "Delete" then
			DeleteAction(Player, Pet)
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	else -- there are multiple ids
		if Action == "Equip" then -- equip all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				EquipAction(Player, Pet)
			end

		elseif Action == "Delete" then -- delete all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				DeleteAction(Player, Pet)				
			end
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	end
end)

-- Egg
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

function ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

	for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
	end

	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
		return a[2] > b[2]
	end)

	local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

	for _,v in Pets do
		local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
		TotalWeight += Chance
		v[2] = Chance
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0,TotalWeight)

	local Counter = 0
	for _,v in Pets do	
		Counter += v[2]

		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v[1]
		end
	end
end

Remotes.Egg.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Egg, Amount)
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then return end -- cooldown
	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + Amount > Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player) then return end -- max storage

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)

	if not EggInfo then print(Egg.." does not exist!") return end -- egg does not exist!
	if EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then return end -- robux egg

	if Amount == 3 and ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then
		return -- if this is true, it means the player is trying to open a triple egg while there is a gamepass which they don't own
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount
		Player.Data.PlayerData.EggsHatched.Value += Amount
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true

		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()

		local Results = {}

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for i = 1, Amount do
			local PetName = ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier) 

			if not Player.Data.AutoDelete[PetName].Value then -- auto delete
				local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
				NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
				NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
			end

			Results[i] = PetName
		end

		return Results
	end
end

--// Auto Delete
Remotes.AutoDelete.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Pet)
	Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value = not Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
	return Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
end

--// Area
Remotes.Area.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == true then return end
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end)()

	local NextArea = ReplicatedStorage.Areas:FindFirstChild(Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1)
	if not NextArea then return end


	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value < NextArea.Cost.Value then return end

	if NextArea.Cost.Value == -1 then return end -- max area

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= NextArea.Cost.Value
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = tonumber(NextArea.Name)
end)

--// Gemshop
Remotes.GemUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Upgrade)
	if not ReplicatedStorage.GemShop:FindFirstChild(Upgrade) then return end

	local GemUpg = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop[Upgrade]
	local UpgradeTier = Player.Data.PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..Upgrade]

	if UpgradeTier.Value >= GemUpg.Max.Value then return end -- max

	local Cost = GemUpg.Price
	local Price

	if Cost.Exponential.Value then
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value * Cost.IncreasePer.Value ^ UpgradeTier.Value
	else
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value + Cost.IncreasePer.Value * (UpgradeTier.Value+1)
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value >= Price then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Price
		UpgradeTier.Value += 1
	end
end)

--// Server Handler
-- Server info, announcements, shutdown, and server-wide tools.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ServerHandler = {}

function ServerHandler.GetInfo()
	local Info = {
		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AnimationsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Animations")

-- Animations in this set play WITHOUT leg counter-rotation, because their leg
-- keyframes are intentional (kicks, sits, swims, etc.). Everything else gets the
-- counter-rotation applied to keep legs vertical when the torso rotates.
local SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE = {
	["Leg Kick Animation"] = true,
	["Double Jump Backflip Animation"] = true,
	["Driving Steering Animation"] = true,
	["Flying Animation"] = true,
	["Gun Shooting Position Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Hurting Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Item Pickup Animation"] = true,
	["Level Up Celebration Animation"] = true,
	["Seating Animation"] = true,
	["Sliding Animation"] = true,
	["Sneak Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Spell Cast Fireball Animation"] = true,
	["Swimming Animation"] = true,
	["Zombie Walk Animation"] = true,
}

-- Internal class: drives Motor6D.Transform per frame, lerping between keyframes.
local AnimationExecutor = {}
AnimationExecutor.__index = AnimationExecutor

function AnimationExecutor.new(character: Model)
	local self = setmetatable({}, AnimationExecutor)

	self.Character = character
	self.Joints = {}
	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.Connection = nil
	self.IsPlaying = false

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Motor6D") and desc.Part1 then
			self.Joints[desc.Part1.Name] = desc
		elseif desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and desc.Attachment1 then
			local part = desc.Attachment1.Parent
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				self.Joints[part.Name] = desc
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function AnimationExecutor:Stop()
	self.IsPlaying = false
	if self.Connection then
		self.Connection:Disconnect()
		self.Connection = nil
	end
end

function AnimationExecutor:PlayFromTable(animTable, options)
	if self.Connection then self:Stop() end

	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.IsPlaying = true

	options = options or {}
	local counterRotateLegs = options.counterRotateLegs ~= false  -- default true

	local timestamps = {}
	for t, _ in pairs(animTable.Timestamps) do
		table.insert(timestamps, t)
	end
	table.sort(timestamps)

	local maxTime = timestamps[#timestamps]
	local isLooping = animTable.Settings.Loop

	self.Connection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
		if not self.IsPlaying then return end

		self.CurrentTime += dt

		if self.CurrentTime >= maxTime then
			if isLooping then
				self.CurrentTime %= maxTime
			else
				self.CurrentTime = maxTime
				self:Stop()
				return
			end
		end

		local tStart, tEnd = timestamps[1], timestamps[#timestamps]
		for i = 1, #timestamps - 1 do
			if self.CurrentTime >= timestamps[i] and self.CurrentTime < timestamps[i+1] then
				tStart = timestamps[i]
				tEnd = timestamps[i+1]
				break
			end
		end

		local segmentDuration = tEnd - tStart
		local alpha = (segmentDuration > 0) and (self.CurrentTime - tStart) / segmentDuration or 0

		local dataStart = animTable.Timestamps[tStart]
		local dataEnd = animTable.Timestamps[tEnd]

		for partName, joint in pairs(self.Joints) do
			local cfA = dataStart[partName] or joint.Transform
			local cfB = dataEnd[partName] or cfA
			joint.Transform = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
		end

		-- Counter-rotate legs against LowerTorso (only when caller asks for it)
		if counterRotateLegs then
			local lowerTorso = self.Joints["LowerTorso"]
			if lowerTorso then
				local lt = lowerTorso.Transform
				local invRot = (lt - lt.Position):Inverse()
				for _, legName in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg"}) do
					local legJoint = self.Joints[legName]
					if legJoint then
						legJoint.Transform = invRot * legJoint.Transform
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Public API
local AnimationController = {}

local executor = nil
local currentCharacter = nil

local function ensureExecutor()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	-- Re-create the executor if the character changed (respawn, R6/R15 swap, etc.)
	if character ~= currentCharacter then
		currentCharacter = character
		executor = AnimationExecutor.new(character)
	end
	return executor
end

-- Reset on respawn so we don't reuse joints from the old character
Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	executor = nil
	currentCharacter = nil
end)

function AnimationController.Play(animationName)
	local animModule = AnimationsFolder:FindFirstChild(animationName)
	if not animModule then
		warn("AnimationController: no animation named", animationName)
		return
	end
	local exec = ensureExecutor()
	local skipLegFix = SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE[animationName] == true
	exec:PlayFromTable(require(animModule), { counterRotateLegs = not skipLegFix })
end

function AnimationController.Stop()
	if executor then executor:Stop() end
end

return AnimationController

	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},

--------- Main Script ---------

	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

local DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION = 180

local DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER = 1.5

local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",

		},
		{

			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,
			ObjectiveReward = 500,

			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,

	}
	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]
	selected.Duration = normalizeDuration(DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION + math.random(-45, 60))

end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)

end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

		Info.EasingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
		Info.RepeatCount or 0,
		Info.Reverses or false,
		Info.DelayTime or 0
	)
	
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(Object, info, Goal1)
	Tween:Play()
end

function Module.TweenModel(EndCFrame,TI,Model)
	local NewCFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	NewCFrameValue.Value = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(NewCFrameValue,TI,EndCFrame)
	local Connection
	Connection = NewCFrameValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		Model:PivotTo(NewCFrameValue.Value)
	end)
	Tween:Play()
	Tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		NewCFrameValue:Destroy()
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

return Module

--[[
	This script handles the client. 
	
	Contents:
	- ClickButton
	- Overlay (Currency counter)
	- Popups
	- Close Buttons of Frames
	- Buttons on the side
	- Settings
	- Rebirth
	- Shop
	- Pet Inventory
	- Egg Preview (Frame that shows the price etc)
	- Egg Hatching
	- Pet Follow
	- Areas
	- Trading
	- Gem Shop
	- Codes
	- Stats
	- Functions
	
	Only edit if you know what you're doing!
]]

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Loading
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil

if Player.Parent == nil then return end

--// Variables
local Data = Player.Data
local PlayerData = Data.PlayerData

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local Utilities = require(Modules.Utilities)

local UI = Player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("GameUI")
local Frames = UI.Frames

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

--// Clicker
if GameSettings.GameType.Value == "Clicker" then
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(UI.Clicker)

	UI.Clicker.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)

	if GameSettings.ClickingAnywhere.Value then
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
			if Processed then return end
			if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end -- not a left mouse click
			Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Overlay
local CurrencySide = UI[GameSettings.CurrencySide.Value]
CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
end)

CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
PlayerData.Currency2.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
end)


--// Popups
local CurrencyOld = PlayerData.Currency.Value
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function(NewValue)
	task.spawn(function()
		if NewValue > CurrencyOld then
			local NewPopup = script.Popup:Clone()
			NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
			NewPopup.Currency.Image = CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Currency.Image
			NewPopup.Amount.Text = "+"..Utilities.Short.en(NewValue - CurrencyOld)
			NewPopup.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0, math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0) -- sets it in a random position in the middle square
			NewPopup.Parent = UI.Popups
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.176,0,0.105,0), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5)
			task.wait(1)
			NewPopup:TweenPosition(CurrencySide.Position, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.05,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			task.wait(1.4)
			NewPopup:Destroy()

function SortInventory(SortTable, ObjectHolder)
	local TableToSort = SortTable ~= nil and SortTable or PetInventory -- so it can differentiate between trade and normal inventories

	table.sort(TableToSort, function(a,b)
		if not a or not b then return end

		if a.Multiplier ~= b.Multiplier then
			return a.Multiplier > b.Multiplier
		else
			return a.ID > b.ID
		end
	end)

	for Order,PetInfo in TableToSort do
		if not Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetInfo.ID) then
			table.remove(TableToSort, Order)
			continue
		end

		if not ObjectHolder then
			PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		else
			ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		end
	end
end

local CurrentlySelected = 0

function AddPet(PetInstance, SortTable, Parent) -- Creates a pet slot
	task.wait(0.1)
	local NewPet = script.PetTemplate:Clone()

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Parent = NewPet.Display

	local MainPart = PetModel:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	local Pos

	if not MainPart then
		warn(PetModel.Name.." does not have a MainPart, please add one by calling one of the parts 'MainPart'")

		for _,v in PetModel:GetChildren() do -- this here chooses a random part of the pet instead of the mainpart.
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				Pos = v.Position
				break
			end
		end
	else
		Pos = MainPart.Position
	end

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	NewPet.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

	if not Parent then -- normal pet
		NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

		PetInstance.Equipped.Changed:Connect(function()
			NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

			if CurrentlySelected == tonumber(PetInstance.Name) then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			end

			SortInventory()
		end)

		NewPet.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not IsMultiDeleting then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			else
				if not table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)) then
					table.insert(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = true
				else
					table.remove(SelectedForDelete, table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = false
				end
			end
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
	NewPet.Name = PetInstance.Name
	NewPet.Parent = Parent == nil and PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder or Parent

	if SortTable == nil then
		PetInventory[#PetInventory+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	else
		SortTable[#SortTable+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	end

	return NewPet
end

function UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance) -- PetInstance is the folder in Player.Pets

--// Egg Preview
local PreviewFrame = UI.PreviewFrame
local DefaultSize = PreviewFrame.Size
local CurrentTarget = PreviewFrame.CurrentTarget
PreviewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)

function FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable)
	local CurrentClosest, ClosestDistance = nil, 100

	for _,Egg in EggsAvailable do
		local EggModel = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg]
		local mag = (EggModel:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= ClosestDistance then
			CurrentClosest = EggModel
			ClosestDistance = mag
		end
	end
	return CurrentClosest
end

local IsClosing = false -- so it doesnt ruin the animation

function FindEgg()
	if not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Player.Character.Humanoid.Health == 0 then return end

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local EggsAvailable = {}
	local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/11

	for _,Egg in workspace.Map.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if Egg == nil then continue end
		if not Egg:FindFirstChild("EggModel") then warn(Egg.Name.." does not have an EggModel") end

		local mag = (Egg:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= 12 then
			EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = Egg.Name
		end
	end

	local SetVisibility = #EggsAvailable >= 1 -- if its 0 then its already false

	if SetVisibility then -- a egg(s) is in distance
		local Egg = #EggsAvailable > 1 and FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable) or workspace.Map.Eggs[EggsAvailable[1]]
		local WSP = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg:GetPivot().Position)
		PreviewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
		CurrentTarget.Value = Egg.Name
	else
		CurrentTarget.Value = "None"
	end

	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then
		SetVisibility = false -- if you are opening an egg itll auto close the previewframe
	end

	--// Make the previewframe visible
	if SetVisibility and not PreviewFrame.Visible then
		PreviewFrame.Visible = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(DefaultSize.X.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.X.Offset, DefaultSize.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.Y.Offset)})	
	elseif not SetVisibility and PreviewFrame.Visible and not IsClosing then -- set to invisible, while is visible & isnt closing
		IsClosing = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)})	
		task.wait(0.15)
		PreviewFrame.Visible = false
		IsClosing = false
	end
end

function UpdatePreviewFrame()
	if CurrentTarget.Value ~= "None" then
		local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value
		PreviewFrame.EggInfo.EggName.Text = Egg

		if not ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg) then print(Egg.." does not have settings in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs!") return end

		local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]

		local IsRobuxEgg = EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId")
		if IsRobuxEgg then
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs \u{E002}"..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		else
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs "..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		end

		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Triple.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg
		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Auto.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg

		--// This part gets the pet chances
		local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

		for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
		end

		table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
			return a[2] > b[2]
		end)

		local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for _,v in Pets do
			local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
			TotalWeight += Chance
			v[2] = Chance
		end

		for i = 1,9 do
			local PetInfo = Pets[i]
			local PetSlot = PreviewFrame.PetChances.List["Pet"..i]
			PetSlot.Visible = PetInfo ~= nil

			if PetInfo == nil then continue end

			PetSlot.Rarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]].Settings.Rarity.Value
			PetSlot.Percentage.Text = Utilities.Short.en(100/TotalWeight * PetInfo[2]).."%"
			PetSlot.Delete.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[PetInfo[1]].Value
			PetSlot.PetName.Value = PetInfo[1]

			local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]]:Clone()
			PetModel.Parent = PetSlot.Pet

			local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
			local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
			PetSlot.Pet.CurrentCamera = Camera
			PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
		end
	end
end

local IsAutoOpening = false

function HatchEgg(Egg: string, Result: string, Offset:number)
	local OpeningTime = 3

	local NewViewport = script.EggViewport:Clone()
	NewViewport.Parent = UI.OpenEgg

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 15
	Frames.Visible = false
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = false

	local Clone = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg].EggModel:Clone()
	Clone:ScaleTo(0.5)
	Clone.Parent = workspace

	local Rot, X, Y, Z = Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue")
	Rot.Value = 30 Z.Value = -4 X.Value = 10

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 1.5
	PL.Parent = Clone.Egg

	Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z))
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local TweenIn = TweenService:Create(X, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = Offset})
	TweenIn:Play()

	local RotTweenIn = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 0})
	RotTweenIn:Play()

	-- add an audio for the egg flying in
	TweenIn.Completed:Wait()

	local Eggdelay = 0.075
	for i = 1,(OpeningTime * 1.5) + 1 do
		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 6})
		Tween:Play()
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -6})
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween:Play()
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		Eggdelay -= .005
	end

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()	
	Clone:Destroy()	

	-- Now we're going to show the pet

	local PetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result]:Clone()
	PetModel:ScaleTo(0.6)
	PetModel.Parent = workspace

	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[Result].Value
	NewViewport.PetName.Text = Result
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = true
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Text = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result].Settings.Rarity.Value
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = true

	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 2
	PL.Parent = PetModel.MainPart

	X.Value = Offset Y.Value = 0 Z.Value = -4 Rot.Value = 175
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	task.wait(OpeningTime*0.25)

	NewViewport:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(NewViewport.Position.X.Scale, 0, NewViewport.Position.Y.Scale + 10, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, OpeningTime * 0.1)
	TweenService:Create(Y, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -5}):Play()
	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = false
	task.wait(OpeningTime * 0.15)

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()

Remotes.Egg.OnClientInvoke = HatchEgg

function SingleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return end

	if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then
		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 1)

		if Result ~= nil then
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end
	else
		MarketPlaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Player, EggInfo.ProductId.Value)
	end
end

function TripleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 3)

	if Result ~= nil then
		for i = 1,#Result do
			coroutine.wrap(function()
				local Position = (i - 2) * 3
				HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
			end)()
		end
	end
end

local function ChooseEggAmount(Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return 1 end

	local EggAmount = 1

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then 
		return EggAmount
	end -- triple egg is a gamepass that the player doesn't own, so open 1 egg

	if PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * 3 then
		EggAmount = 3
	end

	return EggAmount
end

function AutoEgg()
	if IsAutoOpening then return end

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("AutoEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value then 
		MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value)
		return
	end

	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value	
	IsAutoOpening = true

	while true do
		if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then task.wait(0.1) continue end -- player is already opening an egg

		if CurrentTarget.Value == "None" or CurrentTarget.Value ~= Egg then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, ChooseEggAmount(Egg))

		if Result == nil then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		if #Result > 1 then
			for i = 1,#Result do
				coroutine.wrap(function()
					local Position = (i - 2) * 3
					HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
				end)()
			end
		else
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

--// Pet Follow
-- Credits to azypro777 for helping out with this part!
local Spacing, PetSize, MaxClimbHeight = 5, 3, 6

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
local RayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -500, 0)

local TempPets = Instance.new("Folder")
TempPets.Name = "PlayerPets"
TempPets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then -- Show pets is false
		-- put the pets in "TempPets"
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end
			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end
	end
end

		local R = v.Reward

		if R.Exponential.Value then
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Reward
		else
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Reward
		end
	end

		local C = v.Price

		if C.Exponential.Value then

		else
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value + C.IncreasePer.Value * (PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value+1)

			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(CalcCost())
		else
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > Max"
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = "Max"
		end
	end

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

-- HELPERS

	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN
