--// Players Handler
-- View player data, modify stats, kick, manage pets/gamepasses.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayersHandler = {}

function PlayersHandler.FindPlayer(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	Name = string.lower(Name)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == Name or string.lower(Player.DisplayName) == Name then
			return Player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayersHandler.ListPlayers()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local PD = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
			petCount = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("Pets") and #Data.Pets:GetChildren() or 0,
			currency = PD and PD.Currency.Value or 0,
			gems = PD and PD.Currency2.Value or 0,
			rebirths = PD and PD.Rebirth.Value or 0,
			zone = PD and PD.BestZone.Value or 0,
			eggsHatched = PD and PD.EggsHatched.Value or 0,
			totalCurrency = PD and PD.TotalCurrency.Value or 0,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function()
				local NSV = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues")
				return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false
			end)(),
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PlayersHandler.GetPlayerData(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return nil end
	local Data = Player.Data
	local PD = Data.PlayerData
	local GP = Data.Gamepasses

	local Gamepasses = {}
	for _, Value in GP:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
			Gamepasses[Value.Name] = Value.Value
		end
	end

	local Pets = {}
	for _, Pet in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Pets[#Pets + 1] = {
			id = Pet.Name,
			name = Pet.PetName.Value,
			equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end

	local AutoDelete = {}
	for _, AD in Data.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if AD:IsA("BoolValue") then
			AutoDelete[AD.Name] = AD.Value
		end
	end

	local GemShop = {}
	local GemShopFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if GemShopFolder then
		for _, Upgrade in GemShopFolder:GetChildren() do
			local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
			local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
			local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
			local CurrentLevel = PD:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. Upgrade.Name)
			GemShop[#GemShop + 1] = {
				id = Upgrade.Name,
				name = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or ("Upgrade " .. Upgrade.Name),
				level = CurrentLevel and CurrentLevel.Value or 0,
				max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		name = Player.Name,
		displayName = Player.DisplayName,
		userId = Player.UserId,
		accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
		loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
		isTrading = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsTrading"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		isOpeningEgg = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsOpeningEgg"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		petsEquipped = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("PetsEquipped"); return V and V.Value or 0 end)(),

		currency = PD.Currency.Value,
		gems = PD.Currency2.Value,
		rebirths = PD.Rebirth.Value,
		zone = PD.BestZone.Value,
		eggsHatched = PD.EggsHatched.Value,
		totalCurrency = PD.TotalCurrency.Value,
		gemUpgrade1 = PD.GemUpgrade1.Value,
		gemUpgrade2 = PD.GemUpgrade2.Value,

		music = PD.Music.Value,
		showOtherPets = PD.ShowOtherPets.Value,

		gamepasses = Gamepasses,
		pets = Pets,
		petCount = #Pets,
		autoDelete = AutoDelete,
		gemShop = GemShop,

		maxStorage = 50
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage1 and 50 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage2 and 250 or 0),
		maxEquipped = 5
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets1 and 3 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets2 and 10 or 0),
	}
end

function PlayersHandler.SetValue(Value, NewValue)
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false end
		Value.Value = Num
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function PlayersHandler.SetCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = Num
	return true, "Set currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
	Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value = Num
	return true, "Set gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetRebirths(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value = Num
	return true, "Set rebirths"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetZone(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = Num
	return true, "Set zone"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGemUpgrade(Player, Slot, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local S = tonumber(Slot)
	local A = tonumber(Amount)
	if not S or not A then return false, "Invalid input" end
	local Value = Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. S)
	if not Value then return false, "Upgrade not found" end
	Value.Value = A
	return true, "Set gem upgrade " .. S
end

function PlayersHandler.ToggleGamepass(Player, Name, State)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Value = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Value then return false, "Gamepass not found" end
	Value.Value = (State == true or State == "true")
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Value.Value)
end

function PlayersHandler.KickPlayer(Player, Reason)
	if not Player then return false, "Player not found" end
	local R = tostring(Reason or "Kicked by admin")
	if R == "" then R = "Kicked by admin" end
	Player:Kick(R)
	return true, "Kicked " .. Player.Name
end

return PlayersHandler

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local tagName = "GMHeadTag"
local glowName = "GMHeadGlow"
local tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 54)
local tagHex = "#FFDD36"

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = glowName
	glow.Adornee = head
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
	glow.Parent = character

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = tagName
	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Text = "GM"
	label.TextColor3 = tagColor
	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
	label.Parent = billboard

	local textTween = TweenService:Create(
		label,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 150), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55}
	)
	textTween:Play()
end

local function refresh()
	if player.Character then addTag(player.Character) end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsGM"):Connect(refresh)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	addTag(character)
end)

TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.PrefixText = string.format("<font color='%s'>[GM]</font> %s", tagHex, message.PrefixText)
		end
	end
	return properties
end

TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = function(message, adornee)
	local properties = Instance.new("BubbleChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 8)
			properties.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 125)
			properties.TextSize = 18
			properties.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
			properties.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
			properties.TailVisible = true
		end
	end
	return properties
end

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

return StaminaSystem

	Number += 1

	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

local ADMINRANK = 254 -- What rank in group for admin


--// MAIN SCRIPT
local AdminFunctions = {}

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// General
function AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, AdminList) -- checks if user is allowed to use commands
	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK
	else
		return CreatorId == Player.UserId
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == PlayerName then
			return Player
		end
	end
end

--// Stats
function AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(Player, StatName)
	for _, Stat in Player.Data:GetDescendants() do
		if string.lower(Stat.Name) == StatName then
			return Stat
		end
	end
end

--// Pets
function AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(Player, PetName)
	for _, Pet in ReplicatedStorage.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if string.lower(Pet.Name) == PetName then
			return Pet
		end
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

return AdminFunctions

local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Trading

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

local TradeOffers = {} -- table with trade offers of the players inside

Remotes.RequestTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Player has clicked on "Send Trade" button
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return "Player has not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "Player is in trade" end
	-- You can also add requirements here for trading, such as 250 eggs opened

	--// Make a button pop up in their ui
	Remotes.RequestTrade:InvokeClient(Player2, Player.Name)	
end

Remotes.StartTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Starting trade
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return end

	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true

	TradeOffers[Player.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}} -- creates the inventory during the trade
	TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}}

	Remotes.StartTrade:InvokeClient(Player2,Player.Name) -- player 2 knows the trade started
	return true
end

Remotes.ChangeOffer.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)
	
	if Args.OfferType == "Pet" then
		if not TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] then
			if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player2) <= #Player2.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + #TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets then return "Max" end
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = 1
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2,"PetAdded", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Added"
		else
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = nil
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "PetRemoved", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Removed"
		end
	elseif Args.OfferType == "TradeTokens" then
		if tonumber(Args.Amount) and tonumber(Args.Amount) >= 0 then
			if not Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then return end -- 
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < tonumber(Args.Amount) then return end -- not enough tokens

			TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens = tonumber(Args.Amount)
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "TradeTokens", tonumber(Args.Amount))
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		end
	end
end

Remotes.TradeAction.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		TradeOffers[Player.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data to free up space
		TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data, if the player left it does not matter as it should still be removed

		if Player2 then -- incase the player left, you dont edit the data. If they did not, edit the data
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Cancel"})
		end

		return true
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- makes player ready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = true

			if Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- both are ready
				local Active = true

				--// Countdown Timer
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				
				local function BothReady()
					return Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value and Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value
				end
				
				local function CancelCountdown()
					Active = false 
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
				end
				
				for i = 10, 1, -1 do
					if not BothReady() then 
						CancelCountdown()
						break 
					end
					task.wait(0.3)	
				end
				
				if not BothReady() then
					CancelCountdown()
				end
			
				if not Active then return end
				
				print("Completing Trade")
				CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
			else
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Ready"})
				return "Ready"
			end
		else --// unready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Unready"})
			return "Unready"
		end		
	end
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already unequipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			NewPet:PivotTo(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)			
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false

	--// Player 1 to Player 2
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player, ClonedPet)
		end
		
		ClonedPet.Parent = Player2.Data.Pets
	end

	--// Player 2 to Player 1
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player2.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player2.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player2, ClonedPet)
		end

		ClonedPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	
	LoadEquipped(Player)
	LoadEquipped(Player2)

	if Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then -- like gems or smth exist
		Player2.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens -- for example u get 400 u give 150
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens
	end
end

--// Server Handler
-- Server info, announcements, shutdown, and server-wide tools.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ServerHandler = {}

function ServerHandler.GetInfo()
	local Info = {
		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--// Players Handler
-- View player data, modify stats, kick, manage pets/gamepasses.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayersHandler = {}

function PlayersHandler.FindPlayer(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	Name = string.lower(Name)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == Name or string.lower(Player.DisplayName) == Name then
			return Player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayersHandler.ListPlayers()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local PD = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
			petCount = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("Pets") and #Data.Pets:GetChildren() or 0,
			currency = PD and PD.Currency.Value or 0,
			gems = PD and PD.Currency2.Value or 0,
			rebirths = PD and PD.Rebirth.Value or 0,
			zone = PD and PD.BestZone.Value or 0,
			eggsHatched = PD and PD.EggsHatched.Value or 0,
			totalCurrency = PD and PD.TotalCurrency.Value or 0,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function()
				local NSV = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues")
				return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false
			end)(),
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PlayersHandler.GetPlayerData(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return nil end
	local Data = Player.Data
	local PD = Data.PlayerData
	local GP = Data.Gamepasses

	local Gamepasses = {}
	for _, Value in GP:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
			Gamepasses[Value.Name] = Value.Value
		end
	end

	local Pets = {}
	for _, Pet in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Pets[#Pets + 1] = {
			id = Pet.Name,
			name = Pet.PetName.Value,
			equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end

	local AutoDelete = {}
	for _, AD in Data.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if AD:IsA("BoolValue") then
			AutoDelete[AD.Name] = AD.Value
		end
	end

	local GemShop = {}
	local GemShopFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if GemShopFolder then
		for _, Upgrade in GemShopFolder:GetChildren() do
			local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
			local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
			local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
			local CurrentLevel = PD:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. Upgrade.Name)
			GemShop[#GemShop + 1] = {
				id = Upgrade.Name,
				name = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or ("Upgrade " .. Upgrade.Name),
				level = CurrentLevel and CurrentLevel.Value or 0,
				max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		name = Player.Name,
		displayName = Player.DisplayName,
		userId = Player.UserId,
		accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
		loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
		isTrading = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsTrading"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		isOpeningEgg = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsOpeningEgg"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		petsEquipped = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("PetsEquipped"); return V and V.Value or 0 end)(),

		currency = PD.Currency.Value,
		gems = PD.Currency2.Value,
		rebirths = PD.Rebirth.Value,
		zone = PD.BestZone.Value,
		eggsHatched = PD.EggsHatched.Value,
		totalCurrency = PD.TotalCurrency.Value,
		gemUpgrade1 = PD.GemUpgrade1.Value,
		gemUpgrade2 = PD.GemUpgrade2.Value,

		music = PD.Music.Value,
		showOtherPets = PD.ShowOtherPets.Value,

		gamepasses = Gamepasses,
		pets = Pets,
		petCount = #Pets,
		autoDelete = AutoDelete,
		gemShop = GemShop,

		maxStorage = 50
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage1 and 50 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage2 and 250 or 0),
		maxEquipped = 5
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets1 and 3 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets2 and 10 or 0),
	}
end

function PlayersHandler.SetValue(Value, NewValue)
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false end
		Value.Value = Num
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function PlayersHandler.SetCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = Num
	return true, "Set currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
	Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value = Num
	return true, "Set gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetRebirths(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value = Num
	return true, "Set rebirths"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetZone(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = Num
	return true, "Set zone"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGemUpgrade(Player, Slot, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local S = tonumber(Slot)
	local A = tonumber(Amount)
	if not S or not A then return false, "Invalid input" end
	local Value = Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. S)
	if not Value then return false, "Upgrade not found" end
	Value.Value = A
	return true, "Set gem upgrade " .. S
end

function PlayersHandler.ToggleGamepass(Player, Name, State)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Value = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Value then return false, "Gamepass not found" end
	Value.Value = (State == true or State == "true")
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Value.Value)
end

function PlayersHandler.KickPlayer(Player, Reason)
	if not Player then return false, "Player not found" end
	local R = tostring(Reason or "Kicked by admin")
	if R == "" then R = "Kicked by admin" end
	Player:Kick(R)
	return true, "Kicked " .. Player.Name
end

return PlayersHandler

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test
--  • Studio project information
--  • Script count
--  • Pending changes
--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK
--  • Verification
--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and
-- report that Studio is asking for permission.
----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
------------------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
------------------------------------------------------------

local CONFIG = {
	PLUGIN_NAME = "Squeeze",
	VERSION = "6.0.0",

	-- CHANGE THIS
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio",

	-- Optional local bridge.
	-- Leave empty if you don't have one yet.
	LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:32145",

	HEALTH_ENDPOINT = "/health",
	AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/auto-connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/heartbeat",
	PULL_ENDPOINT = "/files/pull",
	ACK_ENDPOINT = "/ack",
	DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/disconnect",
	SNAPSHOT_ENDPOINT = "/project/snapshot",

	HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5,
	RECONNECT_INTERVAL = 5,
	PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 3,

	MAX_LOG_LINES = 300,

	-- Permission test object.
	PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER = "__SQUEEZE_PERMISSION_TEST__",
	PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT = "__SQUEEZE_SCRIPT_TEST__",
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------

type Change = {
	changeId: string?,
	eventId: string?,
	path: string?,
	source: string?,
	className: string?,
	action: string?,
	operation: string?,
	version: number?,
	name: string?,
	parentPath: string?,
	newName: string?,
	newParentPath: string?,
	property: string?,
	value: any?,
	attribute: string?,
	properties: {[string]: any}?,
	attributes: {[string]: any}?,
}

type Session = {
	token: string,
	sessionId: string,
	projectId: string,
	projectName: string,

	status: string,
	connected: boolean,

	lastHeartbeat: number,
	lastSync: number,

	pendingChanges: number,

	reconnecting: boolean,
}

type Permissions = {
	httpBackend: boolean,
	httpLocalBridge: boolean,
	scriptEditorRead: boolean,
	scriptEditorWrite: boolean,
	instanceWrite: boolean,
	changeHistory: boolean,
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local destroyed = false
local busy = false
local heartbeatRunning = false
local reconnectRunning = false
local previewRunning = false

local session: Session = {
	token = "",
	sessionId = "",
	projectId = "",
	projectName = "",

	status = "Starting",
	connected = false,

	lastHeartbeat = 0,
	lastSync = 0,

	pendingChanges = 0,

	reconnecting = false,
}

local permissions: Permissions = {
	httpBackend = false,
	httpLocalBridge = false,
	scriptEditorRead = false,
	scriptEditorWrite = false,
	instanceWrite = false,
	changeHistory = false,
}

local pendingChanges: {Change} = {}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- COLORS
------------------------------------------------------------

local COLORS = {
	BACKGROUND = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26),
	PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(29, 32, 38),
	PANEL_2 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 39, 46),

	TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(238, 240, 244),
	MUTED = Color3.fromRGB(155, 160, 172),

	GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(75, 208, 105),
	YELLOW = Color3.fromRGB(238, 188, 58),
	RED = Color3.fromRGB(235, 82, 88),
	BLUE = Color3.fromRGB(90, 165, 255),

	BUTTON = Color3.fromRGB(53, 57, 65),
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOOLBAR
------------------------------------------------------------

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar(
	CONFIG.PLUGIN_NAME
)

local toolbarButton = toolbar:CreateButton(
	"SqueezeStudio",
	"Open Squeeze Studio",
	"",
	"Squeeze"
)

toolbarButton.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

------------------------------------------------------------
-- DOCK WIDGET
------------------------------------------------------------

local widgetInfo = DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(
	Enum.InitialDockState.Float,
	false,
	false,
	430,
	560,
	350,
	440
)

local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGuiAsync(
	"SqueezeStudio",
	widgetInfo
)

widget.Title = "Squeeze Studio"
widget.Enabled = false

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ROOT
------------------------------------------------------------

local root = Instance.new("Frame")
root.Name = "Root"
root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
root.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.BACKGROUND
root.BorderSizePixel = 0
root.Parent = widget

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEADER
------------------------------------------------------------

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64)
header.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.BACKGROUND
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = root

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Squeeze Studio"
title.TextColor3 = COLORS.TEXT
title.TextSize = 18
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = header

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 35)
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 20)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "● Starting..."
statusLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.YELLOW
statusLabel.TextSize = 12
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = header

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PROJECT CARD
------------------------------------------------------------

local projectCard = Instance.new("Frame")

local function addLog(
	message: string,
	color: Color3?
)
	local count = 0

	for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count >= CONFIG.MAX_LOG_LINES then
		for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text =
		"[" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "] "
		.. message
	label.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.MUTED
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = logs
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end
