--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

--// Function for handling buttons

local ButtonHandler = {}

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local function BlurAnimation(Transparency)
	Tween.Tween(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameUI.Blur, {Speed = 0.25}, {BackgroundTransparency=Transparency})
end

ButtonHandler.OnClick = function(Frame,Size)	
	if not Frame.Visible then
		--// Close other frames
		for _,OtherFrame in Frame.Parent:GetChildren() do
			if OtherFrame:IsA("Frame") and OtherFrame.Visible then
				OtherFrame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.1, true)
				task.wait(0.04)
				OtherFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end

		--// Open frame

		Frame.Size = Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.1)
		Frame.Visible = true
		Frame:TweenSize(Size, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		BlurAnimation(0.4)
	else
		--// Close the frame

		BlurAnimation(1)
		Frame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		Frame.Visible = false
	end
end

return ButtonHandler

-- In this module you can find things like Rebirth Multiplier. By using code such as Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player) returns a number which is that player's multiplier. Useful if you have multipliers in multiple scripts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]

local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Multipliers = {}

function Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = 1
	
	if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
		Multi *= (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value * GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1) -- so multi = RebirthMulti + 1
	else
		Multi *= (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 0.5) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value
	end
	
	return Multi	
end

function Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = GameSettings.CurrencyMultiplier.Value
	Multi *= (Player.Data.Gamepasses.DoubleCurrency.Value and 2 or 1)
	Multi *= Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	Multi *= PetMultipliers.ReadPlayerMultiplier(Player.Name)
	
	local R = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop["2"].Reward
	if R.Exponential.Value then
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	else
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	end
	
	return Multi
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player)
	return 5
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets1"].Value and 3 or 0)
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets2"].Value and 10 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	return 50 + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage1"].Value and 50 or 0) + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage2"].Value and 250 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)
	return 1 * (Player.Data.Gamepasses.Lucky.Value and 2 or 1)
end

return Multipliers

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test
--  • Studio project information
--  • Script count
--  • Pending changes
--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK
--  • Verification
--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and
-- report that Studio is asking for permission.
----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
------------------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
------------------------------------------------------------

local CONFIG = {
	PLUGIN_NAME = "Squeeze",
	VERSION = "6.0.0",

	-- CHANGE THIS
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio",

	-- Optional local bridge.
	-- Leave empty if you don't have one yet.
	LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:32145",

	HEALTH_ENDPOINT = "/health",
	AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/auto-connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/heartbeat",
	PULL_ENDPOINT = "/files/pull",
	ACK_ENDPOINT = "/ack",
	DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/disconnect",
	SNAPSHOT_ENDPOINT = "/project/snapshot",

	HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5,
	RECONNECT_INTERVAL = 5,
	PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 3,

	MAX_LOG_LINES = 300,

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------

type Change = {
	changeId: string?,
	eventId: string?,
	path: string?,
	source: string?,
	className: string?,
	action: string?,
	operation: string?,
	version: number?,
	name: string?,
	parentPath: string?,
	newName: string?,
	newParentPath: string?,
	property: string?,
	value: any?,
	attribute: string?,
	properties: {[string]: any}?,
	attributes: {[string]: any}?,
}

type Session = {
	token: string,
	sessionId: string,
	projectId: string,
	projectName: string,

	status: string,
	connected: boolean,

	lastHeartbeat: number,
	lastSync: number,

	pendingChanges: number,

	reconnecting: boolean,
}

type Permissions = {
	httpBackend: boolean,
	httpLocalBridge: boolean,
	scriptEditorRead: boolean,
	scriptEditorWrite: boolean,
	instanceWrite: boolean,
	changeHistory: boolean,
}

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

logPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

local function addLog(
	message: string,
	color: Color3?
)
	local count = 0

	for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count >= CONFIG.MAX_LOG_LINES then
		for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text =
		"[" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "] "
		.. message
	label.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.MUTED
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = logs
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATUS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3
)

	statusLabel.Text = "● " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateUI()
	projectNameLabel.Text =
		session.projectName ~= ""
		and session.projectName
		or "Not connected"

	placeLabel.Text =
		"Place: "
		.. game.Name
		.. " / "
		.. tostring(game.PlaceId)

	local scriptCount = 0

	for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			scriptCount += 1
		end
	end

	scriptsLabel.Text =
		"Scripts: "
		.. tostring(scriptCount)

	pendingLabel.Text =
		"Pending: "
		.. tostring(session.pendingChanges)

	if session.lastSync > 0 then
		syncLabel.Text =
			"Last sync: "
			.. os.date("%H:%M:%S")
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: HTTP BACKEND
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testBackendHTTP(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing HTTP access to backend...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.HEALTH_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpBackend = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Backend HTTP permission/access failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown error"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpBackend = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Backend HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: LOCAL BRIDGE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testLocalBridgeHTTP(): boolean
	if CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL == "" then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge disabled in configuration.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	addLog(
		"Testing localhost bridge...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL,
			"GET",
			"/health",
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge unavailable.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpLocalBridge = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Local Bridge HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR READ
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorRead(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing ScriptEditorService read access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local temporaryScript: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			local folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			local module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return true"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			temporaryScript =
			module

			local result =
			ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				module
			)

			if typeof(result) ~= "string" then
				error(
					"GetEditorSource returned invalid value."
				)
			end
		end)

	if temporaryScript then
		temporaryScript.Parent = nil
		temporaryScript:Destroy()
	end

	local testFolder =
		game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		:FindFirstChild(
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER
		)

	if testFolder then
		testFolder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorRead = false

		addLog(
			"✗ ScriptEditorService read permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.scriptEditorRead = true

	addLog(
		"✓ ScriptEditorService read access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR WRITE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorWrite(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing Script Injection / ScriptEditor write access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local folder: Folder? = nil
	local module: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return 1"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			local successUpdate =
			pcall(function()
				ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
					module :: ModuleScript,
					function()
						return "return 2"
					end
				)
			end)

			if not successUpdate then
				error(
					"ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync was rejected."
				)
			end
		end)

	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorWrite = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(source)
	end

	return true, source
end

local function writeScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.scriptEditorWrite then
		return false,
			"Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission is not enabled."
	end

	local ok, err =
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
				scriptInstance,
				function()
					return source
				end
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
------------------------------------------------------------

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Sync Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"⚠ %d/%d applied. %d failed.",
				applied,
				total,
				failed
			),
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	updateUI()

	syncButton.Text =
		"Sync All"

	busy = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled =
		not widget.Enabled
end)

permissionsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		checkAllPermissions()
	end)
end)

syncButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		syncAll()
	end)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
------------------------------------------------------------

addLog(
	"Squeeze Studio Plugin initialized.",
	COLORS.TEXT
)

addLog(
	"Running permission diagnostics...",
	COLORS.BLUE
)

updateUI()

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	checkAllPermissions()

	if permissions.httpBackend then
		local connected =
			autoConnect()

		if connected then
			startHeartbeat()
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

startReconnectLoop()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UNLOAD
------------------------------------------------------------

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	destroyed = true

	if session.token ~= "" then
		pcall(function()
			request(
				CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
				"POST",
				CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					reason = "Plugin unloaded",
				}
			)
		end)
	end

	session.token = ""
	session.connected = false
end)

print(
	"[Squeeze Studio] v"
		.. CONFIG.VERSION
		.. " loaded."
)

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

    --------------------------------------------

-- STATUS
--------------------------------------------------

statusLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.RED
statusLabel.TextSize = 13
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- BOTTOM CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------

local bottom = Instance.new("Frame")
bottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
bottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -40)
bottom.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bottom.Parent = content

local logsButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
logsButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30)
logsButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 5)
logsButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.BUTTON
logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
logsButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
logsButton.TextSize = 12
logsButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
logsButton.Parent = bottom

local logsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
logsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
logsCorner.Parent = logsButton

--------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------

local function log(...)
	if not logsEnabled then
		return
	end

	print("[Lemonade WebSync]", ...)
end

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN,
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		connectButton.Text = "Connect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.RED

		setStatus(
			"Offline",
			COLORS.RED,
			COLORS.RED
		)
	end
end

local function updateLastSync()
	lastSyncText = os.date("%X")

	syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: " .. lastSyncText
end

local function getProjectName(): string
	local gameName = game:GetAttribute("GameName")

	if typeof(gameName) == "string" and gameName ~= "" then
		return gameName
	end

	return game.Name
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP HELPER
--------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	method: string,
	path: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)

	local url = CONFIG.BACKEND_URL .. path

	local requestData = {
		Url = url,
		Method = method,
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		},
	}

	if sessionToken then
		requestData.Headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. sessionToken
	end

	if body ~= nil then
		requestData.Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
	end

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync(requestData)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP error:", response)
		return false, nil
	end

	if not response.Success then
		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP status:",
			response.StatusCode,
			response.StatusMessage
		)

		return false, response
	end

	local decoded = nil

	if response.Body and response.Body ~= "" then
		local decodeSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
		end)

		if decodeSuccess then
			decoded = result
		end
	end

	return true, decoded
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function connectToBackend()

	if connecting then
		return
	end

	if connected then
		return
	end

	connecting = true

	connectButton.Text = "Connecting..."
	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW,
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	log("Connecting to backend...")

	local success, response = request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectName = getProjectName(),
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "2.3",
			studioName = "Roblox Studio",
		}
	)

	if success and response then

		sessionToken = response.token
		projectId = response.projectId

		if typeof(response.prompts) == "number" then
			promptCount = response.prompts
			promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: " .. tostring(promptCount)
		end

		setConnectedState(true)
		updateLastSync()

		projectLabel.Text =
			"Project: " ..
			(response.projectName or "ok")

		log("Connected successfully.")
	else

		setConnectedState(false)

		connectButton.Text = "Connect"

		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] Failed to connect."
		)
	end

	connecting = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DISCONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function disconnectFromBackend()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	log("Disconnecting...")

	request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectId = projectId,
		}
	)

	sessionToken = nil
	projectId = nil

	setConnectedState(false)

	log("Disconnected.")
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while true do

		task.wait(CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)

		if connected and sessionToken then

			local success = request(
				"POST",
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					projectId = projectId,
					projectName = getProjectName(),
					placeId = game.PlaceId,
				}
			)

			if success then
				updateLastSync()
			else
				warn(
					"[Lemonade WebSync] Heartbeat failed."
				)
			end
		end
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PLUGIN BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()

	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled

	if widget.Enabled then
		log("Widget opened.")
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLOSE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

connectButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if connected then
		disconnectFromBackend()
	else
		connectToBackend()
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOG TOGGLE
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	logsEnabled = not logsEnabled

	if logsEnabled then
		logsButton.Text = "Logs On"
	else
		logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL UI
--------------------------------------------------

projectLabel.Text = "Project: " .. getProjectName()
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"

setConnectedState(false)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SELECTION DEBUG
--------------------------------------------------

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	local selected = Selection:Get()

	log(
		"Selection changed:",
		#selected
	)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
--------------------------------------------------

print("[Lemonade WebSync] Plugin Loaded")
print("Project:", getProjectName())
print("PlaceId:", game.PlaceId)

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local tagName = "GMHeadTag"
local glowName = "GMHeadGlow"
local tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 54)

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")

	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
	glow.Parent = character

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = tagName
	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Text = "GM"
	label.TextColor3 = tagColor
	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
	label.Parent = billboard

	local textTween = TweenService:Create(
		label,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 150), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55}
	)
	textTween:Play()
end

local function refresh()
	if player.Character then addTag(player.Character) end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsGM"):Connect(refresh)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	addTag(character)
end)

	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.PrefixText = string.format("<font color='%s'>[GM]</font> %s", tagHex, message.PrefixText)
		end
	end
	return properties
end

TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = function(message, adornee)
	local properties = Instance.new("BubbleChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 8)
			properties.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 125)
			properties.TextSize = 18
			properties.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
			properties.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
			properties.TailVisible = true
		end
	end
	return properties
end

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")
local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION = 180
local DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER = 0.65
local DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER = 2
local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 25,
			ObjectiveReward = 250,
			ExclusivePet = "Event Rush Pet",
			SpawnMultiplier = DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER,
			RewardMultiplier = DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			HealthMultiplier = DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER,
		},
		{
			Name = "Golden Paws",
			Description = "Scavenge together to fill the golden paw meter.",
			ObjectiveType = "Scavenge",
			ObjectiveText = "Scavenge 40 times as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 40,
			ObjectiveReward = 350,
			ExclusiveEgg = "Golden Paws Egg",
			SpawnMultiplier = 1.2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,
			ObjectiveReward = 500,
			ExclusivePet = "Wild Companion",
			SpawnMultiplier = 2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.5,
			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,
			HealthMultiplier = 1.5,
		},
	}
	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]
	selected.Duration = normalizeDuration(DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION + math.random(-45, 60))
	WorldEventService.Start(selected)
end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)
StateChanged.OnServerEvent:Connect(function() end)

WorldEventService.Publish()
task.delay(10, beginDynamicEvent)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		local state = WorldEventService.GetState()
		if state.Active and os.time() >= state.EndsAt then
			WorldEventService.End()
			task.delay(math.random(30, 60), beginDynamicEvent)
		end
	end
end)

		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

		New("TextLabel", {

				TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
				BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Green,

--// Open / Close

	RefreshBrowse()
	RefreshList()
	RefreshMyListings()
	RefreshInbox()
end

Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
end)

local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
local ButtonTemplate = nil
for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if Child:IsA("Frame") then
		ButtonTemplate = Child
		break
	end
end

local OpenButton
if ButtonTemplate then
	OpenButton = ButtonTemplate:Clone()
else
	OpenButton = New("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.08),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.9),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
	})
	New("TextButton", {
		Text = "Auction",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, OpenButton)
end

OpenButton.Name = "AuctionHouse"
OpenButton:SetAttribute("AuctionButton", true)

if OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Title") then
	OpenButton.Title.Text = "Auction"
end

--// Position: find the last existing button BEFORE parenting the clone,
-- otherwise the clone is its own "last child" and ends up overlapping it.
local HasLayout = ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") ~= nil
	or ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout") ~= nil

local LastButton = nil
if not HasLayout then
	for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA("Frame") then LastButton = Child end
	end
end

OpenButton.Parent = ButtonSide.Buttons
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(OpenButton)

if HasLayout then
	OpenButton.LayoutOrder = 999
elseif LastButton then
	OpenButton.Position = UDim2.new(LastButton.Position.X.Scale, LastButton.Position.X.Offset, LastButton.Position.Y.Scale + LastButton.Size.Y.Scale + 0.01, LastButton.Position.Y.Offset)
end

local OpenClick = OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Click") or OpenButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
if OpenClick then
	OpenClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
		RefreshAll()
	end)
end

--// Notifications
AuctionNotice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Kind, Value)
	if Kind == "sold" then
		if Value > 0 then
			ShowNotice("Your pet sold for " .. Short.en(Value) .. " gems!", Colors.Green)
		end
		RefreshInbox()
		RefreshMyListings()
	elseif Kind == "petReturned" then
		ShowNotice("An unsold pet was returned to you", Colors.Accent)
		RefreshInbox()
	elseif Kind == "listingsChanged" then
		if AuctionFrame.Visible then
			RefreshBrowse()
			RefreshMyListings()
		end
	end
end)
