--// Pet Follow
-- Credits to azypro777 for helping out with this part!
local Spacing, PetSize, MaxClimbHeight = 5, 3, 6

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
local RayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -500, 0)

local TempPets = Instance.new("Folder")
TempPets.Name = "PlayerPets"
TempPets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then -- Show pets is false
		-- put the pets in "TempPets"
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end
			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end
	end
end

	for _,v in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do -- load pets

			PetClicked(Pet)

		end)()

	local SortTable2 = {}
	for _,v in Players[OtherPlayer].Data.Pets:GetChildren() do -- load pets
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			local Pet = AddPet(v, SortTable2, PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Inventory)

	end

end

Remotes.Trading.StartTrade.OnClientInvoke = StartTrade

Remotes.Trading.TradeAction.OnClientInvoke = function(Args) -- function is ran when u add pets to a trade, add currency etc
	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		if TradeFrame.Visible then
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, TradeFrame.Size) --// close the trade
			PlayerTrade.Visible = false
			TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = true
		end
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = Args.Option == "Ready" 
	elseif Args.Option == "Countdown" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = true

		if Args.Count == 0 then --// end trade
			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = false			

			if TradeFrame.Visible then
				Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, TradeFrame.Size) --// close the trade
				PlayerTrade.Visible = false
				TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = true
			end
		else

		end

	NewUpgrade.Name = i

	local function CalcReward(Reward)
		local R = v.Reward

		if R.Exponential.Value then
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Reward
		else
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Reward
		end
	end

		local C = v.Price

		else
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value + C.IncreasePer.Value * (PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value+1)

		else

		end
	end

local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION = 180
local DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER = 0.65
local DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER = 2
local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 25,
			ObjectiveReward = 250,
			ExclusivePet = "Event Rush Pet",
			SpawnMultiplier = DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER,
			RewardMultiplier = DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			HealthMultiplier = DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER,
		},
		{
			Name = "Golden Paws",
			Description = "Scavenge together to fill the golden paw meter.",
			ObjectiveType = "Scavenge",
			ObjectiveText = "Scavenge 40 times as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 40,
			ObjectiveReward = 350,

			SpawnMultiplier = 1.2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,

			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,

	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]

end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)

	end
end)

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)
	local Setting = GameSettings:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Setting then return false, "Unknown setting" end
	if Setting:IsA("IntValue") or Setting:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Setting.Value = Num
	elseif Setting:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Setting.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	elseif Setting:IsA("StringValue") then
		Setting.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Setting.Value)
end

function SettingsHandler.AllAreas()
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Area in Areas:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Area:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		Result[#Result + 1] = { name = Area.Name, cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0 }
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return tonumber(A.name) < tonumber(B.name) end)
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetAreaCost(AreaName, NewValue)
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return false, "No areas" end
	local Area = Areas:FindFirstChild(tostring(AreaName))
	if not Area or not Area:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Area not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Area.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set area " .. AreaName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function SettingsHandler.AllGemShop()
	local GemShop = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if not GemShop then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Upgrade in GemShop:GetChildren() do
		local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
		local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
		local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
		local UpgName = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or Upgrade.Name
		local DefaultReward = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("DefaultReward") and Reward.DefaultReward.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Reward.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Reward.Exponential.Value or false
		local DefaultPrice = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("DefaultPrice") and Price.DefaultPrice.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Price.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Price.Exponential.Value or false
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = Upgrade.Name,
			name = UpgName,
			max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			reward = { default = DefaultReward, increasePer = IncreasePerR, exponential = ExpR },
			price = { default = DefaultPrice, increasePer = IncreasePerP, exponential = ExpP },
		}
	end
	return Result
end

return SettingsHandler

-- ReplicatedStorage.AnimationController
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AnimationsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Animations")

-- Animations in this set play WITHOUT leg counter-rotation, because their leg
-- keyframes are intentional (kicks, sits, swims, etc.). Everything else gets the
-- counter-rotation applied to keep legs vertical when the torso rotates.
local SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE = {
	["Leg Kick Animation"] = true,
	["Double Jump Backflip Animation"] = true,
	["Driving Steering Animation"] = true,
	["Flying Animation"] = true,
	["Gun Shooting Position Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Hurting Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Item Pickup Animation"] = true,
	["Level Up Celebration Animation"] = true,
	["Seating Animation"] = true,
	["Sliding Animation"] = true,
	["Sneak Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Spell Cast Fireball Animation"] = true,
	["Swimming Animation"] = true,
	["Zombie Walk Animation"] = true,
}

-- Internal class: drives Motor6D.Transform per frame, lerping between keyframes.
local AnimationExecutor = {}
AnimationExecutor.__index = AnimationExecutor

function AnimationExecutor.new(character: Model)
	local self = setmetatable({}, AnimationExecutor)

	self.Character = character
	self.Joints = {}
	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.Connection = nil
	self.IsPlaying = false

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Motor6D") and desc.Part1 then
			self.Joints[desc.Part1.Name] = desc
		elseif desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and desc.Attachment1 then
			local part = desc.Attachment1.Parent
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				self.Joints[part.Name] = desc
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function AnimationExecutor:Stop()
	self.IsPlaying = false
	if self.Connection then
		self.Connection:Disconnect()
		self.Connection = nil
	end
end

function AnimationExecutor:PlayFromTable(animTable, options)
	if self.Connection then self:Stop() end

	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.IsPlaying = true

	options = options or {}
	local counterRotateLegs = options.counterRotateLegs ~= false  -- default true

	local timestamps = {}
	for t, _ in pairs(animTable.Timestamps) do
		table.insert(timestamps, t)
	end
	table.sort(timestamps)

	local maxTime = timestamps[#timestamps]
	local isLooping = animTable.Settings.Loop

	self.Connection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
		if not self.IsPlaying then return end

		self.CurrentTime += dt

		if self.CurrentTime >= maxTime then
			if isLooping then
				self.CurrentTime %= maxTime
			else
				self.CurrentTime = maxTime
				self:Stop()
				return
			end
		end

		local tStart, tEnd = timestamps[1], timestamps[#timestamps]
		for i = 1, #timestamps - 1 do
			if self.CurrentTime >= timestamps[i] and self.CurrentTime < timestamps[i+1] then
				tStart = timestamps[i]
				tEnd = timestamps[i+1]
				break
			end
		end

		local segmentDuration = tEnd - tStart
		local alpha = (segmentDuration > 0) and (self.CurrentTime - tStart) / segmentDuration or 0

		local dataStart = animTable.Timestamps[tStart]
		local dataEnd = animTable.Timestamps[tEnd]

		for partName, joint in pairs(self.Joints) do
			local cfA = dataStart[partName] or joint.Transform
			local cfB = dataEnd[partName] or cfA
			joint.Transform = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
		end

		-- Counter-rotate legs against LowerTorso (only when caller asks for it)
		if counterRotateLegs then
			local lowerTorso = self.Joints["LowerTorso"]
			if lowerTorso then
				local lt = lowerTorso.Transform
				local invRot = (lt - lt.Position):Inverse()
				for _, legName in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg"}) do
					local legJoint = self.Joints[legName]
					if legJoint then
						legJoint.Transform = invRot * legJoint.Transform
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Public API
local AnimationController = {}

local executor = nil
local currentCharacter = nil

local function ensureExecutor()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	-- Re-create the executor if the character changed (respawn, R6/R15 swap, etc.)
	if character ~= currentCharacter then
		currentCharacter = character
		executor = AnimationExecutor.new(character)
	end
	return executor
end

-- Reset on respawn so we don't reuse joints from the old character
Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	executor = nil
	currentCharacter = nil
end)

function AnimationController.Play(animationName)
	local animModule = AnimationsFolder:FindFirstChild(animationName)
	if not animModule then
		warn("AnimationController: no animation named", animationName)
		return
	end
	local exec = ensureExecutor()
	local skipLegFix = SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE[animationName] == true
	exec:PlayFromTable(require(animModule), { counterRotateLegs = not skipLegFix })
end

function AnimationController.Stop()
	if executor then executor:Stop() end
end

return AnimationController

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

function CodesHandler.ListCodes()
	-- Read the codes from the CodesHandler script source
	-- We replicate the same table here for the dashboard to display
	local Codes = {
		["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"},
		["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
		["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
		["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"},
	}

	local Result = {}
	for Code, Reward in pairs(Codes) do
		local IsPet = type(Reward[1]) == "string"
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			code = Code,
			rewardType = IsPet and "pet" or "currency",
			rewardValue = Reward[1],
			rewardTarget = Reward[2] or nil,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.code < B.code end)
	return Result
end

return CodesHandler

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

function Module.CreateBottomStatPopup(Amount, Stat, Colors, Time)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")
local CombatFeedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Enemies = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies") or Instance.new("Folder")
Enemies.Name = "PetEnemies"
Enemies.Parent = Workspace
local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER = 6

local DEFAULTS = {
	EnemySpawnEnabled = true,
	EnemySpawnInterval = 6,
	EnemySpawnChance = 1,
	EnemyMaxCount = MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER,
	EnemySpawnMinDistance = 24,
	EnemySpawnMaxDistance = 34,
	EnemyHealth = 35,
	EnemyGoldMin = 10,
	EnemyGoldMax = 30,
}

local AREA_CONFIG = {
	Spawn = {Health = 35, Damage = 5, Speed = 4.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 92, 92)},
	Candy = {Health = 55, Damage = 7, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 190)},
	Tech = {Health = 80, Damage = 10, Speed = 6.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 255)},
	Desert = {Health = 100, Damage = 12, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 175, 75)},
	Ocean = {Health = 120, Damage = 14, Speed = 7, Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 170, 255)},
	Volcano = {Health = 160, Damage = 18, Speed = 6, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 35)},
	Winter = {Health = 140, Damage = 16, Speed = 5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)},
}

local cooldowns = {}
local scavenged = {}
local playerEnemies = {}
local lastSpawn = {}
local enemyAttackCooldowns = {}
local comboState = {}
local enemyMotion = {}
local enemyTemplateNames
local clientPetPositions = {}
local MOVEMENT_TICK = 1 / 60
local STEERING_RESPONSE = 12
local ROTATION_RESPONSE = 14
local ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 0.45
local ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION = 0.72

local function moveSmoothly(enemy, targetPosition, targetLookPosition, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
	local current = enemy:GetPivot()
	local currentPosition = current.Position
	local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPosition.X, currentPosition.Y, targetPosition.Z)
	local offset = flatTarget - currentPosition
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	local maxStep = speed * deltaTime
	local alpha = math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	local desiredVelocity = distance > 0.05 and offset.Unit * math.min(speed, distance / math.max(deltaTime, 0.001)) or Vector3.zero
	local currentVelocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	local velocity = typeof(currentVelocity) == "Vector3" and currentVelocity:Lerp(desiredVelocity, alpha) or desiredVelocity
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", velocity)
	local displacement = velocity * deltaTime
	if displacement.Magnitude > maxStep then displacement = displacement.Unit * maxStep end
	local nextPosition = currentPosition + displacement
	local groundY = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GroundY"))
	if groundY then nextPosition = Vector3.new(nextPosition.X, groundY, nextPosition.Z) end
	local jumpOffset = jumping and math.sin(math.clamp((os.clock() - (enemyMotion[enemy].jumpStart or os.clock())) / 0.55, 0, 1) * math.pi) * 1.4 or 0
	nextPosition += Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
	local lookPosition = Vector3.new(targetLookPosition.X, nextPosition.Y, targetLookPosition.Z)
	local lookDirection = lookPosition - nextPosition
	local targetCFrame = lookDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, lookPosition) or CFrame.new(nextPosition)
	local rotationAlpha = math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	enemy:PivotTo(current:Lerp(targetCFrame, rotationAlpha))
	return distance
end

local function stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
	local velocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	if typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local nextVelocity = velocity:Lerp(Vector3.zero, math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", nextVelocity)
end

local enemyTemplateNames = {"Mouse", "Bee", "Lizard", "Desert Mouse", "Ocean Dog", "Volcano Bunny", "Frozen Dog"}

local function tell(player, action, message, pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Mood") or nil,
		hunger = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Hunger") or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function combat(player, kind, data)
	data = data or {}
	data.kind = kind
	CombatFeedback:FireClient(player, data)
end

local function burst(position, color, count, scale)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = Workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.9
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(7, 16)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 20)
	Debris:AddItem(part, scale or 1)
end

local function ownerPet(player, petId)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= player.UserId then return end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not root or not main or (root.Position - main.Position).Magnitude > 22 then return end
	return pet
end

local function giveGold(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not currency then return false end
	currency.Value += amount
	return true
end

local function getEnemyNear(position, radius)
	local best, distance
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health"))
		if main and health and health > 0 then
			local current = (main.Position - position).Magnitude
			if current <= radius and (not distance or current < distance) then
				best, distance = enemy, current
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getActivePet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local best
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") ~= "Stop" and (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) > 0 then
				best = pet
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getPetMain(pet)
	local main = pet and (pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
	return main and main:IsA("BasePart") and main or nil
end

local function hitboxParts(cframe, size, excluded)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, params)
end

local function attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then return end
	if enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] and now - enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] < 1.65 then return end
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	if not enemyMain or not petMain then return end
	local distance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5.5) + 1 then return end
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(enemyMain.Position, petMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.3), Vector3.new(6, 5, 6), {enemy})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(pet) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then return end
	enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = now
	motion.attackLockUntil = now + ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", pet.Name)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", now)
	local damage = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackDamage")) or 5)
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) - damage)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", health)
	pet:SetAttribute("LastEnemyAttack", now)
	combat(player, "EnemyHit", {position = petMain.Position, damage = damage, enemy = enemy.Name})
	tell(player, "EnemyAttack", "An enemy pet attacked " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. " for " .. math.floor(damage) .. ".", pet)
	burst(petMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(235, 75, 75), 18, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Stop")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		combat(player, "PetKnockedOut", {position = petMain.Position, text = "KNOCKED OUT!"})
		tell(player, "PetDefeated", "Your pet was knocked out and needs a moment to recover.", pet)
		task.delay(6, function()
			if pet.Parent then
				pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
				pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")
				pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", true)
				combat(player, "PetRecovered", {position = getPetMain(pet) and getPetMain(pet).Position})
			end
		end)
	end
end

local boundsForZone

local function setMotion(enemy, moving, jumping)
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") ~= moving then enemy:SetAttribute("Moving", moving) end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Jumping") ~= jumping then enemy:SetAttribute("Jumping", jumping) end
end

local function updateEnemy(enemy, deltaTime)
	local targetUserId = enemy:GetAttribute("OwnerTarget")
	if typeof(targetUserId) ~= "number" then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetUserId)
	local pet = player and getActivePet(player)
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not enemyMain then return end
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {nextRoam = 0, roamTarget = nil, nextJump = os.clock() + math.random(2, 5), jumpUntil = 0, attackLockUntil = 0}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	local now = os.clock()
	
	local petPos = clientPetPositions[player.UserId]
	local followTarget = petPos or (playerRoot and playerRoot.Position)
	
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then
		if followTarget then
			local look = Vector3.new(followTarget.X, enemyMain.Position.Y, followTarget.Z)
			if (look - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot():Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(enemy:GetPivot().Position, look), math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))) end
		end
		stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
		setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		return
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
	end
	local targetDistance = followTarget and (enemyMain.Position - followTarget).Magnitude or math.huge
	local stopDistance = 7
	if petMain then
		local petDistance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
		local attackRange = math.max(4, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5)
		if petDistance <= attackRange then
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
			enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
			attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
			return
		end
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing") end
	if followTarget and targetDistance < 26 then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
		local speed = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, followTarget, followTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		setMotion(enemy, distance > stopDistance + 0.15, jumping)
	else
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Roaming")
		if now >= motion.nextRoam or not motion.roamTarget then
			local zoneCenter = enemyMain.Position
			local zone = Workspace.Map and Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild(tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")))
			local low, high = zone and boundsForZone(zone)
			if low and high then
				zoneCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(math.floor(low.X), math.floor(high.X)), enemyMain.Position.Y, math.random(math.floor(low.Z), math.floor(high.Z)))
			else
				zoneCenter += Vector3.new(math.random(-14, 14), 0, math.random(-14, 14))
			end
			motion.roamTarget = zoneCenter
			motion.nextRoam = now + math.random(3, 7)
		end
		local speed = (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5) * ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, motion.roamTarget, motion.roamTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		if distance > 2 then
			setMotion(enemy, true, jumping)
		else
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		end
	end
	if now >= motion.nextJump and (enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") == true or petPos ~= nil) then
		motion.jumpStart = now
		motion.jumpUntil = now + 0.55
		motion.nextJump = now + math.random(3, 6)
		setMotion(enemy, true, true)
		combat(player, "EnemyJump", {position = enemyMain.Position, enemy = enemy.Name})
	end
end

local function attack(player, pet)
	local main = getPetMain(pet)
	if not main then return end
	local enemy = getEnemyNear(main.Position, 32)
	if not enemy then tell(player, "Attack", "No enemy pet is close enough.", pet) return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local key = player.UserId
	if cooldowns[key] and now - cooldowns[key] < 0.48 then return end
	cooldowns[key] = now
	local state = comboState[key] or {count = 0, last = 0}
	state.count = now - state.last <= 1.4 and (state.count % 4) + 1 or 1
	state.last = now
	comboState[key] = state
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(main.Position, enemyMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.1), Vector3.new(7, 6, 8), {pet, player.Character})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(enemy) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then
		combat(player, "Whiff", {position = main.Position, combo = state.count})
		return
	end
	local baseDamage = 10 * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1)
	local damage = math.floor(baseDamage * (1 + state.count * 0.18))
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) - damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("LastHitBy", player.UserId)
	combat(player, "PetHit", {position = enemyMain.Position, damage = damage, combo = state.count, enemy = enemy.Name})
	burst(enemyMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 70), 24, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		local reward = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GoldReward")) or 10
		giveGold(player, reward)
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "DefeatEnemies")
		combat(player, "EnemyDefeated", {position = enemyMain.Position, reward = reward, combo = state.count, text = "DEFEATED!"})
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet defeated an enemy and found " .. reward .. " gold.", pet)
		enemy:Destroy()
	else
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet attacked for " .. math.floor(damage) .. " damage.", pet)
	end
end

local function scavenge(player, pet)
	local key = pet:GetDebugId()
	if scavenged[key] and os.clock() - scavenged[key] < 20 then
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "This pet needs a little time before scavenging again.", pet)
		return
	end
	scavenged[key] = os.clock()
	local amount = math.floor(math.random(5, 25) * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1))
	if giveGold(player, amount) then
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "Scavenge")
		local main = getPetMain(pet)
		if main then burst(main.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 70), 16, 1) end
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "Your pet scavenged " .. amount .. " gold.", pet)
	end
end

local function chooseTemplate(zone)
	local petFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not petFolder then return nil end
	local configured = zone and zone:GetAttribute("EnemyTemplate")
	if type(configured) == "string" then
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(configured)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then return template end
	end
	local available = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(enemyTemplateNames) do
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then table.insert(available, template) end
	end
	return #available > 0 and available[math.random(1, #available)] or nil
end

boundsForZone = function(zone)
	local minVector, maxVector
	for _, item in zone:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			local half = item.Size * 0.5
			local low = item.Position - half
			local high = item.Position + half
			minVector = minVector and Vector3.new(math.min(minVector.X, low.X), math.min(minVector.Y, low.Y), math.min(minVector.Z, low.Z)) or low
			maxVector = maxVector and Vector3.new(math.max(maxVector.X, high.X), math.max(maxVector.Y, high.Y), math.max(maxVector.Z, high.Z)) or high
		end
	end
	return minVector, maxVector
end

local function zoneAt(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if not map then return nil end
	for _, zone in map:GetChildren() do
		if zone:IsA("Folder") or zone:IsA("Model") then
			local minVector, maxVector = boundsForZone(zone)
			if minVector and position.X >= minVector.X and position.X <= maxVector.X and position.Z >= minVector.Z and position.Z <= maxVector.Z then return zone end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function eventValue(name, default)
	local value = WorldEvents:GetAttribute(name)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value or default
end

local function readSetting(player, zone, name)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil and zone then value = zone:GetAttribute(name) end
	if value == nil then value = DEFAULTS[name] end
	return value
end

local function configureSettings(player)
	for name, value in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
		if player:GetAttribute(name) == nil then player:SetAttribute(name, value) end
	end
end

local function configureEnemy(enemy, ownerTarget, zone)
	local main = enemy:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not main then enemy:Destroy() return nil end
	local area = AREA_CONFIG[zone and zone.Name] or AREA_CONFIG.Spawn
	local health = math.max(1, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyHealth")) or area.Health) * eventValue("HealthMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMin = math.max(0, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMin")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMin) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMax = math.max(goldMin, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMax")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMax) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	enemy.PrimaryPart = main
	enemy:SetAttribute("IsPetEnemy", true)
	enemy:SetAttribute("OwnerTarget", ownerTarget.UserId)
	enemy:SetAttribute("ZoneName", zone and zone.Name or "Unzoned")
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("GoldReward", math.random(goldMin, goldMax))
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackDamage", area.Damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackRange", 5.5)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MoveSpeed", area.Speed)
	enemy:SetAttribute("CombatColor", area.Color)
	for _, descendant in enemy:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", Vector3.zero)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Spawning")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", "")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", 0)
	return enemy
end

local function getCollectAreaPosition(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return position end
	local closestPoint, closestDistance
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			local localPosition = areaPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
			local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
			local clamped = Vector3.new(
				math.clamp(localPosition.X, -halfSize.X + 3, halfSize.X - 3),
				0,
				math.clamp(localPosition.Z, -halfSize.Z + 3, halfSize.Z - 3)
			)
			local candidate = areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(clamped)
			local distance = (candidate - position).Magnitude
			if not closestDistance or distance < closestDistance then
				closestPoint, closestDistance = candidate, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPoint or position
end

local function getAnyCollectAreaPosition(referencePosition)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return nil end
	local candidates = {}
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") and areaPart.Size.X > 8 and areaPart.Size.Z > 8 then
			table.insert(candidates, areaPart)
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then return nil end
	local areaPart = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
	local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
	local localPosition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.X + 4), math.floor(halfSize.X - 4)),
		0,
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.Z + 4), math.floor(halfSize.Z - 4))
	)
	return areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)
end

local function placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, horizontalPosition, referenceY, character)
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, enemy, Enemies}
	rayParams.IgnoreWater = false
	local origin = Vector3.new(horizontalPosition.X, math.max(referenceY + 80, horizontalPosition.Y + 80), horizontalPosition.Z)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -240, 0), rayParams)
	if not result then return false end
	local pivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(horizontalPosition.X, result.Position.Y + 0.1, horizontalPosition.Z) * pivot.Rotation)
	local boxCFrame, boxSize = enemy:GetBoundingBox()
	local bottomOffset = boxCFrame.Position.Y - boxSize.Y * 0.5 - enemy:GetPivot().Position.Y
	enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 - bottomOffset, 0))
	local groundedPivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:SetAttribute("GroundY", groundedPivot.Position.Y)
	return true
end

local function spawnNearPlayer(player)
	local enemies = playerEnemies[player] or {}
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
	local spawnMultiplier = eventValue("SpawnMultiplier", 1)
	local configuredMax = tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemyMaxCount")) or MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER
	local maxCount = math.clamp(math.floor(configuredMax * spawnMultiplier), 0, MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER)
	if readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnEnabled") ~= true or #enemies >= maxCount then return end
	if math.random() > math.clamp((tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnChance")) or 1) * math.min(spawnMultiplier, 2), 0, 1) then return end
	local template = chooseTemplate(zone)
	if not template then return end
	local enemy = configureEnemy(template:Clone(), player, zone)
	if not enemy then return end
	enemy.Name = "PetEnemy_Player_" .. player.UserId .. "_" .. math.random(1000, 9999)
	local minDistance = math.max(8, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMinDistance")) or 24)
	local maxDistance = math.max(minDistance, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMaxDistance")) or 34)
	local frontDirection = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if frontDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then frontDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else frontDirection = frontDirection.Unit end
	local rightDirection = Vector3.new(-frontDirection.Z, 0, frontDirection.X)
	local distance = math.random(math.floor(minDistance), math.floor(maxDistance))
	local sideOffset = math.random(-8, 8)
	local spawnPosition = root.Position + frontDirection * distance + rightDirection * sideOffset
	spawnPosition = getCollectAreaPosition(spawnPosition)
	if not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, spawnPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
		local fallbackPosition = getAnyCollectAreaPosition(root.Position)
		if not fallbackPosition or not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, fallbackPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
			enemy:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end
	enemy.Parent = Enemies
	table.insert(enemies, enemy)
	playerEnemies[player] = enemies
	combat(player, "EnemySpawned", {position = enemy.PrimaryPart.Position, enemy = enemy.Name, zone = enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")})
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function()
		enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = nil
		local list = playerEnemies[player]
		if list then for index, current in ipairs(list) do if current == enemy then table.remove(list, index) break end end end
	end)
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	configureSettings(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
		playerEnemies[player] = {}
		lastSpawn[player] = 0
		comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setupPlayer(player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
	playerEnemies[player] = nil
	lastSpawn[player] = nil
	cooldowns[player.UserId] = nil
	comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	clientPetPositions[player.UserId] = nil
end)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	local pet = ownerPet(player, petId)
	if not pet then return end
	if action == "Attack" then attack(player, pet) elseif action == "Scavenge" then scavenge(player, pet) end
end)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action, extra)
	if action == "PositionUpdate" and typeof(extra) == "Vector3" then
		clientPetPositions[player.UserId] = extra
	end
end)

local function autoAttackPets()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		if not folder then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
			if not pet:IsA("Model") then continue end
			local state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState")
			if state ~= "Follow" then continue end
			local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
			if not petMain then continue end
			local enemy = getEnemyNear(petMain.Position, 32)
			if enemy then
				attack(player, pet)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.5) do
		autoAttackPets()
	end
end)

local movementAccumulator = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	movementAccumulator += dt
	if movementAccumulator < MOVEMENT_TICK then return end
	local stepDelta = movementAccumulator
	movementAccumulator = 0
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy.Parent then updateEnemy(enemy, stepDelta) end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(2) do
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
				local interval = math.max(2, (tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnInterval")) or DEFAULTS.EnemySpawnInterval) * eventValue("SpawnIntervalMultiplier", 1))
				if os.clock() - (lastSpawn[player] or 0) >= interval then
					lastSpawn[player] = os.clock()
					spawnNearPlayer(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test
--  • Studio project information
--  • Script count
--  • Pending changes
--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK
--  • Verification
--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and
-- report that Studio is asking for permission.
----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
------------------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
------------------------------------------------------------

local CONFIG = {
	PLUGIN_NAME = "Squeeze",
	VERSION = "6.0.0",

	-- CHANGE THIS
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio",

	-- Optional local bridge.
	-- Leave empty if you don't have one yet.
	LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:32145",

	HEALTH_ENDPOINT = "/health",
	AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/auto-connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/heartbeat",
	PULL_ENDPOINT = "/files/pull",
	ACK_ENDPOINT = "/ack",
	DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/disconnect",
	SNAPSHOT_ENDPOINT = "/project/snapshot",

	HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5,
	RECONNECT_INTERVAL = 5,
	PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 3,

	MAX_LOG_LINES = 300,

	-- Permission test object.
	PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER = "__SQUEEZE_PERMISSION_TEST__",
	PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT = "__SQUEEZE_SCRIPT_TEST__",
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------

type Change = {
	changeId: string?,
	eventId: string?,
	path: string?,
	source: string?,
	className: string?,
	action: string?,
	operation: string?,
	version: number?,
	name: string?,
	parentPath: string?,
	newName: string?,
	newParentPath: string?,
	property: string?,
	value: any?,
	attribute: string?,
	properties: {[string]: any}?,
	attributes: {[string]: any}?,
}

type Session = {
	token: string,
	sessionId: string,
	projectId: string,
	projectName: string,

	status: string,
	connected: boolean,

	lastHeartbeat: number,
	lastSync: number,

	pendingChanges: number,

	reconnecting: boolean,
}

type Permissions = {
	httpBackend: boolean,
	httpLocalBridge: boolean,
	scriptEditorRead: boolean,
	scriptEditorWrite: boolean,
	instanceWrite: boolean,
	changeHistory: boolean,
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local destroyed = false
local busy = false
local heartbeatRunning = false
local reconnectRunning = false
local previewRunning = false

local session: Session = {
	token = "",
	sessionId = "",
	projectId = "",
	projectName = "",

	status = "Starting",
	connected = false,

	lastHeartbeat = 0,
	lastSync = 0,

	pendingChanges = 0,

	reconnecting = false,
}

local permissions: Permissions = {
	httpBackend = false,
	httpLocalBridge = false,
	scriptEditorRead = false,
	scriptEditorWrite = false,
	instanceWrite = false,
	changeHistory = false,
}

local pendingChanges: {Change} = {}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- COLORS
------------------------------------------------------------

local COLORS = {
	BACKGROUND = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26),
	PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(29, 32, 38),
	PANEL_2 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 39, 46),

	RED = Color3.fromRGB(235, 82, 88),
	BLUE = Color3.fromRGB(90, 165, 255),

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOOLBAR
------------------------------------------------------------

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar(
	CONFIG.PLUGIN_NAME

toolbarButton.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGuiAsync(

widget.Title = "Squeeze Studio"

------------------------------------------------------------

local projectNameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

local placeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

local scriptsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

scriptsLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.MUTED

local pendingLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

pendingLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 20)

local syncLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

syncLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20)

syncLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.MUTED
syncLabel.TextSize = 11

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACTION BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

local permissionsButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
permissionsButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 222)
permissionsButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -18, 0, 40)

Instance.new("UICorner", permissionsButton).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 8)

local syncButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

syncButton.TextSize = 13

syncButton.Parent = root

Instance.new("UICorner", syncButton).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 8)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION PANEL
------------------------------------------------------------

local permissionPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
permissionPanel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 274)
permissionPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 145)
permissionPanel.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.PANEL
permissionPanel.BorderSizePixel = 0
permissionPanel.Parent = root

Instance.new("UICorner", permissionPanel).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 10)

local permissionTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
permissionTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 9)
permissionTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
permissionTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
permissionTitle.Text = "STUDIO ACCESS"
permissionTitle.TextColor3 = COLORS.MUTED
permissionTitle.TextSize = 10

permissionTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
permissionTitle.Parent = permissionPanel

local permissionText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
permissionText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 31)
permissionText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -38)
permissionText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
permissionText.Text = "Checking permissions..."
permissionText.TextColor3 = COLORS.TEXT
permissionText.TextSize = 11
permissionText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
permissionText.TextWrapped = true
permissionText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
permissionText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
permissionText.Parent = permissionPanel

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOGS
------------------------------------------------------------

local logs = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
logs.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 431)
logs.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -443)
logs.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 23)
logs.BorderSizePixel = 0
logs.ScrollBarThickness = 5
logs.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
logs.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
logs.Parent = root

Instance.new("UICorner", logs).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 8)

local logLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
logLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
logLayout.Parent = logs

local logPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
logPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.Parent = logs

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOG
------------------------------------------------------------

local function addLog(
	message: string,
	color: Color3?
)
	local count = 0

	for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count >= CONFIG.MAX_LOG_LINES then
		for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text =
		"[" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "] "
		.. message
	label.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.MUTED
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = logs
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATUS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3
)
	session.status = text
	statusLabel.Text = "● " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateUI()
	projectNameLabel.Text =
		session.projectName ~= ""
		and session.projectName
		or "Not connected"

	placeLabel.Text =
		"Place: "
		.. game.Name
		.. " / "
		.. tostring(game.PlaceId)

	local scriptCount = 0

	for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			scriptCount += 1
		end
	end

	scriptsLabel.Text =
		"Scripts: "
		.. tostring(scriptCount)

	pendingLabel.Text =
		"Pending: "
		.. tostring(session.pendingChanges)

	if session.lastSync > 0 then
		syncLabel.Text =
			"Last sync: "
			.. os.date("%H:%M:%S")
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =

------------------------------------------------------------

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end
