local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(source)
	end

	return true, source
end

local function writeScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.scriptEditorWrite then
		return false,
			"Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission is not enabled."
	end

	local ok, err =
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
				scriptInstance,
				function()
					return source
				end
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACK
------------------------------------------------------------

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
------------------------------------------------------------

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Sync Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"⚠ %d/%d applied. %d failed.",
				applied,
				total,
				failed
			),
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	updateUI()

	syncButton.Text =
		"Sync All"

	busy = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled =
		not widget.Enabled
end)

permissionsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		checkAllPermissions()
	end)
end)

syncButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		syncAll()
	end)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
------------------------------------------------------------

addLog(
	"Squeeze Studio Plugin initialized.",
	COLORS.TEXT
)

addLog(
	"Running permission diagnostics...",
	COLORS.BLUE
)

updateUI()

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	checkAllPermissions()

	if permissions.httpBackend then
		local connected =
			autoConnect()

		if connected then
			startHeartbeat()
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

startReconnectLoop()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UNLOAD
------------------------------------------------------------

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	destroyed = true

	if session.token ~= "" then
		pcall(function()
			request(
				CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
				"POST",
				CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					reason = "Plugin unloaded",
				}
			)
		end)
	end

	session.token = ""
	session.connected = false
end)

print(
	"[Squeeze Studio] v"
		.. CONFIG.VERSION
		.. " loaded."
)

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Codes Handler
-- View the hardcoded codes table.

local CodesHandler = {}

function CodesHandler.ListCodes()
	-- Read the codes from the CodesHandler script source
	-- We replicate the same table here for the dashboard to display
	local Codes = {
		["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"},
		["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
		["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
		["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"},
	}

	local Result = {}
	for Code, Reward in pairs(Codes) do
		local IsPet = type(Reward[1]) == "string"
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			code = Code,
			rewardType = IsPet and "pet" or "currency",
			rewardValue = Reward[1],
			rewardTarget = Reward[2] or nil,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.code < B.code end)
	return Result
end

return CodesHandler

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 18
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Stop" or action == "Follow" or action == "Sit" or action == "Sleep" or action == "Jump" or action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, action)
		if action == "Sleep" then stats.mood += 5 end
		if action == "Jump" then stats.mood += 2 end
		local color = action == "Sleep" and Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
		effect(pet, color, action == "Fly" and 22 or 12)
		send(player, action, "Pet behavior set to " .. action .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)
	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1
				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

--[[
	This script handles the client. 
	
	Contents:
	- ClickButton
	- Overlay (Currency counter)
	- Popups
	- Close Buttons of Frames
	- Buttons on the side
	- Settings
	- Rebirth
	- Shop
	- Pet Inventory
	- Egg Preview (Frame that shows the price etc)
	- Egg Hatching
	- Pet Follow
	- Areas
	- Trading
	- Gem Shop
	- Codes
	- Stats
	- Functions
	
	Only edit if you know what you're doing!
]]

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Loading
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil

if Player.Parent == nil then return end

--// Variables
local Data = Player.Data
local PlayerData = Data.PlayerData

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local Utilities = require(Modules.Utilities)

local UI = Player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("GameUI")
local Frames = UI.Frames

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

--// Clicker
if GameSettings.GameType.Value == "Clicker" then
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(UI.Clicker)

	UI.Clicker.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)

	if GameSettings.ClickingAnywhere.Value then
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
			if Processed then return end
			if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end -- not a left mouse click
			Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Overlay
local CurrencySide = UI[GameSettings.CurrencySide.Value]
CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
end)

CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
PlayerData.Currency2.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
end)


--// Popups
local CurrencyOld = PlayerData.Currency.Value
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function(NewValue)
	task.spawn(function()
		if NewValue > CurrencyOld then
			local NewPopup = script.Popup:Clone()
			NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
			NewPopup.Currency.Image = CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Currency.Image
			NewPopup.Amount.Text = "+"..Utilities.Short.en(NewValue - CurrencyOld)
			NewPopup.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0, math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0) -- sets it in a random position in the middle square
			NewPopup.Parent = UI.Popups
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.176,0,0.105,0), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5)
			task.wait(1)
			NewPopup:TweenPosition(CurrencySide.Position, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.05,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			task.wait(1.4)
			NewPopup:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	CurrencyOld = NewValue
end)

--// Frames
local BaseSize = {}
for _,Frame in Frames:GetChildren() do
	if not Frame:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Frame:GetAttribute("Keep") then continue end

	BaseSize[Frame.Name] = Frame.Size

	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Close") then
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Frame.Close)
		Frame.Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(Frame, UDim2.new(0,0,0,0))
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Buttons
local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
for _,Button in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if not Button:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Button:GetAttribute("AuctionButton") then continue end

	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Button)
	Button.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(UI.Frames[Button.Name], BaseSize[Button.Name])
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)
end

--// Settings
local SettingsScroll = Frames.Settings.ObjectHolder

-- Music Setting
local MusicSetting = SettingsScroll.Music
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.Off)

MusicSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

MusicSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
PlayerData.Music.Changed:Connect(function()
	SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
end)

-- ShowOtherPets
local ShowOtherPetsSetting = SettingsScroll.ShowOtherPets
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", false)

function SortInventory(SortTable, ObjectHolder)
	local TableToSort = SortTable ~= nil and SortTable or PetInventory -- so it can differentiate between trade and normal inventories

	table.sort(TableToSort, function(a,b)
		if not a or not b then return end

		if a.Multiplier ~= b.Multiplier then
			return a.Multiplier > b.Multiplier
		else
			return a.ID > b.ID
		end
	end)

	for Order,PetInfo in TableToSort do
		if not Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetInfo.ID) then
			table.remove(TableToSort, Order)
			continue
		end

		if not ObjectHolder then
			PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		else
			ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		end
	end
end

local CurrentlySelected = 0

function AddPet(PetInstance, SortTable, Parent) -- Creates a pet slot
	task.wait(0.1)
	local NewPet = script.PetTemplate:Clone()

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Parent = NewPet.Display

	local MainPart = PetModel:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	local Pos

	if not MainPart then
		warn(PetModel.Name.." does not have a MainPart, please add one by calling one of the parts 'MainPart'")

		for _,v in PetModel:GetChildren() do -- this here chooses a random part of the pet instead of the mainpart.
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				Pos = v.Position
				break
			end
		end
	else
		Pos = MainPart.Position
	end

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	NewPet.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

	if not Parent then -- normal pet
		NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

		PetInstance.Equipped.Changed:Connect(function()
			NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

			if CurrentlySelected == tonumber(PetInstance.Name) then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			end

			SortInventory()
		end)

		NewPet.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not IsMultiDeleting then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			else
				if not table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)) then
					table.insert(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = true
				else
					table.remove(SelectedForDelete, table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = false
				end
			end
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
	NewPet.Name = PetInstance.Name
	NewPet.Parent = Parent == nil and PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder or Parent

	if SortTable == nil then
		PetInventory[#PetInventory+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	else
		SortTable[#SortTable+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	end

	return NewPet
end

local PreviewFrame = UI.PreviewFrame
local DefaultSize = PreviewFrame.Size
local CurrentTarget = PreviewFrame.CurrentTarget
PreviewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)

function FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable)
	local CurrentClosest, ClosestDistance = nil, 100

	for _,Egg in EggsAvailable do
		local EggModel = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg]
		local mag = (EggModel:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= ClosestDistance then
			CurrentClosest = EggModel
			ClosestDistance = mag
		end
	end
	return CurrentClosest
end

local IsClosing = false -- so it doesnt ruin the animation

function FindEgg()
	if not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Player.Character.Humanoid.Health == 0 then return end

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local EggsAvailable = {}
	local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/11

	for _,Egg in workspace.Map.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if Egg == nil then continue end
		if not Egg:FindFirstChild("EggModel") then warn(Egg.Name.." does not have an EggModel") end

		local mag = (Egg:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= 12 then
			EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = Egg.Name
		end
	end

	local SetVisibility = #EggsAvailable >= 1 -- if its 0 then its already false

	if SetVisibility then -- a egg(s) is in distance
		local Egg = #EggsAvailable > 1 and FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable) or workspace.Map.Eggs[EggsAvailable[1]]
		local WSP = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg:GetPivot().Position)
		PreviewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
		CurrentTarget.Value = Egg.Name
	else
		CurrentTarget.Value = "None"
	end

	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then
		SetVisibility = false -- if you are opening an egg itll auto close the previewframe
	end

	--// Make the previewframe visible
	if SetVisibility and not PreviewFrame.Visible then
		PreviewFrame.Visible = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(DefaultSize.X.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.X.Offset, DefaultSize.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.Y.Offset)})	
	elseif not SetVisibility and PreviewFrame.Visible and not IsClosing then -- set to invisible, while is visible & isnt closing
		IsClosing = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)})	
		task.wait(0.15)
		PreviewFrame.Visible = false
		IsClosing = false
	end
end

function UpdatePreviewFrame()
	if CurrentTarget.Value ~= "None" then
		local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value
		PreviewFrame.EggInfo.EggName.Text = Egg

		if not ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg) then print(Egg.." does not have settings in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs!") return end

		local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]

		local IsRobuxEgg = EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId")
		if IsRobuxEgg then
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs \u{E002}"..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		else
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs "..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		end

		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Triple.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg
		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Auto.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg

		--// This part gets the pet chances
		local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

		for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
		end

		table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
			return a[2] > b[2]
		end)

		local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for _,v in Pets do
			local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
			TotalWeight += Chance
			v[2] = Chance
		end

		for i = 1,9 do
			local PetInfo = Pets[i]
			local PetSlot = PreviewFrame.PetChances.List["Pet"..i]
			PetSlot.Visible = PetInfo ~= nil

			if PetInfo == nil then continue end

			PetSlot.Rarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]].Settings.Rarity.Value
			PetSlot.Percentage.Text = Utilities.Short.en(100/TotalWeight * PetInfo[2]).."%"
			PetSlot.Delete.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[PetInfo[1]].Value
			PetSlot.PetName.Value = PetInfo[1]

			local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]]:Clone()
			PetModel.Parent = PetSlot.Pet

			local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
			local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
			PetSlot.Pet.CurrentCamera = Camera
			PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
		end
	end
end

--// Egg Hatching
local IsAutoOpening = false

function HatchEgg(Egg: string, Result: string, Offset:number)
	local OpeningTime = 3

	local NewViewport = script.EggViewport:Clone()
	NewViewport.Parent = UI.OpenEgg

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 15
	Frames.Visible = false
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = false

	local Clone = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg].EggModel:Clone()
	Clone:ScaleTo(0.5)
	Clone.Parent = workspace

	local Rot, X, Y, Z = Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue")
	Rot.Value = 30 Z.Value = -4 X.Value = 10

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 1.5
	PL.Parent = Clone.Egg

	Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z))
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local TweenIn = TweenService:Create(X, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = Offset})
	TweenIn:Play()

	local RotTweenIn = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 0})
	RotTweenIn:Play()

	-- add an audio for the egg flying in
	TweenIn.Completed:Wait()

	local Eggdelay = 0.075
	for i = 1,(OpeningTime * 1.5) + 1 do
		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 6})
		Tween:Play()
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -6})
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween:Play()
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		Eggdelay -= .005
	end

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()	
	Clone:Destroy()	

	-- Now we're going to show the pet

	local PetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result]:Clone()
	PetModel:ScaleTo(0.6)
	PetModel.Parent = workspace

	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[Result].Value
	NewViewport.PetName.Text = Result
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = true
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Text = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result].Settings.Rarity.Value
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = true

	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 2
	PL.Parent = PetModel.MainPart

	X.Value = Offset Y.Value = 0 Z.Value = -4 Rot.Value = 175
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	task.wait(OpeningTime*0.25)

	NewViewport:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(NewViewport.Position.X.Scale, 0, NewViewport.Position.Y.Scale + 10, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, OpeningTime * 0.1)
	TweenService:Create(Y, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -5}):Play()
	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = false
	task.wait(OpeningTime * 0.15)

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()
	X:Destroy() Y:Destroy() Z:Destroy() Rot:Destroy()

	PetModel:Destroy()
	NewViewport:Destroy()

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = true
	Frames.Visible = true	
end

Remotes.Egg.OnClientInvoke = HatchEgg

function SingleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return end

	if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then
		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 1)

		if Result ~= nil then
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end
	else
		MarketPlaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Player, EggInfo.ProductId.Value)
	end
end

function TripleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 3)

	if Result ~= nil then
		for i = 1,#Result do
			coroutine.wrap(function()
				local Position = (i - 2) * 3
				HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
			end)()
		end
	end
end

local function ChooseEggAmount(Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return 1 end

	local EggAmount = 1

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then 
		return EggAmount
	end -- triple egg is a gamepass that the player doesn't own, so open 1 egg

	if PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * 3 then
		EggAmount = 3
	end

	return EggAmount
end

function AutoEgg()
	if IsAutoOpening then return end

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("AutoEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value then 
		MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value)
		return
	end

	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value	
	IsAutoOpening = true

	while true do
		if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then task.wait(0.1) continue end -- player is already opening an egg

		if CurrentTarget.Value == "None" or CurrentTarget.Value ~= Egg then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, ChooseEggAmount(Egg))

		if Result == nil then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		if #Result > 1 then
			for i = 1,#Result do
				coroutine.wrap(function()
					local Position = (i - 2) * 3
					HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
				end)()
			end
		else
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

--// Pet Follow
-- Credits to azypro777 for helping out with this part!
local Spacing, PetSize, MaxClimbHeight = 5, 3, 6

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
local RayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -500, 0)

local TempPets = Instance.new("Folder")
TempPets.Name = "PlayerPets"
TempPets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then -- Show pets is false
		-- put the pets in "TempPets"
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end
			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end
	end
end

		local R = v.Reward

		else
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Reward
		end

		local C = v.Price

		else

			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(CalcCost())
		else
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > Max"
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = "Max"
		end
	end

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

-- [Squeeze Luau Co-Pilot] Production Game System
-- Placed inside: ServerScriptService.GameSystem (Server Script)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CONFIG = {
	TICK_RATE = 1.0,
	AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL = 60,
}

local playerSessions: { [number]: { joinTime: number, active: boolean } } = {}

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	playerSessions[player.UserId] = {
		joinTime = os.time(),
		active = true,
	}
	print(string.format("[System] Initialized session for %s (%d)", player.Name, player.UserId))
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local session = playerSessions[player.UserId]
	if session then
		session.active = false
		playerSessions[player.UserId] = nil
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

game:BindToClose(function()
	print("[System] Server shutting down, performing safe state cleanup...")
	task.wait(1)
end)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Game System] Running with strict Luau typing.")

local function show(data)
	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))
	stateLabel.Text = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	
	local stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 120, 80)
	local stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
	local state = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	if state == "Stop" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 60)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
	elseif state == "Follow" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 100)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
	elseif state == "Sit" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 50)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 180)
	elseif state == "Sleep" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 140)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
	elseif state == "Jump" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 160)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)
	elseif state == "Fly" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 80, 180)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
	end

	TweenService:Create(moodFill, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)}):Play()

	moodFill.BackgroundColor3 = moodColor
	
	setActiveButton(state)
	
	if not panel.Visible then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(10, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenScale(0.8, 0.2)
			task.wait(0.2)
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

	outline.Thickness = 1
	outline.Parent = background
	local moodLabel = label(background, "Mood 0%", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 4), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 135))
	moodLabel.TextSize = 13
	moodLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local hungerLabel = label(background, "Hunger 0%", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 27), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, Color3.fromRGB(135, 230, 170))
	hungerLabel.TextSize = 13
	hungerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local function makeNeedBar(name, y, color)
		local track = Instance.new("Frame")
		track.Name = name .. "Bar"
		track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, y)
		track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(174, 7)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 56, 68)
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.Parent = background
		local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		trackCorner.Parent = track
		local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		fill.Name = "Fill"
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.75, 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.Parent = track
		local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		fillCorner.Parent = fill
		return fill
	end
	local moodFill = makeNeedBar("Mood", 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 100))
	local hungerFill = makeNeedBar("Hunger", 43, Color3.fromRGB(100, 215, 160))
	local moodIcon = Instance.new("Frame")
	moodIcon.Name = "MoodIndicator"
	moodIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	moodIcon.Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0, 12)
	moodIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
	moodIcon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 130)
	moodIcon.BorderSizePixel = 0
	moodIcon.Parent = background
	local moodIconCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	moodIconCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	moodIconCorner.Parent = moodIcon
	local function update()
		local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 0, 0, 100)
		local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 0, 0, 100)
		moodLabel.Text = "Mood  " .. math.floor(mood) .. "%"
		hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger  " .. math.floor(hunger) .. "%"
		moodFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)
		hungerFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)
		moodIcon.BackgroundColor3 = mood >= 70 and Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 130) or mood >= 35 and Color3.fromRGB(245, 190, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90)
	end
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Mood"):Connect(update)
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Hunger"):Connect(update)
	pet.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent) if not parent then petNeedsBillboards[pet] = nil end end)
	petNeedsBillboards[pet] = billboard
	update()
end

local playerPets = workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local function inspectPetFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do createPetNeedsBillboard(pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(createPetNeedsBillboard, pet) end)
end
for _, folder in ipairs(playerPets:GetChildren()) do
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end
playerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(folder) if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end end)

local function refreshInteractionPanel()
	if currentPetId then
		local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(currentPetId)
		if pet then
			show({petId = pet.Name, petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or pet.Name, mood = pet:GetAttribute("Mood"), hunger = pet:GetAttribute("Hunger"), state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"})
		end
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(1, refreshInteractionPanel) end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if child.Name == "GameUI" then task.defer(refreshInteractionPanel) end end)

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end
	
	Save["Accessories"] = {}
	local accessories = Folder:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if accessories then
		for _, accessory in accessories:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("BoolValue") and accessory.Value then Save["Accessories"][accessory.Name] = true end
		end
	end

	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

return SavingFunctions

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test

--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK

--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and

----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

local function addLog(
	message: string,

)

			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count >= CONFIG.MAX_LOG_LINES then
		for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text =
		"[" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "] "
		.. message
	label.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.MUTED
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = logs
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATUS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3
)

	statusLabel.Text = "● " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateUI()
	projectNameLabel.Text =
		session.projectName ~= ""
		and session.projectName
		or "Not connected"

	placeLabel.Text =
		"Place: "
		.. game.Name
		.. " / "
		.. tostring(game.PlaceId)

	local scriptCount = 0

	for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			scriptCount += 1
		end
	end

	scriptsLabel.Text =
		"Scripts: "
		.. tostring(scriptCount)

	pendingLabel.Text =
		"Pending: "
		.. tostring(session.pendingChanges)

	if session.lastSync > 0 then
		syncLabel.Text =
			"Last sync: "
			.. os.date("%H:%M:%S")
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: HTTP BACKEND
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testBackendHTTP(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing HTTP access to backend...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.HEALTH_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpBackend = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Backend HTTP permission/access failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown error"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpBackend = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Backend HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: LOCAL BRIDGE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testLocalBridgeHTTP(): boolean
	if CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL == "" then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge disabled in configuration.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	addLog(
		"Testing localhost bridge...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL,
			"GET",
			"/health",
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge unavailable.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpLocalBridge = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Local Bridge HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR READ
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorRead(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing ScriptEditorService read access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)
