------------------------------------------------------------

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(source)
	end

	return true, source
end

local function writeScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.scriptEditorWrite then
		return false,
			"Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission is not enabled."
	end

	local ok, err =
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
				scriptInstance,
				function()
					return source
				end
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Sync Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"⚠ %d/%d applied. %d failed.",
				applied,
				total,
				failed
			),
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	updateUI()

	syncButton.Text =
		"Sync All"

	busy = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled =
		not widget.Enabled
end)

permissionsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		checkAllPermissions()
	end)
end)

syncButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		syncAll()
	end)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
------------------------------------------------------------

addLog(
	"Squeeze Studio Plugin initialized.",
	COLORS.TEXT
)

addLog(
	"Running permission diagnostics...",
	COLORS.BLUE
)

updateUI()

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	checkAllPermissions()

	if permissions.httpBackend then
		local connected =
			autoConnect()

		if connected then
			startHeartbeat()
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

startReconnectLoop()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UNLOAD
------------------------------------------------------------

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	destroyed = true

	if session.token ~= "" then
		pcall(function()
			request(
				CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
				"POST",
				CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					reason = "Plugin unloaded",
				}
			)
		end)
	end

	session.token = ""
	session.connected = false
end)

print(
	"[Squeeze Studio] v"
		.. CONFIG.VERSION
		.. " loaded."
)

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore
		local MainFrame = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame
		MainFrame.Title.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and "Top 100 Most "..RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Title
		MainFrame.Players.Amount.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Stat
		
		local Template = script.Template
		if Leaderboard:FindFirstChild("Template") then
			Template = Leaderboard.Template
		end
		
		for i = 1,100 do			
			local Clone = Template:Clone()
			Clone.LayoutOrder = i
			Clone.Name = i
			Clone.Rank.Text = ""
			Clone.PlrName.Text = ""
			Clone.Amount.Text = ""
			Clone.Parent = MainFrame.Players.Scroll
		end 
	end
end

return Main

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

local AdminFunctions = {}

--// General
function AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, AdminList) -- checks if user is allowed to use commands
	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK
	else
		return CreatorId == Player.UserId
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")

		end

		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do

			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Main = {}

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore
		local MainFrame = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame
		MainFrame.Title.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and "Top 100 Most "..RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Title
		MainFrame.Players.Amount.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Stat
		
		local Template = script.Template

			Template = Leaderboard.Template
		end
		
		for i = 1,100 do			
			local Clone = Template:Clone()
			Clone.LayoutOrder = i
			Clone.Name = i
			Clone.Rank.Text = ""
			Clone.PlrName.Text = ""
			Clone.Amount.Text = ""
			Clone.Parent = MainFrame.Players.Scroll
		end 
	end
end

return Main

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

--// Function for handling buttons

local ButtonHandler = {}

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local function BlurAnimation(Transparency)
	Tween.Tween(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameUI.Blur, {Speed = 0.25}, {BackgroundTransparency=Transparency})
end

ButtonHandler.OnClick = function(Frame,Size)	
	if not Frame.Visible then
		--// Close other frames
		for _,OtherFrame in Frame.Parent:GetChildren() do
			if OtherFrame:IsA("Frame") and OtherFrame.Visible then
				OtherFrame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.1, true)
				task.wait(0.04)
				OtherFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end

		--// Open frame

		Frame.Size = Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.1)
		Frame.Visible = true
		Frame:TweenSize(Size, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		BlurAnimation(0.4)
	else
		--// Close the frame

		BlurAnimation(1)
		Frame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		Frame.Visible = false
	end
end

return ButtonHandler

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.AnimationController
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AnimationsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Animations")

-- Animations in this set play WITHOUT leg counter-rotation, because their leg
-- keyframes are intentional (kicks, sits, swims, etc.). Everything else gets the
-- counter-rotation applied to keep legs vertical when the torso rotates.
local SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE = {
	["Leg Kick Animation"] = true,
	["Double Jump Backflip Animation"] = true,
	["Driving Steering Animation"] = true,
	["Flying Animation"] = true,
	["Gun Shooting Position Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Hurting Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Item Pickup Animation"] = true,
	["Level Up Celebration Animation"] = true,
	["Seating Animation"] = true,
	["Sliding Animation"] = true,
	["Sneak Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Spell Cast Fireball Animation"] = true,
	["Swimming Animation"] = true,
	["Zombie Walk Animation"] = true,
}

-- Internal class: drives Motor6D.Transform per frame, lerping between keyframes.
local AnimationExecutor = {}
AnimationExecutor.__index = AnimationExecutor

function AnimationExecutor.new(character: Model)
	local self = setmetatable({}, AnimationExecutor)

	self.Character = character
	self.Joints = {}
	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.Connection = nil
	self.IsPlaying = false

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Motor6D") and desc.Part1 then
			self.Joints[desc.Part1.Name] = desc
		elseif desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and desc.Attachment1 then
			local part = desc.Attachment1.Parent
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				self.Joints[part.Name] = desc
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function AnimationExecutor:Stop()
	self.IsPlaying = false
	if self.Connection then
		self.Connection:Disconnect()
		self.Connection = nil
	end
end

function AnimationExecutor:PlayFromTable(animTable, options)
	if self.Connection then self:Stop() end

	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.IsPlaying = true

	options = options or {}
	local counterRotateLegs = options.counterRotateLegs ~= false  -- default true

	local timestamps = {}
	for t, _ in pairs(animTable.Timestamps) do
		table.insert(timestamps, t)
	end
	table.sort(timestamps)

	local maxTime = timestamps[#timestamps]
	local isLooping = animTable.Settings.Loop

	self.Connection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
		if not self.IsPlaying then return end

		self.CurrentTime += dt

		if self.CurrentTime >= maxTime then
			if isLooping then
				self.CurrentTime %= maxTime
			else
				self.CurrentTime = maxTime
				self:Stop()
				return
			end
		end

		local tStart, tEnd = timestamps[1], timestamps[#timestamps]
		for i = 1, #timestamps - 1 do
			if self.CurrentTime >= timestamps[i] and self.CurrentTime < timestamps[i+1] then
				tStart = timestamps[i]
				tEnd = timestamps[i+1]
				break
			end
		end

		local segmentDuration = tEnd - tStart
		local alpha = (segmentDuration > 0) and (self.CurrentTime - tStart) / segmentDuration or 0

		local dataStart = animTable.Timestamps[tStart]
		local dataEnd = animTable.Timestamps[tEnd]

		for partName, joint in pairs(self.Joints) do
			local cfA = dataStart[partName] or joint.Transform
			local cfB = dataEnd[partName] or cfA
			joint.Transform = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
		end

		-- Counter-rotate legs against LowerTorso (only when caller asks for it)
		if counterRotateLegs then
			local lowerTorso = self.Joints["LowerTorso"]
			if lowerTorso then
				local lt = lowerTorso.Transform
				local invRot = (lt - lt.Position):Inverse()
				for _, legName in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg"}) do
					local legJoint = self.Joints[legName]
					if legJoint then
						legJoint.Transform = invRot * legJoint.Transform
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Public API
local AnimationController = {}

local executor = nil
local currentCharacter = nil

local function ensureExecutor()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	-- Re-create the executor if the character changed (respawn, R6/R15 swap, etc.)
	if character ~= currentCharacter then
		currentCharacter = character
		executor = AnimationExecutor.new(character)
	end
	return executor
end

-- Reset on respawn so we don't reuse joints from the old character
Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	executor = nil
	currentCharacter = nil
end)

function AnimationController.Play(animationName)
	local animModule = AnimationsFolder:FindFirstChild(animationName)
	if not animModule then
		warn("AnimationController: no animation named", animationName)
		return
	end
	local exec = ensureExecutor()
	local skipLegFix = SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE[animationName] == true
	exec:PlayFromTable(require(animModule), { counterRotateLegs = not skipLegFix })
end

function AnimationController.Stop()
	if executor then executor:Stop() end
end

return AnimationController

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem
