--!strict
-- LeaderboardEngine.lua
-- Seasonal leaderboards with snapshots, ranks, and rewards

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LeaderboardEngine = {}
LeaderboardEngine.__index = LeaderboardEngine

-- DataStores
local SEASON_STORE = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("SeasonLeaderboards")
local SNAPSHOT_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonSnapshots")
local REWARDS_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonRewards")

-- Messaging
local TOPICS = {
	SeasonReset = "Leaderboard_SeasonReset",
	RewardClaimed = "Leaderboard_RewardClaimed",
	ScoreUpdate = "Leaderboard_ScoreUpdate",
}

-- ============================================
-- SEASON CONFIGURATION
-- ============================================

export type SeasonConfig = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	type: "weekly" | "monthly",
	startTime: number,
	endTime: number,
	categories: {SeasonCategory},
	rewards: {[string]: SeasonRewards}, -- tier -> rewards
}

export type SeasonCategory = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	metric: string, -- DataStore key for scoring
	weight: number, -- for tiebreaking
}

export type SeasonRewards = {
	-- tier: "top1" | "top3" | "top10" | "top25" | "top50" | "participation"
	gems: number,
	title: string?,
	titleDuration: number?, -- seconds
	petId: string?,
	auraId: string?,
	trailId: string?,
	badgeId: string?,
	cosmeticCrate: string?,
}

-- Default season configuration
local DEFAULT_CATEGORIES: {SeasonCategory} = {
	{id = "clicks", name = "Click Master", metric = "total_clicks", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "hatches", name = "Hatch Champion", metric = "eggs_hatched", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "gold", name = "Gold Tycoon", metric = "gold_earned", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "collection", name = "Pet Collector", metric = "unique_pets", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "combat", name = "Combat Veteran", metric = "enemies_defeated", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "trading", name = "Trade Baron", metric = "trade_volume", weight = 1.0},
}

local WEEKLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 50000, title = "Weekly Champion", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "golden_egg", auraId = "golden_glow"},
	top3 = {gems = 20000, title = "Silver Contender", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "silver_egg"},
	top10 = {gems = 10000, title = "Bronze Challenger", titleDuration = 604800},
	top25 = {gems = 5000},
	top50 = {gems = 2000},
	participation = {gems = 500},
}

local MONTHLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 200000, title = "Monthly Legend", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "legendary_exclusive", auraId = "legendary_aura", trailId = "cosmic_trail"},
	top3 = {gems = 100000, title = "Monthly Elite", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "epic_exclusive", trailId = "elite_trail"},
	top10 = {gems = 50000, title = "Monthly Rising Star", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "rare_exclusive"},
	top25 = {gems = 20000, cosmeticCrate = "monthly_elite_crate"},
	top50 = {gems = 10000},
	participation = {gems = 5000},
}

-- Active season state
local currentSeason: {config: any, active: boolean} = {active = false}
local categoryScores = {} -- [categoryId][playerId] = score

-- ============================================
-- SEASON MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetCurrentSeason(): {config: any, active: boolean}?
	return currentSeason.active and currentSeason or nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetTimeRemaining(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, currentSeason.config.endTime - os.time())
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonProgress(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	local elapsed = os.time() - currentSeason.config.startTime
	local total = currentSeason.config.endTime - currentSeason.config.startTime
	return math.clamp(elapsed / total, 0, 1)
end

function LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason(config: {type: string, categories: {SeasonCategory}?, rewards: any?})
	local now = os.time()
	local duration = config.type == "monthly" and 2592000 or 604800
	
	local seasonConfig = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		name = config.type .. "_season_" .. os.date("%Y_%m_%d", now),
		type = config.type,
		startTime = now,
		endTime = now + duration,
		categories = config.categories or DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
		rewards = config.rewards or (config.type == "monthly" and MONTHLY_REWARDS or WEEKLY_REWARDS),
	}
	
	currentSeason = {config = seasonConfig, active = true}
	categoryScores = {}
	
	-- Initialize category scores
	for _, cat in seasonConfig.categories do
		categoryScores[cat.id] = {}
	end
	
	-- Schedule reset
	task.delay(duration, function()
		LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	end)
	
	-- Broadcast season start
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonStart", {
			seasonId = seasonConfig.id,
			type = seasonConfig.type,
			endTime = seasonConfig.endTime,
			categories = seasonConfig.categories,
		})
	end
	
	return seasonConfig
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	local seasonId = currentSeason.config.id
	
	-- Snapshot all category scores
	for catId, scores in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local data = {}
		
		-- Convert to array of {playerId, score}
		local entries = {}
		for playerId, score in scores do
			table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
		end
		
		-- Sort by score descending
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
		
		-- Store top 10000
		local topEntries = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(10000, #entries) do
			table.insert(topEntries, entries[i])
		end
		
		-- Save snapshot
		local success = pcall(function()
			SNAPSHOT_STORE:SetAsync(snapshotKey, topEntries)
		end)
		
		if not success then
			warn("LeaderboardEngine: Failed to save snapshot for " .. catId)
		end
	end
	
	-- Calculate and queue rewards
	LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId)
	
	-- Broadcast reset
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonReset", {
			seasonId = seasonId,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		})
	end
	
	-- Clear scores
	categoryScores = {}
	currentSeason.active = false
end

function LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId: string)
	local config = currentSeason.config
	if not config then return end
	
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local success, snapshot = pcall(function()
			return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
		end)
		
		if not success or not snapshot then continue end
		
		-- Determine tier cutoffs
		local total = #snapshot
		local cutoffs = {
			top1 = math.ceil(total * 0.01),
			top3 = math.ceil(total * 0.03),
			top10 = math.ceil(total * 0.10),
			top25 = math.ceil(total * 0.25),
			top50 = math.ceil(total * 0.50),
		}
		
		for rank, entry in ipairs(snapshot) do
			local tier = "participation"
			if rank <= cutoffs.top1 then tier = "top1"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top3 then tier = "top3"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top10 then tier = "top10"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top25 then tier = "top25"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top50 then tier = "top50"
			end
			
			local rewards = config.rewards[tier] or config.rewards.participation
			
			-- Queue reward for player
			local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. entry.playerId
			local rewardData = {
				seasonId = seasonId,
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				tier = tier,
				rewards = rewards,
				claimed = false,
				timestamp = os.time(),
			}
			
			pcall(function()
				REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
					if old then return old end -- Don't overwrite
					return rewardData
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- SCORING
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.AddScore(playerId: number, metric: string, amount: number)
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	-- Find category for this metric
	local categoryId = nil
	for _, cat in currentSeason.config.categories do
		if cat.metric == metric then
			categoryId = cat.id
			break
		end
	end
	
	if not categoryId then return end
	
	if not categoryScores[categoryId] then
		categoryScores[categoryId] = {}
	end
	
	categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] = (categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0) + amount
	
	-- Broadcast update (throttled)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ScoreUpdate, {
			playerId = playerId,
			category = categoryId,
			newScore = categoryScores[categoryId][playerId],
			delta = amount,
		})
	end
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetScore(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number
	return categoryScores[categoryId] and categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetAllScores(categoryId: string): {playerId: number}
	return categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- LEADERBOARD QUERIES
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId: string, limit: number?): {{rank: number, playerId: number, score: number}}
	local scores = categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
	local limit = limit or 100
	
	local entries = {}
	for playerId, score in scores do
		table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
	end
	
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		if a.score ~= b.score then return a.score > b.score end
		return a.playerId < b.playerId
	end)
	
	local results = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(limit, #entries) do
		table.insert(results, {rank = i, playerId = entries[i].playerId, score = entries[i].score})
	end
	
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number?
	local leaderboard = LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId, 10000)
	for _, entry in leaderboard do
		if entry.playerId == playerId then
			return entry.rank
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerSnapshot(playerId: number): {category: string, rank: number, score: number}
	local result = {}
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local rank = LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId, catId)
		if rank then
			table.insert(result, {
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				score = categoryScores[catId][playerId] or 0,
			})
		end
	end
	return result
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonSnapshot(seasonId: string, categoryId: string): {{playerId: number, score: number}}
	local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. categoryId
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
	end)
	return success and data or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- REWARDS
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPendingRewards(playerId: number): {{seasonId: string, category: string, rank: number, tier: string, rewards: any, claimed: boolean}}
	local results = {}
	
	-- Scan recent seasons (last 5)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local seasonTime = os.time() - i * 604800 -- approximate
		-- In production, would track season IDs properly
	end
	
	-- For now, scan all reward keys for this player
	-- In production, maintain an index
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ClaimReward(playerId: number, seasonId: string, categoryId: string): (boolean, any?)
	local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. playerId
	local success, rewardData = pcall(function()
		return REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
			if not old or old.claimed then return old end
			old.claimed = true
			return old
		end)
	end
	
	if success and rewardData and not rewardData.claimed then
		return true, rewardData.rewards
	end
	return false, nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonHistory(limit: number?): {{seasonId: string, type: string, startTime: number, endTime: number}}
	-- Would query snapshot store for season history
	return {}
end

-- ============================================
-- ANTI-CHEAT
-- ============================================

local scoreHistory = {} -- [playerId][category] = {timestamp, delta}

function LeaderboardEngine.ValidateScoreDelta(playerId: number, categoryId: string, delta: number): boolean
	if delta <= 0 then return false end
	if delta > 10000 then return false end -- Sanity cap
	
	local history = scoreHistory[playerId] and scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] or {}
	table.insert(history, {time = os.time(), delta = delta})
	
	-- Keep last 100 entries
	if #history > 100 then table.remove(history, 1) end
	
	if not scoreHistory[playerId] then scoreHistory[playerId] = {} end
	scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] = history
	
	-- Check rate: max 1000 per minute
	local recent = 0
	local now = os.time()
	for _, entry in history do
		if now - entry.time < 60 then
			recent += entry.delta
		end
	end
	
	if recent > 10000 then
		-- Flag for review
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
				playerId = playerId,
				category = categoryId,
				recentScore = recent,
				reason = "Excessive score rate",
			})
		end
		return false
	end
	
	-- Statistical outlier detection (simplified)
	if #history > 20 then
		local sum = 0
		for _, e in history do sum += e.delta end
		local avg = sum / #history
		local variance = 0
		for _, e in history do variance += (e.delta - avg)^2 end
		local stdDev = math.sqrt(variance / #history)
		
		if delta > avg + 4 * stdDev then
			-- Flag as outlier
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
					playerId = playerId,
					category = categoryId,
					delta = delta,
					avg = avg,
					stdDev = stdDev,
					reason = "Statistical outlier",
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

-- ============================================
-- INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-start weekly season on Mondays
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local now = os.time()
			local nextMonday = now + ((1 - os.date("*t", now).wday) % 7) * 86400
			if nextMonday <= now then nextMonday += 604800 end
			local waitTime = nextMonday - now
			
			task.wait(waitTime)
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "weekly"})
			
			-- Monthly on 1st
			task.wait(2592000 - 604800) -- ~3 weeks
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "monthly"})
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardEngine

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end
	
	Save["Accessories"] = {}
	local accessories = Folder:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if accessories then
		for _, accessory in accessories:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("BoolValue") and accessory.Value then Save["Accessories"][accessory.Name] = true end
		end
	end

	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

return SavingFunctions

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")

local DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION = 180
local DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER = 0.65
local DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER = 2
local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 25,
			ObjectiveReward = 250,
			ExclusivePet = "Event Rush Pet",
			SpawnMultiplier = DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER,
			RewardMultiplier = DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			HealthMultiplier = DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER,
		},
		{
			Name = "Golden Paws",
			Description = "Scavenge together to fill the golden paw meter.",
			ObjectiveType = "Scavenge",
			ObjectiveText = "Scavenge 40 times as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 40,
			ObjectiveReward = 350,
			ExclusiveEgg = "Golden Paws Egg",
			SpawnMultiplier = 1.2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,
			ObjectiveReward = 500,
			ExclusivePet = "Wild Companion",
			SpawnMultiplier = 2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.5,
			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,
			HealthMultiplier = 1.5,
		},
	}
	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]
	selected.Duration = normalizeDuration(DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION + math.random(-45, 60))
	WorldEventService.Start(selected)
end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)
StateChanged.OnServerEvent:Connect(function() end)

WorldEventService.Publish()
task.delay(10, beginDynamicEvent)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		local state = WorldEventService.GetState()
		if state.Active and os.time() >= state.EndsAt then
			WorldEventService.End()
			task.delay(math.random(30, 60), beginDynamicEvent)
		end
	end
end)

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

function PlayAnimation(Popup, Time)
	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

function Module.CreateBottomStatPopup(Amount, Stat, Colors, Time)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore
		local MainFrame = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame
		MainFrame.Title.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and "Top 100 Most "..RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Title
		MainFrame.Players.Amount.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Stat
		
		local Template = script.Template
		if Leaderboard:FindFirstChild("Template") then
			Template = Leaderboard.Template
		end
		
		for i = 1,100 do			
			local Clone = Template:Clone()
			Clone.LayoutOrder = i
			Clone.Name = i
			Clone.Rank.Text = ""
			Clone.PlrName.Text = ""
			Clone.Amount.Text = ""
			Clone.Parent = MainFrame.Players.Scroll
		end 
	end
end

return Main

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 18
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Stop" or action == "Follow" or action == "Sit" or action == "Sleep" or action == "Jump" or action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, action)
		if action == "Sleep" then stats.mood += 5 end
		if action == "Jump" then stats.mood += 2 end
		local color = action == "Sleep" and Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
		effect(pet, color, action == "Fly" and 22 or 12)
		send(player, action, "Pet behavior set to " .. action .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)
	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1
				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

local Module = {}

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

function Module.Tween(Object, Info, Goal1)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		Info.Speed or 0.25,
		Info.EasingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Info.EasingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
		Info.RepeatCount or 0,
		Info.Reverses or false,
		Info.DelayTime or 0
	)
	
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(Object, info, Goal1)
	Tween:Play()
end

function Module.TweenModel(EndCFrame,TI,Model)
	local NewCFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	NewCFrameValue.Value = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(NewCFrameValue,TI,EndCFrame)
	local Connection
	Connection = NewCFrameValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		Model:PivotTo(NewCFrameValue.Value)
	end)
	Tween:Play()
	Tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		NewCFrameValue:Destroy()
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local systemFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DayNightSystem")
local toggleCycle = systemFolder:WaitForChild("ToggleCycle") :: RemoteEvent

local DAY_LENGTH_MINUTES = 12
local START_TIME = 8
local cycleEnabled = true
local currentClockTime = START_TIME

systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime

local function setCycleEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	cycleEnabled = enabled
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

toggleCycle.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, requestedState: boolean?)
	if typeof(requestedState) == "boolean" then
		setCycleEnabled(requestedState)
	else
		setCycleEnabled(not cycleEnabled)
	end
	print(string.format("[DayNightSystem] %s set cycle %s", player.Name, cycleEnabled and "On" or "Off"))
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
	if not cycleEnabled then
		return
	end

	currentClockTime = (currentClockTime + (24 / (DAY_LENGTH_MINUTES * 60)) * deltaTime) % 24
	Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
end)

print("[DayNightSystem] Dynamic day/night cycle started")

--// Services
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)

--[[
Code system originally made by Croissant God, on roblox @DemonicMakesGames
]]

local Codes = {
	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
	["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
	["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"}, -- Put in pet name
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

--// Functions
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Rebirths" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		else
			return
		end
	else -- Pet
		if ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(Codes[Code][1]) == nil then warn("Error: "..Codes[Code][1].." Does not exist") return end -- Pet doesn't exist
		local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
		NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
		NewPet.PetName.Value = Codes[Code][1]
		NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	CodeStore:SetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId), true)
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138903578"
	killSound.Volume = 0.6
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	killSound:Play()
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
	elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(data.reward or 0) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		playKillSound(data.position)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			humanoid.Jump = false
		end
		local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
		if controller then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
			if ok and module and module.Play then module.Play("Double Jump Backflip Animation") end
		end
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler
