--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION = 180
local DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER = 0.65
local DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER = 2
local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 25,
			ObjectiveReward = 250,
			ExclusivePet = "Event Rush Pet",
			SpawnMultiplier = DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER,
			RewardMultiplier = DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			HealthMultiplier = DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER,
		},
		{
			Name = "Golden Paws",
			Description = "Scavenge together to fill the golden paw meter.",
			ObjectiveType = "Scavenge",
			ObjectiveText = "Scavenge 40 times as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 40,
			ObjectiveReward = 350,
			ExclusiveEgg = "Golden Paws Egg",
			SpawnMultiplier = 1.2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,
			ObjectiveReward = 500,
			ExclusivePet = "Wild Companion",
			SpawnMultiplier = 2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.5,
			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,
			HealthMultiplier = 1.5,
		},
	}
	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]
	selected.Duration = normalizeDuration(DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION + math.random(-45, 60))
	WorldEventService.Start(selected)
end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)
StateChanged.OnServerEvent:Connect(function() end)

WorldEventService.Publish()
task.delay(10, beginDynamicEvent)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		local state = WorldEventService.GetState()
		if state.Active and os.time() >= state.EndsAt then
			WorldEventService.End()
			task.delay(math.random(30, 60), beginDynamicEvent)
		end
	end
end)

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

- CurrencyMultiplier, this is the default that you get of currency, increasing this will make your game easier
- Datasave, this is the key for saving your player data, changing this will wipe people's stats.
- MaxDrops, incase you have a game where objects are dropped, you can edit this value to set the max per area
- RebirthBasePrice, howmuch rebirth costs (excluding increasing costs)
- RebirthMultiplier, howmuch currency multiplier Rebirth gives

In ReplicatedStorage-> Gamepasses, you can edit the following
- DoubleCurrency, change the value of this numbervalue to your gamepass id

In ReplicatedStorage-> Eggs, you can edit the following
- Names of the eggs (must also change the egg incubator's name in workspace)
- Cost of the egg, edit the cost number value
- Pets inside the egg, the name is the pet name and the value is the chance

In ReplicatedStorage-> Areas, you can edit the following
(will be finished in the future)

And ofcourse, you can edit all the scripts!
]]

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

--// Server Handler
-- Server info, announcements, shutdown, and server-wide tools.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ServerHandler = {}

function ServerHandler.GetInfo()
	local Info = {
		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Variables
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Trading

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

local TradeOffers = {} -- table with trade offers of the players inside

Remotes.RequestTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Player has clicked on "Send Trade" button
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return "Player has not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "Player is in trade" end
	-- You can also add requirements here for trading, such as 250 eggs opened

	--// Make a button pop up in their ui
	Remotes.RequestTrade:InvokeClient(Player2, Player.Name)	
end

Remotes.StartTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Starting trade
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return end

	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true

	TradeOffers[Player.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}} -- creates the inventory during the trade
	TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}}

	Remotes.StartTrade:InvokeClient(Player2,Player.Name) -- player 2 knows the trade started
	return true
end

Remotes.ChangeOffer.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)
	
	if Args.OfferType == "Pet" then
		if not TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] then
			if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player2) <= #Player2.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + #TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets then return "Max" end
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = 1
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2,"PetAdded", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Added"
		else
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = nil
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "PetRemoved", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Removed"
		end
	elseif Args.OfferType == "TradeTokens" then
		if tonumber(Args.Amount) and tonumber(Args.Amount) >= 0 then
			if not Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then return end -- 
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < tonumber(Args.Amount) then return end -- not enough tokens

			TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens = tonumber(Args.Amount)
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "TradeTokens", tonumber(Args.Amount))
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		end
	end
end

Remotes.TradeAction.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		TradeOffers[Player.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data to free up space
		TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data, if the player left it does not matter as it should still be removed

		if Player2 then -- incase the player left, you dont edit the data. If they did not, edit the data
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Cancel"})
		end

		return true
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- makes player ready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = true

			if Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- both are ready
				local Active = true

				--// Countdown Timer
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				
				local function BothReady()
					return Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value and Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value
				end
				
				local function CancelCountdown()
					Active = false 
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
				end
				
				for i = 10, 1, -1 do
					if not BothReady() then 
						CancelCountdown()
						break 
					end
					task.wait(0.3)	
				end
				
				if not BothReady() then
					CancelCountdown()
				end
			
				if not Active then return end
				
				print("Completing Trade")
				CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
			else
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Ready"})
				return "Ready"
			end
		else --// unready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Unready"})
			return "Unready"
		end		
	end
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already unequipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			NewPet:PivotTo(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)			
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false

	--// Player 1 to Player 2
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player, ClonedPet)
		end
		
		ClonedPet.Parent = Player2.Data.Pets
	end

	--// Player 2 to Player 1
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player2.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player2.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player2, ClonedPet)
		end

		ClonedPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	
	LoadEquipped(Player)
	LoadEquipped(Player2)

	if Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then -- like gems or smth exist
		Player2.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens -- for example u get 400 u give 150
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

local DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER = 2
local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 25,
			ObjectiveReward = 250,
			ExclusivePet = "Event Rush Pet",
			SpawnMultiplier = DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER,
			RewardMultiplier = DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			HealthMultiplier = DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER,
		},
		{
			Name = "Golden Paws",
			Description = "Scavenge together to fill the golden paw meter.",
			ObjectiveType = "Scavenge",
			ObjectiveText = "Scavenge 40 times as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 40,
			ObjectiveReward = 350,
			ExclusiveEgg = "Golden Paws Egg",
			SpawnMultiplier = 1.2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,

			SpawnMultiplier = 2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.5,
			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,
			HealthMultiplier = 1.5,
		},
	}
	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]
	selected.Duration = normalizeDuration(DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION + math.random(-45, 60))
	WorldEventService.Start(selected)
end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)
StateChanged.OnServerEvent:Connect(function() end)

WorldEventService.Publish()
task.delay(10, beginDynamicEvent)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		local state = WorldEventService.GetState()
		if state.Active and os.time() >= state.EndsAt then
			WorldEventService.End()

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

local Codes = {
	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
	["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
	["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"}, -- Put in pet name
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

--// Functions
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Rebirths" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		else
			return
		end
	else -- Pet
		if ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(Codes[Code][1]) == nil then warn("Error: "..Codes[Code][1].." Does not exist") return end -- Pet doesn't exist
		local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()

		NewPet.PetName.Value = Codes[Code][1]
		NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	CodeStore:SetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId), true)
end)

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end
	
	Save["Accessories"] = {}
	local accessories = Folder:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if accessories then
		for _, accessory in accessories:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("BoolValue") and accessory.Value then Save["Accessories"][accessory.Name] = true end
		end
	end

	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)
	local Setting = GameSettings:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Setting then return false, "Unknown setting" end
	if Setting:IsA("IntValue") or Setting:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Setting.Value = Num
	elseif Setting:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Setting.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	elseif Setting:IsA("StringValue") then
		Setting.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Setting.Value)
end

function SettingsHandler.AllAreas()
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Area in Areas:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Area:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		Result[#Result + 1] = { name = Area.Name, cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0 }
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return tonumber(A.name) < tonumber(B.name) end)
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetAreaCost(AreaName, NewValue)
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return false, "No areas" end
	local Area = Areas:FindFirstChild(tostring(AreaName))
	if not Area or not Area:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Area not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Area.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set area " .. AreaName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function SettingsHandler.AllGemShop()
	local GemShop = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if not GemShop then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Upgrade in GemShop:GetChildren() do
		local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
		local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
		local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
		local UpgName = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or Upgrade.Name
		local DefaultReward = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("DefaultReward") and Reward.DefaultReward.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Reward.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Reward.Exponential.Value or false
		local DefaultPrice = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("DefaultPrice") and Price.DefaultPrice.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Price.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Price.Exponential.Value or false
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = Upgrade.Name,
			name = UpgName,
			max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			reward = { default = DefaultReward, increasePer = IncreasePerR, exponential = ExpR },
			price = { default = DefaultPrice, increasePer = IncreasePerP, exponential = ExpP },
		}
	end
	return Result
end

return SettingsHandler

function CreatePopup(Type)

		NewPopup.Visible = true
		NewPopup.Parent = Player.PlayerGui.Interface.HUD.Popups

	end
	
	return
end

function PlayAnimation(Popup, Time)
	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

function Module.CreateBottomStatPopup(Amount, Stat, Colors, Time)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
