local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local feedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function getFrames()
	local gameUI = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GameUI")
	return gameUI and gameUI:FindFirstChild("Frames")
end

local existing = playerGui:FindFirstChild("PetInteractionUI")
if existing then existing:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetInteractionUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 30
gui.Parent = playerGui

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "RadialPanel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.54)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 460)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 20, 30)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = gui
local panelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
panelCorner.Parent = panel
local panelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
panelStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
panelStroke.Thickness = 2
panelStroke.Transparency = 0.3
panelStroke.Parent = panel
local panelGlow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
panelGlow.Name = "Glow"
panelGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 1.1)
panelGlow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.05, -0.05)
panelGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
panelGlow.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"
panelGlow.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 200)
panelGlow.ImageTransparency = 0.85
panelGlow.ZIndex = -1
panelGlow.Parent = panel

local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
panelScale.Scale = 0.8
panelScale.Parent = panel

local function tweenScale(target, duration)
	TweenService:Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = target}):Play()
end

panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
	if panel.Visible then
		tweenScale(1, 0.3)
	else
		tweenScale(0.8, 0.2)
	end
end)

local panelClose = Instance.new("TextButton")
panelClose.Name = "CloseButtonTop"
panelClose.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
panelClose.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8)
panelClose.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
panelClose.Text = "X"
panelClose.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
panelClose.TextSize = 16
panelClose.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
panelClose.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
panelClose.BorderSizePixel = 0
panelClose.Parent = panel
local panelCloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
panelCloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
panelCloseCorner.Parent = panelClose
local panelCloseStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
panelCloseStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 120)
panelCloseStroke.Thickness = 1.5
panelCloseStroke.Transparency = 0.3
panelCloseStroke.Parent = panelClose

local function hoverTween(button, enter)
	local goal = enter and {BackgroundColor3 = button:GetAttribute("HoverColor") or Color3.fromRGB(70, 110, 170)} or {BackgroundColor3 = button:GetAttribute("BaseColor") or Color3.fromRGB(52, 91, 143)}
	TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), goal):Play()
end

panelClose.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hoverTween(panelClose, true) end)
panelClose.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hoverTween(panelClose, false) end)
panelClose:SetAttribute("BaseColor", Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80))
panelClose:SetAttribute("HoverColor", Color3.fromRGB(230, 80, 100))
panelClose.Activated:Connect(function()
	tweenScale(0.8, 0.2)
	task.wait(0.2)
	panel.Visible = false
end)

local center = Instance.new("Frame")
center.Name = "Center"
center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 140)
center.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 42)
center.BorderSizePixel = 0
center.Parent = panel
local centerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
centerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
centerCorner.Parent = center
local centerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
centerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 240)
centerStroke.Thickness = 2
centerStroke.Transparency = 0.2
centerStroke.Parent = center
local centerGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
centerGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 60), Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38))
centerGradient.Rotation = 90
centerGradient.Parent = center

local function label(parent, text, size, position, font, color, textSize, alignment)
	local item = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	item.Text = text
	item.Size = size
	item.Position = position
	item.Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham
	item.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 250)
	item.TextSize = textSize or 14
	item.TextXAlignment = alignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	item.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end

local petIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
petIcon.Name = "PetIcon"
petIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
petIcon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
petIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
petIcon.Text = "PET"
petIcon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
petIcon.TextSize = 18
petIcon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 210, 255)
petIcon.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
petIcon.Parent = center

local title = label(center, "PET", UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(52, 6), Enum.Font.GothamBold, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 20, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)

local stateBadge = Instance.new("Frame")
stateBadge.Name = "StateBadge"
stateBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 22)
stateBadge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 34)
stateBadge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 120, 80)
stateBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
stateBadge.Parent = center
local stateBadgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
stateBadgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
stateBadgeCorner.Parent = stateBadge
local stateLabel = label(stateBadge, "Follow", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), Enum.Font.GothamBold, Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230), 12)

local function createNeedTrack(name, y, color, icon)
	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = name.."Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 24)
	container.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, y)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = center
	
	local iconLabel = label(container, icon, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Enum.Font.GothamBold, color, 14)
	iconLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	
	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Name = "Track"
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 8)
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 8)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 55)
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = container
	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trackCorner.Parent = track
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.75, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill
	local fillGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	fillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.fromRGB(
		math.floor(color.R * 255 * 0.7),
		math.floor(color.G * 255 * 0.7),
		math.floor(color.B * 255 * 0.7)
	))
	fillGradient.Rotation = 0
	fillGradient.Parent = fill
	
	local valueLabel = label(container, "75%", UDim2.fromOffset(26, 16), UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 4), Enum.Font.GothamBold, Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 225), 11, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
	
	return fill, valueLabel
end

local moodFill, moodValue = createNeedTrack("Mood", 64, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80), "M")
local hungerFill, hungerValue = createNeedTrack("Hunger", 96, Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 140), "H")

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "CloseButton"
closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12)
closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
closeButton.Text = "CLOSE"
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeButton.TextSize = 13
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 50, 60)
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.Parent = panel
local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
closeCorner.Parent = closeButton
local closeStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
closeStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 110)
closeStroke.Thickness = 1
closeStroke.Transparency = 0.4
closeStroke.Parent = closeButton
closeButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hoverTween(closeButton, true) end)
closeButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hoverTween(closeButton, false) end)
closeButton:SetAttribute("BaseColor", Color3.fromRGB(80, 50, 60))
closeButton:SetAttribute("HoverColor", Color3.fromRGB(110, 70, 80))
closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	tweenScale(0.8, 0.2)
	task.wait(0.2)
	panel.Visible = false
end)

local currentPetId
local buttonMap = {}
local activeButton = nil

local buttonConfig = {
	{cmd = "Stop",    color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80),  hover = Color3.fromRGB(230, 80, 100), icon = "STOP"},
	{cmd = "Follow",  color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 100), hover = Color3.fromRGB(70, 170, 130), icon = "FOLLOW"},
	{cmd = "Sit",     color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 50), hover = Color3.fromRGB(170, 130, 70), icon = "SIT"},
	{cmd = "Sleep",   color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 140),  hover = Color3.fromRGB(100, 80, 170), icon = "SLEEP"},
	{cmd = "Jump",    color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 160), hover = Color3.fromRGB(70, 160, 190), icon = "JUMP"},
	{cmd = "Fly",     color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 80, 180), hover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 100, 210), icon = "FLY"},
	{cmd = "Feed",    color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 120, 50), hover = Color3.fromRGB(210, 150, 70), icon = "FEED"},
	{cmd = "Pet",     color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 140), hover = Color3.fromRGB(230, 100, 170), icon = "LOVE"},
	{cmd = "Attack",  color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50),  hover = Color3.fromRGB(230, 70, 70),  icon = "ATK"},
	{cmd = "Scavenge",color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 120), hover = Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 150), icon = "SEARCH"},
}

local positions = {
	Vector2.new(210, 28),  Vector2.new(310, 52),  Vector2.new(368, 132), Vector2.new(350, 228), Vector2.new(265, 332),
	Vector2.new(165, 332), Vector2.new(70, 228),  Vector2.new(52, 132),  Vector2.new(108, 52),  Vector2.new(210, 370),
}

local function makeButton(config, index)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = config.cmd .. "Button"
	btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(positions[index].X, positions[index].Y)
	btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 52)
	btn.Text = ""
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 13
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = config.color
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Parent = panel
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
	corner.Parent = btn
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Name = "Stroke"
	stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.6
	stroke.Parent = btn
	
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.R * 255 * 1.2)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.G * 255 * 1.2)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.B * 255 * 1.2))
		),
		config.color
	)
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = btn
	
	local iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	iconLabel.Name = "Icon"
	iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)
	iconLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 4)
	iconLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	iconLabel.Text = config.icon
	iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	iconLabel.TextSize = 14
	iconLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	iconLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	iconLabel.Parent = btn
	
	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Name = "Name"
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.35)
	nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.62)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = config.cmd
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	nameLabel.TextSize = 10
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
	nameLabel.Parent = btn
	
	local glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	glow.Name = "Glow"
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.3, 1.3)
	glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.15, -0.15)
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glow.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"
	glow.ImageColor3 = config.color
	glow.ImageTransparency = 1
	glow.ZIndex = -1
	glow.Parent = btn
	
	btn:SetAttribute("BaseColor", config.color)
	btn:SetAttribute("HoverColor", config.hover)
	
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if activeButton ~= btn then
			hoverTween(btn, true)
			TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.2}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 0.7}):Play()
		end
	end)
	
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if activeButton ~= btn then
			hoverTween(btn, false)
			TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.6}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end)
	
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if currentPetId then
			feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, config.cmd)
		end
	end)
	
	buttonMap[config.cmd] = btn
	return btn
end

for index, config in ipairs(buttonConfig) do
	makeButton(config, index)
end

local function setActiveButton(cmd)
	for _, btn in buttonMap do
		local base = btn:GetAttribute("BaseColor")
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundColor3 = base}):Play()
		btn:FindFirstChild("Stroke").Transparency = 0.6
		btn:FindFirstChild("Glow").ImageTransparency = 1
	end
	if cmd and buttonMap[cmd] then
		activeButton = buttonMap[cmd]
		local hover = activeButton:GetAttribute("HoverColor")
		TweenService:Create(activeButton, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundColor3 = hover}):Play()
		activeButton:FindFirstChild("Stroke").Transparency = 0.1
		activeButton:FindFirstChild("Glow").ImageTransparency = 0.6
	end
end

local inventoryButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
inventoryButton.Name = "InventoryButton"
inventoryButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
inventoryButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 200)
inventoryButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 34)
inventoryButton.Text = "INVENTORY"
inventoryButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
inventoryButton.TextSize = 12
inventoryButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
inventoryButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 100, 70)
inventoryButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
inventoryButton.Parent = panel
local inventoryCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
inventoryCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
inventoryCorner.Parent = inventoryButton
local inventoryStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
inventoryStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 120)
inventoryStroke.Thickness = 1
inventoryStroke.Transparency = 0.4
inventoryStroke.Parent = inventoryButton
inventoryButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hoverTween(inventoryButton, true) end)
inventoryButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hoverTween(inventoryButton, false) end)
inventoryButton:SetAttribute("BaseColor", Color3.fromRGB(40, 100, 70))
inventoryButton:SetAttribute("HoverColor", Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 100))
inventoryButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if currentPetId then feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, "Inventory") end
end)

local hideToken = 0
local visibleActions = {
	Pet = true, Inventory = true, Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true,
	Sleep = true, Jump = true, Fly = true, Feed = true, Attack = true,
	Scavenge = true,
}

local function show(data)
	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))
	stateLabel.Text = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	
	local stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 120, 80)
	local stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
	local state = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	if state == "Stop" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 60)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
	elseif state == "Follow" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 100)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
	elseif state == "Sit" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 50)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 180)
	elseif state == "Sleep" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 140)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
	elseif state == "Jump" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 160)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)
	elseif state == "Fly" then
		stateColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 80, 180)
		stateTextCol = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
	end
	TweenService:Create(stateBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundColor3 = stateColor}):Play()
	stateLabel.TextColor3 = stateTextCol
	
	local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(data.mood) or 0, 0, 100)
	local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(data.hunger) or 0, 0, 100)
	
	TweenService:Create(moodFill, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(hungerFill, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)}):Play()
	moodValue.Text = math.floor(mood).."%"
	hungerValue.Text = math.floor(hunger).."%"
	
	local moodColor = mood >= 70 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or mood >= 35 and Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70)
	moodFill.BackgroundColor3 = moodColor
	
	setActiveButton(state)
	
	if not panel.Visible then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(10, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenScale(0.8, 0.2)
			task.wait(0.2)
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.action == "Needs" then
		if panel.Visible and data.petId and data.petId == currentPetId then
			show(data)
		end
		return
	end
	if not visibleActions[data.action] then return end
	show(data)

end)

local petNeedsBillboards = {}
local function createPetNeedsBillboard(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") or petNeedsBillboards[pet] then return end
	local adornee = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 82)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 1.8, 3), 0)
	billboard.Parent = pet
	local background = Instance.new("Frame")
	background.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	background.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	background.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	background.BorderSizePixel = 0
	background.Parent = billboard
	local backgroundCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	backgroundCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
	backgroundCorner.Parent = background
	local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 165, 220)
	outline.Thickness = 1
	outline.Parent = background
	local moodLabel = label(background, "Mood 0%", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 4), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 135))
	moodLabel.TextSize = 13
	moodLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local hungerLabel = label(background, "Hunger 0%", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 27), Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, Color3.fromRGB(135, 230, 170))
	hungerLabel.TextSize = 13
	hungerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local function makeNeedBar(name, y, color)

		track.Name = name .. "Bar"
		track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, y)
		track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(174, 7)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 56, 68)
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.Parent = background
		local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		trackCorner.Parent = track
		local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		fill.Name = "Fill"
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.75, 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.Parent = track
		local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		fillCorner.Parent = fill
		return fill
	end
	local moodFill = makeNeedBar("Mood", 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 100))
	local hungerFill = makeNeedBar("Hunger", 43, Color3.fromRGB(100, 215, 160))
	local moodIcon = Instance.new("Frame")
	moodIcon.Name = "MoodIndicator"
	moodIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	moodIcon.Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0, 12)
	moodIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
	moodIcon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 130)
	moodIcon.BorderSizePixel = 0
	moodIcon.Parent = background
	local moodIconCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	moodIconCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	moodIconCorner.Parent = moodIcon
	local function update()
		local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 0, 0, 100)
		local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 0, 0, 100)
		moodLabel.Text = "Mood  " .. math.floor(mood) .. "%"
		hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger  " .. math.floor(hunger) .. "%"
		moodFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)
		hungerFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)
		moodIcon.BackgroundColor3 = mood >= 70 and Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 130) or mood >= 35 and Color3.fromRGB(245, 190, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90)
	end
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Mood"):Connect(update)
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Hunger"):Connect(update)
	pet.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent) if not parent then petNeedsBillboards[pet] = nil end end)
	petNeedsBillboards[pet] = billboard
	update()
end

local playerPets = workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local function inspectPetFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do createPetNeedsBillboard(pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(createPetNeedsBillboard, pet) end)
end
for _, folder in ipairs(playerPets:GetChildren()) do
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end
playerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(folder) if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end end)

	if currentPetId then
		local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(currentPetId)
		if pet then
			show({petId = pet.Name, petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or pet.Name, mood = pet:GetAttribute("Mood"), hunger = pet:GetAttribute("Hunger"), state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"})
		end
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(1, refreshInteractionPanel) end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if child.Name == "GameUI" then task.defer(refreshInteractionPanel) end end)

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

-- In this module you can find things like Rebirth Multiplier. By using code such as Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player) returns a number which is that player's multiplier. Useful if you have multipliers in multiple scripts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]

local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Multipliers = {}

function Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = 1
	
	if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
		Multi *= (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value * GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1) -- so multi = RebirthMulti + 1
	else
		Multi *= (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 0.5) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value
	end
	
	return Multi	
end

function Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = GameSettings.CurrencyMultiplier.Value
	Multi *= (Player.Data.Gamepasses.DoubleCurrency.Value and 2 or 1)
	Multi *= Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	Multi *= PetMultipliers.ReadPlayerMultiplier(Player.Name)
	
	local R = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop["2"].Reward
	if R.Exponential.Value then
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	else
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	end
	
	return Multi
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player)
	return 5
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets1"].Value and 3 or 0)
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets2"].Value and 10 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	return 50 + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage1"].Value and 50 or 0) + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage2"].Value and 250 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)
	return 1 * (Player.Data.Gamepasses.Lucky.Value and 2 or 1)
end

return Multipliers

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

--// Function for handling buttons

local ButtonHandler = {}

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local function BlurAnimation(Transparency)
	Tween.Tween(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameUI.Blur, {Speed = 0.25}, {BackgroundTransparency=Transparency})
end

ButtonHandler.OnClick = function(Frame,Size)	
	if not Frame.Visible then
		--// Close other frames
		for _,OtherFrame in Frame.Parent:GetChildren() do
			if OtherFrame:IsA("Frame") and OtherFrame.Visible then
				OtherFrame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.1, true)
				task.wait(0.04)
				OtherFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end

		--// Open frame

		Frame.Size = Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.1)
		Frame.Visible = true
		Frame:TweenSize(Size, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		BlurAnimation(0.4)
	else
		--// Close the frame

		BlurAnimation(1)
		Frame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		Frame.Visible = false
	end
end

-- GUI Setup

-- Deduplication cache

-- Cross-server messaging
local MESSAGING_TOPIC = "NotificationSystem"

-- Initialize messaging subscription
local function initMessaging()
	if RunService:IsServer() then return end
	
	task.spawn(function()
		local success, err = pcall(function()
			MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, function(message)
				local data = message.Data
				NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
			end)
		end)
		if not success then
			warn("NotificationSystem: Failed to subscribe to messaging:", err)
		end
	end)
end

	local template = Instance.new("Frame")
	template.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	template.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 70)
	template.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

	stroke.Transparency = 0.4

	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1

-- Core send function
function NotificationSystem.Send(player, data)
	-- Server-side: publish to player's topic
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local message = {
			id = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),
			type = data.type,
			title = data.title,
			body = data.body,
			icon = data.icon,
			sound = data.sound,
			actions = data.actions,
			autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss,
			priority = data.priority,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		}
		
		-- Check deduplication
		local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
		if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
			return -- Suppressed duplicate
		end
		recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
		
		-- Check settings
		if not settings[data.type] then return end
		if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
		
		-- Publish
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, message)
		return
	end
	
	-- Client-side: receive from server
	NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
end

function NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
	-- Check deduplication
	local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
	if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
		return
	end
	recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
	
	-- Check settings
	if not settings[data.type] then return end
	if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
	
	-- Play sound
	if data.sound then
		local AudioEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AudioEffects)
		AudioEffects.PlayPreset(data.sound)
	end
	
	-- Create UI
	local typeConfig = NOTIFICATION_TYPES[data.type]
	local channel = data.channel or typeConfig.channel
	
	if channel == "Toast" then
		if #activeToasts >= maxToasts then
			-- Remove oldest
			local oldestId = next(activeToasts)
			if oldestId then dismissToast(oldestId) end
		end
		
		local toast = createToast(data)
		toast.Parent = toastContainer
		activeToasts[data.id] = toast
		
		if data.autoDismiss then
			task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end)
		end
		
	elseif channel == "Banner" then
		createBanner(data)
	elseif channel == "Modal" then
		-- Create modal dialog
		NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	elseif channel == "Badge" then
		updateBadge(data.type, 1)
	end
end

function NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Modal_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = gui
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Darken background
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	overlay.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex - 1
	overlay.Parent = gui
	
	-- Content
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.Parent = frame
	
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 16
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Action buttons
	if data.actions then
		for i, action in data.actions do
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 170, 180)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.Text = action.text
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 14
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			btn.Parent = frame
			
			local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnCorner.Parent = btn
			
			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if action.callback then action.callback() end
				overlay:Destroy()
				frame:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 18
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		overlay:Destroy()
		frame:Destroy()
	end)
	
	-- Entrance
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	}):Play()
end

-- Settings
function NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings(newSettings)
	for k, v in newSettings do
		settings[k] = v
	end
end

function NotificationSystem.GetSettings()
	return settings
end

-- Offline queue handling
function NotificationSystem.QueueOffline(playerId, data)
	if not pendingOffline[playerId] then
		pendingOffline[playerId] = {}
	end
	table.insert(pendingOffline[playerId], data)
end

function NotificationSystem.DeliverOffline(playerId)
	local queue = pendingOffline[playerId]
	if queue then
		for _, data in queue do
			NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
		end
		pendingOffline[playerId] = nil
	end
end

-- Initialize
initMessaging()

-- Cleanup old dedup entries periodically
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		local now = os.time()
		for key, timestamp in recentNotifications do
			if now - timestamp > DEDUP_WINDOW * 2 then
				recentNotifications[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

return NotificationSystem

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

--// Services
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

	TweenService:Create(playButton, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.34), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(83, 188, 255)}):Play()
end)
playButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(playButton, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.58, 0.31)}):Play()
end)
playButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(playButton, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Size = hovering and UDim2.fromScale(0.66, 0.38) or UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.34)}):Play()
end)

local stages = {{0.2, "Connecting to world..."}, {0.45, "Loading pets and companions..."}, {0.7, "Preparing areas and events..."}, {0.9, "Applying settings..."}, {1, "Ready"}}
local ready = false
local fading = false
local function fadeOut()
	if fading then return end
	fading = true
	for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local goals = {BackgroundTransparency = 1}
			if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then goals.TextTransparency = 1 end
			pcall(function() TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(0.8), goals):Play() end)
		end
	end
	TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	task.wait(0.9)
	gui:Destroy()
end

playButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not ready then return end
	playButton.Active = false
	subtitle.Text = "Entering the world..."
	fadeOut()
end)

task.spawn(function()
	for _, stage in ipairs(stages) do
		local value, text = stage[1], stage[2]
		subtitle.Text = text
		TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(value, 1)}):Play()
		percent.Text = math.floor(value * 100) .. "%"
		task.wait(0.65)
	end
	ready = true
	panel.Visible = true
	playButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(83, 188, 255)
end)

--!strict

--[[
    Lemonade-Style Roblox Studio WebSync Plugin
    --------------------------------------------
    Features:
    • Adds a button to the Plugins toolbar
    • Opens a dockable "Connect" window
    • Connect / Disconnect
    • Connection indicator
    • Project status
    • Prompt count
    • WebSync last sync
    • Backend pairing request
    • Basic heartbeat
    • Logs toggle
]]

--------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
--------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
--------------------------------------------------

local CONFIG = {
	PLUGIN_NAME = "Lemonade WebSync",

	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- Replace this with your real backend URL.
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app",

	CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/api/studio/connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/api/studio/heartbeat",
	DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/api/studio/disconnect",
	PROJECT_ENDPOINT = "/api/studio/project",

	POLL_INTERVAL = 5,
	HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 15,
}

--------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
--------------------------------------------------

local connected = false
local connecting = false
local logsEnabled = false

local sessionToken: string? = nil
local projectId: string? = nil

local lastSyncText = "Never"
local promptCount = 0

--------------------------------------------------
-- TOOLBAR
--------------------------------------------------

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar("Lemonade")

local toolbarButton = toolbar:CreateButton(
	"LemonadeConnect",
	"Open Lemonade WebSync",
	"rbxassetid://4458901886"
)

toolbarButton.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

--------------------------------------------------
-- WIDGET
--------------------------------------------------

	Enum.InitialDockState.Float,
	true,
	false,
	360,
	300,
	300,
	250
)

local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui(
	"LemonadeWebSyncWidget",
	widgetInfo
)

widget.Title = "Lemonade"
widget.Enabled = false

--------------------------------------------------
-- COLORS
--------------------------------------------------

local COLORS = {

	PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(31, 33, 38),

	GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 88),

--------------------------------------------------

-- TOP BAR
--------------------------------------------------

title.TextSize = 16

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONTENT
--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------
-- VERSION / STATUS ROW
--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECTION DOT
--------------------------------------------------

local statusDotFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

local statusDot = Instance.new("Frame")

--------------------------------------------------
-- PROJECT INFO PANEL
--------------------------------------------------

local infoPanel = Instance.new("Frame")

infoPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100)
infoPanel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 52)
infoPanel.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.PANEL
infoPanel.BorderColor3 = COLORS.BORDER
infoPanel.BorderSizePixel = 1
infoPanel.Parent = content

local infoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
infoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
infoCorner.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- PROJECT
--------------------------------------------------

local projectLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

projectLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
projectLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
projectLabel.Text = "Project: ok"
projectLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
projectLabel.TextSize = 13
projectLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
projectLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
projectLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
--------------------------------------------------

local syncLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
syncLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 25)
syncLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10)
syncLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"
syncLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
syncLabel.TextSize = 13
syncLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
syncLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
syncLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- PROMPTS
--------------------------------------------------

local promptsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
promptsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 25)

promptsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
promptsLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
promptsLabel.TextSize = 13
promptsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
promptsLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
promptsLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- STATUS
--------------------------------------------------

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 25)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 45)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Status: Offline"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.RED
statusLabel.TextSize = 13
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- BOTTOM CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------

local bottom = Instance.new("Frame")
bottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
bottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -40)
bottom.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bottom.Parent = content

local logsButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
logsButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30)
logsButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 5)
logsButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.BUTTON
logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
logsButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
logsButton.TextSize = 12
logsButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
logsButton.Parent = bottom

local logsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
logsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
logsCorner.Parent = logsButton

--------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------

local function log(...)
	if not logsEnabled then
		return
	end

	print("[Lemonade WebSync]", ...)
end

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN,
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		connectButton.Text = "Connect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.RED

		setStatus(
			"Offline",
			COLORS.RED,
			COLORS.RED
		)
	end
end

local function updateLastSync()
	lastSyncText = os.date("%X")

	syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: " .. lastSyncText
end

local function getProjectName(): string
	local gameName = game:GetAttribute("GameName")

	if typeof(gameName) == "string" and gameName ~= "" then
		return gameName
	end

	return game.Name
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP HELPER
--------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	method: string,
	path: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)

	local url = CONFIG.BACKEND_URL .. path

	local requestData = {
		Url = url,
		Method = method,
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		},
	}

	if sessionToken then
		requestData.Headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. sessionToken
	end

	if body ~= nil then
		requestData.Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
	end

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync(requestData)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP error:", response)
		return false, nil
	end

	if not response.Success then
		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP status:",
			response.StatusCode,
			response.StatusMessage
		)

		return false, response
	end

	local decoded = nil

	if response.Body and response.Body ~= "" then
		local decodeSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
		end)

		if decodeSuccess then
			decoded = result
		end
	end

	return true, decoded
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function connectToBackend()

	if connecting then
		return
	end

	if connected then
		return
	end

	connecting = true

	connectButton.Text = "Connecting..."
	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW,
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	log("Connecting to backend...")

	local success, response = request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectName = getProjectName(),
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "2.3",
			studioName = "Roblox Studio",
		}
	)

	if success and response then

		sessionToken = response.token
		projectId = response.projectId

		if typeof(response.prompts) == "number" then
			promptCount = response.prompts
			promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: " .. tostring(promptCount)
		end

		setConnectedState(true)
		updateLastSync()

		projectLabel.Text =
			"Project: " ..
			(response.projectName or "ok")

		log("Connected successfully.")
	else

		setConnectedState(false)

		connectButton.Text = "Connect"

		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] Failed to connect."
		)
	end

	connecting = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DISCONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function disconnectFromBackend()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	log("Disconnecting...")

	request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectId = projectId,
		}
	)

	sessionToken = nil
	projectId = nil

	setConnectedState(false)

	log("Disconnected.")
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while true do

		task.wait(CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)

		if connected and sessionToken then

			local success = request(
				"POST",
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					projectId = projectId,
					projectName = getProjectName(),
					placeId = game.PlaceId,
				}
			)

			if success then
				updateLastSync()
			else
				warn(
					"[Lemonade WebSync] Heartbeat failed."
				)
			end
		end
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PLUGIN BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()

	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled

	if widget.Enabled then
		log("Widget opened.")
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLOSE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

connectButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if connected then
		disconnectFromBackend()
	else
		connectToBackend()
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOG TOGGLE
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	logsEnabled = not logsEnabled

	if logsEnabled then
		logsButton.Text = "Logs On"
	else
		logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL UI
--------------------------------------------------

projectLabel.Text = "Project: " .. getProjectName()
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"

setConnectedState(false)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SELECTION DEBUG
--------------------------------------------------

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	local selected = Selection:Get()

	log(
		"Selection changed:",
		#selected
	)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
--------------------------------------------------

print("========================================")
print("[Lemonade WebSync] Plugin Loaded")
print("Project:", getProjectName())
print("PlaceId:", game.PlaceId)
print("========================================")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local enemies = workspace:WaitForChild("PetEnemies")
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("EnemyCombatUI")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 75
gui.Parent = playerGui

local hud = Instance.new("Frame")

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
