status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.Text = "ENEMY COMBAT"
status.Parent = hud

local substatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
substatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
substatus.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 31)
substatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18)
substatus.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
substatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 215, 230)
substatus.TextSize = 14
substatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
substatus.Text = "Scanning for enemies..."
substatus.Parent = hud

local barBack = Instance.new("Frame")
barBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 55)
barBack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 9)
barBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 62, 75)
barBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
barBack.Parent = hud
local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
barCorner.Parent = barBack
local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 85, 85)
bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
bar.Parent = barBack
local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
fillCorner.Parent = bar

local overlays = {}
local function makeOverlay(enemy)
	if overlays[enemy] or not enemy:IsA("Model") then return end
	local adornee = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head", true) or enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not adornee then return end
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "EnemyHeadOverlay"
	billboard.Adornee = adornee
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 66)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 1.8, 3), 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 80
	billboard.Enabled = false
	billboard.Parent = enemy

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.Parent = billboard
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = root
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 3)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 18)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 230)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = root
	local state = title:Clone()
	state.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 21)
	state.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 16)
	state.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	state.TextSize = 12
	state.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
	state.Parent = root
	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 47)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 8)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 62, 75)
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = root
	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trackCorner.Parent = track
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "HealthFill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 120)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	local fillCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner2.Parent = fill
	overlays[enemy] = {billboard = billboard, title = title, state = state, fill = fill}
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function() overlays[enemy] = nil end)
end

local function updateOverlay(enemy, data)
	local entry = overlays[enemy]
	if not entry then makeOverlay(enemy) entry = overlays[enemy] end
	if not entry then return end
	local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local distance = main and rootPart and (main.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
	local health = math.max(0, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0)
	local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)
	local stateText = tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") or "Roaming")
	entry.billboard.Enabled = distance <= 80 and health > 0
	entry.title.Text = enemy.Name:gsub("PetEnemy_Player_%d+_", "ENEMY ")
	entry.state.Text = string.upper(stateText) .. (data and data.damage and "  -" .. tostring(data.damage) or "")
	entry.state.TextColor3 = stateText == "Attacking" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125) or Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
	entry.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
end

for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do makeOverlay(enemy) end
enemies.ChildAdded:Connect(function(enemy) task.defer(makeOverlay, enemy) end)

local selectedEnemy
local lastCombat = {}
combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local enemyName = data.enemy
	local enemy = enemyName and enemies:FindFirstChild(enemyName)
	if enemy then
		selectedEnemy = enemy
		lastCombat[enemy] = data
		updateOverlay(enemy, data)
		hud.Visible = true

		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0

		bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
	end
end)

local updateTimer = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	updateTimer += deltaTime
	if updateTimer < 0.1 then return end
	updateTimer = 0
	for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") then updateOverlay(enemy, lastCombat[enemy]) end

	if selectedEnemy and selectedEnemy.Parent then

		local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	end
end)

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Variables
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Trading

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

local TradeOffers = {} -- table with trade offers of the players inside

Remotes.RequestTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Player has clicked on "Send Trade" button
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return "Player has not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "Player is in trade" end
	-- You can also add requirements here for trading, such as 250 eggs opened

	--// Make a button pop up in their ui
	Remotes.RequestTrade:InvokeClient(Player2, Player.Name)	
end

Remotes.StartTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Starting trade
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return end

	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true

	TradeOffers[Player.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}} -- creates the inventory during the trade
	TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}}

	Remotes.StartTrade:InvokeClient(Player2,Player.Name) -- player 2 knows the trade started
	return true
end

Remotes.ChangeOffer.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)
	
	if Args.OfferType == "Pet" then
		if not TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] then
			if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player2) <= #Player2.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + #TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets then return "Max" end
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = 1
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2,"PetAdded", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Added"
		else
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = nil
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "PetRemoved", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Removed"
		end
	elseif Args.OfferType == "TradeTokens" then
		if tonumber(Args.Amount) and tonumber(Args.Amount) >= 0 then
			if not Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then return end -- 
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < tonumber(Args.Amount) then return end -- not enough tokens

			TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens = tonumber(Args.Amount)
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "TradeTokens", tonumber(Args.Amount))
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		end
	end
end

Remotes.TradeAction.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		TradeOffers[Player.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data to free up space
		TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data, if the player left it does not matter as it should still be removed

		if Player2 then -- incase the player left, you dont edit the data. If they did not, edit the data
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Cancel"})
		end

		return true
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- makes player ready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = true

			if Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- both are ready
				local Active = true

				--// Countdown Timer
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				
				local function BothReady()
					return Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value and Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value
				end
				
				local function CancelCountdown()
					Active = false 
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
				end
				
				for i = 10, 1, -1 do
					if not BothReady() then 
						CancelCountdown()
						break 
					end
					task.wait(0.3)	
				end
				
				if not BothReady() then
					CancelCountdown()
				end
			
				if not Active then return end
				
				print("Completing Trade")
				CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
			else
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Ready"})
				return "Ready"
			end
		else --// unready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Unready"})
			return "Unready"
		end		
	end
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already unequipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			NewPet:PivotTo(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)			
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false

	--// Player 1 to Player 2
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player, ClonedPet)
		end
		
		ClonedPet.Parent = Player2.Data.Pets
	end

	--// Player 2 to Player 1
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player2.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player2.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player2, ClonedPet)
		end

		ClonedPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	
	LoadEquipped(Player)
	LoadEquipped(Player2)

	if Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then -- like gems or smth exist
		Player2.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens -- for example u get 400 u give 150
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens
	end
end

--[[
Thanks for using my plugin! This script contains information on how to edit your game.

In ReplicatedStorage-> Game Settings, you can edit the following:
- ClickingAnywhere, this is a beta feature for clicker games which allows you to click an ywhere on the game to get clicks. Set it to true if you want this
- CurrencyMultiplier, this is the default that you get of currency, increasing this will make your game easier
- Datasave, this is the key for saving your player data, changing this will wipe people's stats.
- MaxDrops, incase you have a game where objects are dropped, you can edit this value to set the max per area
- RebirthBasePrice, howmuch rebirth costs (excluding increasing costs)
- RebirthMultiplier, howmuch currency multiplier Rebirth gives

In ReplicatedStorage-> Gamepasses, you can edit the following
- DoubleCurrency, change the value of this numbervalue to your gamepass id

In ReplicatedStorage-> Eggs, you can edit the following
- Names of the eggs (must also change the egg incubator's name in workspace)
- Cost of the egg, edit the cost number value
- Pets inside the egg, the name is the pet name and the value is the chance

In ReplicatedStorage-> Areas, you can edit the following
(will be finished in the future)

And ofcourse, you can edit all the scripts!
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local tagName = "GMHeadTag"
local glowName = "GMHeadGlow"
local tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 54)
local tagHex = "#FFDD36"

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = glowName
	glow.Adornee = head
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
	glow.Parent = character

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = tagName
	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Text = "GM"
	label.TextColor3 = tagColor
	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
	label.Parent = billboard

	local textTween = TweenService:Create(
		label,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 150), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55}
	)
	textTween:Play()
end

local function refresh()
	if player.Character then addTag(player.Character) end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsGM"):Connect(refresh)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	addTag(character)
end)

TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.PrefixText = string.format("<font color='%s'>[GM]</font> %s", tagHex, message.PrefixText)
		end
	end
	return properties
end

TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = function(message, adornee)
	local properties = Instance.new("BubbleChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 8)
			properties.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 125)
			properties.TextSize = 18
			properties.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
			properties.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
			properties.TailVisible = true
		end
	end
	return properties
end

local Module = {}

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

function Module.Tween(Object, Info, Goal1)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		Info.Speed or 0.25,
		Info.EasingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Info.EasingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
		Info.RepeatCount or 0,
		Info.Reverses or false,
		Info.DelayTime or 0
	)
	
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(Object, info, Goal1)
	Tween:Play()
end

function Module.TweenModel(EndCFrame,TI,Model)
	local NewCFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	NewCFrameValue.Value = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(NewCFrameValue,TI,EndCFrame)
	local Connection
	Connection = NewCFrameValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		Model:PivotTo(NewCFrameValue.Value)
	end)
	Tween:Play()
	Tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		NewCFrameValue:Destroy()
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

return Module

	local entry = overlays[enemy]

	local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)

	entry.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
end

		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
		local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)
		bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
	end
end)

local updateTimer = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	updateTimer += deltaTime
	if updateTimer < 0.1 then return end
	updateTimer = 0
	for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") then updateOverlay(enemy, lastCombat[enemy]) end
	end
	if selectedEnemy and selectedEnemy.Parent then
		local main = selectedEnemy.PrimaryPart or selectedEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if main and rootPart and (main.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > 80 then hud.Visible = false end
	end

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end
	
	Save["Accessories"] = {}
	local accessories = Folder:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if accessories then
		for _, accessory in accessories:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("BoolValue") and accessory.Value then Save["Accessories"][accessory.Name] = true end
		end
	end

	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

return SavingFunctions

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138903578"
	killSound.Volume = 0.6
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	killSound:Play()
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
	elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(data.reward or 0) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		playKillSound(data.position)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			humanoid.Jump = false
		end
		local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
		if controller then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
			if ok and module and module.Play then module.Play("Double Jump Backflip Animation") end
		end
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

	participation.Text = state.ObjectiveCompleted and "Objective complete! Rewards will be granted when the event ends." or "Contribute to earn the completion reward."
	participation.TextColor3 = state.ObjectiveCompleted and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 220, 175)
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / target, 0, 1), 1)
end

stateChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(updateEvent)
for _, name in {"Active", "Description", "EndsAt", "ObjectiveText", "ObjectiveProgress", "ObjectiveTarget", "ObjectiveCompleted"} do
	worldEvents:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
		local state = currentState or {}
		state.Active = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Active")
		state.Name = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Name")
		state.Description = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Description")
		state.EndsAt = worldEvents:GetAttribute("EndsAt")

		state.ObjectiveTarget = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveTarget")
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveCompleted") == true
		updateEvent(state)
	end)
end

		if currentState and currentState.Active then

end)

end)

end

--// Players Handler
-- View player data, modify stats, kick, manage pets/gamepasses.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayersHandler = {}

function PlayersHandler.FindPlayer(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	Name = string.lower(Name)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == Name or string.lower(Player.DisplayName) == Name then
			return Player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayersHandler.ListPlayers()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local PD = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
			petCount = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("Pets") and #Data.Pets:GetChildren() or 0,
			currency = PD and PD.Currency.Value or 0,
			gems = PD and PD.Currency2.Value or 0,
			rebirths = PD and PD.Rebirth.Value or 0,
			zone = PD and PD.BestZone.Value or 0,
			eggsHatched = PD and PD.EggsHatched.Value or 0,
			totalCurrency = PD and PD.TotalCurrency.Value or 0,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function()
				local NSV = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues")
				return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false
			end)(),
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PlayersHandler.GetPlayerData(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return nil end
	local Data = Player.Data
	local PD = Data.PlayerData
	local GP = Data.Gamepasses

	local Gamepasses = {}
	for _, Value in GP:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
			Gamepasses[Value.Name] = Value.Value
		end
	end

	local Pets = {}
	for _, Pet in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Pets[#Pets + 1] = {
			id = Pet.Name,
			name = Pet.PetName.Value,
			equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end

	local AutoDelete = {}
	for _, AD in Data.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if AD:IsA("BoolValue") then
			AutoDelete[AD.Name] = AD.Value
		end
	end

	local GemShop = {}
	local GemShopFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if GemShopFolder then
		for _, Upgrade in GemShopFolder:GetChildren() do
			local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
			local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
			local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
			local CurrentLevel = PD:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. Upgrade.Name)
			GemShop[#GemShop + 1] = {
				id = Upgrade.Name,
				name = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or ("Upgrade " .. Upgrade.Name),
				level = CurrentLevel and CurrentLevel.Value or 0,
				max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		name = Player.Name,
		displayName = Player.DisplayName,
		userId = Player.UserId,
		accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
		loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
		isTrading = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsTrading"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		isOpeningEgg = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsOpeningEgg"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		petsEquipped = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("PetsEquipped"); return V and V.Value or 0 end)(),

		currency = PD.Currency.Value,
		gems = PD.Currency2.Value,
		rebirths = PD.Rebirth.Value,
		zone = PD.BestZone.Value,
		eggsHatched = PD.EggsHatched.Value,
		totalCurrency = PD.TotalCurrency.Value,
		gemUpgrade1 = PD.GemUpgrade1.Value,
		gemUpgrade2 = PD.GemUpgrade2.Value,

		music = PD.Music.Value,
		showOtherPets = PD.ShowOtherPets.Value,

		gamepasses = Gamepasses,
		pets = Pets,
		petCount = #Pets,
		autoDelete = AutoDelete,
		gemShop = GemShop,

		maxStorage = 50
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage1 and 50 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage2 and 250 or 0),
		maxEquipped = 5
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets1 and 3 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets2 and 10 or 0),
	}
end

function PlayersHandler.SetValue(Value, NewValue)
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false end
		Value.Value = Num
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function PlayersHandler.SetCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = Num
	return true, "Set currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
	Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value = Num
	return true, "Set gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetRebirths(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value = Num
	return true, "Set rebirths"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetZone(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = Num
	return true, "Set zone"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGemUpgrade(Player, Slot, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local S = tonumber(Slot)
	local A = tonumber(Amount)
	if not S or not A then return false, "Invalid input" end
	local Value = Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. S)
	if not Value then return false, "Upgrade not found" end
	Value.Value = A
	return true, "Set gem upgrade " .. S
end

function PlayersHandler.ToggleGamepass(Player, Name, State)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Value = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Value then return false, "Gamepass not found" end
	Value.Value = (State == true or State == "true")
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Value.Value)
end

function PlayersHandler.KickPlayer(Player, Reason)
	if not Player then return false, "Player not found" end
	local R = tostring(Reason or "Kicked by admin")
	if R == "" then R = "Kicked by admin" end
	Player:Kick(R)
	return true, "Kicked " .. Player.Name
end

return PlayersHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138903578"
	killSound.Volume = 0.6
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	killSound:Play()
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
	elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(data.reward or 0) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		playKillSound(data.position)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			humanoid.Jump = false
		end
		local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
		if controller then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
			if ok and module and module.Play then module.Play("Double Jump Backflip Animation") end
		end
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

-- In this module you can find things like Rebirth Multiplier. By using code such as Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player) returns a number which is that player's multiplier. Useful if you have multipliers in multiple scripts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]

local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Multipliers = {}

function Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = 1
	
	if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
		Multi *= (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value * GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1) -- so multi = RebirthMulti + 1
	else
		Multi *= (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 0.5) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value
	end
	
	return Multi	
end

function Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = GameSettings.CurrencyMultiplier.Value
	Multi *= (Player.Data.Gamepasses.DoubleCurrency.Value and 2 or 1)
	Multi *= Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	Multi *= PetMultipliers.ReadPlayerMultiplier(Player.Name)
	
	local R = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop["2"].Reward
	if R.Exponential.Value then
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	else
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	end
	
	return Multi
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player)
	return 5
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets1"].Value and 3 or 0)
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets2"].Value and 10 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	return 50 + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage1"].Value and 50 or 0) + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage2"].Value and 250 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)
	return 1 * (Player.Data.Gamepasses.Lucky.Value and 2 or 1)
end

return Multipliers

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

		NewPopup.Visible = true

function PlayAnimation(Popup, Time)
	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then

-- ReplicatedStorage.AnimationController
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AnimationsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Animations")

-- Animations in this set play WITHOUT leg counter-rotation, because their leg
-- keyframes are intentional (kicks, sits, swims, etc.). Everything else gets the
-- counter-rotation applied to keep legs vertical when the torso rotates.
local SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE = {
	["Leg Kick Animation"] = true,
	["Double Jump Backflip Animation"] = true,
	["Driving Steering Animation"] = true,
	["Flying Animation"] = true,
	["Gun Shooting Position Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Hurting Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Item Pickup Animation"] = true,
	["Level Up Celebration Animation"] = true,
	["Seating Animation"] = true,
	["Sliding Animation"] = true,
	["Sneak Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Spell Cast Fireball Animation"] = true,
	["Swimming Animation"] = true,
	["Zombie Walk Animation"] = true,
}

-- Internal class: drives Motor6D.Transform per frame, lerping between keyframes.
local AnimationExecutor = {}
AnimationExecutor.__index = AnimationExecutor

function AnimationExecutor.new(character: Model)
	local self = setmetatable({}, AnimationExecutor)

	self.Character = character
	self.Joints = {}
	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.Connection = nil
	self.IsPlaying = false

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Motor6D") and desc.Part1 then
			self.Joints[desc.Part1.Name] = desc
		elseif desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and desc.Attachment1 then
			local part = desc.Attachment1.Parent
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				self.Joints[part.Name] = desc
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function AnimationExecutor:Stop()
	self.IsPlaying = false
	if self.Connection then
		self.Connection:Disconnect()
		self.Connection = nil
	end
end

function AnimationExecutor:PlayFromTable(animTable, options)
	if self.Connection then self:Stop() end

	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.IsPlaying = true

	options = options or {}
	local counterRotateLegs = options.counterRotateLegs ~= false  -- default true

	local timestamps = {}
	for t, _ in pairs(animTable.Timestamps) do
		table.insert(timestamps, t)
	end
	table.sort(timestamps)

	local maxTime = timestamps[#timestamps]
	local isLooping = animTable.Settings.Loop

	self.Connection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
		if not self.IsPlaying then return end

		self.CurrentTime += dt

		if self.CurrentTime >= maxTime then
			if isLooping then
				self.CurrentTime %= maxTime
			else
				self.CurrentTime = maxTime
				self:Stop()
				return
			end
		end

		local tStart, tEnd = timestamps[1], timestamps[#timestamps]
		for i = 1, #timestamps - 1 do
			if self.CurrentTime >= timestamps[i] and self.CurrentTime < timestamps[i+1] then
				tStart = timestamps[i]
				tEnd = timestamps[i+1]
				break
			end
		end

		local segmentDuration = tEnd - tStart
		local alpha = (segmentDuration > 0) and (self.CurrentTime - tStart) / segmentDuration or 0

		local dataStart = animTable.Timestamps[tStart]
		local dataEnd = animTable.Timestamps[tEnd]

		for partName, joint in pairs(self.Joints) do
			local cfA = dataStart[partName] or joint.Transform
			local cfB = dataEnd[partName] or cfA
			joint.Transform = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
		end

		-- Counter-rotate legs against LowerTorso (only when caller asks for it)
		if counterRotateLegs then
			local lowerTorso = self.Joints["LowerTorso"]
			if lowerTorso then
				local lt = lowerTorso.Transform
				local invRot = (lt - lt.Position):Inverse()
				for _, legName in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg"}) do
					local legJoint = self.Joints[legName]
					if legJoint then
						legJoint.Transform = invRot * legJoint.Transform
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Public API
local AnimationController = {}

local executor = nil
local currentCharacter = nil

local function ensureExecutor()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	-- Re-create the executor if the character changed (respawn, R6/R15 swap, etc.)
	if character ~= currentCharacter then
		currentCharacter = character
		executor = AnimationExecutor.new(character)
	end
	return executor
end

-- Reset on respawn so we don't reuse joints from the old character
Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	executor = nil
	currentCharacter = nil
end)

function AnimationController.Play(animationName)
	local animModule = AnimationsFolder:FindFirstChild(animationName)
	if not animModule then
		warn("AnimationController: no animation named", animationName)
		return
	end
	local exec = ensureExecutor()
	local skipLegFix = SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE[animationName] == true
	exec:PlayFromTable(require(animModule), { counterRotateLegs = not skipLegFix })
end

function AnimationController.Stop()
	if executor then executor:Stop() end
end

return AnimationController

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)

	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end

end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)
	local Setting = GameSettings:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Setting then return false, "Unknown setting" end
	if Setting:IsA("IntValue") or Setting:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Setting.Value = Num
	elseif Setting:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Setting.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	elseif Setting:IsA("StringValue") then
		Setting.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Setting.Value)
end

function SettingsHandler.AllAreas()
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Area in Areas:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Area:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		Result[#Result + 1] = { name = Area.Name, cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0 }
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return tonumber(A.name) < tonumber(B.name) end)
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetAreaCost(AreaName, NewValue)
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return false, "No areas" end
	local Area = Areas:FindFirstChild(tostring(AreaName))
	if not Area or not Area:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Area not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Area.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set area " .. AreaName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function SettingsHandler.AllGemShop()
	local GemShop = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if not GemShop then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Upgrade in GemShop:GetChildren() do
		local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
		local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
		local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
		local UpgName = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or Upgrade.Name
		local DefaultReward = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("DefaultReward") and Reward.DefaultReward.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Reward.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Reward.Exponential.Value or false
		local DefaultPrice = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("DefaultPrice") and Price.DefaultPrice.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Price.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Price.Exponential.Value or false
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = Upgrade.Name,
			name = UpgName,
			max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			reward = { default = DefaultReward, increasePer = IncreasePerR, exponential = ExpR },
			price = { default = DefaultPrice, increasePer = IncreasePerP, exponential = ExpP },
		}
	end
	return Result
end

return SettingsHandler

--// Eggs Handler

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()

					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
