	statusLabel.Text = "● " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateUI()
	projectNameLabel.Text =
		session.projectName ~= ""
		and session.projectName
		or "Not connected"

	placeLabel.Text =
		"Place: "
		.. game.Name
		.. " / "
		.. tostring(game.PlaceId)

	local scriptCount = 0

	for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			scriptCount += 1
		end
	end

	scriptsLabel.Text =
		"Scripts: "
		.. tostring(scriptCount)

	pendingLabel.Text =
		"Pending: "
		.. tostring(session.pendingChanges)

	if session.lastSync > 0 then
		syncLabel.Text =
			"Last sync: "
			.. os.date("%H:%M:%S")
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: HTTP BACKEND
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testBackendHTTP(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing HTTP access to backend...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.HEALTH_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpBackend = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Backend HTTP permission/access failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown error"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpBackend = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Backend HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: LOCAL BRIDGE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testLocalBridgeHTTP(): boolean
	if CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL == "" then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge disabled in configuration.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	addLog(
		"Testing localhost bridge...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL,
			"GET",
			"/health",
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge unavailable.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpLocalBridge = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Local Bridge HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR READ
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorRead(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing ScriptEditorService read access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local temporaryScript: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			local folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			local module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return true"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			temporaryScript =
			module

			local result =
			ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				module
			)

			if typeof(result) ~= "string" then
				error(
					"GetEditorSource returned invalid value."
				)
			end
		end)

	if temporaryScript then
		temporaryScript.Parent = nil
		temporaryScript:Destroy()
	end

	local testFolder =
		game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		:FindFirstChild(
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER
		)

	if testFolder then
		testFolder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorRead = false

		addLog(
			"✗ ScriptEditorService read permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.scriptEditorRead = true

	addLog(
		"✓ ScriptEditorService read access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR WRITE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorWrite(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing Script Injection / ScriptEditor write access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local folder: Folder? = nil
	local module: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return 1"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			local successUpdate =
			pcall(function()
				ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
					module :: ModuleScript,
					function()
						return "return 2"
					end
				)
			end)

			if not successUpdate then
				error(
					"ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync was rejected."
				)
			end
		end)

	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorWrite = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Open Plugins → Manage Plugins → Squeeze and allow Script Injection.",
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.scriptEditorWrite = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Script Injection / ScriptEditor write access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE WRITE TEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testInstanceWrite(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing Studio DataModel write access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local testPart: Part? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			local part =
			Instance.new("Part")

			part.Name =
			"__SQUEEZE_PERMISSION_PART__"

			part.Size =
			Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

			part.Transparency = 1

			part.CanCollide = false

			part.Parent =
			game:GetService("Workspace")

			testPart = part

			part:SetAttribute(
				"SqueezePermissionTest",
				true
			)
		end)

	if testPart then
		testPart:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.instanceWrite = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Studio Instance write failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.instanceWrite = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio DataModel write access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

-- SCRIPT READ/WRITE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(source)
	end

	return true, source
end

local function writeScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.scriptEditorWrite then
		return false,
			"Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission is not enabled."
	end

	local ok, err =
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
				scriptInstance,
				function()
					return source
				end
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACK
------------------------------------------------------------

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
------------------------------------------------------------

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end
	
	Save["Accessories"] = {}
	local accessories = Folder:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if accessories then
		for _, accessory in accessories:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("BoolValue") and accessory.Value then Save["Accessories"][accessory.Name] = true end
		end
	end

	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

return SavingFunctions

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore
		local MainFrame = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame
		MainFrame.Title.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and "Top 100 Most "..RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Title
		MainFrame.Players.Amount.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Stat
		
		local Template = script.Template
		if Leaderboard:FindFirstChild("Template") then
			Template = Leaderboard.Template
		end
		
		for i = 1,100 do			
			local Clone = Template:Clone()
			Clone.LayoutOrder = i
			Clone.Name = i
			Clone.Rank.Text = ""
			Clone.PlrName.Text = ""
			Clone.Amount.Text = ""
			Clone.Parent = MainFrame.Players.Scroll
		end 
	end
end

return Main

--[[
Code system originally made by Croissant God, on roblox @DemonicMakesGames
]]

local Codes = {
	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
	["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
	["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"}, -- Put in pet name
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

--// Functions
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Rebirths" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		else
			return
		end
	else -- Pet
		if ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(Codes[Code][1]) == nil then warn("Error: "..Codes[Code][1].." Does not exist") return end -- Pet doesn't exist
		local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
		NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
		NewPet.PetName.Value = Codes[Code][1]
		NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	CodeStore:SetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId), true)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Action = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetAccessoryAction")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))

local function getFolder(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not data then return nil end
	local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	if not accessories then
		accessories = Instance.new("Folder")
		accessories.Name = "Accessories"
		accessories.Parent = data
	end
	return accessories
end

local function owned(folder, name)
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function addAccessory(player, name)
	if not Data[name] then return false end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then return false end
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = folder
	return true
end

local function equip(player, petId, accessoryName)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(accessoryName) ~= "string" or not Data[accessoryName] then return end
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not owned(folder, accessoryName) then return end
	local petData = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local pet = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or not pet:IsA("Folder") then return end
	pet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local liveFolder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local livePet = liveFolder and liveFolder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if livePet then livePet:SetAttribute("EquippedAccessory", accessoryName) end
end

local function setup(player)
	local folder = getFolder(player)
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for name in Data do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = false
			value.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setup(player) end

Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	if action == "Equip" then
		equip(player, value and value.PetId, value and value.Accessory)
	elseif action == "Unlock" then
		addAccessory(player, value)
	end
end)

return nil

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Cooldowns = {}

--// Script

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false

	local PetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	PetFolder.Name = Player.Name
	PetFolder.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets

	repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	LoadEquipped(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
	workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:Destroy()
end)

-- Clicker
Remotes.Clicker.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Clicker" then return end

	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Music
Remotes.Setting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, SettingName, Toggled)
	Player.Data.PlayerData[SettingName].Value = Toggled
end)

-- Rebirth
function Rebirth(Player) -- this will run the action when you passed all requirements for rebirthing
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = 0
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += 1
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += 10 -- gems
end

Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true	
		if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1) then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		else
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1.25) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Pet
function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", Player.UserId)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetName", PetInstance.PetName.Value)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			local character = Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then NewPet:PivotTo(root.CFrame) end
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already equipped
	if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player) <= Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value then return end -- Too many pets equipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = true
	PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, Pet)
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet or not Pet:IsDescendantOf(Player.Data.Pets) then return end
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipAll(Player)
	local pets = Player:FindFirstChild("Data") and Player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not pets then return end
	for _, Pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet:IsA("Folder") or Pet:IsA("Configuration") then
			UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
		end
	end
	LoadEquipped(Player)
end

function EquipAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for equipping a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	else
		EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	end
end

function DeleteAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for deleting a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then UnequipPet(Player, Pet) end -- unequip if it's equipped
	Pet:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Pet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Action, Parameter)
	if Action == "UnequipAll" then
		UnequipAll(Player)
		return
	end
	if type(Parameter) ~= "table" then -- so if this condition is true, then Parameter should be the id of the pet
		local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[Parameter]

		if Action == "Equip" then
			EquipAction(Player, Pet)
		elseif Action == "Delete" then
			DeleteAction(Player, Pet)
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	else -- there are multiple ids
		if Action == "Equip" then -- equip all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				EquipAction(Player, Pet)
			end

		elseif Action == "Delete" then -- delete all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				DeleteAction(Player, Pet)				
			end
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	end
end)

-- Egg
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

function ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

	for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
	end

	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
		return a[2] > b[2]
	end)

	local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

	for _,v in Pets do
		local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
		TotalWeight += Chance
		v[2] = Chance
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0,TotalWeight)

	local Counter = 0
	for _,v in Pets do	
		Counter += v[2]

		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v[1]
		end
	end
end

Remotes.Egg.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Egg, Amount)
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then return end -- cooldown
	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + Amount > Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player) then return end -- max storage

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)

	if not EggInfo then print(Egg.." does not exist!") return end -- egg does not exist!
	if EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then return end -- robux egg

	if Amount == 3 and ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then
		return -- if this is true, it means the player is trying to open a triple egg while there is a gamepass which they don't own
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount
		Player.Data.PlayerData.EggsHatched.Value += Amount
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true

		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()

		local Results = {}

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for i = 1, Amount do
			local PetName = ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier) 

			if not Player.Data.AutoDelete[PetName].Value then -- auto delete
				local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
				NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
				NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
			end

			Results[i] = PetName
		end

		return Results
	end
end

--// Auto Delete
Remotes.AutoDelete.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Pet)
	Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value = not Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
	return Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
end

--// Area
Remotes.Area.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == true then return end
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end)()

	local NextArea = ReplicatedStorage.Areas:FindFirstChild(Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1)
	if not NextArea then return end


	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value < NextArea.Cost.Value then return end

	if NextArea.Cost.Value == -1 then return end -- max area

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= NextArea.Cost.Value
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = tonumber(NextArea.Name)
end)

--// Gemshop
Remotes.GemUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Upgrade)
	if not ReplicatedStorage.GemShop:FindFirstChild(Upgrade) then return end

	local GemUpg = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop[Upgrade]
	local UpgradeTier = Player.Data.PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..Upgrade]

	if UpgradeTier.Value >= GemUpg.Max.Value then return end -- max

	local Cost = GemUpg.Price
	local Price

	if Cost.Exponential.Value then
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value * Cost.IncreasePer.Value ^ UpgradeTier.Value
	else
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value + Cost.IncreasePer.Value * (UpgradeTier.Value+1)
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value >= Price then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Price
		UpgradeTier.Value += 1
	end
end)

--// ============================================================
--// Admin Dashboard Client v4 — Premium Dark UI
--// Opens with /admin chat command. Server-verified.
--// ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
if not Remotes then return end
local RF = Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminDashboard", 15)
if not RF then return end
local AdminCheck = RF:WaitForChild("AdminCheck", 10)
local AdminRemote = RF:WaitForChild("AdminRemote", 10)
if not AdminCheck or not AdminRemote then return end
local AdminNotify = RF:WaitForChild("AdminNotify", 10)

local OK, IsAdmin = pcall(function() return AdminCheck:InvokeServer() end)
if not OK or not IsAdmin then return end

--// ============================================================
--// Theme
--// ============================================================
local Th = {
	Bg          = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 18),
	Surface     = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 28),
	Surface2    = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 32),
	Card        = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 38),
	CardHover   = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 50),
	Input       = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 24),
	Accent      = Color3.fromRGB(108, 72, 220),
	AccentHover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 94, 240),
	AccentDim   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 38, 140),
	Green       = Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 90),
	GreenDim    = Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 52),
	Red         = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	RedHover    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75),
	RedDim      = Color3.fromRGB(140, 35, 35),
	Orange      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40),
	Yellow      = Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 60),
	Text        = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
	Sub         = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165),
	Muted       = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100),
	Border      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	BorderLight = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 60),
	Online      = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 100),
	Offline     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
}

--// ============================================================
--// Helpers
--// ============================================================
local function Inst(Class: string, Props: {[string]: any}, Parent: Instance?): Instance
	local I = Instance.new(Class)
	for K, V in pairs(Props) do I[K] = V end
	if Parent then I.Parent = Parent end
	return I
end

local function RC(F, R) Inst("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R or 6)}, F) end
local function RS(F, Col) Inst("UIStroke", {Color = Col or Th.Border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.3}, F) end
local function RP(F, T, B, L, R)
	Inst("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T or 4),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, B or 4),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, L or 6),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, R or 6),
	}, F)
end

local function Lbl(P, Text, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local L = Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Col or Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}, P)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 14}, L)
	return L
end

local function Btn(P, Text, Fn, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local BC = Col or Th.Accent
	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = BC,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)}):Play()
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC}):Play()
	end)
	if Fn then B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Fn) end
	return B
end

local function Txt(P: Instance, Ph: string?, Sz: UDim2?, Pos: UDim2?): TextBox
	local B = Inst("TextBox", {
		PlaceholderText = Ph or "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = Th.Muted,
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Input, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P) :: TextBox
	RC(B, 6)
	RP(B, 2, 2, 8, 8)
	RS(B)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	return B
end

local function Scr(P, Sz, Pos)
	local S = Inst("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Th.AccentDim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, S)
	RP(S, 4, 4, 4, 4)
	return S
end

local function Card(P, H, Ord)
	local F = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H or 36),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = Ord or 0,
	}, P)
	RC(F, 6)
	RS(F, Th.Border)
	return F
end

local function StatCard(P, Title, Value, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 46, Ord)
	RP(F, 6, 6, 10, 10)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.06))
	Lbl(F, tostring(Value), Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.44))
	return F
end

local function ARow(P, Title, Ph, Btns, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 40, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 13), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
	local Box = Txt(F, Ph, UDim2.new(0.26, 0, 0, 28), UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.08))
	local N = #Btns
	local Gap = 4
	local BW = (0.34 * F.AbsoluteSize.X - Gap * (N - 1)) / N
	BW = math.max(BW / F.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.08)
	local X = 0.62
	for _, S in Btns do
		local LS = S
		Btn(F, LS.text, function() LS.click(Box) end, LS.color, UDim2.new(BW, -2, 0, 28), UDim2.new(X, 0, 0.06, 0))
		X += BW + Gap / F.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	return F, Box
end

local function DangerRow(P, Title, Fn, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 36, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Btn(F, Title, function() Fn(F) end, Th.Red, UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.08, 0))
	return F
end

local function SectionHdr(P, Text, Ord)
	Lbl(P, Text, Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)).LayoutOrder = Ord or 0
end

local function EmptyState(P, Icon, Title, Desc)
	local Holder = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 0,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 30,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Sub,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Desc, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 3,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, Holder)
	return Holder
end

--// ============================================================
--// Toast
--// ============================================================
local ToastId = 0
local function Toast(Msg, Type)
	ToastId += 1
	local MyId = ToastId
	local Col = Type == "error" and Th.Red or Type == "warning" and Th.Orange or Th.Green
	local Icon = Type == "error" and "✕  " or Type == "warning" and "⚠  " or "✓  "

	local T = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 38),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 600,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, SG)
	RC(T, 8)
	RS(T, Col)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon .. tostring(Msg), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Col, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.15, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 601,
	}, T)

	TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.04, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.delay(3, function()
		if ToastId == MyId then
			TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, function() T:Destroy() end)
		end
	end)
end

--// ============================================================
--// Confirm Modal
--// ============================================================
local function Confirm(Title, Msg, BtnText, Callback)
	local Overlay = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		ZIndex = 500,
	}, SG)

	local Modal = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 190),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 501,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, Overlay)
	RC(Modal, 12)
	RS(Modal, Th.BorderLight)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Msg, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 50), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 46),
		TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	local CancelBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = "Cancel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Border,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -184, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(CancelBtn, 6)

	local ConfirmBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = BtnText or "Confirm", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Red,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(ConfirmBtn, 6)

	local function Close()
		TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TS:Create(Overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.2, function() Overlay:Destroy() end)
	end

	CancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Close)
	ConfirmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Callback()
		Close()
	end)

	TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
end

--// ============================================================
--// Remote wrappers
--// ============================================================
local function Req(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R, M = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	if not OK then Toast("Error: " .. tostring(R), "error") return nil end
	if type(R) == "string" then Toast(M or R, R:find("Error") and "error" or "success")
	elseif type(R) == "boolean" and M then Toast(M, R and "success" or "error") end
	return R
end

local function ReqS(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	return OK and R or nil
end

--// ============================================================
--// Main Window
--// ============================================================
local SG = Inst("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "AdminDashboard", ResetOnSpawn = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	DisplayOrder = 100, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

local WIN_W, WIN_H = 840, 540
local SideW = 144

local Main = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, WIN_W, 0, WIN_H),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Bg,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Visible = false,
}, SG)
RC(Main, 12)
RS(Main, Th.Border)

-- Title bar
local TitleH = 38
local TitleBar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TitleH),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, Main)
RC(TitleBar, 12)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "⚡ Admin Panel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15,
	TextColor3 = Th.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "v4.0", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
	TextColor3 = Th.Muted, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 2),
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)

local CloseBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
	Text = "✕", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
	TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.RedDim,
	AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 6),
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)
RC(CloseBtn, 6)
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Main.Visible = false end)
CloseBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TS:Create(CloseBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Red}):Play() end)
CloseBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TS:Create(CloseBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.RedDim}):Play() end)

-- Sidebar
local Sidebar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, SideW, 1, -TitleH),
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TitleH),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, Main)

local TabBar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, Sidebar)
Inst("UIListLayout", {
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
}, TabBar)
RP(TabBar, 6, 6, 6, 6)

-- Content
local Content = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -SideW - 2, 1, -TitleH - 2),
	Position = UDim2.new(0, SideW + 2, 0, TitleH + 2),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, Main)

--// ============================================================
--// Tab System
--// ============================================================
local Tabs = {}
local TabSide = {}
local TabRefresh = {}
local CurTab = "Players"
local TabBtns = {}

local function ShowTab(Name)
	CurTab = Name
	for N, F in pairs(Tabs) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, F in pairs(TabSide) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, B in pairs(TabBtns) do
		if N == Name then
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Accent
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Text
		else
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Sub
		end
	end
	if TabRefresh[Name] then pcall(TabRefresh[Name]) end
end

local TabOrder = 0
local function AddTab(Name, Ord)
	TabOrder += 1
	local OrdVal = Ord or TabOrder

	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 30),
		LayoutOrder = OrdVal,
	}, TabBar)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 11}, B)
	B.Name = Name
	TabBtns[Name] = B

	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.CardHover}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowTab(Name) end)

	local S = Scr(Content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	S.Visible = false
	Tabs[Name] = S
	return S
end

--// Clear helper
local function Clear(P: Instance?)
	if not P then return end
	for _, Child in P:GetChildren() do
		if not Child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not Child:IsA("UIPadding") and not Child:IsA("UICorner") and not Child:IsA("UIStroke") then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

--// ============================================================
--// PLAYERS TAB
--// ============================================================
local PlayersTab = AddTab("Players", 1)
local PLPanel = nil
local PRPanel = nil
local SelName = nil
local RefreshPR: () -> () -- forward declaration

local function RefreshPL(Search: string?)
	if not PLPanel then return end
	Clear(PLPanel)
	local List = (AdminRemote:InvokeServer("getPlayers") :: {any}) or {}
	local Q = (Search and string.lower(Search)) or ""
	local Ord = 0
	for _, I in ipairs(List) do
		if Q == "" or string.find(string.lower(I.name), Q) or string.find(string.lower(I.displayName), Q) then
			Ord += 1
			local IsSel = (I.name == SelName)

function RefreshPR()

	Lbl(H, "Pets: " .. D.petCount .. "/" .. D.maxStorage .. "  •  Equipped: " .. D.petsEquipped .. "/" .. D.maxEquipped, Th.Muted, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.88))

	SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── CURRENCY ──────────────────────────", 2)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Currency", "Amt", {
		{text = "+Give", click = function(B) Req("giveCurrency", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Green},
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setCurrency", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 3)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Gems", "Amt", {
		{text = "+Give", click = function(B) Req("giveGems", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Green},
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setGems", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 4)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Rebirths", "#", {
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setRebirths", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 5)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Zone", "#", {
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setZone", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 6)

	-- Gem upgrades
	if D.gemShop then
		SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── GEM UPGRADES ──────────────────────", 7)
		for i, U in D.gemShop do
			ARow(PRPanel, U.name .. " Lv" .. U.level .. "/" .. U.max, "Lv", {
				{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setGemUpgrade", SelName, U.id, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
			}, 8 + i)
		end
	end

	SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── PETS ──────────────────────────────", 20)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Give Pet", "Name", {
		{text = "Give", click = function(B) Req("givePet", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Green},
	}, 21)

	-- Gamepasses
	if D.gamepasses then
		SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── GAMEPASSES ────────────────────────", 25)
		local GPIndex = 26
		for GN, GV in pairs(D.gamepasses) do
			local R = Card(PRPanel, 34, GPIndex)
			RP(R, 4, 4, 8, 8)
			Lbl(R, GN, GV and Th.Green or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
			local LG, LV = GN, GV
			Btn(R, LV and "Active" or "Inactive", function()
				Req("toggleGamepass", SelName, LG, (not LV) and "true" or "false")
				RefreshPR()
			end, LV and Th.Green or Th.Border, UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0))
			GPIndex += 1
		end
	end

	-- Pets list
	if D.pets and #D.pets > 0 then
		SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── OWNED PETS (" .. #D.pets .. ") ────────────────────", 30)

local PetsTab = AddTab("Pets", 2)

local PetDetS = nil

local function RefreshPets(Search)
	Clear(PetListS)
	local List = ReqS("getPets")
	if type(List) ~= "table" then return end
	local Q = Search and string.lower(Search) or ""
	local Ord = 0
	for _, I in List do
		if Q == "" or string.find(string.lower(I.name), Q) or string.find(string.lower(I.rarity), Q) then
			Ord += 1
			local IsSel = I.name == SelPet
			local R = Inst("TextButton", {
				Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = IsSel and Th.Accent or Th.Card,
				AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), LayoutOrder = Ord,
			}, PetListS) :: TextButton
			RC(R, 5)
			if not IsSel then RS(R, Th.Border) end
			Lbl(R, I.name, IsSel and Th.Text or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.08))
			Lbl(R, I.rarity, Th.Muted, UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.54, 0.08))
			Lbl(R, "×" .. tostring(I.multiplier), Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.08))
			local PN = I.name
			R.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelPet = PN RefreshPets(Search) RefreshPetDet() end)
		end
	end
	if Ord == 0 then
		EmptyState(PetListS, "🔍", "No pets found", "Try a different search")
	end
end

function RefreshPetDet()
	Clear(PetDetS)

	local PI = nil
	for _, P in Info do if P.name == SelPet then PI = P break end end

local function RefreshEggs()

	SectionHdr(EggsS, "── EGG CONFIGURATION ─────────────────", 0)

				{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setEggCost", Egg.name, B.Text) RefreshEggs() end, color = Th.Accent},
			})

			for _, Pet in Egg.pets do

					{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setEggPetChance", Egg.name, Pet.name, B.Text) end, color = Th.Accent},

local CfgTab = AddTab("Config", 5)
local CfgS = Scr(CfgTab, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))

local function RefreshCfg()
	Clear(CfgS)
	SectionHdr(CfgS, "── GAME SETTINGS ─────────────────────", 0)
	local S = ReqS("getSettings")
	if S then
		local N = {} for K in pairs(S) do N[#N+1] = K end
		table.sort(N)
		local Ord = 1
		for _, NM in N do
			local I = S[NM]
			if I.className == "BoolValue" then
				local R = Card(CfgS, 36, Ord)
				RP(R, 4, 4, 8, 8)
				Lbl(R, NM, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
				local SL = Lbl(R, tostring(I.value), I.value and Th.Green or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.1))
				local SN = NM
				Btn(R, "Toggle", function()
					Req("setSetting", SN, (not I.value) and "true" or "false")
					I.value = not I.value SL.Text = tostring(I.value)
					SL.TextColor3 = I.value and Th.Green or Th.Sub
				end, Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.14, 0, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0.1, 0))
			else
				ARow(CfgS, NM, tostring(I.value), {
					{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setSetting", NM, B.Text) end, color = Th.Accent},
				})
			end
			Ord += 1
		end
	end

	SectionHdr(CfgS, "── AREAS ─────────────────────────────", Ord + 10)
	local A = ReqS("getAreas")
	if A then
		local AOrd = Ord + 11
		for _, Ar in A do
			ARow(CfgS, "Area " .. Ar.name, tostring(Ar.cost), {
				{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setAreaCost", Ar.name, B.Text) end, color = Th.Accent},
			}, AOrd)
			AOrd += 1
		end
	end
end

--// Server Handler
-- Server info, announcements, shutdown, and server-wide tools.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ServerHandler = {}

function ServerHandler.GetInfo()
	local Info = {
		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

		Info.Speed or 0.25,

		Info.EasingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
		Info.RepeatCount or 0,

	)

function Module.TweenModel(EndCFrame,TI,Model)
	local NewCFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	NewCFrameValue.Value = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(NewCFrameValue,TI,EndCFrame)
	local Connection
	Connection = NewCFrameValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		Model:PivotTo(NewCFrameValue.Value)
	end)
	Tween:Play()
	Tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		NewCFrameValue:Destroy()
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

return Module

	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module
