--// Egg Preview
local PreviewFrame = UI.PreviewFrame
local DefaultSize = PreviewFrame.Size
local CurrentTarget = PreviewFrame.CurrentTarget
PreviewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)

function FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable)
	local CurrentClosest, ClosestDistance = nil, 100

	for _,Egg in EggsAvailable do
		local EggModel = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg]
		local mag = (EggModel:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= ClosestDistance then
			CurrentClosest = EggModel
			ClosestDistance = mag
		end
	end
	return CurrentClosest
end

local IsClosing = false -- so it doesnt ruin the animation

function FindEgg()
	if not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Player.Character.Humanoid.Health == 0 then return end

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local EggsAvailable = {}
	local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/11

	for _,Egg in workspace.Map.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if Egg == nil then continue end
		if not Egg:FindFirstChild("EggModel") then warn(Egg.Name.." does not have an EggModel") end

		local mag = (Egg:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= 12 then
			EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = Egg.Name
		end
	end

	local SetVisibility = #EggsAvailable >= 1 -- if its 0 then its already false

	if SetVisibility then -- a egg(s) is in distance
		local Egg = #EggsAvailable > 1 and FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable) or workspace.Map.Eggs[EggsAvailable[1]]
		local WSP = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg:GetPivot().Position)
		PreviewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
		CurrentTarget.Value = Egg.Name
	else
		CurrentTarget.Value = "None"
	end

	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then
		SetVisibility = false -- if you are opening an egg itll auto close the previewframe
	end

	--// Make the previewframe visible
	if SetVisibility and not PreviewFrame.Visible then
		PreviewFrame.Visible = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(DefaultSize.X.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.X.Offset, DefaultSize.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.Y.Offset)})	
	elseif not SetVisibility and PreviewFrame.Visible and not IsClosing then -- set to invisible, while is visible & isnt closing
		IsClosing = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)})	
		task.wait(0.15)
		PreviewFrame.Visible = false
		IsClosing = false
	end
end

function UpdatePreviewFrame()
	if CurrentTarget.Value ~= "None" then
		local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value
		PreviewFrame.EggInfo.EggName.Text = Egg

		if not ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg) then print(Egg.." does not have settings in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs!") return end

		local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]

		local IsRobuxEgg = EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId")
		if IsRobuxEgg then
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs \u{E002}"..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		else
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs "..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		end

		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Triple.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg
		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Auto.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg

		--// This part gets the pet chances
		local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

		for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
		end

		table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
			return a[2] > b[2]
		end)

		local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for _,v in Pets do
			local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
			TotalWeight += Chance
			v[2] = Chance
		end

		for i = 1,9 do
			local PetInfo = Pets[i]
			local PetSlot = PreviewFrame.PetChances.List["Pet"..i]
			PetSlot.Visible = PetInfo ~= nil

			if PetInfo == nil then continue end

			PetSlot.Rarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]].Settings.Rarity.Value
			PetSlot.Percentage.Text = Utilities.Short.en(100/TotalWeight * PetInfo[2]).."%"
			PetSlot.Delete.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[PetInfo[1]].Value
			PetSlot.PetName.Value = PetInfo[1]

			local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]]:Clone()
			PetModel.Parent = PetSlot.Pet

			local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
			local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
			PetSlot.Pet.CurrentCamera = Camera
			PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
		end
	end
end

CurrentTarget.Changed:Connect(UpdatePreviewFrame)

--// Egg Hatching
local IsAutoOpening = false

function HatchEgg(Egg: string, Result: string, Offset:number)
	local OpeningTime = 3

	local NewViewport = script.EggViewport:Clone()
	NewViewport.Parent = UI.OpenEgg

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 15
	Frames.Visible = false
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = false

	local Clone = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg].EggModel:Clone()
	Clone:ScaleTo(0.5)
	Clone.Parent = workspace

	local Rot, X, Y, Z = Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue")
	Rot.Value = 30 Z.Value = -4 X.Value = 10

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 1.5
	PL.Parent = Clone.Egg

	Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z))
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local TweenIn = TweenService:Create(X, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = Offset})
	TweenIn:Play()

	local RotTweenIn = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 0})
	RotTweenIn:Play()

	-- add an audio for the egg flying in
	TweenIn.Completed:Wait()

	local Eggdelay = 0.075
	for i = 1,(OpeningTime * 1.5) + 1 do
		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 6})
		Tween:Play()
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -6})
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween:Play()
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		Eggdelay -= .005
	end

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()	
	Clone:Destroy()	

	-- Now we're going to show the pet

	local PetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result]:Clone()
	PetModel:ScaleTo(0.6)
	PetModel.Parent = workspace

	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[Result].Value
	NewViewport.PetName.Text = Result
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = true
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Text = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result].Settings.Rarity.Value
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = true

	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 2
	PL.Parent = PetModel.MainPart

	X.Value = Offset Y.Value = 0 Z.Value = -4 Rot.Value = 175
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	task.wait(OpeningTime*0.25)

	NewViewport:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(NewViewport.Position.X.Scale, 0, NewViewport.Position.Y.Scale + 10, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, OpeningTime * 0.1)
	TweenService:Create(Y, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -5}):Play()
	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = false
	task.wait(OpeningTime * 0.15)

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()
	X:Destroy() Y:Destroy() Z:Destroy() Rot:Destroy()

	PetModel:Destroy()
	NewViewport:Destroy()

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5

Remotes.Egg.OnClientInvoke = HatchEgg

function SingleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return end

	if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then
		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 1)

		if Result ~= nil then
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end
	else
		MarketPlaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Player, EggInfo.ProductId.Value)
	end
end

function TripleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 3)

	if Result ~= nil then
		for i = 1,#Result do
			coroutine.wrap(function()
				local Position = (i - 2) * 3
				HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
			end)()
		end
	end
end

local function ChooseEggAmount(Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return 1 end

	local EggAmount = 1

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then 
		return EggAmount
	end -- triple egg is a gamepass that the player doesn't own, so open 1 egg

	if PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * 3 then
		EggAmount = 3
	end

	return EggAmount
end

function AutoEgg()
	if IsAutoOpening then return end

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("AutoEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value then 
		MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value)
		return
	end

	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value	
	IsAutoOpening = true

	while true do
		if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then task.wait(0.1) continue end -- player is already opening an egg

		if CurrentTarget.Value == "None" or CurrentTarget.Value ~= Egg then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, ChooseEggAmount(Egg))

		if Result == nil then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		if #Result > 1 then
			for i = 1,#Result do
				coroutine.wrap(function()
					local Position = (i - 2) * 3
					HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
				end)()
			end
		else
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

--// Pet Follow
-- Credits to azypro777 for helping out with this part!
local Spacing, PetSize, MaxClimbHeight = 5, 3, 6

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
local RayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -500, 0)

local TempPets = Instance.new("Folder")
TempPets.Name = "PlayerPets"
TempPets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

local EnemyAggroRange = 28
local EnemyAttackRange = 6
local PetAttackCooldown = 0.5
local petAttackTimers = {}

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		local enemiesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies")

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end

			local petPos = petMain.Position
			local closestEnemy, closestDist
			if enemiesFolder then
				for _, enemy in enemiesFolder:GetChildren() do
					if not enemy:IsA("Model") then continue end
					local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local enemyHealth = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
					if not enemyMain or enemyHealth <= 0 then continue end
					local dist = (petPos - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude
					if dist <= EnemyAggroRange and (not closestDist or dist < closestDist) then
					closestEnemy = enemy
						closestDist = dist
					end
				end
			end

			if closestEnemy and closestDist then
				local enemyMain = closestEnemy.PrimaryPart or closestEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				if enemyMain then
					local direction = (enemyMain.Position - petPos)
					direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
					local distToEnemy = direction.Magnitude
					local targetPos
					if distToEnemy > EnemyAttackRange then
						local moveDist = math.min(distToEnemy - EnemyAttackRange + 2, distToEnemy)
						targetPos = petPos + direction.Unit * moveDist
					else
						targetPos = petPos
					end

					local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(petMain.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), petMain.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)
					local targetY = 0
					if RayResult then
						targetY = RayResult.Position.Y + petMain.Size.Y/2
					end

					local lookCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(targetPos.X, petPos.Y, targetPos.Z), Vector3.new(enemyMain.Position.X, petPos.Y, enemyMain.Position.Z))
					local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos.X, targetY, targetPos.Z) * lookCFrame.Rotation
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(targetCFrame, 0.15))

					if distToEnemy <= EnemyAttackRange then
						local petId = Pet.Name
						local now = os.clock()
						if not petAttackTimers[petId] or now - petAttackTimers[petId] >= PetAttackCooldown then
							petAttackTimers[petId] = now
							feedback:FireServer(petId, "Attack")
							Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
						end
					end
					continue
				end
			end

			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end
	end
end

		coroutine.wrap(function()

Remotes.Trading.TradeAction.OnClientInvoke = function(Args) -- function is ran when u add pets to a trade, add currency etc

		if TradeFrame.Visible then
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, TradeFrame.Size) --// close the trade
			PlayerTrade.Visible = false
			TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = true
		end
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = Args.Option == "Ready" 
	elseif Args.Option == "Countdown" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = true

		if Args.Count == 0 then --// end trade
			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = false			

			if TradeFrame.Visible then
				Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, TradeFrame.Size) --// close the trade
				PlayerTrade.Visible = false
				TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = true
			end
		else
			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = true

			for i = Args.Count * 10, 1, -1 do
				if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then
					PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = false
					break
				end
				PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Text = (i/10).." Seconds Left.."

				task.wait(0.1)
			end	

			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Text = "Processing..."			
		end

for _,v in Gemshop:GetChildren() do
	local i = v.Name
	local NewUpgrade = GemUpgradeTemplate:Clone()
	NewUpgrade.LayoutOrder = tonumber(i)
	NewUpgrade.Name = i
	NewUpgrade.Title.Text = v.UpgradeName.Value

	local function CalcReward(Reward)
		local R = v.Reward

		if R.Exponential.Value then
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Reward
		else
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Reward
		end
	end

	local function CalcCost()
		local C = v.Price

		if C.Exponential.Value then
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value * C.IncreasePer.Value ^ PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value
		else
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value + C.IncreasePer.Value * (PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value+1)
		end
	end

	local function Update()
		local O = v.Operator.Value
		local CurrentLevel = PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value

		if CurrentLevel < v.Max.Value then
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > "..O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel+1))
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(CalcCost())
		else
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > Max"
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = "Max"
		end
	end

	Update()
	PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Changed:Connect(Update)

	NewUpgrade.Parent = Frames.GemShop.Upgrades

	NewUpgrade.Buy.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.GemUpgrade:FireServer(i)

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local accessoryData = require(RS:WaitForChild("AccessoryData"))
	local accessoryFolder = CreateFolder(MainFolder, "Accessories")
	for accessoryName in accessoryData do
		local owned = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		owned.Name = accessoryName
		owned.Value = Datastore and Datastore.Accessories and Datastore.Accessories[accessoryName] == true or false
		owned.Parent = accessoryFolder
	end

	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

		end

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

--// ============================================================
--// Admin Dashboard Client v4 — Premium Dark UI
--// Opens with /admin chat command. Server-verified.
--// ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
if not Remotes then return end
local RF = Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminDashboard", 15)
if not RF then return end
local AdminCheck = RF:WaitForChild("AdminCheck", 10)
local AdminRemote = RF:WaitForChild("AdminRemote", 10)
if not AdminCheck or not AdminRemote then return end
local AdminNotify = RF:WaitForChild("AdminNotify", 10)

local OK, IsAdmin = pcall(function() return AdminCheck:InvokeServer() end)
if not OK or not IsAdmin then return end

--// ============================================================
--// Theme
--// ============================================================
local Th = {
	Bg          = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 18),
	Surface     = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 28),
	Surface2    = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 32),
	Card        = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 38),
	CardHover   = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 50),
	Input       = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 24),
	Accent      = Color3.fromRGB(108, 72, 220),
	AccentHover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 94, 240),
	AccentDim   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 38, 140),
	Green       = Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 90),
	GreenDim    = Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 52),
	Red         = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	RedHover    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75),
	RedDim      = Color3.fromRGB(140, 35, 35),
	Orange      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40),
	Yellow      = Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 60),
	Text        = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
	Sub         = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165),
	Muted       = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100),
	Border      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	BorderLight = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 60),
	Online      = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 100),
	Offline     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
}

--// ============================================================
--// Helpers
--// ============================================================
local function Inst(Class: string, Props: {[string]: any}, Parent: Instance?): Instance
	local I = Instance.new(Class)
	for K, V in pairs(Props) do I[K] = V end
	if Parent then I.Parent = Parent end
	return I
end

local function RC(F, R) Inst("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R or 6)}, F) end
local function RS(F, Col) Inst("UIStroke", {Color = Col or Th.Border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.3}, F) end
local function RP(F, T, B, L, R)
	Inst("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T or 4),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, B or 4),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, L or 6),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, R or 6),
	}, F)
end

local function Lbl(P, Text, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local L = Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Col or Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}, P)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 14}, L)
	return L
end

local function Btn(P, Text, Fn, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local BC = Col or Th.Accent
	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = BC,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)}):Play()
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC}):Play()
	end)
	if Fn then B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Fn) end
	return B
end

local function Txt(P: Instance, Ph: string?, Sz: UDim2?, Pos: UDim2?): TextBox

local function ARow(P, Title, Ph, Btns, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 40, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 13), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
	local Box = Txt(F, Ph, UDim2.new(0.26, 0, 0, 28), UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.08))
	local N = #Btns
	local Gap = 4
	local BW = (0.34 * F.AbsoluteSize.X - Gap * (N - 1)) / N
	BW = math.max(BW / F.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.08)
	local X = 0.62
	for _, S in Btns do
		local LS = S
		Btn(F, LS.text, function() LS.click(Box) end, LS.color, UDim2.new(BW, -2, 0, 28), UDim2.new(X, 0, 0.06, 0))
		X += BW + Gap / F.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	return F, Box
end

local ToastId = 0
local function Toast(Msg, Type)
	ToastId += 1
	local MyId = ToastId
	local Col = Type == "error" and Th.Red or Type == "warning" and Th.Orange or Th.Green
	local Icon = Type == "error" and "✕  " or Type == "warning" and "⚠  " or "✓  "

	local T = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 38),

		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),

		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, SG)

	RS(T, Col)

	Inst("TextLabel", {

		TextColor3 = Col, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.15, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 601,
	}, T)

	TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.04, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.delay(3, function()
		if ToastId == MyId then
			TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, function() T:Destroy() end)
		end
	end)
end

--// ============================================================
--// Remote wrappers
--// ============================================================
local function Req(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R, M = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	if not OK then Toast("Error: " .. tostring(R), "error") return nil end
	if type(R) == "string" then Toast(M or R, R:find("Error") and "error" or "success")
	elseif type(R) == "boolean" and M then Toast(M, R and "success" or "error") end
	return R
end

local function ReqS(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	return OK and R or nil
end

--// ============================================================
--// Tab System
--// ============================================================
local Tabs = {}
local TabSide = {}
local TabRefresh = {}
local CurTab = "Players"
local TabBtns = {}

local function ShowTab(Name)
	CurTab = Name
	for N, F in pairs(Tabs) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, F in pairs(TabSide) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, B in pairs(TabBtns) do
		if N == Name then
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Accent
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Text
		else
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Sub
		end
	end
	if TabRefresh[Name] then pcall(TabRefresh[Name]) end
end

local TabOrder = 0
local function AddTab(Name, Ord)
	TabOrder += 1
	local OrdVal = Ord or TabOrder

	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 30),
		LayoutOrder = OrdVal,
	}, TabBar)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 11}, B)
	B.Name = Name
	TabBtns[Name] = B

	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.CardHover}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowTab(Name) end)

	local S = Scr(Content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	S.Visible = false
	Tabs[Name] = S
	return S
end

--// Clear helper
local function Clear(P: Instance?)
	if not P then return end
	for _, Child in P:GetChildren() do
		if not Child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not Child:IsA("UIPadding") and not Child:IsA("UICorner") and not Child:IsA("UIStroke") then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local PlayersTab = AddTab("Players", 1)
local PLPanel = nil
local PRPanel = nil
local SelName = nil
local RefreshPR: () -> () -- forward declaration

local function RefreshPL(Search: string?)
	if not PLPanel then return end
	Clear(PLPanel)
	local List = (AdminRemote:InvokeServer("getPlayers") :: {any}) or {}
	local Q = (Search and string.lower(Search)) or ""
	local Ord = 0
	for _, I in ipairs(List) do
		if Q == "" or string.find(string.lower(I.name), Q) or string.find(string.lower(I.displayName), Q) then
			Ord += 1
			local IsSel = (I.name == SelName)
			local R = Inst("TextButton", {
				Text = "",
				BackgroundColor3 = IsSel and Th.Accent or Th.Card,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38),
				LayoutOrder = Ord,
			}, PLPanel) :: TextButton
			RC(R, 6)
			if not IsSel then RS(R, Th.Border) end
			Lbl(R, I.displayName, IsSel and Th.Text or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.05))
			Lbl(R, "@" .. I.name, Th.Muted, UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.52))
			local Dot = Inst("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
				Position = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.35, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = I.loaded and Th.Online or Th.Offline,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, R)
			RC(Dot, 3)
			R.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				SelName = I.name
				RefreshPL(Search)
				RefreshPR()
			end)
		end
	end
	if Ord == 0 then
		EmptyState(PLPanel, "🔍", "No players found", "Try a different search term")
	end
end

function RefreshPR()
	Clear(PRPanel)
	if not SelName then
		EmptyState(PRPanel, "👥", "Select a Player", "Choose a player from the list to view their data")
		return
	end
	local D = ReqS("getPlayerData", SelName)
	if not D then
		EmptyState(PRPanel, "⚠", "Failed to Load", "Could not retrieve player data")
		return
	end

	-- Header card
	local H = Card(PRPanel, 56, 1)
	RP(H, 8, 8, 12, 12)
	Lbl(H, D.displayName, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 15), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.05))
	Lbl(H, "@" .. D.name, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.4))
	local StatusDot = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.82, 0, 0.15, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = D.loaded and Th.Online or Th.Offline,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, H)
	RC(StatusDot, 4)
	Lbl(H, D.loaded and "Online" or "Offline", D.loaded and Th.Online or Th.Offline, UDim2.new(0.14, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.13))
	Lbl(H, "UID: " .. D.userId .. "  •  " .. D.accountAge .. "d old", Th.Muted, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.72))
	Lbl(H, "Pets: " .. D.petCount .. "/" .. D.maxStorage .. "  •  Equipped: " .. D.petsEquipped .. "/" .. D.maxEquipped, Th.Muted, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.88))

	SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── CURRENCY ──────────────────────────", 2)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Currency", "Amt", {
		{text = "+Give", click = function(B) Req("giveCurrency", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Green},
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setCurrency", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 3)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Gems", "Amt", {
		{text = "+Give", click = function(B) Req("giveGems", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Green},
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setGems", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 4)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Rebirths", "#", {
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setRebirths", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 5)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Zone", "#", {
		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setZone", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
	}, 6)

	-- Gem upgrades
	if D.gemShop then
		SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── GEM UPGRADES ──────────────────────", 7)
		for i, U in D.gemShop do
			ARow(PRPanel, U.name .. " Lv" .. U.level .. "/" .. U.max, "Lv", {
				{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setGemUpgrade", SelName, U.id, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},
			}, 8 + i)
		end
	end

	SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── PETS ──────────────────────────────", 20)

	ARow(PRPanel, "Give Pet", "Name", {
		{text = "Give", click = function(B) Req("givePet", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Green},
	}, 21)

	-- Gamepasses
	if D.gamepasses then
		SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── GAMEPASSES ────────────────────────", 25)
		local GPIndex = 26
		for GN, GV in pairs(D.gamepasses) do
			local R = Card(PRPanel, 34, GPIndex)
			RP(R, 4, 4, 8, 8)
			Lbl(R, GN, GV and Th.Green or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
			local LG, LV = GN, GV
			Btn(R, LV and "Active" or "Inactive", function()
				Req("toggleGamepass", SelName, LG, (not LV) and "true" or "false")
				RefreshPR()
			end, LV and Th.Green or Th.Border, UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0))
			GPIndex += 1
		end
	end

	-- Pets list
	if D.pets and #D.pets > 0 then
		SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── OWNED PETS (" .. #D.pets .. ") ────────────────────", 30)
		local PY = 0
		local N = 0
		for _, Pet in D.pets do
			N += 1
			if N > 20 then break end
			local PC = Card(PRPanel, 30, 31 + PY)
			RP(PC, 2, 2, 8, 8)
			Lbl(PC, Pet.name, Pet.equipped and Th.Green or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
			if Pet.equipped then
				Lbl(PC, "EQUIPPED", Th.Green, UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0, 9), UDim2.fromScale(0.48, 0.15))
			end
			local PID = Pet.id
			Btn(PC, "✕", function() Req("deletePet", SelName, PID) RefreshPR() end, Th.RedDim, UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.1, 0))
			PY += 1
		end
	end

	SectionHdr(PRPanel, "── DANGER ZONE ───────────────────────", 50)
	DangerRow(PRPanel, "Delete ALL Pets", function() Req("deleteAllPets", SelName) RefreshPR() end, 51)
	DangerRow(PRPanel, "Kick Player", function() Req("kick", SelName) RefreshPR() end, 52)
end

local Module = {}

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

function Module.Tween(Object, Info, Goal1)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		Info.Speed or 0.25,
		Info.EasingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Info.EasingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
		Info.RepeatCount or 0,
		Info.Reverses or false,
		Info.DelayTime or 0
	)
	
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(Object, info, Goal1)
	Tween:Play()
end

function Module.TweenModel(EndCFrame,TI,Model)
	local NewCFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	NewCFrameValue.Value = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(NewCFrameValue,TI,EndCFrame)
	local Connection
	Connection = NewCFrameValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		Model:PivotTo(NewCFrameValue.Value)
	end)
	Tween:Play()
	Tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		NewCFrameValue:Destroy()
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

return Module

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK
	else
		return CreatorId == Player.UserId
	end
end

		end
	end
end

	for _, Stat in Player.Data:GetDescendants() do
		if string.lower(Stat.Name) == StatName then
			return Stat
		end
	end
end

	for _, Pet in ReplicatedStorage.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if string.lower(Pet.Name) == PetName then
			return Pet
		end
	end
end

	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

--!strict

--[[
    Lemonade-Style Roblox Studio WebSync Plugin
    --------------------------------------------
    Features:
    • Adds a button to the Plugins toolbar
    • Opens a dockable "Connect" window
    • Connect / Disconnect
    • Connection indicator
    • Project status
    • Prompt count
    • WebSync last sync
    • Backend pairing request
    • Basic heartbeat
    • Logs toggle
]]

--------------------------------------------------

statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- BOTTOM CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 5)
logsButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.BUTTON
logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
logsButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
logsButton.TextSize = 12
logsButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
logsButton.Parent = bottom

local logsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
logsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
logsCorner.Parent = logsButton

--------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------

local function log(...)
	if not logsEnabled then
		return

	print("[Lemonade WebSync]", ...)
end

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN,
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		connectButton.Text = "Connect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.RED

		setStatus(
			"Offline",
			COLORS.RED,
			COLORS.RED
		)
	end
end

local function updateLastSync()
	lastSyncText = os.date("%X")

	syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: " .. lastSyncText
end

local function getProjectName(): string
	local gameName = game:GetAttribute("GameName")

	if typeof(gameName) == "string" and gameName ~= "" then
		return gameName
	end

	return game.Name
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP HELPER
--------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	method: string,
	path: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)

	local url = CONFIG.BACKEND_URL .. path

	local requestData = {
		Url = url,
		Method = method,
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		},
	}

	if sessionToken then
		requestData.Headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. sessionToken
	end

	if body ~= nil then
		requestData.Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
	end

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync(requestData)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP error:", response)
		return false, nil
	end

	if not response.Success then
		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP status:",
			response.StatusCode,
			response.StatusMessage
		)

		return false, response
	end

	local decoded = nil

	if response.Body and response.Body ~= "" then
		local decodeSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
		end)

		if decodeSuccess then
			decoded = result
		end
	end

	return true, decoded
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function connectToBackend()

	if connecting then
		return
	end

	if connected then
		return
	end

	connecting = true

	connectButton.Text = "Connecting..."
	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW,
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	log("Connecting to backend...")

	local success, response = request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectName = getProjectName(),
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "2.3",
			studioName = "Roblox Studio",
		}
	)

	if success and response then

		sessionToken = response.token
		projectId = response.projectId

		if typeof(response.prompts) == "number" then
			promptCount = response.prompts
			promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: " .. tostring(promptCount)
		end

		setConnectedState(true)
		updateLastSync()

		projectLabel.Text =
			"Project: " ..
			(response.projectName or "ok")

		log("Connected successfully.")
	else

		setConnectedState(false)

		connectButton.Text = "Connect"

		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] Failed to connect."
		)
	end

	connecting = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DISCONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function disconnectFromBackend()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	log("Disconnecting...")

	request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectId = projectId,
		}
	)

	sessionToken = nil
	projectId = nil

	setConnectedState(false)

	log("Disconnected.")
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while true do

		task.wait(CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)

		if connected and sessionToken then

			local success = request(
				"POST",
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					projectId = projectId,
					projectName = getProjectName(),
					placeId = game.PlaceId,
				}
			)

			if success then
				updateLastSync()
			else
				warn(
					"[Lemonade WebSync] Heartbeat failed."
				)
			end
		end
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PLUGIN BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()

	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled

	if widget.Enabled then
		log("Widget opened.")
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLOSE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

connectButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if connected then
		disconnectFromBackend()
	else
		connectToBackend()
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOG TOGGLE
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	logsEnabled = not logsEnabled

	if logsEnabled then
		logsButton.Text = "Logs On"
	else
		logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL UI
--------------------------------------------------

projectLabel.Text = "Project: " .. getProjectName()
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"

setConnectedState(false)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SELECTION DEBUG
--------------------------------------------------

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	local selected = Selection:Get()

	log(
		"Selection changed:",
		#selected
	)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
--------------------------------------------------

print("========================================")
print("[Lemonade WebSync] Plugin Loaded")
print("Project:", getProjectName())
print("PlaceId:", game.PlaceId)
print("========================================")

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

--[[
Code system originally made by Croissant God, on roblox @DemonicMakesGames
]]

local Codes = {
	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
	["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
	["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"}, -- Put in pet name
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

--// Functions
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Rebirths" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		else
			return
		end
	else -- Pet
		if ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(Codes[Code][1]) == nil then warn("Error: "..Codes[Code][1].." Does not exist") return end -- Pet doesn't exist
		local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
		NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
		NewPet.PetName.Value = Codes[Code][1]
		NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	CodeStore:SetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId), true)
end)

--!strict
-- ToastStack.lua
-- Manages a stack of toast notifications with smooth animations

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ToastStack = {}
ToastStack.__index = ToastStack

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	maxVisible = 3,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
	swipeToDismiss = true,
	position = "top-right",
	toastWidth = 350,
	toastHeight = 70,
	padding = 8,
}

function ToastStack.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ToastStack)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.toasts = {}
	self.container = nil
	self:_createContainer()
	return self
end

function ToastStack:_createContainer()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ToastStack"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 200
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.config.toastWidth, 1, -20)
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = gui

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, self.config.padding)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	layout.Parent = container

	self.container = container
	self.gui = gui
end

function ToastStack:Push(data)
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	data.autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss or 8
	data.timestamp = os.time()

	-- Remove oldest if at capacity
	if #self.toasts >= self.config.maxVisible then
		self:Pop()
	end

	local toast = self:_createToast(data)
	toast.Parent = self.container
	table.insert(self.toasts, 1, {id = data.id, frame = toast, data = data})

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return data.id
end

function ToastStack:_createToast(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, self.config.toastHeight)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.4
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = frame

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 24)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 32)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 12
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame

	-- Progress bar
	if data.autoDismiss then
		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = frame

		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)

	-- Swipe to dismiss
	if self.config.swipeToDismiss then
		local startX = 0
		frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				startX = input.Position.X
			end
		end)

		frame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
				if deltaX > 80 then
					self:Dismiss(data.id)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Entrance animation
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()

	return frame
end

function ToastStack:Dismiss(id)
	for i, toast in ipairs(self.toasts) do
		if toast.id == id then
			local frame = toast.frame
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.2)
			frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.toasts, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function ToastStack:Pop()
	if #self.toasts > 0 then
		self:Dismiss(self.toasts[#self.toasts].id)
	end
end

function ToastStack:Clear()
	for _, toast in self.toasts do
		toast.frame:Destroy()
	end
	self.toasts = {}
end

function ToastStack:Destroy()
	self:Clear()
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return ToastStack
