--!strict
--// ============================================================
--// Admin Dashboard Client v5 — Enhanced Premium UI
--// Opens with /admin or Ctrl+Shift+A
--// ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
if not Remotes then return end
local RF = Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminDashboard", 15)
if not RF then return end
local AdminCheck = RF:WaitForChild("AdminCheck", 10)
local AdminRemote = RF:WaitForChild("AdminRemote", 10)
if not AdminCheck or not AdminRemote then return end
local AdminNotify = RF:WaitForChild("AdminNotify", 10)

local OK, IsAdmin = pcall(function() return AdminCheck:InvokeServer() end)
if not OK or not IsAdmin then return end

--// ============================================================
--// Enhanced Theme with Gradients
--// ============================================================
local Th = {
	Bg          = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 16),
	Surface     = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 24),
	Surface2    = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 30),
	Card        = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 36),
	CardHover   = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	Input       = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 22),
	Accent      = Color3.fromRGB(108, 72, 220),
	AccentHover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 94, 240),
	AccentDim   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 38, 140),
	AccentGlow  = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 180),
	Green       = Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 90),
	GreenDim    = Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 52),
	Red         = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	RedHover    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75),
	RedDim      = Color3.fromRGB(140, 35, 35),
	Orange      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40),
	Yellow      = Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 60),
	Blue        = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255),
	Purple      = Color3.fromRGB(160, 90, 240),
	Text        = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240),
	Sub         = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 175),
	Muted       = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
	Border      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	BorderLight = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 60),
	Online      = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 100),
	Offline     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
}

--// ============================================================
--// Helpers
--// ============================================================
local function Inst(Class: string, Props: {[string]: any}, Parent: Instance?): Instance
	local I = Instance.new(Class)
	for K, V in pairs(Props) do I[K] = V end
	if Parent then I.Parent = Parent end
	return I
end

local function RC(F, R) Inst("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R or 6)}, F) end
local function RS(F, Col, T) Inst("UIStroke", {Color = Col or Th.Border, Thickness = T or 1, Transparency = 0.3}, F) end
local function RP(F, T, B, L, R)
	Inst("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T or 4),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, B or 4),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, L or 6),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, R or 6),
	}, F)
end

local function AddGradient(F, C1, C2, Rot)
	Inst("UIGradient", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new(C1, C2),
		Rotation = Rot or 90,
	}, F)
end

local function AddGlow(F, Col, Size)
	local Glow = Inst("ImageLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(Size or 1.1, Size or 1.1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale((1 - (Size or 1.1))/2, (1 - (Size or 1.1))/2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084",
		ImageColor3 = Col or Th.AccentGlow,
		ImageTransparency = 0.85,
		ZIndex = 0,
	}, F)
	return Glow
end

local function Lbl(P, Text, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local L = Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Col or Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}, P)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 14}, L)
	return L
end

local function Btn(P, Text, Fn, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local BC = Col or Th.Accent
	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = BC,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)

	-- Hover effects
	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)}):Play()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Size = (Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28)) + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)}):Play()
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC}):Play()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28)}):Play()
	end)

	if Fn then B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Fn) end
	return B
end

local function Txt(P: Instance, Ph: string?, Sz: UDim2?, Pos: UDim2?): TextBox
	local B = Inst("TextBox", {
		PlaceholderText = Ph or "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = Th.Muted,
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Input, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P) :: TextBox
	RC(B, 6)
	RP(B, 2, 2, 8, 8)
	RS(B)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)

	-- Focus effects
	B.Focused:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface}):Play()
	end)
	B.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Input}):Play()
	end)

	return B
end

local function Scr(P, Sz, Pos)
	local S = Inst("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScrollBarThickness = 3,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Th.AccentDim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)}, S)
	RP(S, 6, 6, 6, 6)
	return S
end

local function Card(P, H, Ord)
	local F = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H or 36),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = Ord or 0,
	}, P)
	RC(F, 8)
	RS(F, Th.BorderLight)
	return F
end

local function StatCard(P, Title, Value, Icon, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 60, Ord)
	RP(F, 8, 8, 12, 12)

	-- Icon background
	local IconBg = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.15),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.AccentDim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, F)
	RC(IconBg, 8)
	AddGlow(IconBg, Th.AccentGlow, 1.3)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon or "📊",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 20,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, IconBg)

	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.15))
	Lbl(F, tostring(Value), Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18), UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.52))

	return F
end

local function ARow(P, Title, Ph, Btns, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 44, Ord)
	RP(F, 6, 6, 10, 10)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 14), UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.12))
	local Box = Txt(F, Ph, UDim2.new(0.26, 0, 0, 30), UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.1))
	local N = #Btns
	local Gap = 6
	local BW = (0.34 * F.AbsoluteSize.X - Gap * (N - 1)) / N
	BW = math.max(BW / F.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.08)
	local X = 0.62
	for _, S in Btns do
		local LS = S
		Btn(F, LS.text, function() LS.click(Box) end, LS.color, UDim2.new(BW, -2, 0, 30), UDim2.new(X, 0, 0.08, 0))
		X += BW + Gap / F.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	return F, Box
end

local function DangerRow(P, Title, Fn, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 40, Ord)
	RP(F, 6, 6, 10, 10)
	Btn(F, Title, function() Fn(F) end, Th.Red, UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.12, 0))
	return F
end

local function SectionHdr(P, Text, Ord)
	local L = Lbl(P, Text, Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 22), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0))
	L.LayoutOrder = Ord or 0
	L.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 13}, L)
	return L
end

local function EmptyState(P, Icon, Title, Desc)
	local Holder = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 0,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 36,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42), LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Sub,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Desc, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, 18), LayoutOrder = 3,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, Holder)
	return Holder
end

--// ============================================================
--// Enhanced Toast Notifications
--// ============================================================
local ToastId = 0
local ActiveToasts = {}

local function Toast(Msg, Type)
	ToastId += 1
	local MyId = ToastId
	local Col = Type == "error" and Th.Red or Type == "warning" and Th.Orange or Th.Green
	local Icon = Type == "error" and "✕  " or Type == "warning" and "⚠  " or "✓  "

	-- Position existing toasts up
	for _, T in pairs(ActiveToasts) do
		local currentPos = T.Position
		TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {
			Position = currentPos - UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.08)
		}):Play()
	end

	local T = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 44),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface2,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 600,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, SG)
	RC(T, 10)
	RS(T, Col, 2)
	AddGlow(T, Col, 1.15)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon .. tostring(Msg), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13,
		TextColor3 = Col, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.3, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 601,
	}, T)

	ActiveToasts[MyId] = T

	TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.04, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()

	task.delay(3.5, function()
		if ActiveToasts[MyId] then
			TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.delay(0.35, function()
				T:Destroy()
				ActiveToasts[MyId] = nil
			end)
		end
	end)
end

--// ============================================================
--// Confirm Modal (Enhanced)
--// ============================================================
local function Confirm(Title, Msg, BtnText, Callback)
	local Overlay = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = 500,
	}, SG)

--// Remote wrappers
--// ============================================================
local function Req(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R, M = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	if not OK then Toast("Error: " .. tostring(R), "error") return nil end
	if type(R) == "string" then Toast(M or R, R:find("Error") and "error" or "success")
	elseif type(R) == "boolean" and M then Toast(M, R and "success" or "error") end
	return R
end

local function ReqS(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	return OK and R or nil
end

local Tabs = {}
local TabSide = {}
local TabRefresh = {}
local CurTab = "Players"
local TabBtns = {}

local function ShowTab(Name)
	CurTab = Name
	for N, F in pairs(Tabs) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, F in pairs(TabSide) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, B in pairs(TabBtns) do
		if N == Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Accent}):Play()
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = Th.Text}):Play()
		else
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = Th.Sub}):Play()
		end
	end
	if TabRefresh[Name] then pcall(TabRefresh[Name]) end
end

local TabOrder = 0
local function AddTab(Name, Icon, Ord)
	TabOrder += 1
	local OrdVal = Ord or TabOrder

	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = (Icon or "•") .. " " .. Name,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub,
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, 34),
		LayoutOrder = OrdVal,
	}, TabBar)
	RC(B, 7)
	RS(B, Th.BorderLight, 1)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 11}, B)
	B.Name = Name
	TabBtns[Name] = B

	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.CardHover}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowTab(Name) end)

	local S = Scr(Content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	S.Visible = false
	Tabs[Name] = S
	return S
end

--// Clear helper
local function Clear(P: Instance?)
	if not P then return end
	for _, Child in P:GetChildren() do
		if not Child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not Child:IsA("UIPadding") and not Child:IsA("UICorner") and not Child:IsA("UIStroke") and not Child:IsA("UIGradient") then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function RefreshPL(Search: string?)
	if not PLPanel then return end
	Clear(PLPanel)
	local List = (AdminRemote:InvokeServer("getPlayers") :: {any}) or {}
	local Q = (Search and string.lower(Search)) or ""
	local Ord = 0
	for _, I in ipairs(List) do
		if Q == "" or string.find(string.lower(I.name), Q) or string.find(string.lower(I.displayName), Q) then
			Ord += 1
			local IsSel = (I.name == SelName)
			local R = Inst("TextButton", {
				Text = "",
				BackgroundColor3 = IsSel and Th.Accent or Th.Card,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
				LayoutOrder = Ord,
			}, PLPanel) :: TextButton
			RC(R, 7)
			if IsSel then
				AddGlow(R, Th.AccentGlow, 1.12)
			else
				RS(R, Th.BorderLight)
			end
			Lbl(R, I.displayName, IsSel and Th.Text or Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 13), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.08))
			Lbl(R, "@" .. I.name, Th.Muted, UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 10), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.55))
			local Dot = Inst("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7),
				Position = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.38, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = I.loaded and Th.Online or Th.Offline,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, R)
			RC(Dot, 4)
			if I.loaded then AddGlow(Dot, Th.Online, 2) end
			R.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				SelName = I.name
				RefreshPL(Search)
				RefreshPR()
			end)
		end
	end
	if Ord == 0 then
		EmptyState(PLPanel, "🔍", "No players found", "Try a different search term")
	end
end

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)
	local Setting = GameSettings:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Setting then return false, "Unknown setting" end
	if Setting:IsA("IntValue") or Setting:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Setting.Value = Num
	elseif Setting:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Setting.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	elseif Setting:IsA("StringValue") then
		Setting.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Setting.Value)
end

function SettingsHandler.AllAreas()
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Area in Areas:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Area:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		Result[#Result + 1] = { name = Area.Name, cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0 }
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return tonumber(A.name) < tonumber(B.name) end)
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetAreaCost(AreaName, NewValue)
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return false, "No areas" end
	local Area = Areas:FindFirstChild(tostring(AreaName))
	if not Area or not Area:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Area not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Area.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set area " .. AreaName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function SettingsHandler.AllGemShop()
	local GemShop = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if not GemShop then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Upgrade in GemShop:GetChildren() do
		local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
		local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
		local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
		local UpgName = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or Upgrade.Name
		local DefaultReward = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("DefaultReward") and Reward.DefaultReward.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Reward.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Reward.Exponential.Value or false
		local DefaultPrice = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("DefaultPrice") and Price.DefaultPrice.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Price.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Price.Exponential.Value or false
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = Upgrade.Name,
			name = UpgName,
			max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			reward = { default = DefaultReward, increasePer = IncreasePerR, exponential = ExpR },
			price = { default = DefaultPrice, increasePer = IncreasePerP, exponential = ExpP },
		}
	end
	return Result
end

return SettingsHandler

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.AnimationController
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AnimationsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Animations")

-- Animations in this set play WITHOUT leg counter-rotation, because their leg
-- keyframes are intentional (kicks, sits, swims, etc.). Everything else gets the
-- counter-rotation applied to keep legs vertical when the torso rotates.
local SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE = {
	["Leg Kick Animation"] = true,
	["Double Jump Backflip Animation"] = true,
	["Driving Steering Animation"] = true,
	["Flying Animation"] = true,
	["Gun Shooting Position Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Hurting Animation"] = true,
	["Injured Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Item Pickup Animation"] = true,
	["Level Up Celebration Animation"] = true,
	["Seating Animation"] = true,
	["Sliding Animation"] = true,
	["Sneak Walk Animation"] = true,
	["Spell Cast Fireball Animation"] = true,
	["Swimming Animation"] = true,
	["Zombie Walk Animation"] = true,
}

-- Internal class: drives Motor6D.Transform per frame, lerping between keyframes.
local AnimationExecutor = {}
AnimationExecutor.__index = AnimationExecutor

function AnimationExecutor.new(character: Model)
	local self = setmetatable({}, AnimationExecutor)

	self.Character = character
	self.Joints = {}
	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.Connection = nil
	self.IsPlaying = false

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Motor6D") and desc.Part1 then
			self.Joints[desc.Part1.Name] = desc
		elseif desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and desc.Attachment1 then
			local part = desc.Attachment1.Parent
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				self.Joints[part.Name] = desc
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function AnimationExecutor:Stop()
	self.IsPlaying = false
	if self.Connection then
		self.Connection:Disconnect()
		self.Connection = nil
	end
end

function AnimationExecutor:PlayFromTable(animTable, options)
	if self.Connection then self:Stop() end

	self.CurrentTime = 0
	self.IsPlaying = true

	options = options or {}
	local counterRotateLegs = options.counterRotateLegs ~= false  -- default true

	local timestamps = {}
	for t, _ in pairs(animTable.Timestamps) do
		table.insert(timestamps, t)
	end
	table.sort(timestamps)

	local maxTime = timestamps[#timestamps]
	local isLooping = animTable.Settings.Loop

	self.Connection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
		if not self.IsPlaying then return end

		self.CurrentTime += dt

		if self.CurrentTime >= maxTime then
			if isLooping then
				self.CurrentTime %= maxTime
			else
				self.CurrentTime = maxTime
				self:Stop()
				return
			end
		end

		local tStart, tEnd = timestamps[1], timestamps[#timestamps]
		for i = 1, #timestamps - 1 do
			if self.CurrentTime >= timestamps[i] and self.CurrentTime < timestamps[i+1] then
				tStart = timestamps[i]
				tEnd = timestamps[i+1]
				break
			end
		end

		local segmentDuration = tEnd - tStart
		local alpha = (segmentDuration > 0) and (self.CurrentTime - tStart) / segmentDuration or 0

		local dataStart = animTable.Timestamps[tStart]
		local dataEnd = animTable.Timestamps[tEnd]

		for partName, joint in pairs(self.Joints) do
			local cfA = dataStart[partName] or joint.Transform
			local cfB = dataEnd[partName] or cfA
			joint.Transform = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
		end

		-- Counter-rotate legs against LowerTorso (only when caller asks for it)
		if counterRotateLegs then
			local lowerTorso = self.Joints["LowerTorso"]
			if lowerTorso then
				local lt = lowerTorso.Transform
				local invRot = (lt - lt.Position):Inverse()
				for _, legName in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg"}) do
					local legJoint = self.Joints[legName]
					if legJoint then
						legJoint.Transform = invRot * legJoint.Transform
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Public API
local AnimationController = {}

local executor = nil
local currentCharacter = nil

local function ensureExecutor()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	-- Re-create the executor if the character changed (respawn, R6/R15 swap, etc.)
	if character ~= currentCharacter then
		currentCharacter = character
		executor = AnimationExecutor.new(character)
	end
	return executor
end

-- Reset on respawn so we don't reuse joints from the old character
Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	executor = nil
	currentCharacter = nil
end)

function AnimationController.Play(animationName)
	local animModule = AnimationsFolder:FindFirstChild(animationName)
	if not animModule then
		warn("AnimationController: no animation named", animationName)
		return
	end
	local exec = ensureExecutor()
	local skipLegFix = SKIP_LEG_COUNTERROTATE[animationName] == true
	exec:PlayFromTable(require(animModule), { counterRotateLegs = not skipLegFix })
end

function AnimationController.Stop()
	if executor then executor:Stop() end
end

return AnimationController

--!strict
-- ScreenEffects.lua
-- Full-screen visual effects: flash, vignette, chromatic aberration, color grade

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ScreenEffects = {}
ScreenEffects.__index = ScreenEffects

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Effect container
local effectGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
effectGui.Name = "ScreenEffects"
effectGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
effectGui.DisplayOrder = 200
effectGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
effectGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Pool for flash frames
local flashPool = {}
local MAX_POOL = 10

local function getFlashFrame(): Frame
	for _, frame in flashPool do
		if not frame.Visible then
			frame.Visible = true
			return frame
		end
	end
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = effectGui
	table.insert(flashPool, frame)
	return frame
end

local function returnToPool(frame: Frame)
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
end

-- Chromatic aberration frames
local chromaticFrames = {}
local function ensureChromatic()
	if #chromaticFrames > 0 then return end
	for _, color in {Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)} do
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.Parent = effectGui
		table.insert(chromaticFrames, frame)
	end
end

local function returnChromatic()
	for _, frame in chromaticFrames do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	end
end

-- Vignette
local vignetteFrame = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
vignetteFrame.Name = "Vignette"
vignetteFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
vignetteFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
vignetteFrame.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084" -- soft circle
vignetteFrame.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1
vignetteFrame.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
vignetteFrame.Parent = effectGui

-- Color correction (via Lighting)
local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
colorCorrection.Name = "ScreenEffectsCC"
colorCorrection.Enabled = false
colorCorrection.Parent = game.Lighting

-- Public API
function ScreenEffects.Flash(color: Color3, duration: number, easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?)
	local frame = getFlashFrame()
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		returnToPool(frame)
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.RadialFlash(position: Vector2, color: Color3, maxRadius: number, duration: number)
	local frame = getFlashFrame()
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X, position.Y)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	
	local corner = frame:FindFirstChild("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxRadius * 2, maxRadius * 2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		returnToPool(frame)
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(intensity: number, duration: number)
	ensureChromatic()
	local offset = intensity * 4
	
	for i, frame in chromaticFrames do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
		local angle = (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / 3)
		local targetPos = UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle) * offset, math.sin(angle) * offset)
		
		local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			Position = targetPos
		})
		tween:Play()
	end
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		for _, frame in chromaticFrames do
			TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
		end
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.Vignette(intensity: number, duration: number, holdDuration: number?)
	vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1 - intensity
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(vignetteFrame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		ImageTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	
	if holdDuration then
		task.delay(holdDuration, function()
			TweenService:Create(vignetteFrame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				ImageTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
		end)
	end
end

function ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(tintColor: Color3, saturation: number, contrast: number, duration: number, holdDuration: number?)
	colorCorrection.Enabled = true
	colorCorrection.TintColor = tintColor
	colorCorrection.Saturation = saturation
	colorCorrection.Contrast = contrast
	
	if holdDuration then
		task.delay(holdDuration, function()
			TweenService:Create(colorCorrection, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				Saturation = 0,
				Contrast = 0
			}):Play()
			task.wait(duration)
			colorCorrection.Enabled = false
		end)
	else
		TweenService:Create(colorCorrection, TweenInfo.new(duration * 2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Saturation = 0,
			Contrast = 0
		}):Play()
		task.wait(duration * 2)
		colorCorrection.Enabled = false
	end
end

function ScreenEffects.SlowMotion(factor: number, duration: number)
	-- Note: This only affects client-side visual timing
	-- Actual game logic should use server time
	local originalWait = task.wait
	local startTime = os.clock()
	
	local connection
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if os.clock() - startTime > duration then
			connection:Disconnect()
			return
		end
		-- Visual slow-mo via time scaling would need custom heartbeat
	end)
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.StopAll()
	for _, frame in flashPool do
		frame.Visible = false
	end
	returnChromatic()
	vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1
	colorCorrection.Enabled = false
	colorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	colorCorrection.Saturation = 0
	colorCorrection.Contrast = 0
end

-- Preset sequences for game moments
ScreenEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function(position: Vector2?)
		ScreenEffects.RadialFlash(position or Vector2.new(0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), 100, 0.15)
	end,
	
	RareHatch = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 0.1)
		ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(1, 0.5)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(0.6, 0.2, 0.3)
		ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), 0.5, 0.2, 0.5, 0.5)
	end,

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore
		local MainFrame = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame
		MainFrame.Title.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and "Top 100 Most "..RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Title
		MainFrame.Players.Amount.Text = Leaderboard.Name == "Currency" and RS["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value or Module[Leaderboard.Name].Stat
		
		local Template = script.Template
		if Leaderboard:FindFirstChild("Template") then
			Template = Leaderboard.Template
		end
		
		for i = 1,100 do			
			local Clone = Template:Clone()
			Clone.LayoutOrder = i
			Clone.Name = i
			Clone.Rank.Text = ""
			Clone.PlrName.Text = ""
			Clone.Amount.Text = ""
			Clone.Parent = MainFrame.Players.Scroll
		end 
	end
end

return Main

--!strict
-- PetCombatSystem - Improved combat mechanics for pets vs enemies

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CombatFeedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Enemies = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies") or Instance.new("Folder")
Enemies.Name = "PetEnemies"
Enemies.Parent = Workspace

--// Configuration
local CONFIG = {
	PetAttackRange = 8,
	PetAttackCooldown = 1.2,
	PetBaseDamage = 15,
	OwnerMaxDistance = 35, -- Pet stops attacking if owner is further than this

	EnemyBaseHealth = 50,
	EnemyHealthScaling = 1.5, -- Health multiplier per respawn count
	EnemyMaxRespawnCount = 10,
	EnemyRespawnDelay = 5,
	EnemyAttackRange = 6,
	EnemyAttackCooldown = 2,
	EnemyBaseDamage = 8,
	EnemyGoldMin = 15,
	EnemyGoldMax = 35,

	MaxEnemiesPerPlayer = 3,
	EnemySpawnInterval = 8,
	EnemySpawnDistance = {Min = 25, Max = 40},
}

--// State
local petAttackCooldowns = {}
local enemyAttackCooldowns = {}
local enemyRespawnCounts = {} -- Tracks how many times each enemy has respawned
local petCombatTargets = {} -- Tracks which enemy each pet is targeting
local activePetAttacks = {} -- Tracks pets currently in attack mode

--// Helper Functions
local function combat(player, kind, data)
	if not player or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then return end
	data = data or {}
	data.kind = kind
	CombatFeedback:FireClient(player, data)
end

local function giveGold(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not currency then return false end
	currency.Value += amount
	return true
end

local function getOwner(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	if typeof(ownerId) ~= "number" then return nil end
	return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
end

local function getPetMain(pet)
	return pet and (pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
end

local function getEnemyMain(enemy)
	return enemy and (enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
end

local function isOwnerNearby(pet, maxDistance)
	maxDistance = maxDistance or CONFIG.OwnerMaxDistance
	local owner = getOwner(pet)
	if not owner then return false end

	local character = owner.Character
	local ownerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)

	if not ownerRoot or not petMain then return false end

	local distance = (ownerRoot.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
	return distance <= maxDistance
end

local function shouldPetStopAttacking(pet)
	-- Pet should NOT automatically stop attacking when owner moves away
	-- Only stop if explicitly commanded
	return false
end

local function createHitEffect(position, color, damage)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = Workspace

	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.9
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(7, 16)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(math.floor(damage * 1.5))

	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

--// Enemy Management
local function getEnemyRespawnCount(enemyName)
	return enemyRespawnCounts[enemyName] or 0
end

local function incrementEnemyRespawnCount(enemyName)
	enemyRespawnCounts[enemyName] = (enemyRespawnCounts[enemyName] or 0) + 1
	return enemyRespawnCounts[enemyName]
end

local function calculateEnemyHealth(baseHealth, respawnCount)
	respawnCount = math.min(respawnCount, CONFIG.EnemyMaxRespawnCount)
	return math.floor(baseHealth * (CONFIG.EnemyHealthScaling ^ respawnCount))
end

local function createEnemy(position, zone, owner)
	zone = zone or "Spawn"
	local enemy = Instance.new("Model")
	enemy.Name = "Enemy_" .. tostring(owner.UserId) .. "_" .. os.clock()

	local main = Instance.new("Part")
	main.Name = "MainPart"
	main.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	main.Position = position
	main.Anchored = false
	main.CanCollide = true
	main.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
	main.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	main.Parent = enemy

	enemy.PrimaryPart = main

	local respawnCount = getEnemyRespawnCount(enemy.Name)
	local health = calculateEnemyHealth(CONFIG.EnemyBaseHealth, respawnCount)

	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("RespawnCount", respawnCount)
	enemy:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Zone", zone)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Moving", false)

	enemy.Parent = Enemies

	combat(owner, "EnemySpawned", {
		position = position,
		zone = zone,
		health = health,
		respawnCount = respawnCount
	})

	return enemy
end

local function respawnEnemy(enemyName, position, zone, owner)
	task.wait(CONFIG.EnemyRespawnDelay)

	local newRespawnCount = incrementEnemyRespawnCount(enemyName)

	if newRespawnCount > CONFIG.EnemyMaxRespawnCount then
		-- Reset count after max respawns
		enemyRespawnCounts[enemyName] = 0
		newRespawnCount = 0
	end

	local enemy = createEnemy(position, zone, owner)
	enemy.Name = enemyName -- Keep the same name to track respawn count

	combat(owner, "EnemyRespawned", {
		position = position,
		respawnCount = newRespawnCount,
		health = enemy:GetAttribute("Health")
	})
end

--// Combat Functions
local function petAttackEnemy(pet, enemy)
	local owner = getOwner(pet)
	if not owner then return false end

	-- Pet continues attacking regardless of owner distance
	-- Owner must explicitly command pet to stop/follow

	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	local enemyMain = getEnemyMain(enemy)

	if not petMain or not enemyMain then return false end

	-- Check distance
	local distance = (petMain.Position - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > CONFIG.PetAttackRange then return false end

	-- Check cooldown
	local now = os.clock()
	if petAttackCooldowns[pet] and now - petAttackCooldowns[pet] < CONFIG.PetAttackCooldown then
		return false
	end

	petAttackCooldowns[pet] = now

	-- Calculate damage
	local petLevel = tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Level")) or 1
	local moodMultiplier = (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 50) / 100
	local damage = math.floor(CONFIG.PetBaseDamage * (1 + petLevel * 0.1) * (0.5 + moodMultiplier * 0.5))

	-- Apply damage
	local currentHealth = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
	local newHealth = math.max(0, currentHealth - damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", newHealth)

	-- Visual effects
	createHitEffect(enemyMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), damage)

	combat(owner, "PetAttack", {
		position = enemyMain.Position,
		damage = damage,
		enemyHealth = newHealth,
		enemyMaxHealth = enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
	})

	-- Check if enemy is defeated
	if newHealth <= 0 then
		local goldReward = math.random(CONFIG.EnemyGoldMin, CONFIG.EnemyGoldMax)
		local respawnCount = enemy:GetAttribute("RespawnCount") or 0
		goldReward = math.floor(goldReward * (1 + respawnCount * 0.2))

		giveGold(owner, goldReward)

		-- Give pet experience
		local expGain = 10 + respawnCount * 5
		local currentExp = tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Experience")) or 0
		pet:SetAttribute("Experience", currentExp + expGain)

		combat(owner, "EnemyDefeated", {
			position = enemyMain.Position,
			gold = goldReward,
			experience = expGain,
			respawnCount = respawnCount
		})

		-- Store enemy info for respawn
		local enemyName = enemy.Name
		local enemyPos = enemyMain.Position
		local zone = enemy:GetAttribute("Zone")

		enemy:Destroy()
		petCombatTargets[pet] = nil

		-- Respawn enemy with increased health
		task.spawn(respawnEnemy, enemyName, enemyPos, zone, owner)
	end

	return true
end

local function enemyAttackPet(enemy, pet)
	local owner = getOwner(pet)
	if not owner then return false end

	local enemyMain = getEnemyMain(enemy)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)

	if not enemyMain or not petMain then return false end

	-- Check distance
	local distance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > CONFIG.EnemyAttackRange then return false end

	-- Check cooldown
	local now = os.clock()
	if enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] and now - enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] < CONFIG.EnemyAttackCooldown then
		return false
	end

	enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = now

	-- Calculate damage
	local damage = CONFIG.EnemyBaseDamage

	-- Apply damage to pet
	local currentHealth = tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100
	local newHealth = math.max(0, currentHealth - damage)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", newHealth)

	-- Visual effects
	createHitEffect(petMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100), damage)

	combat(owner, "PetHit", {
		position = petMain.Position,
		damage = damage,
		petHealth = newHealth
	})

	-- Reduce pet mood when hit
	local mood = tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 50
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", math.max(0, mood - 5))

	if newHealth <= 0 then
		combat(owner, "PetDefeated", {
			position = petMain.Position
		})
		pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Stop")
		petCombatTargets[pet] = nil
		activePetAttacks[pet] = nil
	end

	return true
end

--// Combat Loop
local function updateCombat()
	-- Update all pets in attack mode
	for pet, _ in pairs(activePetAttacks) do
		if not pet.Parent then
			activePetAttacks[pet] = nil
			petCombatTargets[pet] = nil
			continue
		end

		-- Pet continues attacking until explicitly commanded to stop
		-- No automatic state change based on owner distance

		local target = petCombatTargets[pet]

		-- Find or validate target
		if not target or not target.Parent or (tonumber(target:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) <= 0 then
			-- Find nearest enemy
			local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
			if petMain then
				local nearestEnemy
				local nearestDistance = math.huge

				for _, enemy in ipairs(Enemies:GetChildren()) do
					local enemyMain = getEnemyMain(enemy)
					if enemyMain and (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) > 0 then
						local distance = (petMain.Position - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude
						if distance < nearestDistance and distance <= 30 then
							nearestEnemy = enemy
							nearestDistance = distance
						end
					end
				end

				target = nearestEnemy
				petCombatTargets[pet] = target
			end
		end

		-- Attack target if found
		if target then
			petAttackEnemy(pet, target)
		end
	end

	-- Update enemy attacks
	for _, enemy in ipairs(Enemies:GetChildren()) do
		if (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) > 0 then
			local enemyMain = getEnemyMain(enemy)
			if enemyMain then
				-- Find nearest pet to attack
				local nearestPet
				local nearestDistance = math.huge

				for _, folder in ipairs(PlayerPets:GetChildren()) do
					for _, pet in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
						if pet:IsA("Model") then
							local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
							if petMain and (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) > 0 then
								local distance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
								if distance < nearestDistance and distance <= 15 then
									nearestPet = pet
									nearestDistance = distance
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if nearestPet then
					enemyAttackPet(enemy, nearestPet)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	pcall(updateCombat)
end)

--// Public API
local PetCombatSystem = {}

function PetCombatSystem.StartAttack(pet)
	if not pet or not pet.Parent then return false end

	-- Pet can attack regardless of owner distance
	activePetAttacks[pet] = true
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Attack")

	return true
end

function PetCombatSystem.StopAttack(pet)
	if not pet then return end
	activePetAttacks[pet] = nil
	petCombatTargets[pet] = nil
end

function PetCombatSystem.SpawnEnemy(position, zone, owner)
	return createEnemy(position, zone, owner)
end

return PetCombatSystem

--// Configure

local LoadingFunctions = {}
local Values = require(script.Parent.Values)
local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerData = DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value)

local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local PetMultipliers = require(RS.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local function CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
	local NewFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	NewFolder.Name = FolderName
	NewFolder.Parent = Player
	return NewFolder
end

--// Module

LoadingFunctions.LoadData = function(Player)
	local MainFolder = CreateFolder(Player,"Data")
	local Datastore

	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		Datastore = PlayerData:GetAsync(Player.UserId)
	end)

	if er then warn(er) Player:Kick("Failed to load. Make sure to allow API Services in studio & publish your games in order to make datastores work") return end

	if Datastore and Datastore.SessionId and game.JobId ~= Datastore.SessionId and os.time() - Datastore.LastInGame < 60 and not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then Player:Kick("Session Locked") end

	for _,FolderName in Values.Folders do
		if FolderName ~= "NonSaveValues" then
			CreateFolder(MainFolder,FolderName)
		else
			CreateFolder(Player,FolderName)
		end
	end

	--// Create all the non save values

	for _,Info in Values.NonSaveValues do
		local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
		NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
		NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
		NewInstance.Parent = Player.NonSaveValues
	end

	--// Create all the save values

	for FolderName,FolderInfo in Values.SaveValues do	
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			local NewInstance = Instance.new(Info.Type)
			NewInstance.Name = Info.Name
			NewInstance.Value = Info.Value
			NewInstance.Parent = MainFolder[FolderName]

			if Datastore and Datastore[FolderName] then
				if Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= nil and Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID] ~= Info.Value then
					NewInstance.Value = Datastore[FolderName][Info.ID]
				end
			end
		end		
	end

	--// Check Gamepasses

	for _,Gamepass in MainFolder.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value then continue end -- only check if you DONT have it
		
		if RS.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(Gamepass.Name) == nil then continue end
		
		local GPId = RS.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value
		Gamepass.Value = MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(Player.UserId, GPId)
	end
	
	--// Pets	
	PetMultipliers.AddPlayer(Player.Name)

	if Datastore and Datastore.Pets then
		for PetId, PetInfo in Datastore.Pets do
			local NewPet = RS.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet.Equipped.Value = PetInfo.Equipped
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetInfo.PetName
			NewPet.Parent = MainFolder.Pets
			
			if PetInfo.Equipped then
				PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, NewPet)
			end
		end
end
	
	--// Auto Delete
	for _, Pet in RS.Pets:GetChildren() do
		local AutoDelete = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		
		if Datastore and Datastore.AutoDelete and Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name] then
			AutoDelete.Value = Datastore.AutoDelete[Pet.Name]
		end
		
		AutoDelete.Name = Pet.Name
		AutoDelete.Parent = MainFolder.AutoDelete
	end
	
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

return LoadingFunctions

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

local function New(ClassName, Props, Parent)
	local Obj = Instance.new(ClassName)
	for Name, Value in Props do
		Obj[Name] = Value
	end
	if Parent then Obj.Parent = Parent end
	return Obj
end

local function Rounded(Obj, Radius)
	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Radius)
	Corner.Parent = Obj
end

local function Clear(Parent)
	for _, Child in Parent:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA("UIListLayout") or Child:IsA("UIGridLayout") then continue end
		Child:Destroy()
	end
end

local function AddGlassEffect(Frame, ShadowOffset)
	Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3

	New("UIStroke", {
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		Transparency = 0.9,
		Thickness = 1,
	}, Frame)

	if ShadowOffset then
		local Shadow = New("Frame", {
			Size = Frame.Size,
			Position = Frame.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, ShadowOffset),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = Frame.ZIndex - 1,
		}, Frame.Parent)
		Rounded(Shadow, 10)
		Frame:SetAttribute("Shadow", true)
		return Shadow
	end
end

local ActiveViewports = {}

local function SetupPetViewport(Viewport, PetName)
	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if not PetModel then
		-- Fallback: show placeholder icon
		local Placeholder = New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "?",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		}, Viewport)
		return
	end

	local Clone = PetModel:Clone()
	Clone.Parent = Viewport

	local MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not MainPart then
		MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
	end
	if not MainPart then return end

	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	Viewport.CurrentCamera = Camera

	local Pos = MainPart.Position
	local Size = Clone:GetExtentsSize()
	local Distance = Size.Magnitude * 1.2

	-- Improved camera angle: slightly elevated
	local BaseAngle = 45
	local Elevation = 20

	-- Store rotation state
	local RotationData = {
		Angle = BaseAngle,
		Center = Pos,
		Distance = Distance,
		Elevation = Elevation,
		Active = true
	}
	ActiveViewports[Viewport] = RotationData

	-- Initial camera position
	local function UpdateCamera()
		local angle = math.rad(RotationData.Angle)
		local xOffset = math.cos(angle) * RotationData.Distance
		local zOffset = math.sin(angle) * RotationData.Distance
		local yOffset = RotationData.Distance * math.sin(math.rad(RotationData.Elevation))

		Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(
			Vector3.new(RotationData.Center.X + xOffset, RotationData.Center.Y + yOffset, RotationData.Center.Z + zOffset),
			RotationData.Center
		)
	end
	UpdateCamera()

	-- Cleanup on viewport removal
	Viewport.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not Viewport:IsDescendantOf(game) then
			RotationData.Active = false
			ActiveViewports[Viewport] = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Global rotation heartbeat for all viewports
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	for Viewport, Data in ActiveViewports do
		if Data.Active and Viewport.Visible then
			Data.Angle = (Data.Angle + (dt * 30)) % 360 -- 30 degrees per second

			local angle = math.rad(Data.Angle)
			local xOffset = math.cos(angle) * Data.Distance
			local zOffset = math.sin(angle) * Data.Distance
			local yOffset = Data.Distance * math.sin(math.rad(Data.Elevation))

			if Viewport.CurrentCamera then
				Viewport.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(
					Vector3.new(Data.Center.X + xOffset, Data.Center.Y + yOffset, Data.Center.Z + zOffset),
					Data.Center
				)
			end
		end
	end
end)
