		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = PetRarity(Pet.PetName.Value),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.55),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.25),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		local SelectBtn = New("TextButton", {
			Text = "Select",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.25),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.5),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(SelectBtn, 8)
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(SelectBtn)

		SelectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			SelectedPetId = tonumber(Pet.Name)
			SelectedPetName = Pet.PetName.Value
			SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: " .. SelectedPetName
			SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Colors.Accent
		end)
	end

	if Count == 0 then
		ShowEmptyState(PetList, "🐾", "No pets available to list.\nAll your pets are equipped!")
	end
end

ListConfirm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local Price = tonumber(PriceBox.Text)
	if not SelectedPetId then
		ShowNotice("Select a pet first", Colors.Red)
		return
	end
	if not Price or Price < 1 then
		ShowNotice("Enter a valid price", Colors.Red)
		return
	end

	ListConfirm.Text = "..."
	local Result = ListPetRemote:InvokeServer(SelectedPetId, Price)
	if Result and Result ~= "" and Result ~= "Not loaded" and Result ~= "In a trade" and Result ~= "Slow down" and Result ~= "Invalid price" and Result ~= "Pet not found" and Result ~= "Unequip the pet first" and Result ~= "Max active listings" and Result ~= "Try again" and Result ~= "Invalid input" then
		local ListedName = SelectedPetName
		SelectedPetId = nil
		SelectedPetName = nil
		SelectedLabel.Text = "No pet selected"
		SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Colors.Dim
		ShowNotice("Listed " .. ListedName .. " for " .. Price .. " gems", Colors.Green)
		PriceBox.Text = ""
		RefreshList()
		RefreshMyListings()
	else
		ShowNotice(Result or "Failed to list", Colors.Red)
	end
	ListConfirm.Text = "List for 24h"
end)

--// My Listings View
local MyListView = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Visible = false,
}, ContentFrame)
Views["My Listings"] = MyListView

local MyList = MakeScroll(MyListView, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))

RefreshMyListings = function()
	Clear(MyList)
	local List = GetMyListingsRemote:InvokeServer()

	if #List == 0 then
		ShowEmptyState(MyList, "📋", "You have no active listings.\nCreate a listing to start selling!")
		return
	end

	local AnimDelay = 0
	for _, Listing in List do
		local Card = New("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = Listing.timeLeft,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.26),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, MyList)
		Rounded(Card, 10)
		local Shadow = AddGlassEffect(Card, 4)

		-- Card entrance animation
		Card.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		for _, child in Card:GetDescendants() do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
				child.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
					child.TextTransparency = 1
				end
				if child:IsA("ViewportFrame") then
					child.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
			end
		end

		local currentDelay = AnimDelay
		task.delay(currentDelay, function()
			local targetTransparency = Card.BackgroundColor3 == Colors.Card and 0.3 or 1
			TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential), {
				BackgroundTransparency = targetTransparency
			}):Play()

			for _, child in Card:GetDescendants() do
				if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
					local trans = 0
					if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
						trans = (child.Name == "Overlay" or child.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)) and 0.4 or 0
						TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential), {
							BackgroundTransparency = trans,
							TextTransparency = 0
						}):Play()
					elseif child:IsA("ViewportFrame") then
						TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential), {
							BackgroundTransparency = 1
						}):Play()
					elseif child:IsA("Frame") then
						local bgTrans = (child.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)) and 0.7 or 0
						TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential), {
							BackgroundTransparency = bgTrans
						}):Play()
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		AnimDelay += 0.05

		-- Card hover effect
		local originalPosition = Card.Position
		Card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = originalPosition - UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
			}):Play()
			if Shadow then
				TweenService:Create(Shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
					Position = Shadow.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4),
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
				}):Play()
			end
		end)
		Card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = originalPosition
			}):Play()
			if Shadow then
				TweenService:Create(Shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
					Position = Card.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4),
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
				}):Play()
			end
		end)

		local Viewport = New("ViewportFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Darker,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Viewport, 8)
		SetupPetViewport(Viewport, Listing.petName)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Listing.petName,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.15),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Gems: " .. Short.en(Listing.price),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Time left: " .. Short.time(Listing.timeLeft),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.58, 0.15),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		local Cancel = New("TextButton", {
			Text = "Cancel",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Red,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.25),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.5),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Cancel, 8)
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Cancel)

		Cancel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local Result = CancelRemote:InvokeServer(Listing.id)
			ShowNotice(Result, Result == "Returned" and Colors.Green or Colors.Red)
			RefreshMyListings()
			RefreshInbox()
		end)
	end
end

--// Inbox View
local InboxView = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Visible = false,
}, ContentFrame)
Views.Inbox = InboxView

local InboxGems = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "Pending gems: 0",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Accent,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.1),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.2),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, InboxView)

local InboxPets = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "Pets to claim: 0",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.3),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.2),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, InboxView)

local InboxList = MakeScroll(InboxView, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5))

local ClaimBtn = New("TextButton", {
	Text = "Claim All",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Green,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.18),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.12),
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, InboxView)
Rounded(ClaimBtn, 8)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ClaimBtn)

RefreshInbox = function()
	local Mail = GetMailRemote:InvokeServer()
	InboxGems.Text = "Pending gems: " .. Short.en(Mail.gems)
	InboxPets.Text = "Pets to claim: " .. #Mail.pets

	Clear(InboxList)
	for _, Pet in Mail.pets do
		local Row = New("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, InboxList)
		Rounded(Row, 8)
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Pet.petName,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.2),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.6),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Row)
	end

	if #Mail.pets == 0 then
		ShowEmptyState(InboxList, "✉️", "No pets waiting.\nYour inbox is empty!")
	end
end

ClaimBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local Result = ClaimMailRemote:InvokeServer()
	if type(Result) == "table" then
		ShowNotice("Claimed " .. Result.gems .. " gems and " .. Result.granted .. " pets", Colors.Green)
	else
		ShowNotice(Result or "Failed to claim", Colors.Red)
	end
	RefreshInbox()
end)

--// Tabs
local Tabs = { "Browse", "List", "My Listings", "Inbox" }
local TabButtons = {}

local function ShowView(Name)
	for ViewName, View in Views do
		if ViewName == Name then
			View.Visible = true
			View.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			View.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.05)

			TweenService:Create(View, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			}):Play()
		else
			if View.Visible then
				task.delay(0.15, function()
					View.Visible = false
					View.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, TabButton in TabButtons do
		TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = TabButton.Name == Name and Colors.Accent or Colors.Card
	end
end

for _, TabName in Tabs do
	local TabButton = New("TextButton", {
		Name = TabName,
		Text = TabName,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 0.9),
		LayoutOrder = #TabButtons,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, TabsFrame)
	Rounded(TabButton, 8)
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(TabButton)
	TabButtons[#TabButtons + 1] = TabButton

	TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ShowView(TabName)
	end)
end

AuctionFrame.Parent = Frames

--// Open / Close
local function RefreshAll()
	RefreshBrowse()
	RefreshList()
	RefreshMyListings()
	RefreshInbox()
end

Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
end)

local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
local ButtonTemplate = nil
for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if Child:IsA("Frame") then
		ButtonTemplate = Child
		break
	end
end

local OpenButton
if ButtonTemplate then
	OpenButton = ButtonTemplate:Clone()
else
	OpenButton = New("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.08),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.9),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
	})
	New("TextButton", {
		Text = "Auction",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, OpenButton)
end

OpenButton.Name = "AuctionHouse"
OpenButton:SetAttribute("AuctionButton", true)

if OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Title") then
	OpenButton.Title.Text = "Auction"
end

--// Position: find the last existing button BEFORE parenting the clone,
-- otherwise the clone is its own "last child" and ends up overlapping it.
local HasLayout = ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") ~= nil
	or ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout") ~= nil

local LastButton = nil
if not HasLayout then
	for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA("Frame") then LastButton = Child end
	end
end

OpenButton.Parent = ButtonSide.Buttons
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(OpenButton)

if HasLayout then
	OpenButton.LayoutOrder = 999
elseif LastButton then
	OpenButton.Position = UDim2.new(LastButton.Position.X.Scale, LastButton.Position.X.Offset, LastButton.Position.Y.Scale + LastButton.Size.Y.Scale + 0.01, LastButton.Position.Y.Offset)
end

local OpenClick = OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Click") or OpenButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
if OpenClick then
	OpenClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
		RefreshAll()
	end)
end

--// Notifications
AuctionNotice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Kind, Value)
	if Kind == "sold" then
		if Value > 0 then
			ShowNotice("Your pet sold for " .. Short.en(Value) .. " gems!", Colors.Green)
		end
		RefreshInbox()
		RefreshMyListings()
	elseif Kind == "petReturned" then
		ShowNotice("An unsold pet was returned to you", Colors.Accent)
		RefreshInbox()
	elseif Kind == "listingsChanged" then
		if AuctionFrame.Visible then
			RefreshBrowse()
			RefreshMyListings()
		end
	end
end)

studioFiles.name: PetCombatEffects.client.luau
studioFiles.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local CameraEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CameraEffects)
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

-- Combo Text System (Top-middle of screen)
local comboGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
comboGui.Name = "ComboTextGui"
comboGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
comboGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
comboGui.DisplayOrder = 90
comboGui.Parent = playerGui

local comboContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
comboContainer.Name = "ComboContainer"
comboContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 100)
comboContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 80)
comboContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
comboContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
comboContainer.Parent = comboGui

local comboLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
comboLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
comboLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
comboLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
comboLayout.Parent = comboContainer

local comboCounter = 0
local comboTimer = 0
local comboDisplayLabel = nil

local function updateComboDisplay()
	if comboDisplayLabel then
		comboDisplayLabel.Text = "COMBO x" .. comboCounter
		comboDisplayLabel.TextSize = math.clamp(36 + comboCounter * 2, 36, 72)
		comboDisplayLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((comboCounter * 0.1) % 1, 0.8, 1)
	end
end

local function showComboText(combo)
	comboCounter = combo
	comboTimer = 2.5
	
	if not comboDisplayLabel then
		comboDisplayLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		comboDisplayLabel.Name = "ComboDisplay"
		comboDisplayLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 80)
		comboDisplayLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		comboDisplayLabel.Text = "COMBO x" .. comboCounter
		comboDisplayLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		comboDisplayLabel.TextSize = 36
		comboDisplayLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		comboDisplayLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		comboDisplayLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		comboDisplayLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		comboDisplayLabel.Parent = comboContainer
		
		-- Add UIStroke for glow effect
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
		stroke.Thickness = 3
		stroke.Transparency = 0.2
		stroke.Parent = comboDisplayLabel
	end
	
	updateComboDisplay()
	
	-- Pulse animation
	local tween = TweenService:Create(comboDisplayLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		TextSize = math.clamp(48 + comboCounter * 3, 48, 96)
	})
	tween:Play()
end

-- Combo timer
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		if comboTimer > 0 then
			comboTimer -= 0.1
			if comboTimer <= 0 then
				comboCounter = 0
				if comboDisplayLabel then
					local tween = TweenService:Create(comboDisplayLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
						TextTransparency = 1,
						TextStrokeTransparency = 1
					})
					tween:Play()
					tween.Completed:Connect(function()
						if comboCounter == 0 and comboDisplayLabel then
							comboDisplayLabel:Destroy()
							comboDisplayLabel = nil
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	-- Use a valid Roblox sound ID (click/pop sound)
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://12222005"
	killSound.Volume = 0.5
	killSound.Pitch = 0.8
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		killSound:Play()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Failed to play kill sound:", err)
	end
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
		
		-- Hit marker
		local hitMarker = Instance.new("Frame")
		hitMarker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
		hitMarker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		hitMarker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hitMarker.Parent = gui
		
		local worldPos = data.position
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local screenPos = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
		if screenPos.Z > 0 then
			hitMarker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
			hitMarker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			
			local marker = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
			marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			marker.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			marker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			marker.Image = "rbxassetid://3926305904" -- X marker
			marker.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
			marker.ImageTransparency = 0.2
			marker.Parent = hitMarker
			
			local tween = TweenService:Create(hitMarker, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y - 30)
			})
			tween:Play()
			
			local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(hitMarker, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			})
			fadeTween:Play()
			
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				hitMarker:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		
		-- Screen shake for impact
		if CameraEffects and CameraEffects.Shake then
			CameraEffects.Shake("Light")
		end
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		-- Enhanced death VFX
		local pos = data.position
		local reward = data.reward or 0
		local combo = data.combo or 1
		
		-- Show combo text in top-middle
		showComboText(combo)
		
		-- Main defeat text
		textBurst(pos, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(reward) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		
		-- Enhanced burst with multiple rings
		burst(pos, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		burst(pos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 30)
		ring(pos, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		ring(pos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		
		-- Explosive burst particles
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Size = Vector3.one
		part.Position = pos
		part.Parent = workspace
		
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 150)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		})
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1.2)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 40)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.5),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)
		})
		emitter.Parent = part
		emitter:Emit(60)
		
		-- Shockwave ring
		local shockwave = Instance.new("Part")
		shockwave.Anchored = true
		shockwave.CanCollide = false
		shockwave.Transparency = 1
		shockwave.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.2, 2)
		shockwave.Position = pos
		shockwave.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
		shockwave.Parent = workspace
		
		local shockwaveMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		shockwaveMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		shockwaveMesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://3270017"
		shockwaveMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(5, 5, 0.5)
		shockwaveMesh.Parent = shockwave
		
		local shockwaveTween = TweenService:Create(shockwave, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = Vector3.new(30, 0.2, 30),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0),
			Transparency = 1
		})
		shockwaveTween:Play()
		shockwaveTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			shockwave:Destroy()
		end)
		Debris:AddItem(part, 1.5)
		Debris:AddItem(shockwave, 0.6)
		
		playKillSound(pos)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		-- Visual effects only, don't modify player's humanoid state
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local tagName = "GMHeadTag"
local glowName = "GMHeadGlow"
local tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 54)
local tagHex = "#FFDD36"

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = glowName
	glow.Adornee = head
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
	glow.Parent = character

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = tagName
	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Text = "GM"
	label.TextColor3 = tagColor
	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
	label.Parent = billboard

	local textTween = TweenService:Create(
		label,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 150), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55}
	)
	textTween:Play()
end

local function refresh()
	if player.Character then addTag(player.Character) end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsGM"):Connect(refresh)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	addTag(character)
end)

TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.PrefixText = string.format("<font color='%s'>[GM]</font> %s", tagHex, message.PrefixText)
		end
	end
	return properties
end

TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = function(message, adornee)
	local properties = Instance.new("BubbleChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 8)
			properties.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 125)
			properties.TextSize = 18
			properties.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
			properties.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
			properties.TailVisible = true
		end
	end
	return properties
end

refresh()

local ADMINRANK = 254 -- What rank in group for admin


--// MAIN SCRIPT
local AdminFunctions = {}

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// General
function AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, AdminList) -- checks if user is allowed to use commands
	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK
	else
		return CreatorId == Player.UserId
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == PlayerName then
			return Player
		end
	end
end

--// Stats
function AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(Player, StatName)
	for _, Stat in Player.Data:GetDescendants() do
		if string.lower(Stat.Name) == StatName then
			return Stat
		end
	end
end

--// Pets
function AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(Player, PetName)
	for _, Pet in ReplicatedStorage.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if string.lower(Pet.Name) == PetName then
			return Pet
		end
	end
end

function AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return AdminFunctions.RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

return AdminFunctions

--// Server Handler
-- Server info, announcements, shutdown, and server-wide tools.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ServerHandler = {}

function ServerHandler.GetInfo()
	local Info = {
		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--!strict
-- Modal.lua
-- Modal dialog system for blocking interactions

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Modal = {}
Modal.__index = Modal

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	animationDuration = 0.3,
	backgroundDim = 0.5,
	blocking = true,
	maxWidth = 500,
	maxHeight = 400,
}

function Modal.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Modal)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.activeModals = {}
	self.gui = nil
	return self
end

function Modal:_createGui()
	if self.gui then return end
	
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ModalSystem"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 300
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	self.gui = gui
end

function Modal:Show(data)
	self:_createGui()
	
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	
	-- Create overlay
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "Overlay_" .. data.id
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.ZIndex = 200
	overlay.Parent = self.gui
	
	-- Modal frame
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Modal_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 32)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = 201
	frame.Parent = self.gui
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.ZIndex = 202
	title.Parent = frame
	
	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 16
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.ZIndex = 202
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Action buttons
	if data.actions then
		for i, action in ipairs(data.actions) do
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 170, 180)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.Text = action.text
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 14
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			btn.ZIndex = 202
			btn.Parent = frame
			
			local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnCorner.Parent = btn
			
			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if action.callback then action.callback() end
				self:Dismiss(data.id)
			end)
		end
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 18
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = 202
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)
	
	-- Store modal
	self.activeModals[data.id] = {frame = frame, overlay = overlay}
	
	-- Entrance animation
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1 - self.config.backgroundDim
	}):Play()
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.maxWidth, self.config.maxHeight)
	}):Play()
	
	return data.id
end

function Modal:Dismiss(id)
	local modal = self.activeModals[id]
	if not modal then return end
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(modal.overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	}):Play()
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(modal.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.2)
	modal.overlay:Destroy()
	modal.frame:Destroy()
	self.activeModals[id] = nil
end

function Modal:DismissAll()
	for id, _ in self.activeModals do
		self:Dismiss(id)
	end
end

function Modal:Destroy()
	self:DismissAll()
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return Modal

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

--// Players Handler
-- View player data, modify stats, kick, manage pets/gamepasses.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayersHandler = {}

function PlayersHandler.FindPlayer(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	Name = string.lower(Name)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == Name or string.lower(Player.DisplayName) == Name then
			return Player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayersHandler.ListPlayers()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local PD = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
			petCount = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("Pets") and #Data.Pets:GetChildren() or 0,
			currency = PD and PD.Currency.Value or 0,
			gems = PD and PD.Currency2.Value or 0,
			rebirths = PD and PD.Rebirth.Value or 0,
			zone = PD and PD.BestZone.Value or 0,
			eggsHatched = PD and PD.EggsHatched.Value or 0,
			totalCurrency = PD and PD.TotalCurrency.Value or 0,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function()
				local NSV = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues")
				return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false
			end)(),
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PlayersHandler.GetPlayerData(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return nil end
	local Data = Player.Data
	local PD = Data.PlayerData
	local GP = Data.Gamepasses

	local Gamepasses = {}
	for _, Value in GP:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
			Gamepasses[Value.Name] = Value.Value
		end
	end

	local Pets = {}
	for _, Pet in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Pets[#Pets + 1] = {
			id = Pet.Name,
			name = Pet.PetName.Value,
			equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end

	local AutoDelete = {}
	for _, AD in Data.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if AD:IsA("BoolValue") then
			AutoDelete[AD.Name] = AD.Value
		end
	end

	local GemShop = {}
	local GemShopFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if GemShopFolder then
		for _, Upgrade in GemShopFolder:GetChildren() do
			local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
			local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
			local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
			local CurrentLevel = PD:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. Upgrade.Name)
			GemShop[#GemShop + 1] = {
				id = Upgrade.Name,
				name = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or ("Upgrade " .. Upgrade.Name),
				level = CurrentLevel and CurrentLevel.Value or 0,
				max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		name = Player.Name,
		displayName = Player.DisplayName,
		userId = Player.UserId,
		accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
		loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
		isTrading = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsTrading"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		isOpeningEgg = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsOpeningEgg"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		petsEquipped = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("PetsEquipped"); return V and V.Value or 0 end)(),

		currency = PD.Currency.Value,
		gems = PD.Currency2.Value,
		rebirths = PD.Rebirth.Value,
		zone = PD.BestZone.Value,
		eggsHatched = PD.EggsHatched.Value,
		totalCurrency = PD.TotalCurrency.Value,
		gemUpgrade1 = PD.GemUpgrade1.Value,
		gemUpgrade2 = PD.GemUpgrade2.Value,

		music = PD.Music.Value,
		showOtherPets = PD.ShowOtherPets.Value,

		gamepasses = Gamepasses,
		pets = Pets,
		petCount = #Pets,
		autoDelete = AutoDelete,
		gemShop = GemShop,

		maxStorage = 50
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage1 and 50 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage2 and 250 or 0),
		maxEquipped = 5
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets1 and 3 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets2 and 10 or 0),
	}
end

function PlayersHandler.SetValue(Value, NewValue)
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false end
		Value.Value = Num
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function PlayersHandler.SetCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = Num
	return true, "Set currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
	Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value = Num
	return true, "Set gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetRebirths(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value = Num
	return true, "Set rebirths"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetZone(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = Num
	return true, "Set zone"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGemUpgrade(Player, Slot, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local S = tonumber(Slot)
	local A = tonumber(Amount)
	if not S or not A then return false, "Invalid input" end
	local Value = Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. S)
	if not Value then return false, "Upgrade not found" end
	Value.Value = A
	return true, "Set gem upgrade " .. S
end

function PlayersHandler.ToggleGamepass(Player, Name, State)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Value = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Value then return false, "Gamepass not found" end
	Value.Value = (State == true or State == "true")
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Value.Value)
end

function PlayersHandler.KickPlayer(Player, Reason)
	if not Player then return false, "Player not found" end
	local R = tostring(Reason or "Kicked by admin")
	if R == "" then R = "Kicked by admin" end
	Player:Kick(R)
	return true, "Kicked " .. Player.Name
end

return PlayersHandler

--!strict
-- Chart.lua
-- Price history chart rendering using CanvasDraw-like approach with UI frames

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Chart = {}
Chart.__index = Chart

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	width = 400,
	height = 200,
	margin = {top = 20, right = 20, bottom: 30, left = 50},
	gridColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 70),
	gridStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
	lineColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	lineThickness = 2,
	fillColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	fillTransparency = 0.85,
	pointColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	pointRadius = 4,
	textColor = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200),
	textSize = 11,
	font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	animationDuration = 0.5,
}

function Chart.new(parent, config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Chart)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.frame = nil
	self.canvas = nil
	self.points = {}
	self:_createFrame(parent)
	return self
end

function Chart:_createFrame(parent)
	self.frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.frame.Name = "PriceChart"
	self.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.width, self.config.height)
	self.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	self.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	self.frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	self.frame.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = self.frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 110)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.5
	stroke.Parent = self.frame

	-- Canvas for drawing
	self.canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.canvas.Name = "Canvas"
	self.canvas.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right, 1, -self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.canvas.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left, self.config.margin.top)
	self.canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.canvas.ClipsDescendants = true
	self.canvas.Parent = self.frame

	-- Y-axis labels container
	self.yLabels = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.yLabels.Name = "YLabels"
	self.yLabels.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left - 5, self.config.height - self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.yLabels.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, self.config.margin.top)
	self.yLabels.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.yLabels.Parent = self.frame

	-- X-axis labels container
	self.xLabels = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.xLabels.Name = "XLabels"
	self.xLabels.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right, 0, 20)
	self.xLabels.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left, self.config.height - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.xLabels.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.xLabels.Parent = self.frame

	-- Chart title
	self.titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	self.titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
	self.titleLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
	self.titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.titleLabel.Text = ""
	self.titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	self.titleLabel.TextSize = 14
	self.titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	self.titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	self.titleLabel.Parent = self.frame

	-- Stats panel
	self.statsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.statsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	self.statsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -35)
	self.statsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	self.statsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.statsFrame.Parent = self.frame

	local statsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	statsLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	statsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	statsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15)
	statsLayout.Parent = self.statsFrame
end

function Chart:SetTitle(title: string)
	self.titleLabel.Text = title
end

function Chart:SetData(points: {{x: number, y: number, timestamp: number}})
	-- points: array of {x (timestamp), y (price), timestamp}
	-- x can be sequential index or timestamp
	self.points = points
	self:_render()
end

function Chart:_render()
	if #self.points < 2 then return end

	-- Clear existing
	for _, child in self.canvas:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("ImageLabel") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	for _, child in self.yLabels:GetChildren() do child:Destroy() end
	for _, child in self.xLabels:GetChildren() do child:Destroy() end
	for _, child in self.statsFrame:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	-- Calculate bounds
	local minY = math.huge
	local maxY = -math.huge
	for _, p in self.points do
		minY = math.min(minY, p.y)
		maxY = math.max(maxY, p.y)
	end

	local padding = (maxY - minY) * 0.1
	if padding == 0 then padding = maxY * 0.1 end
	minY = minY - padding
	maxY = maxY + padding

	local chartWidth = self.config.width - self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right
	local chartHeight = self.config.height - self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom

	-- Y-axis labels (5 ticks)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local value = maxY - (maxY - minY) * (i / 4)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left - 5, 20)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i / 4) * chartHeight - 10)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = self:_formatNumber(value)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = self.config.textSize
		label.TextColor3 = self.config.textColor
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		label.Parent = self.yLabels
	end

	-- Draw grid lines
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local y = (i / 4) * chartHeight
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.gridColor
		line.BackgroundTransparency = self.config.gridStrokeTransparency
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.ZIndex = 1
		line.Parent = self.canvas
	end

	-- Calculate points
	local screenPoints = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(self.points) do
		local x = (i - 1) / (#self.points - 1) * chartWidth
		local y = (1 - (p.y - minY) / (maxY - minY)) * chartHeight
		table.insert(screenPoints, {x = x, y = y, value = p.y, timestamp = p.timestamp})
	end

	-- Draw fill area
	if #screenPoints >= 2 then
		-- Create fill using multiple rectangles (approximation)
		for i = 1, #screenPoints - 1 do
			local p1 = screenPoints[i]
			local p2 = screenPoints[i + 1]
			local width = p2.x - p1.x
			local avgY = (p1.y + p2.y) / 2
			local height = chartHeight - avgY

			local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
			fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p1.x, avgY)
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.fillColor
			fill.BackgroundTransparency = self.config.fillTransparency
			fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
			fill.ZIndex = 2
			fill.Parent = self.canvas
		end
	end

	-- Draw line
	for i = 1, #screenPoints - 1 do
		local p1 = screenPoints[i]
		local p2 = screenPoints[i + 1]
		
		local distance = math.sqrt((p2.x - p1.x)^2 + (p2.y - p1.y)^2)
		local angle = math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x)
		
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(distance, self.config.lineThickness)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p1.x, p1.y)
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		line.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.lineColor
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.ZIndex = 3
		line.Parent = self.canvas
	end

	-- Draw points
	for i, p in ipairs(screenPoints) do
		local point = Instance.new("Frame")
		point.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.pointRadius * 2, self.config.pointRadius * 2)
		point.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x - self.config.pointRadius, p.y - self.config.pointRadius)
		point.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.pointColor
		point.BorderSizePixel = 0
		point.ZIndex = 4
		point.Parent = self.canvas

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = point

		-- Hover tooltip
		point.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			self:_showTooltip(p)
		end)
		point.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			self:_hideTooltip()
		end)
	end

	-- X-axis labels (5 ticks)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local idx = math.floor(i / 4 * (#self.points - 1)) + 1
		local p = self.points[idx]
		local x = (i / 4) * (self.config.width - self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right)
		
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 18)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 40, 0)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = os.date("%m/%d", p.timestamp)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = self.config.textSize - 1
		label.TextColor3 = self.config.textColor
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.Parent = self.xLabels
	end

	-- Stats panel
	if #self.points > 0 then
		local current = self.points[#self.points].y
		local change = #self.points > 1 and current - self.points[1].y or 0
		local changePct = self.points[1].y ~= 0 and (change / self.points[1].y * 100) or 0

		local stats = {
			{"Current", self:_formatPrice(current)},
			{"Change", string.format("%s%.2f%%", change >= 0 and "+" or "", changePct)},
			{"24h High", self:_formatPrice(math.max(table.unpack(self:_getYValues())))},
			{"24h Low", self:_formatPrice(math.min(table.unpack(self:_getYValues())))},
		}

		for _, stat in stats do
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20)
			label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Text = stat[1] .. ": " .. stat[2]
			label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			label.TextSize = 11
			label.TextColor3 = stat[1] == "Change" and (change >= 0 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
			label.Parent = self.statsFrame
		end
	end
end

function Chart:_getYValues()
	local values = {}
	for _, p in self.points do table.insert(values, p.y) end
	return values
end

function Chart:_formatNumber(num: number): string
	if num >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", num / 1e9)
	elseif num >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", num / 1e6)
	elseif num >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", num / 1e3)
	else return string.format("%.0f", num) end
end

function Chart:_formatPrice(num: number): string
	return self:_formatNumber(num)
end

function Chart:_showTooltip(point)
	-- Tooltip implementation
end

function Chart:_hideTooltip()
	-- Hide tooltip
end

function Chart:Update(points)
	self.points = points
	self:_render()
end

function Chart:Destroy()
	self.frame:Destroy()
end

return Chart

--!strict
-- [Squeeze Enterprise Admin System] CommandRegistry
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

export type CommandDefinition = {
	Name: string,
	Aliases: { string },
	Description: string,
	MinRank: number,
	Usage: string,
	Execute: (caller: Player, args: { string }) -> (),
}

local CommandRegistry = {}
local registeredCommands: { [string]: CommandDefinition } = {}

function CommandRegistry.Register(def: CommandDefinition)
	registeredCommands[def.Name:lower()] = def
	for _, alias in ipairs(def.Aliases) do
		registeredCommands[alias:lower()] = def
	end
end

function CommandRegistry.Get(name: string): CommandDefinition?
	return registeredCommands[name:lower()]
end

function CommandRegistry.ResolveTargets(caller: Player, selector: string): { Player }
	local results: { Player } = {}
	local s = selector:lower()
	
	if s == "me" or s == "self" then
		table.insert(results, caller)
	elseif s == "all" then
		return Players:GetPlayers()
	elseif s == "others" then
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= caller then
				table.insert(results, p)
			end
		end
	else
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if string.lower(string.sub(p.Name, 1, #s)) == s or string.lower(string.sub(p.DisplayName, 1, #s)) == s then
				table.insert(results, p)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return results
end

return CommandRegistry

-- Layered sound effects with pitch variation, spatial audio, and pooling

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AudioEffects = {}
AudioEffects.__index = AudioEffects

local soundPool = {}
local MAX_POOL = 50
local soundGroups = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getSound(): Sound
	for _, sound in soundPool do
		if not sound.IsPlaying and sound.Parent then
			return sound
		end
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	table.insert(soundPool, sound)
	return sound
end

local function playAtPosition(soundId: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number, parent: Instance?)
	local sound = getSound()
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Pitch = pitch
	sound.PlayOnRemove = false
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	sound.MaxDistance = 100
	sound.Parent = parent or workspace
	sound.Position = position
	sound:Play()
	
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end)
	
	return sound
end

function AudioEffects.PlayGlobal(soundId: string, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	local sound = getSound()
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.Pitch = pitch or 1
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end)
	return sound
end

function AudioEffects.PlayAt(soundId: string, position: Vector3, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	return playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume or 1, pitch or 1)
end

function AudioEffects.PlayOnPart(soundId: string, part: BasePart, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	return playAtPosition(soundId, part.Position, volume or 1, pitch or 1, part)
end

function AudioEffects.PlayLayered(layers: {{soundId: string, volume: number?, pitch: number?, delay: number?}}, position: Vector3?)
	for _, layer in layers do
		task.delay(layer.delay or 0, function()
			if position then
				AudioEffects.PlayAt(layer.soundId, position, layer.volume, layer.pitch)
			else
				AudioEffects.PlayGlobal(layer.soundId, layer.volume, layer.pitch)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function AudioEffects.PlayWithPitchVariation(soundId: string, position: Vector3, baseVolume: number, basePitch: number, pitchVariance: number)
	local pitch = basePitch + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * pitchVariance
	AudioEffects.PlayAt(soundId, position, baseVolume, pitch)
end

function AudioEffects.StopAll()
	for _, sound in soundPool do
		sound:Stop()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end
end

-- Preset sound configurations for game moments

function AudioEffects.PlayPreset(presetName: string, position: Vector3?)

end

--// Function for handling buttons

local ButtonHandler = {}

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local function BlurAnimation(Transparency)
	Tween.Tween(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameUI.Blur, {Speed = 0.25}, {BackgroundTransparency=Transparency})
end

ButtonHandler.OnClick = function(Frame,Size)	
	if not Frame.Visible then
		--// Close other frames
		for _,OtherFrame in Frame.Parent:GetChildren() do
			if OtherFrame:IsA("Frame") and OtherFrame.Visible then
				OtherFrame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.1, true)
				task.wait(0.04)
				OtherFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end

		--// Open frame

		Frame.Size = Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.1)
		Frame.Visible = true
		Frame:TweenSize(Size, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		BlurAnimation(0.4)
	else
		--// Close the frame

		BlurAnimation(1)
		Frame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		Frame.Visible = false
	end
end

return ButtonHandler

function SortInventory(SortTable, ObjectHolder)
	local TableToSort = SortTable ~= nil and SortTable or PetInventory -- so it can differentiate between trade and normal inventories

	table.sort(TableToSort, function(a,b)
		if not a or not b then return end

		if a.Multiplier ~= b.Multiplier then
			return a.Multiplier > b.Multiplier
		else
			return a.ID > b.ID
		end
	end)

	for Order,PetInfo in TableToSort do
		if not Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetInfo.ID) then
			table.remove(TableToSort, Order)
			continue
		end

		if not ObjectHolder then
			PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		else
			ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		end
	end
end

local CurrentlySelected = 0

function AddPet(PetInstance, SortTable, Parent) -- Creates a pet slot
	task.wait(0.1)
	local NewPet = script.PetTemplate:Clone()

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Parent = NewPet.Display

	local MainPart = PetModel:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	local Pos

	if not MainPart then
		warn(PetModel.Name.." does not have a MainPart, please add one by calling one of the parts 'MainPart'")

		for _,v in PetModel:GetChildren() do -- this here chooses a random part of the pet instead of the mainpart.
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				Pos = v.Position
				break
			end
		end
	else
		Pos = MainPart.Position
	end

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	NewPet.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

	if not Parent then -- normal pet
		NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

		PetInstance.Equipped.Changed:Connect(function()
			NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

			if CurrentlySelected == tonumber(PetInstance.Name) then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			end

			SortInventory()
		end)

		NewPet.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not IsMultiDeleting then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			else
				if not table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)) then
					table.insert(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = true
				else
					table.remove(SelectedForDelete, table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = false
				end
			end
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
	NewPet.Name = PetInstance.Name
	NewPet.Parent = Parent == nil and PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder or Parent

	if SortTable == nil then
		PetInventory[#PetInventory+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	else
		SortTable[#SortTable+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	end

	return NewPet
end

function UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance) -- PetInstance is the folder in Player.Pets

	SideFrame.Title.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
