-- ============================================
-- EMOTE STATE MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

local playerEmotes = {} -- [playerId] = {emoteId = true}
local emoteCooldowns = {} -- [playerId][emoteId] = lastUsedTime
local equippedEmotes = {} -- [playerId] = emoteId (for quick access)

-- ============================================
-- CORE FUNCTIONS
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.GetEmote(emoteId: string): Emote?
	return EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAllEmotes(): {Emote}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		table.insert(result, emote)
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEmotesByTier(tier: string): {Emote}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if emote.tier == tier then
			table.insert(result, emote)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEmotesForPlayer(playerId: number): {Emote}
	local owned = playerEmotes[playerId] or {}
	local result = {}
	for emoteId, _ in owned do
		local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
		if emote then table.insert(result, emote) end
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAvailableEmotes(): {Emote}
	-- Returns emotes that can be unlocked (not owned by anyone yet)
	-- In practice, this would filter by global unlock state
	return EmoteEngine.GetAllEmotes()
end

-- Ownership management
function EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	if not EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId] then return false end
	if not playerEmotes[playerId] then playerEmotes[playerId] = {} end
	playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] = true
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine.RevokeEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	if playerEmotes[playerId] then
		playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	return playerEmotes[playerId] and playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] == true
end

function EmoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(playerId: number): {string}
	local owned = playerEmotes[playerId] or {}
	local result = {}
	for emoteId, _ in owned do
		table.insert(result, emoteId)
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- COOLDOWN MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.IsOnCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return true end
	
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId]
	if not cooldowns then return false end
	
	local lastUsed = cooldowns[emoteId]
	if not lastUsed then return false end
	
	return os.clock() - lastUsed < emote.cooldown
end

function EmoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string): number
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return 0 end
	
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId]
	if not cooldowns then return 0 end
	
	local lastUsed = cooldowns[emoteId]
	if not lastUsed then return 0 end
	
	return math.max(0, emote.cooldown - (os.clock() - lastUsed))
end

function EmoteEngine.SetCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	if not emoteCooldowns[playerId] then emoteCooldowns[playerId] = {} end
	emoteCooldowns[playerId][emoteId] = os.clock()
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAllCooldowns(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	local result = {}
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId] or {}
	local now = os.clock()
	
	for emoteId, lastUsed in cooldowns do
		local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
		if emote then
			local remaining = math.max(0, emote.cooldown - (now - lastUsed))
			if remaining > 0 then
				result[emoteId] = remaining
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- EQUIPPED EMOTE (quick access)
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.SetEquipped(playerId: number, emoteId: string?): boolean
	if emoteId and not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	equippedEmotes[playerId] = emoteId
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEquipped(playerId: number): string?
	return equippedEmotes[playerId]
end

function EmoteEngine.UseEquipped(playerId: number): boolean
	local emoteId = equippedEmotes[playerId]
	if not emoteId then return false end
	return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, emoteId)
end

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE EXECUTION
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string, position: Vector3?): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return false end
	
	-- Check ownership
	if not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check cooldown
	if EmoteEngine.IsOnCooldown(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check if player has a pet equipped
	local playerObj = Players:GetPlayerById(playerId)
	if not playerObj or not EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(playerObj) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check anti-spam (max 3 emotes per 10 seconds)
	local recentCount = 0
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, lastUsed in pairs(emoteCooldowns[playerId] or {}) do
		if now - lastUsed < 10 then recentCount += 1 end
	end
	if recentCount >= 3 then return false end
	
	-- Set cooldown
	EmoteEngine.SetCooldown(playerId, emoteId)
	
	-- Trigger animation on server (replicates to nearby clients)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnServer(playerId, emoteId)
	else
		EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnClient(playerId, emoteId)
	end
	
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnServer(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerById(playerId)
	if not player then return end
	
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end
	
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return end
	
	-- Load and play animation
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then return end
	
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = emote.animationId
	animation.Priority = emote.animationPriority
	
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track:Play()
	
	-- Trigger visual and audio feedback for high-tier emotes
	if emote.tier == "Prestige" then
		local pet = EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player)
		if pet then
			-- Example values, these should be tuned based on design
			CameraEffects.Shake(8, 0.5, 30) -- Medium shake
			ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), 0.5) -- Gold flash
			AudioEffects.PlaySound("rbxassetid://Sound_Epic", 1.0, 1.0)
			VFXEffects.SpawnBurst(pet.Position, {particles = 50, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)})
		end
	end
	
	-- Stop after duration (if not looping)
	if emote.duration > 0 then
		task.delay(emote.duration, function()
			track:Stop()
		end)
	end
	
	-- Replicate to nearby clients via remote
	-- (In practice, use a RemoteEvent to fire clients in radius)
	
	-- Trigger VFX at pet position
	local pet = EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player)
	if pet then
		-- Fire client event for VFX
	end
end

function EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnClient(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	-- Client-side animation playback
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return end
	
	-- If local player, play on their character
	if playerId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
				if animator then
					local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
					animation.AnimationId = emote.animationId
					animation.Priority = emote.animationPriority
					local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
					track:Play()
					if emote.duration > 0 then
						task.delay(emote.duration, function() track:Stop() end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Play VFX at pet
	if position then
		-- Play VFX effects
	end
end

function EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player: Player): Model?
	-- Find player's equipped pet
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	if not playerPets then return nil end
	
	local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") == "Follow" then
			return pet
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- ============================================
-- CHAT TRIGGER PARSING
-- ============================================

local EMOTE_PREFIXES = {"/e ", "/emote ", "/em "}

function EmoteEngine.ParseChatMessage(message: string): string?
	message = message:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") -- trim
	
	for _, prefix in EMOTE_PREFIXES do
		if message:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
			local emoteName = message:sub(#prefix + 1):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			return emoteName
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(playerId: number, message: string): boolean
	local emoteName = EmoteEngine.ParseChatMessage(message)
	if not emoteName then return false end
	
	-- Try exact match first
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteName]
	if emote and EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteName) then
		return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, emoteName)
	end
	
	-- Try fuzzy match (partial)
	for id, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if id:find(emoteName, 1, true) and EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, id) then
			return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, id)
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

-- ============================================
-- UNLOCK CONDITIONS
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.CheckUnlockCondition(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return false end
	
	if emote.tier == "Starter" then return true end
	if emote.tier == "Shop" then
		if emote.gamepassId then
			-- Check gamepass ownership
			return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):UserOwnsGamepassAsync(Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId), emote.gamepassId)
		end
		return false
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Progression" then
		-- Check rebirth count from PlayerData
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId)
		if player then
			local rebirths = player.Data and player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirths.Value or 0
			local required = tonumber(emote.unlockCondition:match("%d+"))
			return required and rebirths >= required
		end
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Collection" then
		-- Check unique pet count
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId)
		if player then
			local uniquePets = 0
			local folder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
			if folder then
				for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
									if pet:GetAttribute("PetName") then uniquePets += 1 end
							end
						end
			local required = tonumber(emote.unlockCondition:match("%d+"))
			return required and uniquePets >= required
		end
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Event" then
		-- Check event participation flag
		return false -- Would check event participation data
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Prestige" then
		-- Check leaderboard rank or max rebirth
		return false
	end
	
	return false
end

function EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(playerId: number): {string}
	local granted = {}
	for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) and EmoteEngine.CheckUnlockCondition(playerId, emoteId) then
			EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(playerId, emoteId)
			table.insert(granted, emoteId)
		end
	end
	return granted
end

function EmoteEngine.PurchaseEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote or emote.tier ~= "Shop" then
		warn("Attempt to purchase non-shop emote: " .. tostring(emoteId))
		return false
	end
	
	local player = Players:GetPlayerById(playerId)
	if not player then return false end
	
	if emote.gamepassId then
		-- Prompt gamepass purchase
		local success = pcall(function()
			MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, emote.gamepassId)
		end)
		if not success then
			warn("Failed to prompt gamepass purchase for emote: " .. emoteId)
			return false
		end
		-- The actual granting will happen in the prompt's callback
		-- We'll need to listen for PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished
		return true
	else
		-- Prompt product purchase (Robux)
		if not emote.price then
			warn("Shop emote has no price: " .. emoteId)
			return false
		end
		local success = pcall(function()
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, emote.price)
		end)
		if not success then
			warn("Failed to prompt product purchase for emote: " .. emoteId)
			return false
		end
		-- The actual granting will happen in the prompt's callback
		-- We'll need to listen for PromptProductPurchaseFinished
		return true
	end
end


-- ============================================
-- EMOTE WHEEL (UI Helper)
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.GetEmoteWheelData(playerId: number): {{id: string, name: string, icon: string, cooldown: number, owned: boolean}}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		local owned = EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emote.id)
		local cd = EmoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(playerId, emote.id)
		table.insert(result, {
			id = emote.id,
			name = emote.name,
			icon = EmoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emote.id),
			cooldown = cd,
			owned = owned,
			equipped = equippedEmotes[playerId] == emote.id,
		})
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emoteId: string): string
	local icons = {
		wave = "👋", sit = "🪑", dance = "💃",
		flex = "💪", sleep = "😴", happy = "😄",
		royal = "🤴", spooky = "👻", festive = "🎉",
		winter = "❄️", halloween = "🎃", anniversary = "🎂",
		legend = "🏆", mythic = "🌟", cosmic = "🌌",
		vip = "👑", supporter = "❤️",
	}
	return icons[emoteId] or "✨"
end

-- ============================================
-- SERVER INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-grant starter emotes on join
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.wait(1)
		for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
			if emote.tier == "Starter" then
				EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
			end
		end
		EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(player.UserId)
	end)
	
	-- Chat listener
	Players.PlayerChatted:Connect(function(message, recipient)
		-- message is the Chat message object in newer Roblox
		local text = typeof(message) == "string" and message or message.Text
		local speaker = typeof(message) == "string" and recipient or message.TextSource
		if speaker then
			EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(speaker.UserId, text)
		end
	end)
	
	-- Assume there is a RemoteEvent named "Emote_Purchase" in ReplicatedStorage/Remotes
	local purchaseEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Emote_Purchase")
	purchaseEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, emoteId)
		EmoteEngine.PurchaseEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
	end)
	
	-- Handle emote purchase success
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, gamepassId, purchased)
		if not purchased then return end
		for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
			if emote.tier == "Shop" and emote.gamepassId == gamepassId then
				EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
				break
			end
		end
	end)
	
	MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, productId, purchased)
		if not purchased then return end
		for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
			if emote.tier == "Shop" and emote.price == productId then
				EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
				break
			end
		end
	end)
end

return EmoteEngine

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "EnemyHeadOverlay"
	billboard.Adornee = adornee
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 66)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 1.8, 3), 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 28
	billboard.Enabled = false
	billboard.Parent = enemy

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.Parent = billboard
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = root
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 3)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 18)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 230)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = root
	local state = title:Clone()
	state.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 21)
	state.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 16)
	state.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	state.TextSize = 12
	state.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
	state.Parent = root
	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 47)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 8)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 62, 75)
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = root
	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trackCorner.Parent = track
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "HealthFill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 120)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	local fillCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner2.Parent = fill
	overlays[enemy] = {billboard = billboard, title = title, state = state, fill = fill}
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function() overlays[enemy] = nil end)
end

local function updateOverlay(enemy, data)
	local entry = overlays[enemy]
	if not entry then makeOverlay(enemy) entry = overlays[enemy] end
	if not entry then return end
	local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local distance = main and rootPart and (main.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
	local health = math.max(0, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0)
	local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)
	local stateText = tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") or "Roaming")
	entry.billboard.Enabled = distance <= 28 and health > 0
	entry.title.Text = enemy.Name:gsub("PetEnemy_Player_%d+_", "ENEMY ")
	entry.state.Text = string.upper(stateText) .. (data and data.damage and "  -" .. tostring(data.damage) or "")
	entry.state.TextColor3 = stateText == "Attacking" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125) or Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
	entry.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
end

for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do makeOverlay(enemy) end
enemies.ChildAdded:Connect(function(enemy) task.defer(makeOverlay, enemy) end)

local selectedEnemy
local lastCombat = {}
combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local enemyName = data.enemy
	local enemy = enemyName and enemies:FindFirstChild(enemyName)
	if enemy then
		selectedEnemy = enemy
		lastCombat[enemy] = data
		updateOverlay(enemy, data)
		hud.Visible = true
		status.Text = string.upper(enemy.Name:gsub("PetEnemy_Player_%d+_", "ENEMY "))
		local stateText = tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") or "COMBAT")
		substatus.Text = string.upper(stateText) .. (data.damage and "  |  DAMAGE " .. tostring(data.damage) or "")
		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
		local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)
		bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
	end
end)

local updateTimer = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	updateTimer += deltaTime
	if updateTimer < 0.1 then return end
	updateTimer = 0
	for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") then updateOverlay(enemy, lastCombat[enemy]) end
	end
	if selectedEnemy and selectedEnemy.Parent then
		local main = selectedEnemy.PrimaryPart or selectedEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if main and rootPart and (main.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > 28 then hud.Visible = false end
	end
end)

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Short = require(script.Parent.Short)
local Module = {}

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

function CreatePopup(Type)
	if Player.Data.Settings.Popups.Value then
		local NewPopup = RS.Assets.Templates[Type]:Clone()
		NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.1,0)
		NewPopup.Visible = true
		NewPopup.Parent = Player.PlayerGui.Interface.HUD.Popups
		return NewPopup
	end
	
	return
end

function PlayAnimation(Popup, Time)
	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

function Module.CreateBottomStatPopup(Amount, Stat, Colors, Time)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

--!strict
-- DailyRewardsClient.local.luau
-- Daily login reward UI. Builds its ScreenGui programmatically,
-- auto-opens when a reward is claimable, shows streak progress and
-- a live countdown while on cooldown. All authority lives on the server.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

repeat
	task.wait(0.2)
until player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and player.Loaded.Value or player.Parent == nil
if player.Parent == nil then
	return
end

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local Utilities = require(Modules.Utilities)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local GetStateRemote = Remotes:WaitForChild("DailyReward_GetState") :: RemoteFunction
local ClaimRemote = Remotes:WaitForChild("DailyReward_Claim") :: RemoteEvent

local Short = Utilities.Short

local function playSound(name: string)
	local sounds = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	if not sounds then
		return
	end
	local folder = sounds:FindFirstChild("Sounds")
	local sound = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if sound then
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio(name)
	end
end

--// Theme

local COLORS = {
	Background = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38),
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 54),
	TileClaimed = Color3.fromRGB(52, 52, 68),

	TextPrimary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 190),
	Gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 201, 77),
	Gem = Color3.fromRGB(96, 220, 255),
	ClaimButton = Color3.fromRGB(76, 200, 100),
	Disabled = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105),
}

--// GUI construction

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DailyRewardsGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 50
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

mainFrame.Visible = false
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

title.Parent = mainFrame

local streakLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

streakLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.06)
streakLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
streakLabel.Text = ""
streakLabel.TextScaled = true
streakLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.TextDim
streakLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- Statistics Panel
local statsPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
statsPanel.Name = "StatsPanel"
statsPanel.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Panel
statsPanel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.73)
statsPanel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.14)

local statsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local statsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

statsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
statsLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

-- Create stat items
local function createStatItem(name: string, iconText: string): TextLabel
	local statFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

	statFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

end

local longestStreakLabel = createStatItem("LongestStreak", "🔥 Longest")
local totalClaimedLabel = createStatItem("TotalClaimed", "✓ Total")
local totalGoldLabel = createStatItem("TotalGold", "💰 Gold")
local totalGemsLabel = createStatItem("TotalGems", "💎 Gems")

local tileContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
tileContainer.Name = "Tiles"
tileContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tileContainer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.31)

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.CellSize = UDim2.fromScale(0.125, 1)
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0)
grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
grid.Parent = tileContainer

local claimButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
claimButton.Name = "ClaimButton"
claimButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
claimButton.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.93)
claimButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.13)
claimButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.ClaimButton
claimButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
claimButton.Text = "CLAIM"
claimButton.TextScaled = true
claimButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.TextPrimary
claimButton.AutoButtonColor = false
claimButton.Parent = mainFrame

local claimCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
claimCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
claimCorner.Parent = claimButton

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "CloseButton"
closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 78)
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.TextScaled = true
closeButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.TextPrimary
closeButton.AutoButtonColor = false
closeButton.Parent = mainFrame

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
closeCorner.Parent = closeButton

--// Tile management

type Tile = {
	Day: number,
	Frame: TextButton,
	RewardLabel: TextLabel,
	CheckLabel: TextLabel,
	Stroke: UIStroke,
}

local tiles: {[number]: Tile} = {}

for day = 1, 7 do
	local tileButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	tileButton.Name = "Day" .. day
	tileButton.LayoutOrder = day
	tileButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.TileFuture
	tileButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	tileButton.Text = ""
	tileButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	tileButton.Parent = tileContainer

	local tileCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	tileCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	tileCorner.Parent = tileButton

	local tileStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	tileStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 92)
	tileStroke.Thickness = 2
	tileStroke.Transparency = 1
	tileStroke.Parent = tileButton

	local dayLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	dayLabel.Name = "DayLabel"
	dayLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dayLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.16)
	dayLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dayLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.28)
	dayLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	dayLabel.Text = "Day " .. day
	dayLabel.TextScaled = true
	dayLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.TextPrimary
	dayLabel.Parent = tileButton

	local rewardLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	rewardLabel.Name = "RewardLabel"
	rewardLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rewardLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58)
	rewardLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	rewardLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.4)
	rewardLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	rewardLabel.Text = ""
	rewardLabel.TextWrapped = true
	rewardLabel.TextScaled = true
	rewardLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.TextDim
	rewardLabel.Parent = tileButton

	local checkLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	checkLabel.Name = "Check"
	checkLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	checkLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	checkLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.04)
	checkLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.22)
	checkLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	checkLabel.Text = "✓"
	checkLabel.TextScaled = true
	checkLabel.Visible = false
	checkLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.ClaimButton
	checkLabel.ZIndex = 2
	checkLabel.Parent = tileButton

	tiles[day] = {
		Day = day,
		Frame = tileButton,
		RewardLabel = rewardLabel,
		CheckLabel = checkLabel,
		Stroke = tileStroke,
	}
end

local function formatRewardLine(reward: any): string
	local parts = {}
	if reward.Currency > 0 then
		table.insert(parts, Short.en(reward.Currency) .. " Gold")
	end
	if reward.Currency2 > 0 then
		table.insert(parts, Short.en(reward.Currency2) .. " Gems")
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "\n")
end

local function setTileState(tile: Tile, state: string)
	local frame = tile.Frame

	if state == "claimed" then
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.TileClaimed
		tile.Stroke.Transparency = 1
		tile.CheckLabel.Visible = true
	elseif state == "current" then
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Panel
		tile.Stroke.Color = COLORS.TileCurrent
		tile.Stroke.Transparency = 0
		tile.CheckLabel.Visible = false
	elseif state == "upcoming" then
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Panel
		tile.Stroke.Color = COLORS.TileCurrent
		tile.Stroke.Transparency = 0.5
		tile.CheckLabel.Visible = false
	else
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.TileFuture
		tile.Stroke.Transparency = 1
		tile.CheckLabel.Visible = false
	end
end

--// State handling

local currentState: any? = nil
local countdownEnd = 0
local isOpen = false
local pulseTween: Tween? = nil

local function stopPulse()
	if pulseTween then
		pulseTween:Cancel()
		pulseTween = nil
	end
end

local function refresh(newPulseOnOpen: boolean?)
	if not currentState then
		return
	end

	local cycleLength = currentState.cycleLength

	for day = 1, cycleLength do
		local tile = tiles[day]
		tile.RewardLabel.Text = formatRewardLine(currentState.rewards[day])

		local state = "future"
		if currentState.canClaim and day == currentState.nextDay then
			state = "current"
		elseif not currentState.canClaim and day == currentState.nextDay then
			state = "upcoming"
		end
		setTileState(tile, state)
	end

	if currentState.lastClaimedDay then
		setTileState(tiles[currentState.lastClaimedDay], "claimed")
	end

	streakLabel.Text = ("Streak: %d Day%s"):format(currentState.streak, currentState.streak == 1 and "" or "s")

	-- Update statistics display
	longestStreakLabel.Text = ("🔥 Longest\n%d"):format(currentState.longestStreak or 0)
	totalClaimedLabel.Text = ("✓ Total\n%d"):format(currentState.totalClaimed or 0)
	totalGoldLabel.Text = ("💰 Gold\n%s"):format(Short.en(currentState.totalGoldEarned or 0))
	totalGemsLabel.Text = ("💎 Gems\n%s"):format(Short.en(currentState.totalGemsEarned or 0))

	stopPulse()

	if currentState.canClaim then
		countdownEnd = 0
		claimButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.ClaimButton
		claimButton.Text = "CLAIM DAY " .. currentState.nextDay
		claimButton.Active = true
		if newPulseOnOpen then
			pulseTween = TweenService:Create(claimButton, TweenInfo.new(
				0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
				{BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 230, 130)})
			pulseTween:Play()
		end
	else
		claimButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Disabled
		claimButton.Active = false
		countdownEnd = os.clock() + currentState.timeUntilClaim
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if isOpen and currentState and not currentState.canClaim and countdownEnd > 0 then
			local remaining = math.max(0, countdownEnd - os.clock())
			local hours = math.floor(remaining / 3600)
			local minutes = math.floor((remaining % 3600) / 60)
			local seconds = math.floor(remaining % 60)
			claimButton.Text = ("Ready in %02d:%02d:%02d"):format(hours, minutes, seconds)

			if remaining <= 0 then
				local ok, state = pcall(function()
					return GetStateRemote:InvokeServer()
				end)
				if ok and state then
					currentState = state
					refresh(true)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

--// Open / Close

local function open()
	isOpen = true
	mainFrame.Visible = true
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.5)}):Play()
	playSound("Click")
end

local function close()
	isOpen = false
	stopPulse()
	mainFrame.Visible = false
end

claimButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if not currentState or not currentState.canClaim or not claimButton.Active then
		return
	end

	claimButton.Active = false
	playSound("Click")
	ClaimRemote:FireServer()
end)

ClaimRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(success, dayOrReason, reward)
	if success then
		playSound("LevelUp")

		-- Celebration animation for the claimed tile
		local claimedTile = tiles[dayOrReason]
		if claimedTile then
			-- Scale up animation
			local originalSize = claimedTile.Frame.Size
			TweenService:Create(claimedTile.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 1.2)}):Play()
			task.wait(0.3)
			TweenService:Create(claimedTile.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
				{Size = originalSize}):Play()

			-- Flash effect
			local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
			flash.Name = "Flash"
			flash.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Gold
			flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
			flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			flash.ZIndex = 10
			flash.Parent = claimedTile.Frame

			local flashCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			flashCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
			flashCorner.Parent = flash

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

				Hit = true

		end)

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Cooldowns = {}

--// Script

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false

	local PetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	PetFolder.Name = Player.Name
	PetFolder.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets

	repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	-- Reset all pets to unequipped state before loading equipped ones
	local PlayerDataPets = Player.Data.Pets
	for _, PetInstance in PlayerDataPets:GetChildren() do
		if PetInstance:IsA("Folder") and PetInstance:FindFirstChild("Equipped") then
			PetInstance.Equipped.Value = false
		end
	end

	LoadEquipped(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
	-- Unequip all pets when player leaves so they can re-equip on rejoin
	UnequipAll(Player)
	workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:Destroy()
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
end)

-- Clicker
Remotes.Clicker.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Clicker" then return end

	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Music
Remotes.Setting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, SettingName, Toggled)
	Player.Data.PlayerData[SettingName].Value = Toggled
end)

-- Rebirth
function Rebirth(Player) -- this will run the action when you passed all requirements for rebirthing
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = 0
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += 1
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += 10 -- gems
end

Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true	
		if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1) then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		else
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1.25) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Pet
function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", Player.UserId)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetName", PetInstance.PetName.Value)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			local character = Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then NewPet:PivotTo(root.CFrame) end
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already equipped
	if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player) <= Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value then return end -- Too many pets equipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = true
	PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, Pet)
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet or not Pet:IsDescendantOf(Player.Data.Pets) then return end
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipAll(Player)
	local pets = Player:FindFirstChild("Data") and Player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not pets then return end
	for _, Pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet:IsA("Folder") or Pet:IsA("Configuration") then
			UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
		end
	end
	LoadEquipped(Player)
end

function EquipAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for equipping a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	else
		EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	end
end

function DeleteAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for deleting a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then UnequipPet(Player, Pet) end -- unequip if it's equipped
	Pet:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Pet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Action, Parameter)
	if Action == "UnequipAll" then
		UnequipAll(Player)
		return
	end
	if type(Parameter) ~= "table" then -- so if this condition is true, then Parameter should be the id of the pet
		local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[Parameter]

		if Action == "Equip" then
			EquipAction(Player, Pet)
		elseif Action == "Delete" then
			DeleteAction(Player, Pet)
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	else -- there are multiple ids
		if Action == "Equip" then -- equip all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				EquipAction(Player, Pet)
			end

		elseif Action == "Delete" then -- delete all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				DeleteAction(Player, Pet)				
			end
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	end
end)

-- Egg
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

function ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

	for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
	end

	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
		return a[2] > b[2]
	end)

	local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

	for _,v in Pets do
		local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
		TotalWeight += Chance
		v[2] = Chance
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0,TotalWeight)

	local Counter = 0
	for _,v in Pets do	
		Counter += v[2]

		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v[1]
		end
	end
end

Remotes.Egg.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Egg, Amount)
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then return end -- cooldown
	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + Amount > Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player) then return end -- max storage

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)

	if not EggInfo then print(Egg.." does not exist!") return end -- egg does not exist!
	if EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then return end -- robux egg

	if Amount == 3 and ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then
		return -- if this is true, it means the player is trying to open a triple egg while there is a gamepass which they don't own
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount
		Player.Data.PlayerData.EggsHatched.Value += Amount
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true

		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()

		local Results = {}

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for i = 1, Amount do
			local PetName = ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier) 

			if not Player.Data.AutoDelete[PetName].Value then -- auto delete
				local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
				NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
				NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
			end

			Results[i] = PetName
		end

		return Results
	end
end

--// Auto Delete
Remotes.AutoDelete.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Pet)
	Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value = not Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
	return Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
end

--// Area
Remotes.Area.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == true then return end
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end)()

	local NextArea = ReplicatedStorage.Areas:FindFirstChild(Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1)
	if not NextArea then return end


	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value < NextArea.Cost.Value then return end

	if NextArea.Cost.Value == -1 then return end -- max area

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= NextArea.Cost.Value
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = tonumber(NextArea.Name)
end)

--// Gemshop
Remotes.GemUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Upgrade)
	if not ReplicatedStorage.GemShop:FindFirstChild(Upgrade) then return end

	local GemUpg = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop[Upgrade]
	local UpgradeTier = Player.Data.PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..Upgrade]

	if UpgradeTier.Value >= GemUpg.Max.Value then return end -- max

	local Cost = GemUpg.Price
	local Price

	if Cost.Exponential.Value then
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value * Cost.IncreasePer.Value ^ UpgradeTier.Value
	else
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value + Cost.IncreasePer.Value * (UpgradeTier.Value+1)
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value >= Price then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Price
		UpgradeTier.Value += 1
	end
end)

		Connection:Disconnect()
	end)

--!strict
-- TalentPanel.lua
-- Pet talent inspection and re-roll UI

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TalentPanel = {}
TalentPanel.__index = TalentPanel

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local TalentEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine)

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	width = 400,
	height = 500,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
}

function TalentPanel.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, TalentPanel)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.gui = nil
	self.currentPet = nil
	self.slotFrames = {}
	return self
end

function TalentPanel:_createGui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "TalentPanel"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 220
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.width, self.config.height)
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 18, 28)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

	corner.Parent = panel

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0.3
	stroke.Parent = panel

	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	panelScale.Scale = 0.85
	panelScale.Parent = panel

	local function tweenOpen()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	end

	local function tweenClose()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.85}):Play()
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then tweenOpen() else tweenClose() end
	end)

	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame")
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
	header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	header.BorderSizePixel = 0
	header.Parent = panel

	local headerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	headerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	headerCorner.Parent = header

	local headerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	headerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	headerStroke.Thickness = 1
	headerStroke.Transparency = 0.3
	headerStroke.Parent = header

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 16
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.Parent = header

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Close()
	end)

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "PET TALENTS"
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 20
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = header

	-- Talent slots container
	local slotsContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
	slotsContainer.Name = "SlotsContainer"
	slotsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -80)
	slotsContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	slotsContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	slotsContainer.Parent = panel

	local slotsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	slotsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 16)
	slotsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	slotsLayout.Parent = slotsContainer

	self.panel = panel
	self.panelScale = panelScale
	self.slotsContainer = slotsContainer
	self.gui = gui
end

function TalentPanel:Open(petData)
	if not self.gui then self:_createGui() end
	
	self.currentPet = petData
	self.panel.Visible = true
	self:_renderTalents(petData)
end

function TalentPanel:_renderTalents(petData)
	for _, child in self.slotsContainer:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	self.slotFrames = {}

	local talents = petData.Talents or {}
	
	for slotIndex, slot in ipairs(talents) do
		local talent = TalentEngine.GetTalent(slot.id)
		local frame = self:_createTalentSlot(slotIndex, talent, slot)
		frame.Parent = self.slotsContainer
		self.slotFrames[slotIndex] = frame
	end

	-- Reroll info
	if #talents > 0 then
		local infoFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		infoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		infoFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoFrame.Parent = self.slotsContainer

		local infoText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		infoText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		infoText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoText.Text = "Select a slot to re-roll • Locked slots cannot be re-rolled"
		infoText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		infoText.TextSize = 12

	local lockCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

	-- Reroll button

	rerollBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 32)

	local rerollCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	rerollCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	rerollCorner.Parent = rerollBtn

	if slot.locked then
		rerollBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
		rerollBtn.Text = "LOCKED"
	end

	rerollBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if slot.locked then return end
		self:_requestReroll(slotIndex)
	end)

	-- Reroll cost label
	local cost = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine.GetRerollCost(petData, slotIndex, petData.Rarity or "Common")
	local costLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	costLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 20)
	costLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, -22)
	costLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	costLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	costLabel.Text = "Cost: " .. cost .. " 💎"
	costLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	costLabel.TextSize = 11
	costLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100)
	costLabel.Parent = frame

	return frame
end

function TalentPanel:_getCategoryIcon(category: string): string
	local icons = {
		Hatching = "🥚",
		Combat = "⚔️",
		Movement = "🏃",
		Economy = "💰",
		Utility = "🔧",
	}
	return icons[category] or "✨"
end

function TalentPanel:_requestReroll(slotIndex)
	if not self.currentPet then return end
	
	-- In practice, fire server remote
	local result = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine.RerollTalent(
		self.currentPet, slotIndex, self.currentPet.Rarity or "Common"
	)
	
	if result.success and result.newTalentId then
		-- Update local data
		self.currentPet.Talents[slotIndex].id = result.newTalentId
		self.currentPet.Talents[slotIndex].locked = false
		self:_renderTalents(self.currentPet)
	else
		-- Show error
	end
end

function TalentPanel:Close()
	if self.panel then
		self.panel.Visible = false
	end
end

function TalentPanel:Show(petData)
	if not self.gui then self:_createGui() end
	self:Open(petData)
end

function TalentPanel:Destroy()
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return TalentPanel

--!nonstrict
local ROOT_ALIAS = "root"

local function parsePath(pathStr)
	local pathArray = string.split(pathStr, "/")
	for idx = #pathArray, 1, -1 do
		if pathArray[idx] == "" then
			table.remove(pathArray, idx)
		end
	end
	return pathArray
end

local function isManifestResolved(resolvedManifest, manifestSizeTarget)
	local manifestSize = 0
	for _ in pairs(resolvedManifest) do
		manifestSize += 1
	end

	assert(manifestSize <= manifestSizeTarget, manifestSize)
	return manifestSize == manifestSizeTarget
end

local function unbindNodeDescend(node, resolvedManifest)
	if node.instance == nil then
		return -- Do not try to unbind nodes that are already unbound
	end

	node.instance = nil

	local connections = node.connections
	if connections then
		for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(connections)
	end

	if resolvedManifest and node.alias then
		resolvedManifest[node.alias] = nil
	end

	local children = node.children
	if children then
		for _, childNode in pairs(children) do
			unbindNodeDescend(childNode, resolvedManifest)
		end
	end
end

local AtomicBinding = {}
AtomicBinding.__index = AtomicBinding

function AtomicBinding.new(manifest, boundFn)
	local dtorMap = {} -- { [root] -> dtor }
	local connections = {} -- { Connection, ... }
	local rootInstToRootNode = {} -- { [root] -> rootNode }
	local rootInstToManifest = {} -- { [root] -> { [alias] -> instance } }

	local parsedManifest = {} -- { [alias] = {Name, ...} }
	local manifestSizeTarget = 1 -- Add 1 because root isn't explicitly on the manifest	
	
	for alias, rawPath in pairs(manifest) do
		parsedManifest[alias] = parsePath(rawPath)
		manifestSizeTarget += 1
	end

	return setmetatable({
		_boundFn = boundFn,
		_parsedManifest = parsedManifest,
		_manifestSizeTarget = manifestSizeTarget,
		
		_dtorMap = dtorMap,
		_connections = connections,
		_rootInstToRootNode = rootInstToRootNode,
		_rootInstToManifest = rootInstToManifest,
	}, AtomicBinding)
end

function AtomicBinding:_startBoundFn(root, resolvedManifest)
	local boundFn = self._boundFn
	local dtorMap = self._dtorMap
	
	local oldDtor = dtorMap[root]
	if oldDtor then
		oldDtor()
		dtorMap[root] = nil
	end

	local dtor = boundFn(resolvedManifest)
	if dtor then
		dtorMap[root] = dtor
	end
end

function AtomicBinding:_stopBoundFn(root)
	local dtorMap = self._dtorMap
	
	local dtor = dtorMap[root]
	if dtor then
		dtor()
		dtorMap[root] = nil
	end
end

function AtomicBinding:bindRoot(root)
	debug.profilebegin("AtomicBinding:BindRoot")
	
	local parsedManifest = self._parsedManifest
	local rootInstToRootNode = self._rootInstToRootNode
	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	local manifestSizeTarget = self._manifestSizeTarget
	
	assert(rootInstToManifest[root] == nil)

	local resolvedManifest = {}
	rootInstToManifest[root] = resolvedManifest

	debug.profilebegin("BuildTree")

	local rootNode = {}
	rootNode.alias = ROOT_ALIAS
	rootNode.instance = root
	if next(parsedManifest) then
		-- No need to assign child data if there are no children
		rootNode.children = {}
		rootNode.connections = {}
	end

	rootInstToRootNode[root] = rootNode

	for alias, parsedPath in pairs(parsedManifest) do
		local parentNode = rootNode

		for idx, childName in ipairs(parsedPath) do
			local leaf = idx == #parsedPath
			local childNode = parentNode.children[childName] or {}

			if leaf then
				if childNode.alias ~= nil then
					error("Multiple aliases assigned to one instance")
				end

				childNode.alias = alias

			else
				childNode.children = childNode.children or {}
				childNode.connections = childNode.connections or {}
			end

			parentNode.children[childName] = childNode
			parentNode = childNode
		end
	end

	debug.profileend() -- BuildTree

	-- Recursively descend into the tree, resolving each node.
	-- Nodes start out as empty and instance-less; the resolving process discovers instances to map to nodes.
	local function processNode(node)
		local instance = assert(node.instance)

		local children = node.children
		local alias = node.alias
		local isLeaf = not children

		if alias then
			resolvedManifest[alias] = instance
		end

		if not isLeaf then
			local function processAddChild(childInstance)
				local childName = childInstance.Name
				local childNode = children[childName]
				if not childNode or childNode.instance ~= nil then
					return
				end

				childNode.instance = childInstance
				processNode(childNode)
			end

			local function processDeleteChild(childInstance)
				-- Instance deletion - Parent A detects that child B is being removed
				--    1. A removes B from `children`
				--    2. A traverses down from B,
				--       i.  Disconnecting inputs
				--       ii. Removing nodes from the resolved manifest
				--    3. stopBoundFn is called because we know the tree is no longer complete, or at least has to be refreshed
				-- 	  4. We search A for a replacement for B, and attempt to re-resolve using that replacement if it exists.
				-- To support the above sanely, processAddChild needs to avoid resolving nodes that are already resolved.

				local childName = childInstance.Name
				local childNode = children[childName]

				if not childNode then
					return -- There's no child node corresponding to the deleted instance, ignore
				end

				if childNode.instance ~= childInstance then
					return -- A child was removed with the same name as a node instance, ignore
				end

				self:_stopBoundFn(root) -- Happens before the tree is unbound so the manifest is still valid in the destructor.
				unbindNodeDescend(childNode, resolvedManifest) -- Unbind the tree

				assert(childNode.instance == nil) -- If this triggers, unbindNodeDescend failed

				-- Search for a replacement
				local replacementChild = instance:FindFirstChild(childName)
				if replacementChild then
					processAddChild(replacementChild)
				end
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				processAddChild(child)
			end

			table.insert(node.connections, instance.ChildAdded:Connect(processAddChild))
			table.insert(node.connections, instance.ChildRemoved:Connect(processDeleteChild))
		end

		if isLeaf and isManifestResolved(resolvedManifest, manifestSizeTarget) then
			self:_startBoundFn(root, resolvedManifest)
		end
	end

	debug.profilebegin("ResolveTree")
	processNode(rootNode)
	debug.profileend() -- ResolveTree
	
	debug.profileend() -- AtomicBinding:BindRoot
end

function AtomicBinding:unbindRoot(root)
	local rootInstToRootNode = self._rootInstToRootNode
	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	
	self:_stopBoundFn(root)

	local rootNode = rootInstToRootNode[root]
	if rootNode then
		local resolvedManifest = assert(rootInstToManifest[root])
		unbindNodeDescend(rootNode, resolvedManifest)
		rootInstToRootNode[root] = nil
	end

	rootInstToManifest[root] = nil
end

function AtomicBinding:destroy()
	debug.profilebegin("AtomicBinding:destroy")

	for _, dtor in pairs(self._dtorMap) do
		dtor:destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self._dtorMap)

	for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)

	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	for rootInst, rootNode in pairs(self._rootInstToRootNode) do
		local resolvedManifest = assert(rootInstToManifest[rootInst])
		unbindNodeDescend(rootNode, resolvedManifest)
	end
	table.clear(self._rootInstToManifest)
	table.clear(self._rootInstToRootNode)

	debug.profileend()
end

return AtomicBinding

--!strict
--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

--// Configuration
local CONFIG = {
	DEFAULT_FLY_SPEED = 60,
	MAX_FLY_SPEED = 200,
	MIN_FLY_SPEED = 10,
	-- Set to true if only admins can fly (checks ServerScriptService.AdminDashboard or AdminHandler)
	ADMINS_ONLY = false,
	ADMIN_USER_IDS = {
		[game.CreatorId] = true,
	},
}

--// Remotes Setup
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if not remotesFolder then
	remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotesFolder.Name = "Remotes"
	remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local flightRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("FlightRemote") :: RemoteEvent
if not flightRemote then
	flightRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	flightRemote.Name = "FlightRemote"
	flightRemote.Parent = remotesFolder
end

--// Active Flight Registry: [UserId] -> { isFlying: boolean, speed: number }
local flightRegistry: { [number]: { isFlying: boolean, speed: number } } = {}

--// Permission Validator
local function canPlayerFly(player: Player): boolean
	if not CONFIG.ADMINS_ONLY then
		return true
	end
	if CONFIG.ADMIN_USER_IDS[player.UserId] then
		return true
	end
	-- Check existing AdminHandler module if present in project
	local adminHandler = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("AdminHandler")
	if adminHandler then
		local ok, adminModule = pcall(require, adminHandler:FindFirstChild("AdminFunctions") :: any)
		if ok and type(adminModule) == "table" and type(adminModule.IsPlayerAdmin) == "function" then
			return adminModule.IsPlayerAdmin(player)
		end
	end
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or player:GetRankInGroup(0) >= 254
end

--// Toggle Flight Logic
local function setFlightState(player: Player, enabled: boolean, speed: number?)
	if enabled and not canPlayerFly(player) then
		warn(string.format("[FlightServer] Unauthorized flight attempt by %s (%d)", player.Name, player.UserId))
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not humanoid or not rootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

	local targetSpeed = math.clamp(speed or CONFIG.DEFAULT_FLY_SPEED, CONFIG.MIN_FLY_SPEED, CONFIG.MAX_FLY_SPEED)

	flightRegistry[player.UserId] = {
		isFlying = enabled,
		speed = targetSpeed,
	}

	character:SetAttribute("IsFlying", enabled)
	character:SetAttribute("FlySpeed", targetSpeed)

	-- Inform client to initialize/destroy mover constraints
	flightRemote:FireClient(player, "ToggleFlight", enabled, targetSpeed)
end

--// Remote Event Handler (Client requests toggle or speed change)
flightRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: string, ...: any)
	if action == "RequestToggle" then
		local current = flightRegistry[player.UserId]
		local isCurrentlyFlying = current and current.isFlying or false
		setFlightState(player, not isCurrentlyFlying)
	elseif action == "SetSpeed" then
		local newSpeed = select(1, ...)
		if typeof(newSpeed) == "number" and flightRegistry[player.UserId] and flightRegistry[player.UserId].isFlying then
			setFlightState(player, true, newSpeed)
		end
	end
end)

--// Chat Command Handlers
local function parseCommandText(message: string): (string, number?)
	local tokens = string.split(string.lower(message), " ")
	local cmd = tokens[1] or ""
	local speed = tokens[2] and tonumber(tokens[2]) or nil
	return cmd, speed
end

local function handleChatMessage(player: Player, message: string)
	local cmd, requestedSpeed = parseCommandText(message)
	if cmd == "/fly" or cmd == ":fly" or cmd == "!fly" then
		setFlightState(player, true, requestedSpeed)
	elseif cmd == "/unfly" or cmd == ":unfly" or cmd == "!unfly" then
		setFlightState(player, false)
	end
end

-- Modern TextChatService binding
if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
	local textCommands = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChatCommands")
	if not textCommands then
		textCommands = Instance.new("Folder")
		textCommands.Name = "TextChatCommands"
		textCommands.Parent = TextChatService
	end

	local flyCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	flyCommand.Name = "FlyCommand"
	flyCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/fly"
	flyCommand.SecondaryAlias = ":fly"
	flyCommand.Parent = textCommands
	flyCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource: TextSource, rawText: string)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if player then
			handleChatMessage(player, rawText)
		end
	end)

	local unflyCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	unflyCommand.Name = "UnflyCommand"
	unflyCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/unfly"
	unflyCommand.SecondaryAlias = ":unfly"
	unflyCommand.Parent = textCommands
	unflyCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource: TextSource, rawText: string)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if player then
			handleChatMessage(player, rawText)
		end
	end)
end

-- Player Lifecycle Cleanups
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(msg: string)
		handleChatMessage(player, msg)
	end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char: Model)
		flightRegistry[player.UserId] = { isFlying = false, speed = CONFIG.DEFAULT_FLY_SPEED }
		char:SetAttribute("IsFlying", false)
		char:SetAttribute("FlySpeed", CONFIG.DEFAULT_FLY_SPEED)
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	flightRegistry[player.UserId] = nil
end)

print("[FlightSystem] Server Flight Controller initialized with modern TextChatService bindings.")

--!strict
-- CameraEffects.lua
-- Camera shake, punch zoom, orbit, slow-motion effects

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local CameraEffects = {}
CameraEffects.__index = CameraEffects

local activeEffects = {}
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local connection = nil

-- Noise generator for shake
local function perlinNoise(x: number, y: number): number
	local n = bit32.bxor(bit32.lshift(x, 16), y)
	n = bit32.bxor(n, bit32.rshift(n, 13))
	n = (n * (n * n * 60493 + 19990303) + 1376312589) % 2147483648
	return (n / 2147483648) * 2 - 1
end

local function getNoise(t: number): Vector2
	return Vector2.new(perlinNoise(math.floor(t * 100), 0), perlinNoise(0, math.floor(t * 100)))
end

-- Start the update loop
local function ensureConnection()
	if connection then return end
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not camera then return end
		
		local totalOffset = Vector3.zero
		local totalFOVOffset = 0
		local timeScale = 1
		local now = os.clock()
		
		for _, effect in activeEffects do
			if now > effect.endTime then continue end
			
			local progress = (now - effect.startTime) / effect.duration
			local eased = 1 - (1 - progress) ^ 2 -- ease-out quad
			
			if effect.type == "shake" then
				local noise = getNoise(now * effect.frequency)
				local intensity = effect.intensity * (1 - eased)
				totalOffset += Vector3.new(noise.X, noise.Y, 0) * intensity
				
			elseif effect.type == "punch" then
				totalFOVOffset += effect.amount * (1 - eased)
				
			elseif effect.type == "slowmo" then
				timeScale = math.min(timeScale, effect.factor)
			end
		end
		
		-- Apply shake
		if totalOffset.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(totalOffset)
		end
		
		-- Apply FOV punch
		if totalFOVOffset ~= 0 then
			camera.FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView + totalFOVOffset
		end
		
		-- Clean up expired
		for i = #activeEffects, 1, -1 do
			if os.clock() > activeEffects[i].endTime then
				table.remove(activeEffects, i)
			end
		end
		
		if #activeEffects == 0 and connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
			connection = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Presets
local PRESETS = {
	Micro = { intensity = 2, duration = 0.1, frequency = 60 },
	Light = { intensity = 4, duration = 0.2, frequency = 40 },
	Medium = { intensity = 8, duration = 0.4, frequency = 30 },
	Heavy = { intensity = 16, duration = 0.6, frequency = 20 },
	Massive = { intensity = 24, duration = 1.0, frequency = 15 },
}

-- Public API
function CameraEffects.Shake(presetName: string?, custom: {intensity: number, duration: number, frequency: number}?)
	local preset = PRESETS[presetName or "Light"]
	local params = custom or preset
	ensureConnection()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "shake",
		startTime = os.clock(),
		duration = params.duration,
		intensity = params.intensity,
		frequency = params.frequency,
		endTime = os.clock() + params.duration,
	})
end

function CameraEffects.PunchZoom(amount: number, duration: number, easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?)
	ensureConnection()
	local startFOV = camera.FieldOfView
	local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		FieldOfView = startFOV + amount
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			FieldOfView = startFOV
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function CameraEffects.Orbit(center: Vector3, radius: number, duration: number)
	ensureConnection()
	local startTime = os.clock()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "orbit",
		startTime = startTime,
		duration = duration,
		center = center,
		radius = radius,
		endTime = startTime + duration,
		-- Orbit handled in RenderStepped would need more complex implementation
	})
end

function CameraEffects.SlowMotion(factor: number, duration: number)
	ensureConnection()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "slowmo",
		startTime = os.clock(),
		duration = duration,
		factor = factor,
		endTime = os.clock() + duration,
	})
end

function CameraEffects.StopAll()
	table.clear(activeEffects)
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
end

-- Effect presets for game moments
CameraEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Micro") end,
	LevelUp = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Light") end,
	EnemyHit = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Medium") end,
	BossDefeat = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Heavy") end,
	Rebirth = function() 
		CameraEffects.Shake("Massive")
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(10, 0.3)
	end,
	RareHatch = function()
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(-15, 0.3)
		task.wait(0.05)
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(15, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end,
}

return CameraEffects
