--!strict
-- NotificationSystem.lua
-- Centralized notification queue with deduplication, cross-server delivery, and UI

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local NotificationSystem = {}
NotificationSystem.__index = NotificationSystem

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Configuration
local NOTIFICATION_TYPES = {
	EggReady = { priority = "High", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	TradeReceived = { priority = "High", channel = "Modal", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = false },
	TradeAccepted = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 6 },
	TradeDeclined = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Error", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 6 },
	EventStarting = { priority = "High", channel = "Banner", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 10 },
	EventActive = { priority = "High", channel = "Banner", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = false },
	PetNeedsCritical = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Warning", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	LeaderboardMilestone = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	BuyOrderFilled = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	SnipingAlert = { priority = "High", channel = "Banner", sound = "Alert", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 12 },
	DailyRewardReady = { priority = "Low", channel = "Badge", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = false },
}

-- State
local notificationQueue = {}
local activeToasts = {}
local maxToasts = 3
local settings = {
	EggReady = true,
	TradeReceived = true,
	EventStarting = true,
	PetNeedsCritical = true,
	LeaderboardMilestone = true,
	BuyOrderFilled = true,
	SnipingAlert = true,
	DailyRewardReady = true,
	DoNotDisturb = false,
}

local pendingOffline = {}

-- GUI Setup
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "NotificationSystem"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 200
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

-- Toast Stack Container
local toastContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
toastContainer.Name = "ToastContainer"
toastContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 1, -20)
toastContainer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
toastContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
toastContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toastContainer.Parent = gui

local toastListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
toastListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
toastListLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
toastListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
toastListLayout.Parent = toastContainer

-- Banner Container
local bannerContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
bannerContainer.Name = "BannerContainer"
bannerContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
bannerContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
bannerContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
bannerContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bannerContainer.Parent = gui

-- Badge Container (on menu icons)
local badgeContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
badgeContainer.Name = "BadgeContainer"
badgeContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
badgeContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
badgeContainer.Parent = gui

-- Deduplication cache
local recentNotifications = {}
local DEDUP_WINDOW = 30 -- seconds

-- Cross-server messaging
local MESSAGING_TOPIC = "NotificationSystem"

-- Initialize messaging subscription
local function initMessaging()
	if RunService:IsServer() then return end
	
	task.spawn(function()
		local success, err = pcall(function()
			MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, function(message)
				local data = message.Data
				NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
			end)
		end)
		if not success then
			warn("NotificationSystem: Failed to subscribe to messaging:", err)
		end
	end)
end

-- Create toast UI
local function createToast(data)
	local template = Instance.new("Frame")
	template.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	template.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 70)
	template.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	template.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	template.BorderSizePixel = 0
	template.ClipsDescendants = true
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = template
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.4
	stroke.Parent = template
	
	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = template
	
	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 24)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = template
	
	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 32)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 12
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = template
	
	-- Progress bar for auto-dismiss
	if data.autoDismiss then
		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = template
		
		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = template
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		dismissToast(data.id)
	end)
	
	-- Swipe to dismiss
	local startX = 0
	template.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			startX = input.Position.X
		end
	end)
	
	template.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
			if deltaX > 80 then -- swiped right
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end
		end
	end)
	
	-- Entrance animation
	template.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(template, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	return template
end

local function dismissToast(id: string)
	local toast = toastContainer:FindFirstChild("Toast_" .. id)
	if toast then
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
		toast:Destroy()
		activeToasts[id] = nil
	end
end

-- Banner creation
local function createBanner(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Banner_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = bannerContainer
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Content similar to toast but wider
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = frame
	
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 28)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 12)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 18
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame
	
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 40)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 14
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 24)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 14
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
		frame:Destroy()
	end)
	
	-- Entrance
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -100)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			if frame.Parent then
				game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
				task.wait(0.3)
				frame:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Badge update
local function updateBadge(typeName, count)
	-- This would update badges on menu icons
	-- Implementation depends on your menu structure
end

-- Core send function
function NotificationSystem.Send(player, data)
	-- Server-side: publish to player's topic
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local message = {
			id = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),
			type = data.type,
			title = data.title,
			body = data.body,
			icon = data.icon,
			sound = data.sound,
			actions = data.actions,
			autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss,
			priority = data.priority,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		}
		
		-- Check deduplication
		local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
		if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
			return -- Suppressed duplicate
		end
		recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
		
		-- Check settings
		if not settings[data.type] then return end
		if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
		
		-- Publish
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, message)
		return
	end
	
	-- Client-side: receive from server
	NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
end

function NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
	-- Check deduplication
	local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
	if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
		return
	end
	recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
	
	-- Check settings
	if not settings[data.type] then return end
	if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
	
	-- Play sound
	if data.sound then
		local AudioEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AudioEffects)
		AudioEffects.PlayPreset(data.sound)
	end
	
	-- Create UI
	local typeConfig = NOTIFICATION_TYPES[data.type]
	local channel = data.channel or typeConfig.channel
	
	if channel == "Toast" then
		if #activeToasts >= maxToasts then
			-- Remove oldest
			local oldestId = next(activeToasts)
			if oldestId then dismissToast(oldestId) end
		end
		
		local toast = createToast(data)
		toast.Parent = toastContainer
		activeToasts[data.id] = toast
		
		if data.autoDismiss then
			task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end)
		end
		
	elseif channel == "Banner" then
		createBanner(data)
	elseif channel == "Modal" then
		-- Create modal dialog
		NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	elseif channel == "Badge" then
		updateBadge(data.type, 1)
	end
end

function NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Modal_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 32)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = gui
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Darken background
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	overlay.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex - 1
	overlay.Parent = gui
	
	-- Content
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.Parent = frame
	
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 16
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Action buttons
	if data.actions then
		for i, action in data.actions do
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 170, 180)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.Text = action.text
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 14
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			btn.Parent = frame
			
			local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnCorner.Parent = btn
			
			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if action.callback then action.callback() end
				overlay:Destroy()
				frame:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 18
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		overlay:Destroy()
		frame:Destroy()
	end)
	
	-- Entrance
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	}):Play()
end

-- Settings
function NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings(newSettings)
	for k, v in newSettings do
		settings[k] = v
	end
end

function NotificationSystem.GetSettings()
	return settings
end

-- Offline queue handling
function NotificationSystem.QueueOffline(playerId, data)
	if not pendingOffline[playerId] then
		pendingOffline[playerId] = {}
	end
	table.insert(pendingOffline[playerId], data)
end

function NotificationSystem.DeliverOffline(playerId)
	local queue = pendingOffline[playerId]
	if queue then
		for _, data in queue do
			NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
		end
		pendingOffline[playerId] = nil
	end
end

-- Initialize
initMessaging()

-- Cleanup old dedup entries periodically
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		local now = os.time()
		for key, timestamp in recentNotifications do
			if now - timestamp > DEDUP_WINDOW * 2 then
				recentNotifications[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

return NotificationSystem

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Variables
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Trading

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

local TradeOffers = {} -- table with trade offers of the players inside

Remotes.RequestTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Player has clicked on "Send Trade" button
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return "Player has not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "Player is in trade" end
	-- You can also add requirements here for trading, such as 250 eggs opened

	--// Make a button pop up in their ui
	Remotes.RequestTrade:InvokeClient(Player2, Player.Name)	
end

Remotes.StartTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Starting trade
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return end

	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true

	TradeOffers[Player.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}} -- creates the inventory during the trade
	TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}}

	Remotes.StartTrade:InvokeClient(Player2,Player.Name) -- player 2 knows the trade started
	return true
end

Remotes.ChangeOffer.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)
	
	if Args.OfferType == "Pet" then
		if not TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] then
			if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player2) <= #Player2.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + #TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets then return "Max" end
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = 1
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2,"PetAdded", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Added"
		else
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = nil
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "PetRemoved", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Removed"
		end
	elseif Args.OfferType == "TradeTokens" then
		if tonumber(Args.Amount) and tonumber(Args.Amount) >= 0 then
			if not Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then return end -- 
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < tonumber(Args.Amount) then return end -- not enough tokens

			TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens = tonumber(Args.Amount)
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "TradeTokens", tonumber(Args.Amount))
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		end
	end
end

Remotes.TradeAction.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		TradeOffers[Player.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data to free up space
		TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data, if the player left it does not matter as it should still be removed

		if Player2 then -- incase the player left, you dont edit the data. If they did not, edit the data
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Cancel"})
		end

		return true
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- makes player ready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = true

			if Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- both are ready
				local Active = true

				--// Countdown Timer
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				
				local function BothReady()
					return Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value and Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value
				end
				
				local function CancelCountdown()
					Active = false 
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
				end
				
				for i = 10, 1, -1 do
					if not BothReady() then 
						CancelCountdown()
						break 
					end
					task.wait(0.3)	
				end
				
				if not BothReady() then
					CancelCountdown()
				end
			
				if not Active then return end
				
				print("Completing Trade")
				CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
			else
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Ready"})
				return "Ready"
			end
		else --// unready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Unready"})
			return "Unready"
		end		
	end
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already unequipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			NewPet:PivotTo(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)			
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false

	--// Player 1 to Player 2
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player, ClonedPet)
		end
		
		ClonedPet.Parent = Player2.Data.Pets
	end

	--// Player 2 to Player 1
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player2.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player2.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player2, ClonedPet)
		end

		ClonedPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	
	LoadEquipped(Player)
	LoadEquipped(Player2)

	if Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then -- like gems or smth exist
		Player2.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens -- for example u get 400 u give 150
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens
	end
end

studioFiles.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")
local CombatFeedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Enemies = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies") or Instance.new("Folder")
Enemies.Name = "PetEnemies"
Enemies.Parent = Workspace
local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER = 6

local DEFAULTS = {
	EnemySpawnEnabled = true,
	EnemySpawnInterval = 6,
	EnemySpawnChance = 1,
	EnemyMaxCount = MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER,
	EnemySpawnMinDistance = 24,
	EnemySpawnMaxDistance = 34,
	EnemyHealth = 35,
	EnemyGoldMin = 10,
	EnemyGoldMax = 30,
}

local AREA_CONFIG = {
	Spawn = {Health = 35, Damage = 5, Speed = 4.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 92, 92)},
	Candy = {Health = 55, Damage = 7, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 190)},
	Tech = {Health = 80, Damage = 10, Speed = 6.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 255)},
	Desert = {Health = 100, Damage = 12, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 175, 75)},
	Ocean = {Health = 120, Damage = 14, Speed = 7, Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 170, 255)},
	Volcano = {Health = 160, Damage = 18, Speed = 6, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 35)},
	Winter = {Health = 140, Damage = 16, Speed = 5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)},
}

local cooldowns = {}
local scavenged = {}
local playerEnemies = {}
local lastSpawn = {}
local enemyAttackCooldowns = {}
local comboState = {}
local enemyMotion = {}
local enemyTemplateNames
local clientPetPositions = {}
local MOVEMENT_TICK = 1 / 60
local STEERING_RESPONSE = 12
local ROTATION_RESPONSE = 14
local ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 0.45
local ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION = 0.72

local function moveSmoothly(enemy, targetPosition, targetLookPosition, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
	local current = enemy:GetPivot()
	local currentPosition = current.Position
	local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPosition.X, currentPosition.Y, targetPosition.Z)
	local offset = flatTarget - currentPosition
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	local maxStep = speed * deltaTime
	local alpha = math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	local desiredVelocity = distance > 0.05 and offset.Unit * math.min(speed, distance / math.max(deltaTime, 0.001)) or Vector3.zero
	local currentVelocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	local velocity = typeof(currentVelocity) == "Vector3" and currentVelocity:Lerp(desiredVelocity, alpha) or desiredVelocity
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", velocity)
	local displacement = velocity * deltaTime
	if displacement.Magnitude > maxStep then displacement = displacement.Unit * maxStep end
	local nextPosition = currentPosition + displacement
	local groundY = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GroundY"))
	if groundY then nextPosition = Vector3.new(nextPosition.X, groundY, nextPosition.Z) end
	local jumpOffset = jumping and math.sin(math.clamp((os.clock() - (enemyMotion[enemy].jumpStart or os.clock())) / 0.55, 0, 1) * math.pi) * 1.4 or 0
	nextPosition += Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
	local lookPosition = Vector3.new(targetLookPosition.X, nextPosition.Y, targetLookPosition.Z)
	local lookDirection = lookPosition - nextPosition
	local targetCFrame = lookDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, lookPosition) or CFrame.new(nextPosition)
	local rotationAlpha = math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	enemy:PivotTo(current:Lerp(targetCFrame, rotationAlpha))
	return distance
end

local function stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
	local velocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	if typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local nextVelocity = velocity:Lerp(Vector3.zero, math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", nextVelocity)
end

local enemyTemplateNames = {"Mouse", "Bee", "Lizard", "Desert Mouse", "Ocean Dog", "Volcano Bunny", "Frozen Dog"}

local function tell(player, action, message, pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Mood") or nil,
		hunger = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Hunger") or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function combat(player, kind, data)
	data = data or {}
	data.kind = kind
	CombatFeedback:FireClient(player, data)
end

local function burst(position, color, count, scale)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = Workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.9
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(7, 16)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 20)
	Debris:AddItem(part, scale or 1)
end

local function ownerPet(player, petId)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= player.UserId then return end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not root or not main or (root.Position - main.Position).Magnitude > 22 then return end
	return pet
end

local function giveGold(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not currency then return false end
	currency.Value += amount
	return true
end

local function getEnemyNear(position, radius)
	local best, distance
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health"))
		if main and health and health > 0 then
			local current = (main.Position - position).Magnitude
			if current <= radius and (not distance or current < distance) then
				best, distance = enemy, current
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getActivePet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local best
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") ~= "Stop" and (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) > 0 then
				best = pet
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getPetMain(pet)
	local main = pet and (pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
	return main and main:IsA("BasePart") and main or nil
end

local function hitboxParts(cframe, size, excluded)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, params)
end

local function attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then return end
	if enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] and now - enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] < 1.65 then return end
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	if not enemyMain or not petMain then return end
	local distance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5.5) + 1 then return end
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(enemyMain.Position, petMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.3), Vector3.new(6, 5, 6), {enemy})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(pet) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then return end
	enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = now
	motion.attackLockUntil = now + ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", pet.Name)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", now)
	local damage = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackDamage")) or 5)
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) - damage)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", health)
	pet:SetAttribute("LastEnemyAttack", now)
	combat(player, "EnemyHit", {position = petMain.Position, damage = damage, enemy = enemy.Name})
	tell(player, "EnemyAttack", "An enemy pet attacked " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. " for " .. math.floor(damage) .. ".", pet)
	burst(petMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(235, 75, 75), 18, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Stop")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		combat(player, "PetKnockedOut", {position = petMain.Position, text = "KNOCKED OUT!"})
		tell(player, "PetDefeated", "Your pet was knocked out and needs a moment to recover.", pet)
		task.delay(6, function()
			if pet.Parent then
				pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
				pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")
				pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", true)
				combat(player, "PetRecovered", {position = getPetMain(pet) and getPetMain(pet).Position})
			end
		end)
	end
end

local boundsForZone

local function setMotion(enemy, moving, jumping)
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") ~= moving then enemy:SetAttribute("Moving", moving) end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Jumping") ~= jumping then enemy:SetAttribute("Jumping", jumping) end
end

local function updateEnemy(enemy, deltaTime)
	local targetUserId = enemy:GetAttribute("OwnerTarget")
	if typeof(targetUserId) ~= "number" then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetUserId)
	local pet = player and getActivePet(player)
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not enemyMain then return end
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {nextRoam = 0, roamTarget = nil, nextJump = os.clock() + math.random(2, 5), jumpUntil = 0, attackLockUntil = 0}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	local now = os.clock()
	
	local petPos = clientPetPositions[player.UserId]
	local followTarget = petPos or (playerRoot and playerRoot.Position)
	
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then
		if followTarget then
			local look = Vector3.new(followTarget.X, enemyMain.Position.Y, followTarget.Z)
			if (look - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot():Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(enemy:GetPivot().Position, look), math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))) end
		end
		stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
		setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		return
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
	end
	local targetDistance = followTarget and (enemyMain.Position - followTarget).Magnitude or math.huge
	local stopDistance = 7
	if petMain then
		local petDistance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
		local attackRange = math.max(4, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5)
		if petDistance <= attackRange then
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
			enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
			attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
			return
		end
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing") end
	if followTarget and targetDistance < 26 then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
		local speed = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, followTarget, followTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		setMotion(enemy, distance > stopDistance + 0.15, jumping)
	else
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Roaming")
		if now >= motion.nextRoam or not motion.roamTarget then
			local zoneCenter = enemyMain.Position
			local zone = Workspace.Map and Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild(tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")))
			local low, high = zone and boundsForZone(zone)
			if low and high then
				zoneCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(math.floor(low.X), math.floor(high.X)), enemyMain.Position.Y, math.random(math.floor(low.Z), math.floor(high.Z)))
			else
				zoneCenter += Vector3.new(math.random(-14, 14), 0, math.random(-14, 14))
			end
			motion.roamTarget = zoneCenter
			motion.nextRoam = now + math.random(3, 7)
		end
		local speed = (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5) * ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, motion.roamTarget, motion.roamTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		if distance > 2 then
			setMotion(enemy, true, jumping)
		else
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		end
	end
	if now >= motion.nextJump and (enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") == true or petPos ~= nil) then
		motion.jumpStart = now
		motion.jumpUntil = now + 0.55
		motion.nextJump = now + math.random(3, 6)
		setMotion(enemy, true, true)
		combat(player, "EnemyJump", {position = enemyMain.Position, enemy = enemy.Name})
	end
end

local function attack(player, pet)
	local main = getPetMain(pet)
	if not main then return end

	-- Pet attacks only when explicitly commanded via "Attack" action
	-- No automatic stopping based on owner distance

	-- Check for targeted enemy first
	local targetEnemyName = pet:GetAttribute("TargetEnemy")
	local enemy = targetEnemyName and Enemies:FindFirstChild(targetEnemyName)

	-- Fallback to nearest enemy if no target or target invalid
	if not enemy or not enemy.Parent then
		enemy = getEnemyNear(main.Position, 32)
	end

	if not enemy then
		-- No enemy found, attack misses
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local key = player.UserId
	if cooldowns[key] and now - cooldowns[key] < 0.48 then return end
	cooldowns[key] = now
	local state = comboState[key] or {count = 0, last = 0}
	state.count = now - state.last <= 1.4 and (state.count % 4) + 1 or 1
	state.last = now
	comboState[key] = state
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(main.Position, enemyMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.1), Vector3.new(7, 6, 8), {pet, player.Character})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(enemy) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then
		combat(player, "Whiff", {position = main.Position, combo = state.count})
		return
	end
	local baseDamage = 10 * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1)
	local damage = math.floor(baseDamage * (1 + state.count * 0.18))
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) - damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("LastHitBy", player.UserId)
	combat(player, "PetHit", {position = enemyMain.Position, damage = damage, combo = state.count, enemy = enemy.Name})
	burst(enemyMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 70), 24, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		local reward = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GoldReward")) or 10
		giveGold(player, reward)
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "DefeatEnemies")
		combat(player, "EnemyDefeated", {position = enemyMain.Position, reward = reward, combo = state.count, text = "DEFEATED!", enemyName = enemy.Name})
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet defeated an enemy and found " .. reward .. " gold.", pet)
		enemy:Destroy()
		-- Clear target if it was the defeated enemy
		if pet:GetAttribute("TargetEnemy") == enemy.Name then
			pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", nil)
		end
	else
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet attacked for " .. math.floor(damage) .. " damage.", pet)
	end
end

local function scavenge(player, pet)
	local key = pet:GetDebugId()
	if scavenged[key] and os.clock() - scavenged[key] < 20 then
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "This pet needs a little time before scavenging again.", pet)
		return
	end
	scavenged[key] = os.clock()
	local amount = math.floor(math.random(5, 25) * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1))
	if giveGold(player, amount) then
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "Scavenge")
		local main = getPetMain(pet)
		if main then burst(main.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 70), 16, 1) end
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "Your pet scavenged " .. amount .. " gold.", pet)
	end
end

local function chooseTemplate(zone)
	local petFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not petFolder then return nil end
	local configured = zone and zone:GetAttribute("EnemyTemplate")
	if type(configured) == "string" then
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(configured)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then return template end
	end
	local available = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(enemyTemplateNames) do
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then table.insert(available, template) end
	end
	return #available > 0 and available[math.random(1, #available)] or nil
end

boundsForZone = function(zone)
	local minVector, maxVector
	for _, item in zone:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			local half = item.Size * 0.5
			local low = item.Position - half
			local high = item.Position + half
			minVector = minVector and Vector3.new(math.min(minVector.X, low.X), math.min(minVector.Y, low.Y), math.min(minVector.Z, low.Z)) or low
			maxVector = maxVector and Vector3.new(math.max(maxVector.X, high.X), math.max(maxVector.Y, high.Y), math.max(maxVector.Z, high.Z)) or high
		end
	end
	return minVector, maxVector
end

local function zoneAt(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if not map then return nil end
	for _, zone in map:GetChildren() do
		if zone:IsA("Folder") or zone:IsA("Model") then
			local minVector, maxVector = boundsForZone(zone)
			if minVector and position.X >= minVector.X and position.X <= maxVector.X and position.Z >= minVector.Z and position.Z <= maxVector.Z then return zone end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function eventValue(name, default)
	local value = WorldEvents:GetAttribute(name)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value or default
end

local function readSetting(player, zone, name)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil and zone then value = zone:GetAttribute(name) end
	if value == nil then value = DEFAULTS[name] end
	return value
end

local function configureSettings(player)
	for name, value in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
		if player:GetAttribute(name) == nil then player:SetAttribute(name, value) end
	end
end

local function configureEnemy(enemy, ownerTarget, zone)
	local main = enemy:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not main then enemy:Destroy() return nil end
	local area = AREA_CONFIG[zone and zone.Name] or AREA_CONFIG.Spawn
	local health = math.max(1, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyHealth")) or area.Health) * eventValue("HealthMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMin = math.max(0, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMin")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMin) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMax = math.max(goldMin, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMax")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMax) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	enemy.PrimaryPart = main
	enemy:SetAttribute("IsPetEnemy", true)
	enemy:SetAttribute("OwnerTarget", ownerTarget.UserId)
	enemy:SetAttribute("ZoneName", zone and zone.Name or "Unzoned")
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("GoldReward", math.random(goldMin, goldMax))
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackDamage", area.Damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackRange", 5.5)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MoveSpeed", area.Speed)
	enemy:SetAttribute("CombatColor", area.Color)
	for _, descendant in enemy:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", Vector3.zero)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Spawning")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", "")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", 0)
	return enemy
end

local function getCollectAreaPosition(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return position end
	local closestPoint, closestDistance
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			local localPosition = areaPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
			local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
			local clamped = Vector3.new(
				math.clamp(localPosition.X, -halfSize.X + 3, halfSize.X - 3),
				0,
				math.clamp(localPosition.Z, -halfSize.Z + 3, halfSize.Z - 3)
			)
			local candidate = areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(clamped)
			local distance = (candidate - position).Magnitude
			if not closestDistance or distance < closestDistance then
				closestPoint, closestDistance = candidate, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPoint or position
end

local function getAnyCollectAreaPosition(referencePosition)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return nil end
	local candidates = {}
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") and areaPart.Size.X > 8 and areaPart.Size.Z > 8 then
			table.insert(candidates, areaPart)
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then return nil end
	local areaPart = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
	local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
	local localPosition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.X + 4), math.floor(halfSize.X - 4)),
		0,
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.Z + 4), math.floor(halfSize.Z - 4))
	)
	return areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)
end

local function placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, horizontalPosition, referenceY, character)
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, enemy, Enemies}
	rayParams.IgnoreWater = false
	local origin = Vector3.new(horizontalPosition.X, math.max(referenceY + 80, horizontalPosition.Y + 80), horizontalPosition.Z)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -240, 0), rayParams)
	if not result then return false end
	local pivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(horizontalPosition.X, result.Position.Y + 0.1, horizontalPosition.Z) * pivot.Rotation)
	local boxCFrame, boxSize = enemy:GetBoundingBox()
	local bottomOffset = boxCFrame.Position.Y - boxSize.Y * 0.5 - enemy:GetPivot().Position.Y
	enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 - bottomOffset, 0))
	local groundedPivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:SetAttribute("GroundY", groundedPivot.Position.Y)
	return true
end

local function spawnNearPlayer(player)
	local enemies = playerEnemies[player] or {}
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
	local spawnMultiplier = eventValue("SpawnMultiplier", 1)
	local configuredMax = tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemyMaxCount")) or MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER
	local maxCount = math.clamp(math.floor(configuredMax * spawnMultiplier), 0, MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER)
	if readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnEnabled") ~= true or #enemies >= maxCount then return end
	if math.random() > math.clamp((tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnChance")) or 1) * math.min(spawnMultiplier, 2), 0, 1) then return end
	local template = chooseTemplate(zone)
	if not template then return end
	local enemy = configureEnemy(template:Clone(), player, zone)
	if not enemy then return end
	enemy.Name = "PetEnemy_Player_" .. player.UserId .. "_" .. math.random(1000, 9999)
	local minDistance = math.max(8, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMinDistance")) or 24)
	local maxDistance = math.max(minDistance, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMaxDistance")) or 34)
	local frontDirection = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if frontDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then frontDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else frontDirection = frontDirection.Unit end
	local rightDirection = Vector3.new(-frontDirection.Z, 0, frontDirection.X)
	local distance = math.random(math.floor(minDistance), math.floor(maxDistance))
	local sideOffset = math.random(-8, 8)
	local spawnPosition = root.Position + frontDirection * distance + rightDirection * sideOffset
	spawnPosition = getCollectAreaPosition(spawnPosition)
	if not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, spawnPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
		local fallbackPosition = getAnyCollectAreaPosition(root.Position)
		if not fallbackPosition or not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, fallbackPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
			enemy:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end
	enemy.Parent = Enemies
	table.insert(enemies, enemy)
	playerEnemies[player] = enemies
	combat(player, "EnemySpawned", {position = enemy.PrimaryPart.Position, enemy = enemy.Name, zone = enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")})
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function()
		enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = nil
		local list = playerEnemies[player]
		if list then for index, current in ipairs(list) do if current == enemy then table.remove(list, index) break end end end
	end)
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	configureSettings(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
		playerEnemies[player] = {}
		lastSpawn[player] = 0
		comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setupPlayer(player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
	playerEnemies[player] = nil
	lastSpawn[player] = nil
	cooldowns[player.UserId] = nil
	comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	clientPetPositions[player.UserId] = nil
end)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	local pet = ownerPet(player, petId)
	if not pet then return end
	if action == "Attack" then
		-- Only allow attack if pet state is "Attack"
		if pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") == "Attack" then
			attack(player, pet)
		end
	elseif action == "Scavenge" then
		scavenge(player, pet)
	elseif action == "TargetEnemy" then
		-- Client requested to target a specific enemy
		local enemyName = extra -- extra parameter contains enemy name
		if typeof(extra) == "string" then
			local enemy = Enemies:FindFirstChild(extra)
			if enemy then
				pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", enemy.Name)
				pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", true)
				tell(player, "TargetEnemy", "Pet targeting " .. enemy.Name .. "!", pet)
			end
		end
	end
end)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action, extra)
	if action == "PositionUpdate" and typeof(extra) == "Vector3" then
		clientPetPositions[player.UserId] = extra
	elseif action == "TargetEnemy" and typeof(extra) == "string" then
		local pet = ownerPet(player, petId)
		if pet then
			local enemy = Enemies:FindFirstChild(extra)
			if enemy then
				pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", enemy.Name)
				pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", true)
			end
		end
	elseif action == "ClearTarget" then
		local pet = ownerPet(player, petId)
		if pet then
			pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", nil)
			pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", false)
		end
	end
end)

-- Removed autoAttackPets() - pets now only attack when explicitly commanded
-- This prevents pets from auto-attacking and gives the player full manual control

local movementAccumulator = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	movementAccumulator += dt
	if movementAccumulator < MOVEMENT_TICK then return end
	local stepDelta = movementAccumulator
	movementAccumulator = 0
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy.Parent then updateEnemy(enemy, stepDelta) end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(2) do
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
				local interval = math.max(2, (tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnInterval")) or DEFAULTS.EnemySpawnInterval) * eventValue("SpawnIntervalMultiplier", 1))
				if os.clock() - (lastSpawn[player] or 0) >= interval then
					lastSpawn[player] = os.clock()
					spawnNearPlayer(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local Commands = require(script.Commands)

local ADMIN_IDS = { [12345678] = true } -- Replace with your UserId

TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message: TextChatMessage)
	if message.TextSource then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(message.TextSource.UserId)
		if player and ADMIN_IDS[player.UserId] and message.Text:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
			local parts = message.Text:split(" ")
			local cmd = parts[1]:sub(2):lower()
			local args = {unpack(parts, 2)}
			if Commands[cmd] then
				Commands[cmd](player, args)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function getPooledParticle()
	local particle = table.remove(particlePool)
	if not particle then
		particle = Instance.new("Frame")
		particle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		particle.ZIndex = 1
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = particle
	end
	return particle
end

local function returnToPool(particle)
	particle.Parent = nil
	table.insert(particlePool, particle)
	activeParticles[particle] = nil
end

-- Create floating particles
local function createParticle()
	if #activeParticles >= MAX_PARTICLES then return end

	local particle = getPooledParticle()
	local size = math.random(3, 8)
	particle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
	particle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(0, 100) / 100, 1.1)
	particle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(83, 188, 255)
	particle.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(30, 70) / 100
	particle.Parent = particleContainer
	activeParticles[particle] = true

	-- Animate upward
	local duration = math.random(80, 150) / 10
	local endY = -0.1
	local endX = particle.Position.X.Scale + (math.random(-20, 20) / 100)

	local tween = TweenService:Create(particle, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(endX, endY),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()

	task.delay(duration, function()
		if particle then
			tween:Cancel()
			returnToPool(particle)
		end
	end)
end

-- Spawn particles continuously

local playCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local playConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")

-- Button gradient
local playGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
playGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(83, 188, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(130, 215, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(83, 188, 255))
})
playGradient.Rotation = 45
playGradient.Parent = playButton

-- Animate button gradient
local buttonGradientThread = task.spawn(function()
	while playButton and playButton.Parent and not fading do
		for offset = 0, 1, 0.02 do
			if not playButton or not playButton.Parent or fading then break end
			playGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(offset, 0)
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
		if fading then break end
		for offset = 1, 0, -0.02 do
			if not playButton or not playButton.Parent or fading then break end
			playGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(offset, 0)

	end
end)

local detail = Instance.new("TextLabel")
detail.BackgroundTransparency = 1
detail.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

local detailConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")

local hovering = false
playButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	hovering = true
	TweenService:Create(playButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.44)
	}):Play()

playButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()

playButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

local stages = {
	{0.15, "🌍 Connecting to world..."},
	{0.35, "🐾 Loading pets and companions..."},
	{0.55, "🗺️ Preparing zones and events..."},
	{0.75, "⚙️ Initializing systems..."},
	{0.9, "💎 Loading your inventory..."},
	{1, "✓ Ready to play!"}
}
local ready = false
local fading = false
local function fadeOut()
	if fading then return end
	fading = true

	-- Cancel all background threads
	task.cancel(gradientThread)
	task.cancel(particleThread)
	task.cancel(titleThread)
	task.cancel(barShimmerThread)
	task.cancel(tipThread)
	task.cancel(buttonGradientThread)

	-- Clean up active particles
	for particle in pairs(activeParticles) do
		if particle then particle:Destroy() end
	end
	activeParticles = {}
	particlePool = {}

	-- Flash effect
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flash.ZIndex = 10
	flash.Parent = root

	TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.7}):Play()
	task.wait(0.15)
	TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

	for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do

			local goals = {BackgroundTransparency = 1}
			if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
				goals.TextTransparency = 1
			end
			pcall(function()
				TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), goals):Play()
			end)
		end
	end
	TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	task.wait(0.8)
	gui:Destroy()
end

playButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not ready then return end
	playButton.Active = false

	-- Play button press animation
	TweenService:Create(playButton, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.65, 0.35),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 200)
	}):Play()

	subtitle.Text = "🚀 Launching game..."
	task.wait(0.2)
	fadeOut()
end)

task.spawn(function()
	for _, stage in ipairs(stages) do
		local value, text = stage[1], stage[2]

		-- Update text with fade
		TweenService:Create(subtitle, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
		subtitle.Text = text
		TweenService:Create(subtitle, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()

		-- Animate progress bar
		TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(value, 1)
		}):Play()

		-- Pulse glow when bar progresses
		TweenService:Create(barGlow, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.6}):Play()
		task.wait(0.3)
		TweenService:Create(barGlow, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.85}):Play()

		-- Update percentage with counting animation
		local startPercent = tonumber(percent.Text:match("%d+")) or 0
		local endPercent = math.floor(value * 100)
		local duration = 0.4
		local elapsed = 0

		while elapsed < duration do
			elapsed += task.wait()
			local alpha = math.min(elapsed / duration, 1)
			local currentPercent = math.floor(startPercent + (endPercent - startPercent) * alpha)
			percent.Text = currentPercent .. "%"
		end

		task.wait(0.5)
	end

	-- Loading complete - show play button with animation
	ready = true
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.85)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.12)
	panel.Visible = true

	TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.78),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.16)
	}):Play()

	-- Pulse effect on panel
	local panelPulseThread = task.spawn(function()
		while panel and panel.Parent and not fading do
			TweenService:Create(panelStroke, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {

			TweenService:Create(panelStroke, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
				Transparency = 0.4
			}):Play()
			task.wait(1.2)
		end
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- VFXEffects.lua
-- Particle pooling, ring bursts, trails, and common VFX patterns

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local VFXEffects = {}
VFXEffects.__index = VFXEffects

local particlePool = {}
local MAX_PARTICLES = 100

local function getParticlePart(): Part
	for _, part in particlePool do
		if not part.Parent then
			return part
		end
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	table.insert(particlePool, part)
	return part
end

local function returnParticlePart(part: Part)
	if part.Parent then
		part.Parent = nil
	end
	part:ClearAllChildren()
end

-- Ring burst (expanding circle)
function VFXEffects.RingBurst(position: Vector3, color: Color3, startSize: number, endSize: number, duration: number, thickness: number?)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local ring = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	ring.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	ring.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	ring.LightEmission = 1
	ring.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(duration * 0.5, duration)
	ring.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	ring.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, startSize or 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, endSize or 10),
	})
	ring.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, thickness and 0.1 or 0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	ring.Rate = 0
	ring.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
	ring.Parent = part
	
	ring:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, duration + 0.1)
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Radial burst (sparkles in all directions)
function VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, speedRange: NumberRange, lifetime: NumberRange, sizeRange: NumberRange)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = lifetime
	emitter.Speed = speedRange
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, sizeRange.Min),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime.Max + 0.1)
	task.delay(lifetime.Max + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Directional burst (cone)
function VFXEffects.DirectionalBurst(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, spread: number, speed: number, lifetime: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(lifetime * 0.5, lifetime)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(spread, spread)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Drag = 2
	emitter.Parent = part
	
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime + 0.1)
	task.delay(lifetime + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Trail between two points
function VFXEffects.Trail(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color3, width: number, duration: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(width, width, (to - from).Magnitude)
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.Lifetime = duration
	trail.MinLength = 0
	trail.MaxLength = (to - from).Magnitude + 2
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1)
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	
	local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, (to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	attachment0.Parent = part
	
	local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -(to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	attachment1.Parent = part
	
	trail.Attachment0 = attachment0
	trail.Attachment1 = attachment1
	trail.Parent = part
	
	Debris:AddItem(part, duration + 0.1)
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Text pop (damage numbers, gold gain, etc.)
function VFXEffects.TextPop(position: Vector3, text: string, color: Color3, size: number, duration: number, offset: Vector3?)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position + (offset or Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Parent = part
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = size
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Parent = billboard
	
	-- Animate up and fade
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(part, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), 5, math.random(-2, 2))
	})
	tween:Play()
	
	local fadeTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(label, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		TextTransparency = 1,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	})
	fadeTween:Play()
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Orbital particles around a point
function VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(center: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, radius: number, duration: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = center
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	for i = 1, count do
		local angle = (i / count) * math.pi * 2
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
		attachment.Parent = part
		
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(duration * 0.5, duration)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Parent = attachment
		
		emitter:Emit(1)
	end
	
	-- Rotate the part for orbital motion
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if os.clock() - startTime > duration then
			conn:Disconnect()
			returnParticlePart(part)
			return
		end
		part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 2 * math.pi * 0.5 / 60, 0)
	end)
	
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Explosion with shockwave
function VFXEffects.Explosion(position: Vector3, color: Color3, scale: number)
	-- Shockwave ring
	VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, color, 1 * scale, 20 * scale, 0.4, 0.2)
	
	-- Core flash
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pointLight.Color = color
	pointLight.Range = 30 * scale
	pointLight.Brightness = 5
	pointLight.Parent = part
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(pointLight, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		Brightness = 0,
		Range = 0
	}):Play()
	
	-- Debris burst
	VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, color, 30, NumberRange.new(10, 30), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.8), NumberRange.new(0.5, 2))
	
	Debris:AddItem(part, 0.5)
	task.delay(0.5, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Presets for game moments
VFXEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), 12, NumberRange.new(5, 15), NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5))
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 12, 4, 1)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 2, 15, 0.5)
	end,
	
	RareHatch = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 1, 25, 0.6)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), 30, NumberRange.new(10, 25), NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), NumberRange.new(0.8, 2))
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 16, 5, 1.5)
	end,
	
	LegendaryHatch = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100), 1.5)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200), 24, 6, 2)
		task.wait(0.2)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 30, 0.5)
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 12, 4, 1)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 2, 15, 0.5)
	end,
	
	Rebirth = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 2)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 32, 8, 3)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			task.wait(0.15)
			VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100 + i * 30, 150 + i * 30, 255), 1, 40, 0.6)
		end
	end,
	
	EnemyDefeat = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100), 16, NumberRange.new(8, 20), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2))
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 1, 12, 0.4)
	end,
	
	BossDefeat = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 2)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), 24, 6, 2)
	end,
	
	TradeComplete = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120), 15, NumberRange.new(5, 15), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1))
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 1, 10, 0.3)
	end,
	
	DailyClaim = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 80), 20, NumberRange.new(5, 12), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2))
	end,
}

return VFXEffects
