local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true, Attack = true, Scavenge = true,
	Play = true, Train = true, Equip = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
			energy = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Energy")) or 100, 0, 100),
			experience = tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Experience")) or 0,
			level = tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Level")) or 1,
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		energy = stats and stats.energy or nil,
		experience = stats and stats.experience or nil,
		level = stats and stats.level or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	stats.energy = math.clamp(stats.energy or 100, 0, 100)
	stats.experience = math.max(stats.experience or 0, 0)
	stats.level = math.max(stats.level or 1, 1)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
	pet:SetAttribute("Energy", stats.energy)
	pet:SetAttribute("Experience", stats.experience)
	pet:SetAttribute("Level", stats.level)

	-- Level up logic
	local expNeeded = stats.level * 100
	if stats.experience >= expNeeded then
		stats.experience = stats.experience - expNeeded
		stats.level = stats.level + 1
		stats.mood = 100
		pet:SetAttribute("Experience", stats.experience)
		pet:SetAttribute("Level", stats.level)
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100), 40)
		local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
		if owner then
			send(owner, "LevelUp", "Your pet leveled up to Level " .. stats.level .. "!", pet)
		end
	end
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		-- Allow following in Follow and Attack modes
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow" or state == "Attack")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 14
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		stats.experience += 2
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		stats.experience += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Play" then
		if stats.energy >= 15 then
			stats.energy -= 15
			stats.mood += 12
			stats.experience += 10
			effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120), 20)
			send(player, "Play", "Your pet had fun playing!", pet)
		else
			send(player, "Play", "Your pet is too tired to play.", pet)
		end
	elseif action == "Train" then
		if stats.energy >= 25 and stats.hunger >= 30 then
			stats.energy -= 25
			stats.hunger -= 10
			stats.experience += 25
			stats.mood += 5
			effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255), 24)
			send(player, "Train", "Your pet gained valuable experience!", pet)
		else
			send(player, "Train", "Your pet needs more energy and food to train.", pet)
		end
	elseif action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", nil)
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Follow" then
		setState(pet, "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", nil)
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 180), 12)
		send(player, "Follow", "Your pet will now follow you.", pet)
	elseif action == "Sit" then
		setState(pet, "Sit")
		stats.energy = math.min(stats.energy + 5, 100)
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(230, 170, 90), 12)
		send(player, "Sit", "Your pet is now sitting.", pet)
	elseif action == "Sleep" then
		setState(pet, "Sleep")
		stats.mood += 5
		stats.energy = math.min(stats.energy + 30, 100)
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255), 12)
		send(player, "Sleep", "Your pet is sleeping peacefully.", pet)
	elseif action == "Jump" then
		setState(pet, "Jump")
		stats.mood += 2
		stats.energy -= 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), 12)
		send(player, "Jump", "Your pet is jumping around!", pet)
	elseif action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, "Fly")
		stats.energy -= 2
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255), 22)
		send(player, "Fly", "Your pet is now flying!", pet)
	elseif action == "Attack" then
		if stats.energy >= 10 then
			setState(pet, "Attack")
			stats.energy -= 10
			stats.mood += 3
			effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 80), 18)
			-- Set attack flag so the pet behavior system knows to attack
			pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", true)
			send(player, "Attack", "Your pet is ready to attack! Use Attack command to strike enemies.", pet)
		else
			send(player, "Attack", "Your pet is too tired to attack.", pet)
		end
	elseif action == "Scavenge" then
		if stats.energy >= 20 then
			setState(pet, "Scavenge")
			stats.energy -= 20
			stats.experience += 8
			effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(160, 200, 140), 16)
			send(player, "Scavenge", "Your pet is searching for items!", pet)
		else
			send(player, "Scavenge", "Your pet is too tired to scavenge.", pet)
		end
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	elseif action == "Equip" then
		send(player, "Equip", "Pet equipment screen opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)

	-- Initialize combat flags to false
	pet:SetAttribute("IsAttacking", false)
	pet:SetAttribute("TargetEnemy", nil)

	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				local state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1

				-- Energy regeneration when sleeping or sitting
				if state == "Sleep" then
					stats.energy = math.min(stats.energy + 5, 100)
				elseif state == "Sit" then
					stats.energy = math.min(stats.energy + 2, 100)
				elseif state == "Follow" or state == "Jump" or state == "Fly" then
					stats.energy -= 0.5
				end

				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

studioFiles.source:
-- Squeeze Roblox Studio WebSync Companion Plugin v5.0.0
-- Real-Time Bidirectional Synchronization for Roblox Studio & Squeeze AI Agent
-- Supports Instant Auto-Connect (Zero-Pairing), ScriptEditorService Updates, and Studio Companion Panel.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedFirst = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StudioService = game:GetService("StudioService")
local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")

-- Safely acquire ScriptEditorService if available in Studio
local ScriptEditorService: any = nil
pcall(function()
	ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
end)

-- Configuration
local DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio"
local POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 3.0
local HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 10.0
local MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 5

-- Log Buffer for capturing console and runtime errors
local logBuffer = {} :: {any}

pcall(function()
	LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message, messageType)
		table.insert(logBuffer, {
			message = message,
			messageType = messageType.Name,
			timestamp = os.time()
		})
		if #logBuffer > 150 then
			table.remove(logBuffer, 1)
		end
	end)
end)

-- Plugin State
local pluginSession = {
	backendUrl = DEFAULT_BACKEND_URL,
	token = "",
	pairingCode = "AUTO_CONNECT",
	sessionId = "",
	projectId = "",
	projectName = "",
	status = "Connecting", -- Connecting, Connected, Syncing, Offline, AuthenticationExpired, Error
	lastSyncTime = 0,
	lastHeartbeatTime = 0,
	consecutiveErrors = 0,
	pendingChangesCount = 0,
	connectedPlaceName = game.Name ~= "" and game.Name or "Roblox Studio Place",
	connectedPlaceId = game.PlaceId,
	universeId = game.GameId,
	fileHashes = {} :: { [string]: string },
	fileVersions = {} :: { [string]: number },
	isPolling = false
}

-- Simple Hash helper
local function simpleHash(str: string): string
	local h = 0
	local s = str or ""
	for i = 1, #s do
		h = (h * 31 + string.byte(s, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return string.format("%08x", h)
end

-- Resolve Container Instance from Virtual Path
local function resolveParentFromPath(path: string): (Instance?, string)
	if not path or path == "" then return game, "" end
	local parts = string.split(path, "/")
	local instanceName = parts[#parts] or "Script"

	instanceName = instanceName:gsub("%.server%.luau$", ""):gsub("%.client%.luau$", ""):gsub("%.luau$", ""):gsub("%.lua$", "")

	local currentParent: Instance = game
	local root = parts[1] or ""

	if root == "src" or root == "ServerScriptService" then
		if parts[2] == "server" or root == "ServerScriptService" then
			currentParent = ServerScriptService
		elseif parts[2] == "client" then
			currentParent = StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
		elseif parts[2] == "shared" then
			currentParent = ReplicatedStorage
		else
			currentParent = ServerScriptService
		end
	elseif root == "StarterPlayer" then
		currentParent = StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
	elseif root == "ReplicatedStorage" then
		currentParent = ReplicatedStorage
	elseif root == "StarterGui" then
		currentParent = StarterGui
	elseif root == "Workspace" then
		currentParent = Workspace
	elseif root == "ReplicatedFirst" then
		currentParent = ReplicatedFirst
	elseif root == "ServerStorage" then
		currentParent = ServerStorage
	else
		currentParent = ServerScriptService
	end

	local startIdx = (parts[1] == "src" and 3 or (root == currentParent.Name and 2 or 1))
	for i = startIdx, #parts - 1 do
		local folderName = parts[i]
		if folderName and folderName ~= "" then
			local existingFolder = currentParent:FindFirstChild(folderName)
			if not existingFolder then
				local newFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
				newFolder.Name = folderName
				newFolder.Parent = currentParent
				currentParent = newFolder
			else
				currentParent = existingFolder
			end
		end
	end

	return currentParent, instanceName
end

local function findInstanceByPath(path: string): (Instance?, Instance?)
	local parent, instanceName = resolveParentFromPath(path)
	if not parent then return nil, nil end
	local found = parent:FindFirstChild(instanceName)
	return found, parent
end

-- Safely Update Script Source using ScriptEditorService or Direct Property
local function setScriptSourceSafely(inst: Instance, newSource: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not inst or not inst:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
		return false, "Target is not a LuaSourceContainer"
	end

	local sourceValue = newSource or ""
	local editorUpdated = false

	if ScriptEditorService then
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(inst, function(oldSource)
				return sourceValue
			end)
			editorUpdated = true
		end)
	end

	if not editorUpdated then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			(inst :: any).Source = sourceValue
		end)
		if not ok then
			return false, "Script source update failed (check Script Injection Permissions): " .. tostring(err)
		end
	end

	return true, nil
end

-- Apply incoming operation from Squeeze Website / AI Agent
local function applyOperation(op: any): (boolean, string?)
	if not op or type(op) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Invalid operation payload"
	end

	local opType = op.operation or op.action or "updateScript"
	local path = op.path or op.parentPath or ""

	if opType == "createInstance" or opType == "createScript" or opType == "updateScript" or opType == "update" then
		local className = op.className or (tostring(opType):match("Script") and "Script" or "Folder")
		local existingInst, parent = findInstanceByPath(path)
		if op.name and parent then
			path = (path ~= "" and path .. "/" or "") .. tostring(op.name)
			existingInst, parent = findInstanceByPath(path)
		end
		if not parent then return false, "Invalid parent path: " .. tostring(path) end

		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Squeeze Op: " .. tostring(path)) end)

		local inst = existingInst
		if not inst then
			inst = Instance.new(className)
			local _, nm = resolveParentFromPath(path)
			inst.Name = op.name or nm or "NewInstance"
			inst.Parent = parent
		elseif inst.ClassName ~= className and tostring(className):match("Script") then
			local newInst = Instance.new(className)
			newInst.Name = inst.Name
			newInst.Parent = parent
			if inst:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				setScriptSourceSafely(newInst, (inst :: any).Source)
			end
			inst:Destroy()
			inst = newInst
		end

		if op.source and inst:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			local okSource, errSource = setScriptSourceSafely(inst, op.source)
			if not okSource then
				return false, errSource
			end
			pluginSession.fileHashes[path] = simpleHash(op.source)
		end

		if op.properties and type(op.properties) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(op.properties) do
				pcall(function() (inst :: any)[k] = v end)
			end
		end

		if op.attributes and type(op.attributes) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(op.attributes) do
				pcall(function() inst:SetAttribute(k, v) end)
			end
		end

		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Squeeze Op Complete: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		return true, nil

	elseif opType == "deleteInstance" or opType == "deleteScript" or opType == "delete" then
		local existingInst = findInstanceByPath(path)
		if existingInst then
			pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Squeeze Delete: " .. tostring(path)) end)
			existingInst:Destroy()
			pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Squeeze Deleted: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		end
		return true, nil

	elseif opType == "setProperty" then
		local existingInst = findInstanceByPath(path)
		if not existingInst then return false, "Instance not found for setProperty: " .. tostring(path) end
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Squeeze SetProperty: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		for k, v in pairs(op.properties or {}) do
			pcall(function() (existingInst :: any)[k] = v end)
		end
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Squeeze SetProperty: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		return true, nil

	elseif opType == "setAttribute" then
		local existingInst = findInstanceByPath(path)
		if not existingInst then return false, "Instance not found for setAttribute: " .. tostring(path) end
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Squeeze SetAttribute: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		for k, v in pairs(op.attributes or {}) do
			pcall(function() existingInst:SetAttribute(k, v) end)
		end
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Squeeze SetAttribute: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		return true, nil

	elseif opType == "renameInstance" then
		local existingInst = findInstanceByPath(path)
		if not existingInst then return false, "Instance not found for rename: " .. tostring(path) end
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Squeeze Rename: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		existingInst.Name = op.newName or op.name or existingInst.Name
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Squeeze Rename: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		return true, nil

	elseif opType == "moveInstance" then
		local existingInst = findInstanceByPath(path)
		local newParent = resolveParentFromPath(op.newParentPath or "")
		if not existingInst or not newParent then return false, "Instance or new parent not found" end
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Squeeze Move: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		existingInst.Parent = newParent
		pcall(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Squeeze Move: " .. tostring(path)) end)
		return true, nil
	end

	return false, "Unknown operation type: " .. tostring(opType)
end

-- HTTP Request wrapper with safe pcall, non-JSON handling, and 401 detection
local function httpRequest(url: string, method: string, bodyData: any, token: string?): (boolean, any, number)
	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
	}
	if token and token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. token
	end

	local payload = bodyData and HttpService:JSONEncode(bodyData) or nil

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = url,
			Method = method,
			Headers = headers,
			Body = payload
		})
	end)

	if not success then 
		return false, tostring(response), 0 
	end

	local statusCode = response.StatusCode or 0

	if statusCode == 401 then
		return false, "401 Unauthorized", 401
	end

	if not response.Success then 
		return false, "HTTP " .. tostring(statusCode) .. ": " .. tostring(response.Body), statusCode 
	end

	local decodeSuccess, decoded = pcall(function() 
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) 
	end)

	if not decodeSuccess then 
		return false, "Invalid JSON response from server", statusCode 
	end

	return true, decoded, statusCode
end

-- Proactive Script Injection and Writing Permission Request
local function requestAllPermissions(): boolean
	-- Creating a temporary Script object and setting its parent to ServerScriptService.
	-- This instantly prompts the user with the Roblox Studio Script Injection permission dialog on startup/connection.
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		local testScript = Instance.new("Script")
		testScript.Name = "SqueezePermissionCheck"
		testScript.Source = "-- Squeeze Permission Check\n-- Thank you for granting permissions! Squeeze is now fully authorized."
		testScript.Parent = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
		testScript:Destroy()
	end)
	return success
end

local SqueezePlugin = {}

function SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect(): (boolean, string)
	pluginSession.status = "Connecting"

	-- Request permissions proactively on connect
	requestAllPermissions()

	local autoUrl = pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/auto-connect"
	local success, data, statusCode = httpRequest(
		autoUrl,
		"POST",
		{
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			placeName = game.Name ~= "" and game.Name or "Roblox Studio Place",
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "5.0.0"
		},
		pluginSession.token ~= "" and pluginSession.token or nil
	)

	if not success or not data or not data.success then
		pluginSession.status = "Offline"
		pluginSession.consecutiveErrors = pluginSession.consecutiveErrors + 1
		local errStr = type(data) == "table" and (data.error and (data.error.message or data.error) or "Auto Connect failed") or tostring(data)
		return false, errStr
	end

	pluginSession.token = data.token or ""
	pluginSession.sessionId = data.sessionId or ""
	pluginSession.projectId = data.projectId or "prj_default_roblox"
	pluginSession.projectName = data.projectName or "Roblox Project"
	pluginSession.status = "Connected"
	pluginSession.consecutiveErrors = 0
	pluginSession.lastHeartbeatTime = os.clock()
	pluginSession.lastSyncTime = os.clock()

	task.spawn(function() 
		pcall(function() SqueezePlugin.PushExplorerTree() end) 
	end)

	SqueezePlugin.StartPolling()

	return true, "Connected automatically to Squeeze AI Platform."
end

function SqueezePlugin.PairWithCode(pairingCode: string, customUrl: string?): (boolean, string)
	if customUrl and customUrl ~= "" then
		pluginSession.backendUrl = customUrl:gsub("/+$", "")
	end

	return SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect()
end

function SqueezePlugin.SendHeartbeat()
	if pluginSession.token == "" then 
		SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect()
		return 
	end

	local heartbeatUrl = pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/heartbeat"
	local logsToSend = logBuffer
	logBuffer = {}

	local success, data, statusCode = httpRequest(
		heartbeatUrl,
		"POST",
		{
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			placeName = game.Name ~= "" and game.Name or "Roblox Studio Place",
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "5.0.0",
			logs = logsToSend
		},
		pluginSession.token
	)

	if statusCode == 401 then
		pluginSession.status = "AuthenticationExpired"
		pluginSession.token = ""
		SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect()
		return
	end

	if success and data and data.success then
		pluginSession.lastHeartbeatTime = os.clock()
		pluginSession.status = "Connected"
		pluginSession.consecutiveErrors = 0
		pluginSession.pendingChangesCount = data.pendingChangesCount or 0
	else
		pluginSession.consecutiveErrors = pluginSession.consecutiveErrors + 1
		if pluginSession.consecutiveErrors >= 3 then 
			pluginSession.status = "Offline" 
			task.spawn(function() SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect() end)
		end
	end
end

function SqueezePlugin.PollAndApplyChanges(): number
	if pluginSession.token == "" then return 0 end

	local pullUrl = pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/operations/pending"
	local success, data, statusCode = httpRequest(pullUrl, "GET", nil, pluginSession.token)

	if statusCode == 401 then
		pluginSession.status = "AuthenticationExpired"
		pluginSession.token = ""
		SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect()
		return 0
	end

	if not success and (statusCode == 404 or tostring(data):find("404")) then
		pullUrl = pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/files/pull"
		success, data, statusCode = httpRequest(pullUrl, "GET", nil, pluginSession.token)
	end

	if not success or not data or not data.success or not (data.operations or data.changes) then 
		return 0 
	end

	local ops = data.operations or data.changes
	if type(ops) ~= "table" then return 0 end

	local appliedCount = 0
	for _, op in ipairs(ops) do
		local ok, err = false, "Execution error"
		local pcallOk, pcallRes, pcallErr = pcall(function()
			return applyOperation(op)
		end)
		if pcallOk then
			ok = pcallRes
			err = pcallErr or "Operation failed"
		else
			err = tostring(pcallRes)
		end

		local ackUrl = pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/operations/ack"
		httpRequest(
			ackUrl,
			"POST",
			{
				operationId = op.operationId or op.changeId or op.eventId,
				status = ok and "applied" or "failed",
				errorMessage = err
			},
			pluginSession.token
		)
		if ok then appliedCount = appliedCount + 1 end
	end

	if appliedCount > 0 then pluginSession.lastSyncTime = os.clock() end
	return appliedCount
end

function SqueezePlugin.PushExplorerTree(): (boolean, number)
	if pluginSession.token == "" then return false, 0 end

	local scriptFiles = {}
	local treeNodes = {}

	local function scan(inst: Instance, currentPath: string)
		if not inst then return end
		local nodePath = currentPath .. "/" .. inst.Name
		table.insert(treeNodes, {
			name = inst.Name,
			className = inst.ClassName,
			path = nodePath
		})

		if inst:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			local ext = inst:IsA("LocalScript") and ".client.luau" or inst:IsA("ModuleScript") and ".luau" or ".server.luau"
			local fullScriptPath = nodePath .. ext
			local src = (inst :: any).Source or ""
			table.insert(scriptFiles, {
				path = fullScriptPath,
				name = inst.Name .. ext,
				className = inst.ClassName,
				source = src
			})
			pluginSession.fileHashes[fullScriptPath] = simpleHash(src)
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do scan(child, nodePath) end
	end

	pcall(function() scan(ServerScriptService, "ServerScriptService") end)
	pcall(function() scan(ReplicatedStorage, "ReplicatedStorage") end)
	pcall(function() scan(StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts, "StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts") end)
	pcall(function() scan(StarterGui, "StarterGui") end)
	pcall(function() scan(Workspace, "Workspace") end)

	local snapshotUrl = pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/project/snapshot"
	local success = httpRequest(snapshotUrl, "POST", { tree = treeNodes, scriptFiles = scriptFiles }, pluginSession.token)
	return success, #scriptFiles
end

function SqueezePlugin.StartPolling()
	if pluginSession.isPolling then return end
	pluginSession.isPolling = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while pluginSession.isPolling do
			if pluginSession.token == "" or pluginSession.status == "Offline" or pluginSession.status == "AuthenticationExpired" then
				SqueezePlugin.AutoConnect()
			else
				SqueezePlugin.PollAndApplyChanges()
				if os.clock() - pluginSession.lastHeartbeatTime >= HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS then
					SqueezePlugin.SendHeartbeat()
				end
			end
			task.wait(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
		end
		pluginSession.isPolling = false
	end)
end

function SqueezePlugin.Disconnect(reason: string?)
	if pluginSession.token ~= "" then 
		pcall(function() 
			httpRequest(pluginSession.backendUrl .. "/disconnect", "POST", { reason = reason or "Studio closed" }, pluginSession.token) 
		end) 
	end
	pluginSession.token = ""
	pluginSession.status = "Disconnected"
	pluginSession.isPolling = false
end

function SqueezePlugin.GetStatus() return pluginSession end

-- =========================================================================
-- PLUGIN UI INJECTION (FOR ROBLOX STUDIO TOOLBAR & STATUS PANEL)
-- =========================================================================

local toolbar
local toggleButton
local widget

local function createPluginUI(plugin: Plugin)
	toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar("Squeeze WebSync")
	toggleButton = toolbar:CreateButton("Toggle Squeeze", "Connect and sync your game with Squeeze AI", "rbxassetid://15079493155")

	statusLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local permLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	permLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25)
	permLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 70)
	permLbl.Text = "Script Access: Checking..."
	permLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
	permLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	permLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

	local infoLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	infoLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 50)
	infoLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 100)
	infoLbl.Text = "Grant the 'Allow Script Injection' permission in the popup so Squeeze can create and modify scripts automatically."
	infoLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)

	local function updateStatus(isConnected, msg)

--!strict
-- DailyRewardService.luau
-- Server-authoritative daily login reward system.
-- Players claim a reward once every CLAIM_COOLDOWN_HOURS; missing more than
-- STREAK_RESET_HOURS resets the streak back to day 1.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local DailyRewardConfig = require(Modules.DailyRewardConfig)
local DailyRewardItems = require(Modules.DailyRewardItems)
local NotificationSystem = require(Modules.NotificationSystem)
local DailyRewardSocial = require(Modules.DailyRewardSocial)

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

--// Remotes

local function getOrCreateRemote(name: string, className: string): RemoteEvent | RemoteFunction
	local existing = Remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing then
		return existing
	end

	local remote = Instance.new(className)
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = Remotes
	return remote
end

local GetStateRemote = getOrCreateRemote("DailyReward_GetState", "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction
local ClaimRemote = getOrCreateRemote("DailyReward_Claim", "RemoteEvent")
local GetLeaderboardRemote = getOrCreateRemote("DailyReward_GetLeaderboard", "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction

--// State helpers

local function getDataFolder(player: Player): Folder?
	return player:FindFirstChild("Data")
end

local function getPlayerData(player: Player): Folder?
	local dataFolder = getDataFolder(player)
	if not dataFolder then
		return nil
	end
	return dataFolder:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
end

local function isLoaded(player: Player): boolean
	local loaded = player:FindFirstChild("Loaded")
	if not loaded then
		return false
	end
	return (loaded :: any).Value == true
end

-- Returns seconds remaining until the player can claim again (0 = claimable now)
local function getTimeUntilClaim(playerData: Folder): number
	local lastClaim = playerData.LastDailyClaim.Value
	if lastClaim <= 0 then
		return 0
	end

	local elapsed = os.time() - lastClaim
	local cooldownSeconds = DailyRewardConfig.CLAIM_COOLDOWN_HOURS * 3600
	if elapsed >= cooldownSeconds then
		return 0
	end

	return cooldownSeconds - elapsed
end

-- Day the NEXT claim will grant (absolute, unbounded)
local function getNextClaimDay(playerData: Folder): number
	local streak = playerData.DailyStreak.Value
	if streak <= 0 then
		return 1
	end

	local lastClaim = playerData.LastDailyClaim.Value
	local elapsedHours = (os.time() - lastClaim) / 3600

	-- Streak broken: start over
	if elapsedHours >= DailyRewardConfig.STREAK_RESET_HOURS then
		return 1
	end

	return streak + 1
end

local CYCLE_LENGTH = DailyRewardConfig.GetCycleLength()

local function getCycleDay(absoluteDay: number): number
	return ((absoluteDay - 1) % CYCLE_LENGTH) + 1
end

local function buildState(player: Player)
	local playerData = getPlayerData(player)
	if not playerData then
		return nil
	end

	local timeUntilClaim = getTimeUntilClaim(playerData)
	local canClaim = timeUntilClaim <= 0
	local streak = playerData.DailyStreak.Value

	local rewards = {}
	for day = 1, CYCLE_LENGTH do
		table.insert(rewards, DailyRewardConfig.GetReward(day))
	end

	return {
		canClaim = canClaim,
		streak = streak,
		lastClaimedDay = streak > 0 and getCycleDay(streak) or nil,
		nextDay = getCycleDay(getNextClaimDay(playerData)),
		timeUntilClaim = timeUntilClaim,
		cycleLength = CYCLE_LENGTH,
		rewards = rewards,
		-- Statistics
		longestStreak = playerData.LongestStreak.Value,
		totalClaimed = playerData.TotalDailyRewardsClaimed.Value,
		totalGoldEarned = playerData.TotalDailyGoldEarned.Value,
		totalGemsEarned = playerData.TotalDailyGemsEarned.Value,
	}
end

--// Claim handling

local claimDebounce: {[number]: boolean} = {}

local function grantSpecialReward(player: Player, playerData: Folder, rewardType: string, rewardId: string): boolean
	local item = DailyRewardItems.GetItem(rewardType, rewardId)
	if not item then
		warn("[DailyReward] Unknown special reward: " .. rewardType .. " - " .. rewardId)
		return false
	end

	if rewardType == "Pet" then
		-- Grant a pet
		local petInfo = DailyRewardItems.Pets[rewardId]
		if petInfo and petInfo.PetName then
			-- Find the pet template
			local petTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(petInfo.PetName)
			if petTemplate then
				-- Find next available pet slot
				local maxPetId = 0
				for _, pet in playerData.Parent.Pets:GetChildren() do
					local petId = tonumber(pet.Name)
					if petId and petId > maxPetId then
						maxPetId = petId
					end
				end

				local newPetId = maxPetId + 1
				local newPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				newPet.Name = tostring(newPetId)
				newPet.Equipped.Value = false
				newPet.PetName.Value = petInfo.PetName
				newPet.Parent = playerData.Parent.Pets

				print(("[DailyReward] %s received pet: %s"):format(player.Name, petInfo.PetName))
				return true
			else
				warn("[DailyReward] Pet template not found: " .. petInfo.PetName)
			end
		end
	elseif rewardType == "Booster" then
		-- TODO: Implement booster system
		-- For now, just log it
		print(("[DailyReward] %s received booster: %s"):format(player.Name, rewardId))
		return true
	elseif rewardType == "Title" then
		-- TODO: Implement title system
		-- For now, just log it
		print(("[DailyReward] %s received title: %s"):format(player.Name, rewardId))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function grantReward(player: Player, playerData: Folder, day: number): any
	local reward = DailyRewardConfig.GetReward(day)

	-- Check for gamepass bonus
	local gamepasses = playerData.Parent:FindFirstChild("Gamepasses")
	local hasBoostPass = false
	if gamepasses then
		local boostPass = gamepasses:FindFirstChild(DailyRewardConfig.GAMEPASS_NAME)
		if boostPass and boostPass.Value == true then
			hasBoostPass = true
			reward = DailyRewardConfig.ApplyGamepassBonus(reward, true)
		end
	end

	if reward.Currency > 0 then
		playerData.Currency.Value += reward.Currency
		playerData.TotalCurrency.Value += reward.Currency
		playerData.TotalDailyGoldEarned.Value += reward.Currency
	end

	if reward.Currency2 > 0 then
		playerData.Currency2.Value += reward.Currency2
		playerData.TotalDailyGemsEarned.Value += reward.Currency2
	end

	-- Update statistics
	playerData.TotalDailyRewardsClaimed.Value += 1

	-- Update longest streak if current streak is higher
	if day > playerData.LongestStreak.Value then
		playerData.LongestStreak.Value = day
	end

	-- Grant special rewards if any
	if reward.SpecialReward and reward.SpecialRewardId then
		grantSpecialReward(player, playerData, reward.SpecialReward, reward.SpecialRewardId)
	end

	return reward
end

ClaimRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if claimDebounce[player.UserId] then
		return
	end
	claimDebounce[player.UserId] = true

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if not isLoaded(player) then
			ClaimRemote:FireClient(player, false, "Not loaded")
			return
		end

		local playerData = getPlayerData(player)
		if not playerData then
			ClaimRemote:FireClient(player, false, "No data")
			return
		end

		if getTimeUntilClaim(playerData) > 0 then
			ClaimRemote:FireClient(player, false, "Already claimed")
			return
		end

		local newDay = getNextClaimDay(playerData)
		local reward = grantReward(player, playerData, newDay)

		playerData.DailyStreak.Value = newDay
		playerData.LastDailyClaim.Value = os.time()

		print(("[DailyReward] %s claimed day %d (+%d gold, +%d gems)"):format(
			player.Name, newDay, reward.Currency, reward.Currency2))

		-- Check for broadcast milestone
		if DailyRewardSocial.IsBroadcastMilestone(newDay) then
			local milestoneName = DailyRewardSocial.GetMilestoneName(newDay)
			DailyRewardSocial.BroadcastMilestone(player, newDay, milestoneName)
		end

		-- Update leaderboard
		DailyRewardSocial.UpdateLeaderboard()

		ClaimRemote:FireClient(player, true, newDay, reward)
	end)

	if not ok then
		warn("[DailyReward] Claim error for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end

	task.delay(1, function()
		claimDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end)

GetStateRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	if not isLoaded(player) then
		repeat
			task.wait(0.25)
		until isLoaded(player) or player.Parent == nil
	end

	if player.Parent == nil then
		return nil
	end

	return buildState(player)
end

GetLeaderboardRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, limit: number?)
	return DailyRewardSocial.GetStreakLeaderboard(limit or 100)
end

--// Cleanup

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	claimDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Notification monitoring
-- Check if players have rewards ready and send notifications
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(300) -- Check every 5 minutes

		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if not isLoaded(player) then
				continue
			end

			local playerData = getPlayerData(player)
			if not playerData then
				continue
			end

			local timeUntilClaim = getTimeUntilClaim(playerData)
			if timeUntilClaim <= 0 then
				-- Reward is ready, send notification
				local nextDay = getNextClaimDay(playerData)
				NotificationSystem.Send(player, {
					type = "DailyRewardReady",
					title = "Daily Reward Ready!",
					body = ("Day %d reward is ready to claim!"):format(nextDay),
					icon = "rbxassetid://0", -- Replace with your icon
					sound = "Notification",
					autoDismiss = false,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end)

print("[DailyReward] Service initialized")

--!strict
-- TalentEngine.lua
-- Pet talent rolling, application, stacking, and re-roll mechanics

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TalentEngine = {}
TalentEngine.__index = TalentEngine

-- ============================================
-- TALENT DEFINITIONS
-- ============================================

-- ============================================
-- RARITY SLOT CONFIGURATION
-- ============================================

export type RarityConfig = {
	slots: {min: number, max: number},
	tierWeights: {[number]: number}, -- tier -> weight
}

local RARITY_CONFIG: {[string]: RarityConfig} = {
	Common = {
		slots = {min = 1, max = 1},
		tierWeights = {1 = 80, 2 = 18, 3 = 2, 4 = 0, 5 = 0},
	},
	Uncommon = {
		slots = {min = 1, max = 2},
		tierWeights = {1 = 60, 2 = 30, 3 = 9, 4 = 1, 5 = 0},
	},
	Rare = {
		slots = {min = 2, max = 2},
		tierWeights = {1 = 40, 2 = 35, 3 = 20, 4 = 5, 5 = 0},
	},
	Epic = {
		slots = {min = 2, max = 3},
		tierWeights = {1 = 20, 2 = 30, 3 = 30, 4 = 15, 5 = 5},
	},
	Legendary = {
		slots = {min = 3, max = 3},
		tierWeights = {1 = 10, 2 = 20, 3 = 30, 4 = 30, 5 = 10},
	},
}

-- ============================================
-- TALENT ENGINE CORE
-- ============================================

function TalentEngine.GetTalent(talentId: string): Talent?
	return TALENT_REGISTRY[talentId]
end

function TalentEngine.GetAllTalents(): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		table.insert(result, talent)
	end
	return result
end

function TalentEngine.GetTalentsByCategory(category: string): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.category == category then
			table.insert(result, talent)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function TalentEngine.GetTalentsByTier(tier: number): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.tier == tier then
			table.insert(result, talent)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Weighted random selection
function TalentEngine.RollTalents(rarity: string): {{id: string, locked: boolean}}
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[rarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local slotCount = math.random(config.slots.min, config.slots.max)
	local results = {}
	
	-- Build weighted pool per tier
	local tierPools = {}
	for tier = 1, 5 do
		tierPools[tier] = {}
		for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
			if talent.tier == tier then
				table.insert(tierPools[tier], talent.id)
			end
		end
	end
	
	for i = 1, slotCount do
		-- Pick tier based on rarity weights
		local tier = TalentEngine._PickWeighted(config.tierWeights)
		local pool = tierPools[tier]
		
		if #pool > 0 then
			local talentId = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
			table.insert(results, {id = talentId, locked = false})
		end
	end
	
	return results
end

function TalentEngine._PickWeighted(weights: {[number]: number}): number
	local total = 0
	for _, w in weights do total += w end
	
	local roll = math.random(1, total)
	local cumulative = 0
	for tier, weight in weights do
		cumulative += weight
		if roll <= cumulative then
			return tier
		end
	end
	return 1
end

-- Re-roll a specific slot
export type RerollResult = {
	success: boolean,
	newTalentId: string?,
	error: string?,
	cost: number,
}

function TalentEngine.RerollTalent(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, petRarity: string): RerollResult
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[petRarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local slot = petData.Talents[slotIndex]
	
	if not slot then
		return {success = false, error = "Invalid slot index", cost = 0}
	end
	
	if slot.locked then
		return {success = false, error = "Slot is locked", cost = 0}
	end
	
	-- Calculate cost
	local slotCount = #petData.Talents
	local baseCost = 500 * (1.5 ^ (slotIndex - 1))
	local cost = math.floor(baseCost * (1 + (#petData.Talents - config.slots.min) * 0.5))
	
	-- Roll new talent from same tier distribution
	local tier = TalentEngine._PickWeighted(config.tierWeights)
	local tierPool = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.tier == tier then
			table.insert(tierPool, talent.id)
		end
	end
	
	if #tierPool == 0 then
		return {success = false, error = "No talents available", cost = 0}
	end
	
	local newTalentId = tierPool[math.random(1, #tierPool)]
	
	return {
		success = true,
		newTalentId = newTalentId,
		cost = cost,
	}
end

-- Lock/unlock talent slot
function TalentEngine.LockTalent(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, lock: boolean): boolean
	local slot = petData.Talents[slotIndex]
	if not slot then return false end
	
	slot.locked = lock
	return true
end

-- Calculate re-roll cost
function TalentEngine.GetRerollCost(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, petRarity: string): number
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[petRarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local baseCost = 500 * (1.5 ^ (slotIndex - 1))
	return math.floor(baseCost * (1 + (#petData.Talents - config.slots.min) * 0.5))
end

-- ============================================
-- TALENT APPLICATION ENGINE
-- ============================================

export type StatModifiers = {
	[multiplicative: string]: number,  -- multipliers (stack multiplicatively)
	[additive: string]: number,        -- flat additions
	[flat: string]: number,            -- flat values
	[chance: string]: number,          -- percentage chances
}

function TalentEngine.CalculateModifiers(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, baseStats: StatModifiers?): StatModifiers
	local modifiers: StatModifiers = {}
	
	-- Initialize with base stats
	if baseStats then
		for k, v in baseStats do
			modifiers[k] = v
		end
	end
	
	for _, slot in petData.Talents do
		local talent = TALENT_REGISTRY[slot.id]
		if not talent then continue end
		
		local effect = talent.effect
		local stat = effect.stat
		local value = effect.value
		
		if effect.type == "Multiply" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 1) * value
		elseif effect.type == "Add" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 0) + value
		elseif effect.type == "Flat" then
			modifiers[stat] = value
		elseif effect.type == "Chance" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 0) + value
		end
	end
	
	return modifiers
end

function TalentEngine.ApplyToPetMultipliers(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, petMultipliers: any)
	local modifiers = TalentEngine.CalculateModifiers(petData)
	
	-- Apply to PetMultipliers module (integration point)
	for stat, value in modifiers do
		if petMultipliers[stat] then
			if type(petMultipliers[stat]) == "number" then
				petMultipliers[stat] = petMultipliers[stat] * value
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Get talent display info for UI
function TalentEngine.GetTalentDisplayInfo(talentId: string): {name: string, description: string, tier: number, category: string, icon: string}
	local talent = TALENT_REGISTRY[talentId]
	if not talent then
		return {name = "Unknown", description = "", tier = 1, category = "Unknown", icon = "?"}
	end
	
	return {
		name = talent.name,
		description = talent.description,
		tier = talent.tier,
		category = talent.category,
		icon = TalentEngine._GetCategoryIcon(talent.category),
	}
end

function TalentEngine._GetCategoryIcon(category: string): string
	local icons = {
		Hatching = "🥚",
		Combat = "⚔️",
		Movement = "🏃",
		Economy = "💰",
		Utility = "🔧",
	}
	return icons[category] or "✨"
end

-- Validation
function TalentEngine.ValidateTalents(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}): boolean
	for _, slot in petData.Talents do
		if not TALENT_REGISTRY[slot.id] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Get all talents for a category (for UI filtering)
function TalentEngine.GetTalentsForUI(): {{category: string, talents: {Talent}}}
	local categories = {"Hatching", "Combat", "Movement", "Economy", "Utility"}
	local result = {}
	
	for _, cat in categories do
		local talents = TalentEngine.GetTalentsByCategory(cat)
		table.sort(talents, function(a, b) return a.tier < b.tier end)
		table.insert(result, {category = cat, talents = talents})
	end
	
	return result
end

return TalentEngine

local Particles = {}

Particles.PlayParticle = function(Parent, Particle, EmitCount, Properties)
	local suc,er = spawn(function()
		if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Data.Settings.Effects.Value then
			local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
			Attachment.Parent = Parent
			local NewParticle = Particle:Clone()
			NewParticle.Color = Properties.Color or NewParticle.Color
			NewParticle.Parent = Attachment
			
			NewParticle:Emit(EmitCount)
			task.wait(NewParticle.Lifetime.Max * 2)
			Attachment:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	
	if er then warn(er) end
end

return Particles

--!strict
-- EmoteWheel.lua
-- Radial emote selection wheel for quick access

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local EmoteWheel = {}
EmoteWheel.__index = EmoteWheel

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	radius = 150,
	buttonSize = 70,
	maxButtons = 8,
	openKey = Enum.KeyCode.G,
	animationDuration = 0.25,
}

function EmoteWheel.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, EmoteWheel)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.isOpen = false
	self.buttons = {}
	self.gui = nil
	self.emoteEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EmoteEngine)
	return self
end

function EmoteWheel:_createGui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "EmoteWheel"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 250
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local wheel = Instance.new("Frame")
	wheel.Name = "Wheel"
	wheel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius * 2, self.config.radius * 2)
	wheel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	wheel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	wheel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wheel.Visible = false
	wheel.Parent = gui

	-- Center hub
	local center = Instance.new("Frame")
	center.Name = "Center"
	center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
	center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	center.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	center.BorderSizePixel = 0
	center.Parent = wheel

	local centerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	centerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	centerCorner.Parent = center

	local centerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	centerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	centerStroke.Thickness = 2
	centerStroke.Transparency = 0.3
	centerStroke.Parent = center

	local centerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	centerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	centerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	centerLabel.Text = "EMOTES"
	centerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	centerLabel.TextSize = 12
	centerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
	centerLabel.Parent = center

	self.wheel = wheel
	self.gui = gui
end

function EmoteWheel:Toggle()
	if self.isOpen then
		self:Close()
	else
		self:Open()
	end
end

function EmoteWheel:Open()
	if self.isOpen then return end
	self.isOpen = true
	self.wheel.Visible = true
	self:_updateButtons()
	
	self.wheel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(self.wheel, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius * 2, self.config.radius * 2)
	}):Play()
	
	-- Listen for close
	self._closeConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and (input.KeyCode == self.config.openKey or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
			self:Close()
		end
	end)
end

function EmoteWheel:Close()
	if not self.isOpen then return end
	self.isOpen = false
	
	if self._closeConnection then
		self._closeConnection:Disconnect()
		self._closeConnection = nil
	end
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(self.wheel, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(self.config.animationDuration)
	self.wheel.Visible = false
end

function EmoteWheel:_updateButtons()
	-- Clear old buttons
	for _, btn in self.buttons do
		btn:Destroy()
	end
	self.buttons = {}

	local ownedEmotes = self.emoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(player.UserId)
	local emotesToShow = {}
	
	for _, emoteId in ipairs(ownedEmotes) do
		local emote = self.emoteEngine.GetEmote(emoteId)
		if emote then
			table.insert(emotesToShow, emote)
		end
	end
	
	if #emotesToShow == 0 then
		-- Show placeholder
		local frame = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Text = "No emotes unlocked"
		frame.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		frame.TextSize = 16
		frame.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
		frame.Parent = self.wheel
		return
	end

	-- Limit to max buttons
	local angleStep = (2 * math.pi) / math.min(#emotesToShow, self.config.maxButtons)
	local startAngle = -math.pi / 2

	for i, emote in ipairs(emotesToShow) do
		if i > self.config.maxButtons then break end
		
		local angle = startAngle + (i - 1) * angleStep
		local x = self.config.radius * 0.7 * math.cos(angle)
		local y = self.config.radius * 0.7 * math.sin(angle)

		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Name = emote.id
		btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.buttonSize, self.config.buttonSize)
		btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius + x, self.config.radius + y)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 48)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Text = ""
		btn.Parent = self.wheel

		local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		btnCorner.Parent = btn

		local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
		btnStroke.Thickness = 1.5
		btnStroke.Transparency = 0.4
		btnStroke.Parent = btn

		local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
		icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.1)
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		icon.Text = self.emoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emote.id)
		icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		icon.TextSize = 28
		icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		icon.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
		icon.Parent = btn

		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3)
		name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.7)
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Text = emote.name
		name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		name.TextSize = 10
		name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 230)
		name.TextWrapped = true
		name.Parent = btn

		-- Cooldown overlay
		local cooldownOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
		cooldownOverlay.Name = "CooldownOverlay"
		cooldownOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		cooldownOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		cooldownOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
		cooldownOverlay.Visible = false
		cooldownOverlay.ZIndex = 2
		cooldownOverlay.Parent = btn

		local overlayCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		overlayCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		overlayCorner.Parent = cooldownOverlay

		local cdText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		cdText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		cdText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cdText.Text = ""
		cdText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		cdText.TextSize = 16
		cdText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		cdText.Parent = cooldownOverlay

		-- Hover effects
		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 70)
			}):Play()
		end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 48)
			}):Play()
		end)

		btn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self.emoteEngine.TriggerEmote(player.UserId, emote.id) then
				self:Close()
			end
		end)

		-- Cooldown update
		task.spawn(function()
			while btn.Parent do
				local cd = self.emoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(player.UserId, emote.id)
				if cd > 0 then
					cooldownOverlay.Visible = true
					cdText.Text = string.format("%.1fs", cd)
				else
					cooldownOverlay.Visible = false
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end)

		table.insert(self.buttons, btn)
	end
end

function EmoteWheel:IsOpen()
	return self.isOpen
end

function EmoteWheel:Destroy()
	if self._closeConnection then
		self._closeConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return EmoteWheel

--// Services
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)
