--!strict
-- ServerInit.luau
-- Server-side initialization for all new systems

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Wait for Remotes folder
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

-- ============================================
-- CREATE REMOTE EVENTS
-- ============================================

local function createRemote(name: string, className: string?): RemoteEvent | RemoteFunction
	local remote = Instance.new(className or "RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = Remotes
	return remote
end

-- Auction House
createRemote("Auction_PlaceBuyOrder")
createRemote("Auction_CancelBuyOrder")
createRemote("Auction_GetHistory")
createRemote("Auction_GetListings")
createRemote("Auction_CreateListing")
createRemote("Auction_GetWatchlist")
createRemote("Auction_AddWatchlist")
createRemote("Auction_RemoveWatchlist")
createRemote("Auction_SetSnipingThreshold")

-- Notifications
createRemote("Notification_RequestSettings")
createRemote("Notification_UpdateSettings")
createRemote("Notification_SendToClient")

-- Leaderboards
createRemote("Leaderboard_GetLeaderboard")
createRemote("Leaderboard_GetPlayerRank")
createRemote("Leaderboard_GetSeasonSnapshot")
createRemote("Leaderboard_ClaimReward")
createRemote("Leaderboard_GetPendingRewards")

-- Emotes
createRemote("Emote_Trigger")
createRemote("Emote_GetOwned")
createRemote("Emote_GetEquipped")
createRemote("Emote_SetEquipped")

-- Pet Talents
createRemote("Pet_RerollTalent")
createRemote("Pet_LockTalent")
createRemote("Pet_GetTalents")

-- Visual Effects
createRemote("Effect_Trigger")

-- ============================================
-- LOAD SERVER MODULES
-- ============================================

local AuctionEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AuctionEngine)
local LeaderboardEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.LeaderboardEngine)
local EmoteEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EmoteEngine)
local TalentEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine)
local NotificationSystem = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NotificationSystem)

-- ============================================
- REMOTE HANDLERS
-- ============================================

-- Auction House
Remotes.Auction_PlaceBuyOrder.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId, maxPrice, quantity, durationHours)
	local success, orderId, err = AuctionEngine.PlaceBuyOrder(player.UserId, itemId, maxPrice, quantity, durationHours)
	Remotes.Auction_PlaceBuyOrder:FireClient(player, success, orderId, err)
end)

Remotes.Auction_CancelBuyOrder.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, orderId)
	local success = AuctionEngine.CancelBuyOrder(player.UserId, orderId)
	Remotes.Auction_CancelBuyOrder:FireClient(player, success)
end)

Remotes.Auction_GetHistory.OnServerInvoke = function(player, itemId, bucketType, fromTimestamp, toTimestamp)
	return AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, bucketType, fromTimestamp, toTimestamp)
end

Remotes.Auction_GetListings.OnServerInvoke = function(player, itemId)
	return AuctionEngine.GetActiveListings(itemId)
end

Remotes.Auction_CreateListing.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId, price, quantity, durationHours)
	local success, listingId = AuctionEngine.CreateListing(player.UserId, itemId, price, quantity, durationHours)
	Remotes.Auction_CreateListing:FireClient(player, success, listingId)
end

Remotes.Auction_GetWatchlist.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return AuctionEngine.GetWatchlistData(player.UserId)
end

Remotes.Auction_AddWatchlist.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId)
	AuctionEngine.AddToWatchlist(player.UserId, itemId)
end)

Remotes.Auction_RemoveWatchlist.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId)
	AuctionEngine.RemoveFromWatchlist(player.UserId, itemId)
end)

Remotes.Auction_SetSnipingThreshold.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId, threshold)
	AuctionEngine.SetSnipingThreshold(player.UserId, itemId, threshold)
end)

-- Notifications
Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return NotificationSystem.GetSettings()
end

Remotes.Notification_UpdateSettings.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, newSettings)
	NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings(newSettings)
end)

-- Leaderboards
Remotes.Leaderboard_GetLeaderboard.OnServerInvoke = function(player, categoryId, limit)
	return LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId, limit)
end

Remotes.Leaderboard_GetPlayerRank.OnServerInvoke = function(player, categoryId)
	return LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(player.UserId, categoryId)
end

Remotes.Leaderboard_GetSeasonSnapshot.OnServerInvoke = function(player, seasonId, categoryId)
	return LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonSnapshot(seasonId, categoryId)
end

Remotes.Leaderboard_ClaimReward.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, seasonId, categoryId)
	local success, rewards = LeaderboardEngine.ClaimReward(player.UserId, seasonId, categoryId)
	Remotes.Leaderboard_ClaimReward:FireClient(player, success, rewards)
end

Remotes.Leaderboard_GetPendingRewards.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return LeaderboardEngine.GetPendingRewards(player.UserId)
end

-- Emotes
Remotes.Emote_Trigger.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, emoteId)
	local success = EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
	Remotes.Emote_Trigger:FireClient(player, success)
end)

Remotes.Emote_GetOwned.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return EmoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(player.UserId)
end

Remotes.Emote_GetEquipped.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return EmoteEngine.GetEquipped(player.UserId)
end

Remotes.Emote_SetEquipped.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, emoteId)
	local success = EmoteEngine.SetEquipped(player.UserId, emoteId)
	Remotes.Emote_SetEquipped:FireClient(player, success)
end)

-- Pet Talents
Remotes.Pet_RerollTalent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, slotIndex)
	-- Get pet data from player's pet folder
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local folder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	
	if not pet then
		Remotes.Pet_RerollTalent:FireClient(player, false, "Pet not found")
		return
	end
	
	local petData = {
		Talents = pet:GetAttribute("Talents") or {},
		Rarity = pet:GetAttribute("Rarity") or "Common",
	}
	
	local result = TalentEngine.RerollTalent(petData, slotIndex, petData.Rarity)
	
	if result.success then
		-- Update pet attribute
		local talents = pet:GetAttribute("Talents") or {}
		if talents[slotIndex] then
			talents[slotIndex] = {id = result.newTalentId, locked = false}
			pet:SetAttribute("Talents", talents)
		end
	end
	
	Remotes.Pet_RerollTalent:FireClient(player, result.success, result.newTalentId, result.error, result.cost)
end)

Remotes.Pet_LockTalent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, slotIndex, lock)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local folder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	
	if not pet then
		Remotes.Pet_LockTalent:FireClient(player, false)
		return
	end
	
	local talents = pet:GetAttribute("Talents") or {}
	if talents[slotIndex] then
		talents[slotIndex].locked = lock
		pet:SetAttribute("Talents", talents)
		Remotes.Pet_LockTalent:FireClient(player, true)
	else
		Remotes.Pet_LockTalent:FireClient(player, false)
	end
end)

Remotes.Pet_GetTalents.OnServerInvoke = function(player, petId)
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	local folder = playerPets and playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	
	if not pet then return {} end
	return pet:GetAttribute("Talents") or {}
end

-- Visual Effects (server->client)
Remotes.Effect_Trigger.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, effectName, position, intensity, params)
	-- Broadcast to nearby players
	local radius = 50
	for _, otherPlayer in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if otherPlayer ~= player then
			local char = otherPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp and (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude <= radius then
				Remotes.Effect_Trigger:FireClient(otherPlayer, effectName, position, intensity, params)
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Also send to the triggering player
	Remotes.Effect_Trigger:FireClient(player, effectName, position, intensity, params)
end)

-- ============================================
-- PLAYER DATA SYNC
-- ============================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.wait(1)
	
	-- Initialize emotes
	for emoteId, emote in pairs(require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EmoteEngine).GetAllEmotes()) do
		if emote.tier == "Starter" then
			EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(player.UserId, emote.id)
		end
	end
	
	-- Check unlock conditions
	EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(player.UserId)
	
	-- Send notification settings
	Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings:FireClient(player, NotificationSystem.GetSettings())
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	-- Cleanup
	local TalentEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine)
	-- Any cleanup needed
end)

-- ============================================
-- SEASON INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Check if we need to start a season
	local LeaderboardEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.LeaderboardEngine)
	
	-- Check for active season on startup
	-- In production, would check DataStore for active season
	task.wait(5)
	
	-- Start weekly season if it's Monday
	local now = os.time()
	local today = os.date("*t", now).wday -- 1 = Sunday
	if today == 2 then -- Monday
		LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "weekly"})
	end
	
	-- Monthly on 1st
	if os.date("*t", now).day == 1 then
		LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "monthly"})
	end
end

print("[ServerInit] All systems initialized successfully")

-- Variables used in tracking if the character is using a ControllerManager.
-- This implementation assumes the common case of the ControllerManager being a
-- child of the character, and that only one ControllerManager exists under a given
-- character. If a ControllerManager is not placed under its associated character,
-- then it will not be detected by this script.
-- The basis for this decision is performance: A ChildAdded listener on the
-- character is less of a performance hit than a ChildAdded listener on the
-- Workspace. And a FindFirstChild is more performant than checking for multiple
-- controllers via GetChildren.
local groundSensorChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerRootChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerParentChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local charGroundSensor:ControllerPartSensor? = nil
local charControllerManager:ControllerManager? = nil

local CCLAnimationFixed
do
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return UserSettings():IsUserFeatureEnabled("UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed")
	end)
	CCLAnimationFixed = success and result
end

-- Clean up listeners associated with the character's ControllerManager
function resetManagerListeners()
	if groundSensorChangedListener then
		groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
		groundSensorChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerRootChangedListener then
		managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerRootChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerParentChangedListener then
		managerParentChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerParentChangedListener = nil
	end
end

-- Clean up all listeners and reset state.
function teardownManager()
	resetManagerListeners()
	charGroundSensor = nil
	charControllerManager = nil
end

-- Returns true if checkManager controls the character associated with this script
-- If so, then checkManager is assigned to charControllerManager.
-- TODO: Remove this method when UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed is made permanently true.
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager:ControllerManager):boolean
	if checkManager.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
		if charControllerManager ~= checkManager then
			resetManagerListeners()
			charGroundSensor = checkManager.GroundSensor
			groundSensorChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
					groundSensorChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerRootChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
					managerRootChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerParentChangedListener = checkManager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
				if parent == nil then
					resetManagerListeners()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			charControllerManager = checkManager
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Attach to a confirmed-valid manager: record it, read its current GroundSensor,
-- and watch for GroundSensor changes, RootPart changes, and removal.
function setupManager(manager:ControllerManager)
	charControllerManager = manager
	charGroundSensor = manager.GroundSensor

	groundSensorChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		charGroundSensor = charControllerManager.GroundSensor
	end)

	managerRootChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		if manager.RootPart ~= Character.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)

	managerParentChangedListener = manager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end

-- Looks for the first ControllerManager directly childed to the character. If such
-- a controller does not exist or if it does not control that character, then a listener
-- is set up to check if a controller is ever added.
function lookForControllerManager()
	if CCLAnimationFixed then
		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(child)
			else
				-- Manager exists but RootPart not yet assigned; wait for it.
				local rootPartListener:RBXScriptSignal
				rootPartListener = child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
						rootPartListener:Disconnect()
						setupManager(child)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(newChild)
				if newChild:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		charGroundSensor = nil
		charControllerManager = nil

		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child)
		end
		-- The call to processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter above will have
		-- assigned charControllerManager on success
		if charControllerManager == nil then
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child) then
						managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
						managerAddedListener = nil
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(set, anim)
	if set == nil or anim == nil then
		return 0
	end

	for idx = 1, set.count, 1 do
		if set[idx].anim.AnimationId == anim.AnimationId then
			return idx
		end
	end

	return 0
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	local allowCustomAnimations = true

	local success, msg = pcall(function() allowCustomAnimations = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations end)
	if not success then
		allowCustomAnimations = true
	end

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (allowCustomAnimations and config ~= nil) then
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))

		local idx = 0
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				local newWeight = 1
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject ~= nil) then
					newWeight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				idx = animTable[name].count
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				animTable[name][idx].weight = newWeight
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildAdded:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildRemoved:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
		end
	end

	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do
			if PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
				PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end

	if currentlyPlayingEmote then
		oldAnim = "idle"
		currentlyPlayingEmote = false
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end

	-- clean up walk if there is one
	if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		runAnimTrack:Stop()
		runAnimTrack:Destroy()
		runAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function getHeightScale()
	if Humanoid then
		if not Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
			-- When auto scaling is not enabled, the rig scale stands in for
			-- a computed scale.
			return getRigScale()
		end

		local scale = Humanoid.HipHeight / HumanoidHipHeight
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject == nil then
			AnimationSpeedDampeningObject = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
		end
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject ~= nil then
			scale = 1 + (Humanoid.HipHeight - HumanoidHipHeight) * AnimationSpeedDampeningObject.Value / HumanoidHipHeight
		end
		return scale
	end
	return getRigScale()
end

local function rootMotionCompensation(speed)
	local speedScaled = speed * 1.25
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()
	local runSpeed = speedScaled / heightScale
	return runSpeed
end

local smallButNotZero = 0.0001
local function setRunSpeed(speed)
	local normalizedWalkSpeed = 0.5 -- established empirically using current `913402848` walk animation
	local normalizedRunSpeed  = 1
	local runSpeed = rootMotionCompensation(speed)

	local walkAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local runAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local timeWarp = 1

	if runSpeed <= normalizedWalkSpeed then
		walkAnimationWeight = 1
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedWalkSpeed
	elseif runSpeed < normalizedRunSpeed then
		local fadeInRun = (runSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)/(normalizedRunSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)
		walkAnimationWeight = 1 - fadeInRun
		runAnimationWeight  = fadeInRun
	else
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedRunSpeed
		runAnimationWeight = 1
	end
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(walkAnimationWeight)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(runAnimationWeight)
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if currentAnim == "walk" then
		setRunSpeed(speed)
	else
		if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
			currentAnimSpeed = speed
			currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		if currentAnim == "walk" then
			if runAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
			if currentAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
		else
			local repeatAnim = currentAnim
			-- return to idle if finishing an emote
			if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
				repeatAnim = "idle"
			end

			if currentlyPlayingEmote then
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped then
					-- Allow the emote to loop
					return
				end

				repeatAnim = "idle"
				currentlyPlayingEmote = false
			end

			local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
			playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.15, Humanoid)
			setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function rollAnimation(animName)
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight)
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
	return idx
end

local function switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	-- switch animation
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then

		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			runAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			runAnimTrack:Destroy()
			runAnimTrack = nil
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)

		-- check to see if we need to blend a walk/run animation
		if animName == "walk" then
			local runAnimName = "run"
			local runIdx = rollAnimation(runAnimName)

			runAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animTable[runAnimName][runIdx].anim)
			runAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			runAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)

			if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
				runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
			end
			runAnimKeyframeHandler = runAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = false
end

function playEmote(emoteAnim, transitionTime, humanoid)
	switchToAnim(emoteAnim, emoteAnim.Name, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = true
end

	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()

-- STATE CHANGE HANDLERS

function onRunning(speed)
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()

	-- Adjust the walking speed if a ControllerManager is being used.
	-- "speed" is world speed, whereas we want local speed.
	-- IE, do not animate a walk if the character is stationary atop
	-- a moving platform.
	if charGroundSensor ~= nil and Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local hrp = Humanoid.RootPart
		local sensedPart = charGroundSensor.SensedPart
		if sensedPart then
			local pos = charGroundSensor.HitFrame.Position
			local floorVel = sensedPart:GetVelocityAtPosition(pos)
			local assemblyVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			-- Ignore y-velocity, so that jumping does not influence the animation speed
			local relVel = Vector3.new(assemblyVel.X - floorVel.X, 0, assemblyVel.Z - floorVel.Z)
			local relSpeed = relVel.Magnitude
			local moveMag = charControllerManager.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if moveMag < 0.1 then
				relSpeed = 0
				moveMag = 0
			elseif moveMag > 1.0 then
				moveMag = 1.0
			end
			speed = relSpeed * moveMag
		end
	end

	local movedDuringEmote = currentlyPlayingEmote and Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local speedThreshold = movedDuringEmote and (Humanoid.WalkSpeed / heightScale) or 0.75
	if speed > speedThreshold * heightScale then
		local scale = 16.0
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(speed / scale)
		pose = "Running"
	else
		if emoteNames[currentAnim] == nil and not currentlyPlayingEmote then
			playAnimation("idle", 0.2, Humanoid)
			pose = "Standing"
		end
	end
end

end

function onJumping()
	playAnimation("jump", 0.1, Humanoid)

function getToolAnim(tool)

		if c.Name == "toolanim" and c.className == "StringValue" then
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local lastTick = 0

function stepAnimate(currentTime)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
	local deltaTime = currentTime - lastTick
	lastTick = currentTime

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = currentTime + .3
		end

		if currentTime > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

-- connect events
Humanoid.Died:connect(onDied)
Humanoid.Running:connect(onRunning)
Humanoid.Jumping:connect(onJumping)
Humanoid.Climbing:connect(onClimbing)
Humanoid.GettingUp:connect(onGettingUp)
Humanoid.FreeFalling:connect(onFreeFall)
Humanoid.FallingDown:connect(onFallingDown)
Humanoid.Seated:connect(onSeated)
Humanoid.PlatformStanding:connect(onPlatformStanding)
Humanoid.Swimming:connect(onSwimming)

if not FFlagUserAnimateRemoveEmoteChatHook then
	-- setup emote chat hook
	game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Chatted:connect(function(msg)
		local emote = ""
		if (string.sub(msg, 1, 3) == "/e ") then
			emote = string.sub(msg, 4)
		elseif (string.sub(msg, 1, 7) == "/emote ") then
			emote = string.sub(msg, 8)
		end

		if (pose == "Standing" and emoteNames[emote] ~= nil) then
			playAnimation(emote, EMOTE_TRANSITION_TIME, Humanoid)
		end
	end)
end
	
-- emote bindable hook
script:WaitForChild("PlayEmote").OnInvoke = function(emote)
	-- Only play emotes when idling
	if pose ~= "Standing" then
		return
	end

	if emoteNames[emote] ~= nil then
		-- Default emotes
		playAnimation(emote, EMOTE_TRANSITION_TIME, Humanoid)

		return true, currentAnimTrack
	elseif typeof(emote) == "Instance" and emote:IsA("Animation") then
		-- Non-default emotes
		playEmote(emote, EMOTE_TRANSITION_TIME, Humanoid)

		return true, currentAnimTrack
	end

	-- Return false to indicate that the emote could not be played
	return false
end

if Character.Parent ~= nil then
	-- initialize to idle
	playAnimation("idle", 0.1, Humanoid)
	pose = "Standing"
end

-- loop to handle timed state transitions and tool animations
while Character.Parent ~= nil do
	local _, currentGameTime = wait(0.1)
	stepAnimate(currentGameTime)
end

--!strict
-- DailyRewardConfig.luau
-- Shared configuration for the Daily Login Reward system

local DailyRewardConfig = {}

-- Minimum hours between claims (20h so players don't lose streak from slight schedule drift)
DailyRewardConfig.CLAIM_COOLDOWN_HOURS = 20

-- Streak resets to day 1 if no claim within this window after the cooldown opens
DailyRewardConfig.STREAK_RESET_HOURS = 48

export type RewardData = {
	Currency: number,
	Currency2: number,
	BonusMultiplier: number?, -- Weekend/milestone bonus multiplier
	SpecialReward: string?, -- "Pet", "Booster", "Title", etc.
	SpecialRewardId: string?, -- Identifier for the special reward
	IsWeekendBonus: boolean?,
	IsMilestone: boolean?,
}

-- Base 7-day cycle rewards (significantly improved progression)
local Rewards: {RewardData} = {
	{Currency = 1000, Currency2 = 5}, -- Day 1: Better starting reward
	{Currency = 2500, Currency2 = 10}, -- Day 2
	{Currency = 5000, Currency2 = 15}, -- Day 3
	{Currency = 7500, Currency2 = 25}, -- Day 4
	{Currency = 12500, Currency2 = 35}, -- Day 5
	{Currency = 20000, Currency2 = 50, IsWeekendBonus = true, BonusMultiplier = 1.5}, -- Day 6 (Saturday bonus)
	{Currency = 50000, Currency2 = 100, IsWeekendBonus = true, BonusMultiplier = 2.0, IsMilestone = true}, -- Day 7 (Week milestone)
}

-- Milestone bonuses for long streaks
local MilestoneRewards = {
	[7] = {Currency = 10000, Currency2 = 25, SpecialReward = "Title", SpecialRewardId = "WeekWarrior"},
	[14] = {Currency = 25000, Currency2 = 75, SpecialReward = "Booster", SpecialRewardId = "2xGold_1h"},
	[30] = {Currency = 100000, Currency2 = 250, SpecialReward = "Pet", SpecialRewardId = "DailyDevotion"},
	[60] = {Currency = 250000, Currency2 = 500, SpecialReward = "Title", SpecialRewardId = "CommitmentKing"},
	[90] = {Currency = 500000, Currency2 = 1000, SpecialReward = "Pet", SpecialRewardId = "StreakLegend"},
	[180] = {Currency = 1000000, Currency2 = 2500, SpecialReward = "Title", SpecialRewardId = "DailyDedication"},
	[365] = {Currency = 5000000, Currency2 = 10000, SpecialReward = "Pet", SpecialRewardId = "YearOne"},
}

-- Returns reward table for a given day (1-based). Day 7 repeats for ongoing streaks.
function DailyRewardConfig.GetReward(day: number): RewardData
	local index = ((day - 1) % #Rewards) + 1
	local baseReward = table.clone(Rewards[index])

	-- Check for milestone bonus
	if MilestoneRewards[day] then
		local milestone = MilestoneRewards[day]
		baseReward.Currency += milestone.Currency
		baseReward.Currency2 += milestone.Currency2
		baseReward.SpecialReward = milestone.SpecialReward
		baseReward.SpecialRewardId = milestone.SpecialRewardId
		baseReward.IsMilestone = true
	end

	-- Apply bonus multiplier if present
	if baseReward.BonusMultiplier then
		baseReward.Currency = math.floor(baseReward.Currency * baseReward.BonusMultiplier)
		baseReward.Currency2 = math.floor(baseReward.Currency2 * baseReward.BonusMultiplier)
	end

	return baseReward
end

function DailyRewardConfig.GetCycleLength(): number
	return #Rewards
end

-- Check if a specific day is a milestone
function DailyRewardConfig.IsMilestone(day: number): boolean
	return MilestoneRewards[day] ~= nil
end

-- Get milestone reward info
function DailyRewardConfig.GetMilestoneInfo(day: number): RewardData?
	return MilestoneRewards[day]
end

-- Get all milestone days
function DailyRewardConfig.GetMilestoneDays(): {number}
	local days = {}
	for day, _ in pairs(MilestoneRewards) do
		table.insert(days, day)
	end
	table.sort(days)
	return days
end

-- Check if today is weekend (Saturday or Sunday - days 6, 7 in cycle)
function DailyRewardConfig.IsWeekendDay(cycleDay: number): boolean
	return cycleDay == 6 or cycleDay == 7
end

-- Gamepass bonuses - Uses centralized Multipliers module
-- DailyRewardConfig.GAMEPASS_MULTIPLIER = 2.0 -- Moved to Multipliers module
-- DailyRewardConfig.GAMEPASS_NAME = "DailyRewardBoost" -- Name in Gamepasses folder

-- Apply gamepass multiplier to rewards
function DailyRewardConfig.ApplyGamepassBonus(reward: RewardData, hasGamepass: boolean): RewardData
	if not hasGamepass then
		return reward
	end

	local boostedReward = table.clone(reward)
	local multiplier = 2.0 -- DailyRewardBoost is 2x
	boostedReward.Currency = math.floor(boostedReward.Currency * multiplier)
	boostedReward.Currency2 = math.floor(boostedReward.Currency2 * multiplier)
	return boostedReward
end

return DailyRewardConfig

local function canPerformAction()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastAction < ACTION_COOLDOWN then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function triggerCooldown()
	lastAction = os.clock()
	cooldownOverlay.Visible = true
	TweenService:Create(cooldownOverlay, TweenInfo.new(ACTION_COOLDOWN), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	task.delay(ACTION_COOLDOWN, function()
		cooldownOverlay.Visible = false
		cooldownOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
	end)
end

--// Update UI
local function updatePetInfo(data)
	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))

	local level = tonumber(data.level) or 1
	levelLabel.Text = "Level " .. level

	local state = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	stateLabel.Text = state

	local stateColor = stateColors[state] or stateColors.Follow
	TweenService:Create(stateBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundColor3 = stateColor.bg}):Play()
	stateLabel.TextColor3 = stateColor.text

	local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(data.mood) or 0, 0, 100)
	local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(data.hunger) or 0, 0, 100)
	local energy = math.clamp(tonumber(data.energy) or 0, 0, 100)
	local xp = tonumber(data.experience) or 0
	local xpNeeded = level * 100

	TweenService:Create(moodFill, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(hungerFill, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(energyFill, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(energy / 100, 1)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(xpFill, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(xp / xpNeeded, 0, 1), 1)}):Play()

	moodValue.Text = math.floor(mood) .. "%"
	hungerValue.Text = math.floor(hunger) .. "%"
	energyValue.Text = math.floor(energy) .. "%"
	xpValue.Text = math.floor(xp) .. "/" .. xpNeeded

	local moodColor = mood >= 70 and THEME.Success or mood >= 35 and THEME.Warning or THEME.Danger
	TweenService:Create(moodFill, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundColor3 = moodColor}):Play()

	-- Update button states based on energy/resources
	local actionRequirements = {
		Play = {energy = 15},
		Train = {energy = 25, hunger = 30},
		Attack = {energy = 10},
		Scavenge = {energy = 20},
	}

	for action, requirements in pairs(actionRequirements) do
		local btn = buttonMap[action]
		if btn then
			local canUse = true
			if requirements.energy and energy < requirements.energy then
				canUse = false
			end
			if requirements.hunger and hunger < requirements.hunger then
				canUse = false
			end

			local baseColor = btn:GetAttribute("BaseColor")
			local targetColor = canUse and baseColor or Color3.new(
				baseColor.R * 0.4,
				baseColor.G * 0.4,
				baseColor.B * 0.4
			)
			TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = targetColor}):Play()

			local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if stroke then
				TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Transparency = canUse and 0.7 or 0.9}):Play()
			end
		end
	end

	if not panel.Visible then
		tweenOpen()
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(15, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenClose()
		end
	end)
end

feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.action == "Needs" then
		if panel.Visible and data.petId and data.petId == currentPetId then
			updatePetInfo(data)
		end
		return
	end
	if data.action == "LevelUp" then
		local notification = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Notifications")
		if notification and notification:FindFirstChild("Show") then
			notification.Show:Fire("🌟 " .. (data.message or "Level Up!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100))
		end
		showActionFeedback(data.message or "Your pet leveled up!", THEME.Experience, false)
	end
	if data.action == "Denied" then
		showActionFeedback(data.message or "Action denied", THEME.Danger, true)
		return
	end
	if not visibleActions[data.action] then return end

	-- Show feedback for failed actions (too tired, insufficient resources)
	if data.message and (
		string.find(data.message, "too tired") or
		string.find(data.message, "needs more") or
		string.find(data.message, "not enough")
	) then
		showActionFeedback(data.message, THEME.Warning, true)
	elseif data.message and data.action ~= "Needs" then
		local color = stateColors[data.action] and stateColors[data.action].bg or THEME.Primary
		showActionFeedback(data.message, color, false)
	end

	updatePetInfo(data)
	if data.action == "Inventory" then
		local frames = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GameUI") and playerGui.GameUI:FindFirstChild("Frames")
		local petFrame = frames and frames:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if petFrame then
			petFrame.Visible = true
			local blocker = petFrame:FindFirstChild("SideFrameBlocker")
			if blocker then blocker.Visible = true end
		end
	end
end)

		end

end

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

		if pet:IsA("Folder") then newest = pet end
	end

		selectedPetId = newest.Name
		selectedText.Text = "Selected pet: " .. tostring(newest.PetName.Value)
		accessoryPanel.Visible = true
	end
end

local currentState
local function updateEvent(state)
	currentState = state
	if type(state) ~= "table" or not state.Active then
		banner.Visible = false
		return
	end
	banner.Visible = true
	eventTitle.Text = state.Name or "WORLD EVENT"
	description.Text = state.Description or ""
	local progress = tonumber(state.ObjectiveProgress) or 0
	local target = math.max(1, tonumber(state.ObjectiveTarget) or 1)
	objective.Text = string.format("%s  %d / %d", state.ObjectiveText or "Shared objective", progress, target)
	participation.Text = state.ObjectiveCompleted and "Objective complete! Rewards will be granted when the event ends." or "Contribute to earn the completion reward."
	participation.TextColor3 = state.ObjectiveCompleted and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 220, 175)
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / target, 0, 1), 1)
end

for _, name in {"Active", "Description", "EndsAt", "ObjectiveText", "ObjectiveProgress", "ObjectiveTarget", "ObjectiveCompleted"} do
	worldEvents:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
		local state = currentState or {}
		state.Active = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Active")
		state.Name = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Name")
		state.Description = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Description")
		state.EndsAt = worldEvents:GetAttribute("EndsAt")
		state.ObjectiveText = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveText")
		state.ObjectiveProgress = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveProgress")
		state.ObjectiveTarget = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveTarget")
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveCompleted") == true
		updateEvent(state)
	end)
end

			if remaining <= 0 then banner.Visible = false end
		end
	end
end)

		redrawAccessories()
	end
end)
local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
if accessories then
	for _, value in accessories:GetChildren() do value.Changed:Connect(redrawAccessories) end
end
refreshSelectedPet()
redrawAccessories()

--!strict
-- ClientInit.luau
-- Client-side initialization for all new systems

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

-- Load client modules
local CameraEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CameraEffects)
local ScreenEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ScreenEffects)
local VFXEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.VFXEffects)
local AudioEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AudioEffects)
local EffectSequence = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EffectSequence)
local NotificationSystem = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NotificationSystem)
local TalentEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine)
local AuctionEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AuctionEngine)
local LeaderboardEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.LeaderboardEngine)
local EmoteEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EmoteEngine)

-- UI Components
local ToastStack = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIComponents.ToastStack)
local Banner = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIComponents.Banner)
local Modal = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIComponents.Modal)
local Chart = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIComponents.Chart)
local EmoteWheel = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIComponents.EmoteWheel)
local TalentPanel = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIComponents.TalentPanel)

-- ============================================
-- INITIALIZE UI SYSTEMS
-- ============================================

local toastStack = ToastStack.new()
local banner = Banner.new()
local modal = Modal.new()

-- Global access for other scripts (using _G for standard Roblox compatibility)
_G.ToastStack = toastStack
_G.Banner = banner
_G.Modal = modal
_G.CameraEffects = CameraEffects
_G.ScreenEffects = ScreenEffects
_G.VFXEffects = VFXEffects
_G.AudioEffects = AudioEffects
_G.EffectSequence = EffectSequence

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE WHEEL
-- ============================================

local emoteWheel = EmoteWheel.new()

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
		emoteWheel:Toggle()
	end
end)

-- ============================================
-- EFFECT TRIGGER HANDLER
-- ============================================

Remotes.Effect_Trigger.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(effectName, position, intensity, params)
	-- Camera effects
	if CameraEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		CameraEffects.Presets[effectName]()
	elseif effectName == "Shake" then
		CameraEffects.Shake(nil, intensity and {intensity = intensity, duration = 0.3, frequency = 30})
	elseif effectName == "PunchZoom" then
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(intensity or 10, 0.3)
	end

	-- Screen effects
	if ScreenEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		ScreenEffects.Presets[effectName]()
	elseif effectName == "Flash" then
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.1)
	elseif effectName == "ChromaticAberration" then
		ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(intensity or 1, 0.5)
	end

	-- VFX
	if VFXEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		VFXEffects.Presets[effectName](position)
	end

	-- Audio
	if AudioEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		AudioEffects.PlayPreset(effectName, position)
	end
end)

-- ============================================
- NOTIFICATION SYSTEM SETUP
-- ============================================

-- Request settings from server
Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings:FireServer()

Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(settings)
	for k, v in settings do
		NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings({[k] = v})
	end
end)

-- Listen for notification events from server
Remotes.Notification_SendToClient.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
end)

-- ============================================
- EMOTE CHAT HANDLING
-- ============================================

-- Handle chat messages for emote triggers
if game:GetService("TextChatService").ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
	game:GetService("TextChatService").MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
		if message.TextSource then
			local playerId = message.TextSource.UserId
			if playerId == player.UserId then
				EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(playerId, message.Text)
			end
		end
	else
		-- Legacy chat
		Players.PlayerChatted:Connect(function(message, recipient)
			EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(message, player.UserId)
		end)
	end
end

-- ============================================
- TALENT PANEL INTEGRATION
-- ============================================

local talentPanel = TalentPanel.new()

-- Hook into pet interaction to show talent panel
Remotes.PetInteractionFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if data.action == "TalentPanel" and data.petData then
		talentPanel.Open(data.petData)
	end
end)

-- ============================================
- AUCTION HOUSE UI HOOKS
-- ============================================

-- These would be called from your AuctionHouse UI
_G.AuctionClient = {
	PlaceBuyOrder = function(itemId, maxPrice, quantity, durationHours)
		return Remotes.Auction_PlaceBuyOrder:InvokeServer(itemId, maxPrice, quantity, durationHours)
	end,
	CancelBuyOrder = function(orderId)
		return Remotes.Auction_CancelBuyOrder:InvokeServer(orderId)
	end,
	GetHistory = function(itemId, bucketType, from, to)
		return Remotes.Auction_GetHistory:InvokeServer(itemId, bucketType, from, to)
	end,
	GetListings = function(itemId)
		return Remotes.Auction_GetListings:InvokeServer(itemId)
	end,
	CreateListing = function(itemId, price, quantity, duration)
		return Remotes.Auction_CreateListing:InvokeServer(itemId, price, quantity, duration)
	end,
	GetWatchlist = function()
		return Remotes.Auction_GetWatchlist:InvokeServer()
	end,
	AddWatchlist = function(itemId)
		Remotes.Auction_AddWatchlist:FireServer(itemId)
	end,
	RemoveWatchlist = function(itemId)
		Remotes.Auction_RemoveWatchlist:FireServer(itemId)
	end,
	SetSnipingThreshold = function(itemId, threshold)
		Remotes.Auction_SetSnipingThreshold:FireServer(itemId, threshold)
	end,
}

-- ============================================
- LEADERBOARD UI HOOKS
-- ============================================

_G.LeaderboardClient = {
	GetLeaderboard = function(categoryId, limit)
		return Remotes.Leaderboard_GetLeaderboard:InvokeServer(categoryId, limit)
	end,
	GetPlayerRank = function(categoryId)
		return Remotes.Leaderboard_GetPlayerRank:InvokeServer(categoryId)
	end,
	GetSeasonSnapshot = function(seasonId, categoryId)
		return Remotes.Leaderboard_GetSeasonSnapshot:InvokeServer(seasonId, categoryId)
	end,
	ClaimReward = function(seasonId, categoryId)
		return Remotes.Leaderboard_ClaimReward:InvokeServer(seasonId, categoryId)
	end,
	GetPendingRewards = function()
		return Remotes.Leaderboard_GetPendingRewards:InvokeServer()
	end,
}

-- ============================================
- EMOTE CLIENT
-- ============================================

_G.EmoteClient = {
	GetOwned = function()
		return Remotes.Emote_GetOwned:InvokeServer()
	end,
	GetEquipped = function()
		return Remotes.Emote_GetEquipped:InvokeServer()
	end,
	SetEquipped = function(emoteId)
		return Remotes.Emote_SetEquipped:InvokeServer(emoteId)
	end,
	Trigger = function(emoteId)
		return Remotes.Emote_Trigger:InvokeServer(emoteId)
	end,
	OpenWheel = function() emoteWheel:Open() end,
	CloseWheel = function() emoteWheel:Close() end,
}

-- ============================================
- TALENT PANEL CLIENT
-- ============================================

_G.TalentClient = {
	Open = function(petData) talentPanel.Open(petData) end,
	Close = function() talentPanel.Close() end,
	Reroll = function(petId, slotIndex) return Remotes.Pet_RerollTalent:InvokeServer(petId, slotIndex) end,
	Lock = function(petId, slotIndex, lock) return Remotes.Pet_LockTalent:InvokeServer(petId, slotIndex, lock) end,
	GetTalents = function(petId) return Remotes.Pet_GetTalents:InvokeServer(petId) end,
}

-- ============================================
- SETTINGS SYNC
-- ============================================

Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(settings)
	for k, v in settings do
		NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings({[k] = v})
	end
end)

-- Sync settings to server when changed
local originalUpdateSettings = NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings
NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings = function(newSettings)
	originalUpdateSettings(newSettings)
	Remotes.Notification_UpdateSettings:FireServer(newSettings)
end

-- ============================================
- ACCESSIBILITY SETTINGS
-- ============================================

local accessibilitySettings = {
	reducedMotion = false,
	reducedFlash = false,
	effectIntensity = 1.0,
}

_G.SetAccessibilitySetting = function(key, value)
	accessibilitySettings[key] = value

	-- Apply to effect systems
	if key == "reducedMotion" then
		CameraEffects.StopAll()
		ScreenEffects.StopAll()
	end
end

_G.GetAccessibilitySettings = function()
	return accessibilitySettings
end

-- ============================================
- CLEANUP ON RESPAWN
-- ============================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	-- Re-initialize any character-dependent effects
	task.wait(1)

--!strict
-- LeaderboardEngine.lua
-- Seasonal leaderboards with snapshots, ranks, and rewards

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LeaderboardEngine = {}
LeaderboardEngine.__index = LeaderboardEngine

-- DataStores
local SEASON_STORE = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("SeasonLeaderboards")
local SNAPSHOT_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonSnapshots")
local REWARDS_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonRewards")

-- Cached configuration from Seasons.json
local SEASON_CONFIG_CACHE = nil
local function LoadSeasonConfig()
	if SEASON_CONFIG_CACHE then return SEASON_CONFIG_CACHE end
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local configJson = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("Seasons.json")
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(configJson.Source)
	end)
	if success and result then
		SEASON_CONFIG_CACHE = result
		return result
	end
	-- Fallback to default config
	return {
		seasons = {},
		categories = DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
		rewards = {
			weekly = WEEKLY_REWARDS,
			monthly = MONTHLY_REWARDS
		},
		participationMinimums = {
			weekly = 100,
			monthly = 1000
		}
	}
end

-- Messaging
local TOPICS = {
	SeasonReset = "Leaderboard_SeasonReset",
	RewardClaimed = "Leaderboard_RewardClaimed",
	ScoreUpdate = "Leaderboard_ScoreUpdate",
}

-- ============================================
-- SEASON CONFIGURATION
-- ============================================

export type SeasonConfig = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	type: "weekly" | "monthly",
	startTime: number,
	endTime: number,
	categories: {SeasonCategory},
	rewards: {[string]: SeasonRewards}, -- tier -> rewards
}

export type SeasonCategory = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	metric: string, -- DataStore key for scoring
	weight: number, -- for tiebreaking
}

export type SeasonRewards = {
	-- tier: "top1" | "top3" | "top10" | "top25" | "top50" | "participation"
	gems: number,
	title: string?,
	titleDuration: number?, -- seconds
	petId: string?,
	auraId: string?,
	trailId: string?,
	badgeId: string?,
	cosmeticCrate: string?,
}

-- Default season configuration
local DEFAULT_CATEGORIES: {SeasonCategory} = {
	{id = "clicks", name = "Click Master", metric = "total_clicks", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "hatches", name = "Hatch Champion", metric = "eggs_hatched", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "gold", name = "Gold Tycoon", metric = "gold_earned", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "collection", name = "Pet Collector", metric = "unique_pets", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "combat", name = "Combat Veteran", metric = "enemies_defeated", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "trading", name = "Trade Baron", metric = "trade_volume", weight = 1.0},
}

local WEEKLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 50000, title = "Weekly Champion", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "golden_egg", auraId = "golden_glow"},
	top3 = {gems = 20000, title = "Silver Contender", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "silver_egg"},
	top10 = {gems = 10000, title = "Bronze Challenger", titleDuration = 604800},
	top25 = {gems = 5000},
	top50 = {gems = 2000},
	participation = {gems = 500},
}

local MONTHLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 200000, title = "Monthly Legend", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "legendary_exclusive", auraId = "legendary_aura", trailId = "cosmic_trail"},
	top3 = {gems = 100000, title = "Monthly Elite", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "epic_exclusive", trailId = "elite_trail"},
	top10 = {gems = 50000, title = "Monthly Rising Star", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "rare_exclusive"},
	top25 = {gems = 20000, cosmeticCrate = "monthly_elite_crate"},
	top50 = {gems = 10000},
	participation = {gems = 5000},
}

-- Active season state
local currentSeason: {config: any, active: boolean} = {active = false}
local categoryScores = {} -- [categoryId][playerId] = score

-- ============================================
-- SEASON MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetCurrentSeason(): {config: any, active: boolean}?
	return currentSeason.active and currentSeason or nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetTimeRemaining(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, currentSeason.config.endTime - os.time())
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonProgress(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	local elapsed = os.time() - currentSeason.config.startTime
	local total = currentSeason.config.endTime - currentSeason.config.startTime
	return math.clamp(elapsed / total, 0, 1)
end

function LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason(config: {type: string, categories: {SeasonCategory}?, rewards: any?})
	local now = os.time()
	local duration = config.type == "monthly" and 2592000 or 604800
	
	local configData = LoadSeasonConfig()
	local seasonConfig = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		name = config.type .. "_season_" .. os.date("%Y_%m_%d", now),
		type = config.type,
		startTime = now,
		endTime = now + duration,
		categories = config.categories or configData.categories,
		rewards = config.rewards or configData.rewards[config.type] or (config.type == "monthly" and configData.rewards.monthly or configData.rewards.weekly),
	}
	
	currentSeason = {config = seasonConfig, active = true}
	categoryScores = {}
	
	-- Initialize category scores
	for _, cat in seasonConfig.categories do
		categoryScores[cat.id] = {}
	end
	
	-- Schedule reset
	task.delay(duration, function()
		LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	end)
	
	-- Broadcast season start
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonStart", {
			seasonId = seasonConfig.id,
			type = seasonConfig.type,
			endTime = seasonConfig.endTime,
			categories = seasonConfig.categories,
		})
	end
	
	return seasonConfig
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	local seasonId = currentSeason.config.id
	
	-- Snapshot all category scores
	for catId, scores in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local data = {}
		
		-- Convert to array of {playerId, score}
		local entries = {}
		for playerId, score in scores do
			table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
		end
		
		-- Sort by score descending
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
		
		-- Store top 10000
		local topEntries = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(10000, #entries) do
			table.insert(topEntries, entries[i])
		end
		
		-- Save snapshot
		local success = pcall(function()
			SNAPSHOT_STORE:SetAsync(snapshotKey, topEntries)
		end)
		
		if not success then
			warn("LeaderboardEngine: Failed to save snapshot for " .. catId)
		end
	end
	
	-- Calculate and queue rewards
	LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId)
	
	-- Broadcast reset
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonReset", {
			seasonId = seasonId,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		})
	end
	
	-- Clear scores
	categoryScores = {}
	currentSeason.active = false
end

function LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId: string)
	local config = currentSeason.config
	if not config then return end
	
	local configData = LoadSeasonConfig()
	local participationMinimums = configData.participationMinimums[config.type] or 0
	
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local success, snapshot = pcall(function()
			return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
		end)
		
		if not success or not snapshot then continue end
		
		-- Determine tier cutoffs
		local total = #snapshot
		local cutoffs = {
			top1 = math.ceil(total * 0.01),
			top3 = math.ceil(total * 0.03),
			top10 = math.ceil(total * 0.10),
			top25 = math.ceil(total * 0.25),
			top50 = math.ceil(total * 0.50),
		}
		
		for rank, entry in ipairs(snapshot) do
			local tier = "participation"
			if rank <= cutoffs.top1 then tier = "top1"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top3 then tier = "top3"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top10 then tier = "top10"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top25 then tier = "top25"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top50 then tier = "top50"
			end
			
			-- Check participation minimum
			if tier == "participation" then
				if entry.score < participationMinimums then
					-- Skip this player for participation reward in this category
					continue
				end
			end
			
			local rewards = config.rewards[tier] or config.rewards.participation
			
			-- Queue reward for player
			local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. entry.playerId
			local rewardData = {
				seasonId = seasonId,
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				tier = tier,
				rewards = rewards,
				claimed = false,
				timestamp = os.time(),
			}
			
			pcall(function()
				REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
					if old then return old end -- Don't overwrite
					return rewardData
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- SCORING
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.AddScore(playerId: number, metric: string, amount: number)
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	-- Find category for this metric
	local categoryId = nil
	for _, cat in currentSeason.config.categories do
		if cat.metric == metric then
			categoryId = cat.id
			break
		end
	end
	
	if not categoryId then return end
	
	if not categoryScores[categoryId] then
		categoryScores[categoryId] = {}
	end
	
	categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] = (categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0) + amount
	
	-- Broadcast update (throttled)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ScoreUpdate, {
			playerId = playerId,
			category = categoryId,
			newScore = categoryScores[categoryId][playerId],
			delta = amount,
		})
	end
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetScore(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number
	return categoryScores[categoryId] and categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetAllScores(categoryId: string): {playerId: number}
	return categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- LEADERBOARD QUERIES
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId: string, limit: number?): {{rank: number, playerId: number, score: number}}
	local scores = categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
	local limit = limit or 100
	
	local entries = {}
	for playerId, score in scores do
		table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
	end
	
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		if a.score ~= b.score then return a.score > b.score end
		return a.playerId < b.playerId
	end)
	
	local results = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(limit, #entries) do
		table.insert(results, {rank = i, playerId = entries[i].playerId, score = entries[i].score})
	end
	
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number?
	local leaderboard = LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId, 10000)
	for _, entry in leaderboard do
		if entry.playerId == playerId then
			return entry.rank
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerSnapshot(playerId: number): {category: string, rank: number, score: number}
	local result = {}
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local rank = LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId, catId)
		if rank then
			table.insert(result, {
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				score = categoryScores[catId][playerId] or 0,
			})
		end
	end
	return result
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonSnapshot(seasonId: string, categoryId: string): {{playerId: number, score: number}}
	local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. categoryId
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
	end)
	return success and data or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- REWARDS
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPendingRewards(playerId: number): {{seasonId: string, category: string, rank: number, tier: string, rewards: any, claimed: boolean}}
	-- TODO: Implement proper pending rewards lookup with season index
	-- For now, return empty array
	return {}
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ClaimReward(playerId: number, seasonId: string, categoryId: string): (boolean, any?)
	local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. playerId
	local success, rewardData = pcall(function()
		return REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
			if not old or old.claimed then return old end
			old.claimed = true
			return old
		end)
	end
	
	if success and rewardData and not rewardData.claimed then
		return true, rewardData.rewards
	end
	return false, nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonHistory(limit: number?): {{seasonId: string, type: string, startTime: number, endTime: number}}
	-- Would query snapshot store for season history
	return {}
end

-- ============================================
-- ANTI-CHEAT
-- ============================================

local scoreHistory = {} -- [playerId][category] = {timestamp, delta}

function LeaderboardEngine.ValidateScoreDelta(playerId: number, categoryId: string, delta: number): boolean
	if delta <= 0 then return false end
	if delta > 10000 then return false end -- Sanity cap
	
	local history = scoreHistory[playerId] and scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] or {}
	table.insert(history, {time = os.time(), delta = delta})
	
	-- Keep last 100 entries
	if #history > 100 then table.remove(history, 1) end
	
	if not scoreHistory[playerId] then scoreHistory[playerId] = {} end
	scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] = history
	
	-- Check rate: max 1000 per minute
	local recent = 0
	local now = os.time()
	for _, entry in history do
		if now - entry.time < 60 then
			recent += entry.delta
		end
	end
	
	if recent > 10000 then
		-- Flag for review
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
				playerId = playerId,
				category = categoryId,
				recentScore = recent,
				reason = "Excessive score rate",
			})
		end
		return false
	end
	
	-- Statistical outlier detection (simplified)
	if #history > 20 then
		local sum = 0
		for _, e in history do sum += e.delta end
		local avg = sum / #history
		local variance = 0
		for _, e in history do variance += (e.delta - avg)^2 end
		local stdDev = math.sqrt(variance / #history)
		
		if delta > avg + 4 * stdDev then
			-- Flag as outlier
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
					playerId = playerId,
					category = categoryId,
					delta = delta,
					avg = avg,
					stdDev = stdDev,
					reason = "Statistical outlier",
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

-- ============================================
-- INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-start weekly season on Mondays
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local now = os.time()
			local nextMonday = now + ((1 - os.date("*t", now).wday) % 7) * 86400
			if nextMonday <= now then nextMonday += 604800 end
			local waitTime = nextMonday - now
			
			task.wait(waitTime)
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "weekly"})
			
			-- Monthly on 1st
			task.wait(2592000 - 604800) -- ~3 weeks
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "monthly"})
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardEngine

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ORB_RADIUS = 3
local ORB_SPEED = 2

local function createOrb(character: Model)
	local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart

	local orb = Instance.new("Part")
	orb.Name = "FlyingOrb"
	orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	orb.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
	orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
	orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	orb.Anchored = true
	orb.CanCollide = false
	orb.Parent = character

	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = rootPart

	local angle = 0
	task.spawn(function()
		while orb and orb.Parent do
			angle += 0.05
			local x = math.cos(angle) * ORB_RADIUS
			local z = math.sin(angle) * ORB_RADIUS
			orb.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, 1, z)
			task.wait(1 / 60)
		end
	end)
end

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Ensure Remotes folder and ToggleFly RemoteEvent exist
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") :: Folder
if not remotesFolder then
	remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotesFolder.Name = "Remotes"
	remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local toggleFlyEvent = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("ToggleFly") :: RemoteEvent
if not toggleFlyEvent then
	toggleFlyEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	toggleFlyEvent.Name = "ToggleFly"
	toggleFlyEvent.Parent = remotesFolder
end

-- Keep track of flying players
local flyingPlayers: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

local function setFlying(player: Player, state: boolean)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?

	if not humanoid or not rootPart then return end

	flyingPlayers[player] = state
	character:SetAttribute("IsFlying", state)

	if state then
		-- Server-side setup for flight physics
		-- We use an Attachment and LinearVelocity for modern physics
		local attachment = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlightAttachment") :: Attachment?
		if not attachment then
			attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attachment.Name = "FlightAttachment"
			attachment.Parent = rootPart
		end

		local linearVelocity = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlightVelocity") :: LinearVelocity?
		if not linearVelocity then
			linearVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
			linearVelocity.Name = "FlightVelocity"
			linearVelocity.Attachment0 = attachment
			linearVelocity.MaxForce = 500000 -- High force to overcome gravity
			linearVelocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
			linearVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
			linearVelocity.Parent = rootPart
		end

		local alignOrientation = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlightOrientation") :: AlignOrientation?
		if not alignOrientation then
			alignOrientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
			alignOrientation.Name = "FlightOrientation"
			alignOrientation.Attachment0 = attachment
			alignOrientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationMode.OneAttachment
			alignOrientation.MaxTorque = 500000
			alignOrientation.Responsiveness = 200
			alignOrientation.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
			alignOrientation.Parent = rootPart
		end

		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	else
		-- Clean up flight instances
		local attachment = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlightAttachment")
		if attachment then attachment:Destroy() end

		local linearVelocity = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlightVelocity")
		if linearVelocity then linearVelocity:Destroy() end

		local alignOrientation = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlightOrientation")
		if alignOrientation then alignOrientation:Destroy() end

		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
	end
end

toggleFlyEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local currentState = character:GetAttribute("IsFlying") == true
	setFlying(player, not currentState)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	flyingPlayers[player] = nil
end)

--!strict
-- EffectSequence.lua
-- Composable effect chains for complex multi-stage visual sequences

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local EffectSequence = {}
EffectSequence.__index = EffectSequence

type EffectStep = {
	type: "wait" | "function" | "tween" | "parallel",
	duration: number?,
	callback: (() -> ())?,
	tweenInfo: TweenInfo?,
	target: Instance?,
	properties: {[string]: any}?,
	children: {EffectStep}?
}

function EffectSequence.new()
	local self = setmetatable({}, EffectSequence)
	self.steps = {}
	self.running = false
	self.cancelled = false
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Wait(duration: number)
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "wait", duration = duration})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Call(callback: () -> ())
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "function", callback = callback})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Tween(target: Instance, tweenInfo: TweenInfo, properties: {[string]: any})
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "tween", target = target, tweenInfo = tweenInfo, properties = properties})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Parallel(children: {EffectStep})
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "parallel", children = children})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Then(callback: () -> ())
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "function", callback = callback})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Play()
	if self.running then return end
	self.running = true
	self.cancelled = false
	
	task.spawn(function()
		for _, step in self.steps do
			if self.cancelled then break end
			
			if step.type == "wait" then
				task.wait(step.duration or 0)
				
			elseif step.type == "function" then
				if step.callback then
					step.callback()
				end
				
			elseif step.type == "tween" then
				if step.target and step.tweenInfo and step.properties then
					local tween = TweenService:Create(step.target, step.tweenInfo, step.properties)
					tween:Play()
					tween.Completed:Wait()
				end
				
			elseif step.type == "parallel" then
				local threads = {}
				for _, child in step.children or {} do
					table.insert(threads, task.spawn(function()
						-- Execute child step inline
						if child.type == "wait" then
							task.wait(child.duration or 0)
						elseif child.type == "function" then
							if child.callback then child.callback() end
						elseif child.type == "tween" then
							if child.target and child.tweenInfo and child.properties then
								local tween = TweenService:Create(child.target, child.tweenInfo, child.properties)
								tween:Play()
								tween.Completed:Wait()
							end
						end
					end))
				end
				for _, thread in threads do
					task.wait() -- yield to let all start
				end
				-- Wait for all to complete (simplified)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
		self.running = false
	end)
end

function EffectSequence:Cancel()
	self.cancelled = true
	self.running = false
end

-- Builder helpers
function EffectSequence.Sequence()
	return EffectSequence.new()
end

function EffectSequence.Chain(...)
	local seq = EffectSequence.new()
	for _, fn in {...} do
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			fn(seq)
		end
	end
	return seq
end

return EffectSequence
