--!strict
-- Banner.lua
-- Full-width banner notifications for high-priority alerts

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Banner = {}
Banner.__index = Banner

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	animationDuration = 0.4,
	position = "top-center",
	autoDismiss = true,
}

function Banner.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Banner)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.activeBanners = {}
	self:_createContainer()
	return self
end

function Banner:_createContainer()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "BannerSystem"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 210
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = gui

	self.container = container
	self.gui = gui
end

function Banner:Show(data)
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	data.autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss or 10

	local banner = self:_createBanner(data)
	banner.Parent = self.container
	table.insert(self.activeBanners, {id = data.id, frame = banner})

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return data.id
end

function Banner:_createBanner(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Banner_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = 10

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = data.strokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.ZIndex = 11
	icon.Parent = frame

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 28)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 12)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 18
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.ZIndex = 11
	title.Parent = frame

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 40)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 14
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.ZIndex = 11
	body.Parent = frame

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 24)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 14
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = 11
	closeBtn.Parent = frame

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)

	-- Entrance animation
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -100)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return frame
end

function Banner:Dismiss(id)
	for i, banner in ipairs(self.activeBanners) do
		if banner.id == id then
			local frame = banner.frame
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -100),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.3)
			frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.activeBanners, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function Banner:Clear()
	for _, banner in self.activeBanners do
		banner.frame:Destroy()
	end
	self.activeBanners = {}
end

function Banner:Destroy()
	self:Clear()
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return Banner

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SavingFunctions = {}

SavingFunctions.SaveData = function(Player, AutoSave)
	local Folder = Player.Data
		
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") == nil or Player.Loaded.Value == false then
		return
	end
	
	Player.Loaded.Value = false
	
	local Save = {}
		
	for FolderName,FolderInfo in require(script.Parent.Values).SaveValues do
		Save[FolderName] = {}
		
		for _,Info in FolderInfo do
			Save[FolderName][Info.ID] = Folder[FolderName][Info.Name].Value
		end
	end
	
	Save["Pets"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Save["Pets"][tonumber(Pet.Name)] = {
			PetName = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
end
	
	Save["AutoDelete"] = {}
	for _,Pet in Folder.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Value then
			Save["AutoDelete"][Pet.Name] = true
		end
	end
	
	if AutoSave then
		Save.SessionId = game.JobId
		Save.LastInGame = os.time()
	end
	
	local suc,er = pcall(function()
		DS:GetDataStore(RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value):SetAsync(Player.UserId, Save)
	end)
	
	if er then warn("error with saving data for "..Player.Name.." : "..er) end
end

return SavingFunctions

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

local module = {}

function module.Create(TextLabel, Text)
	local TextLength = string.len(Text)
	
	TextLabel.Text = Text
	TextLabel.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0 -- Characters Visible
	
	repeat 
		task.wait(0.03) 
		TextLabel.MaxVisibleGraphemes += 1
	until
		TextLabel.MaxVisibleGraphemes == TextLength
end

return module

--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local systemFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DayNightSystem")
local toggleCycle = systemFolder:WaitForChild("ToggleCycle") :: RemoteEvent

local DAY_LENGTH_MINUTES = 12
local START_TIME = 8
local cycleEnabled = true
local currentClockTime = START_TIME

systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime

local function setCycleEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	cycleEnabled = enabled
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

toggleCycle.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, requestedState: boolean?)
	if typeof(requestedState) == "boolean" then
		setCycleEnabled(requestedState)
	else
		setCycleEnabled(not cycleEnabled)
	end
	print(string.format("[DayNightSystem] %s set cycle %s", player.Name, cycleEnabled and "On" or "Off"))
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
	if not cycleEnabled then
		return
	end

	currentClockTime = (currentClockTime + (24 / (DAY_LENGTH_MINUTES * 60)) * deltaTime) % 24
	Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
end)

print("[DayNightSystem] Dynamic day/night cycle started")
